summary: A growing, lengthening shaft of light, that appeared to be going up in the sky (as opposed to the way a meteor moves).
description:
Husband and wife out walking the dog at 6:24pm on 12/19/23. Avid skywatchers, we were looking up at the clear sky, when we spotted a smallish light in the western sky that looked “different”. We watched it lengthen - to give an idea of its width, from our perspective, it looked like a short pencil line. It looked almost like an ASCENDING fireball - definitely going up, not down! It appeared to be at the same altitude as planes flying overhead - 30,000 - 40,000 feet. Both have experience as trained observers, and after decades of sky watching, have not seen anything like this before. Checked flight app on phone, nothing. Checked with Starlink launches, etc., and that didn’t appear to fit either, although there was a Starlink launch the night before, in Cape Canaveral (2000 miles south of us). Having seen Starlink in the past, it looked nothing like that to us. AND, Starlink didn’t just “disappear” the way this one did.
Unfortunately, being nighttime, the video doesn’t give a good perspective for the viewer to judge distance, altitude, etc.. The surrounding land is wooded and sparsely populated. After zooming in a few seconds into the video, we attempted to keep the camera as steady…

summary: Changing Lights, odd directional changes
description: The object flying headed from West to East at a fairly slow pace, there were two white/yellow blinking lights close together flashing at the same time. The object suddenly shifted very slowly to the South and went a little further before one light went out, the other dimmed and the object stopped. It then sat for about one minute before it slowly turned back to the West and that light dimmed even further. I looked down to send a message to a friend about it and then when I looked back up no lights were further visible and it was nowhere in sight. It was too windy and early in the morning for me to think it was a drone, but seemed smaller than a regular air craft. It didn’t look to be that far away but it was dark and difficult to get a shape on it. It flew flat, not ascending or descending. My son watched it fly with me but we couldn’t figure out what it was.

summary: Viewer was driving home from work. Saw "3 balls of light" that fell amazingly fast towards the ground. Sighting lasted <5 seconds.
description:
I'm submitting this report on behalf of a friend. We'll call him M for the sake of privacy. This happened at around 11:15 p.m. on road 156 traveling west, leaving Waterloo IL and driving towards Valmeyer IL.
M was just outside the city limits of Waterloo, and his sighting was brief. He describes "looking at the moon" on the way back from work when all of a sudden 3 "balls of light" in a trianglular formation caught his eye off to his right, so that would be rougly due north/north-west based off of his direction of travel.
He reports the lights "fell" from roughly 200-250 (rough approximation) feet down to the ground with baffling speed. Faster than anything should be able to fall, or fly, for that matter. The entire sighting lasted less than 5 seconds. He was driving and did not stop to see what happened to the lights once they reached the ground, or near ground level. According to him, they did not illuminate the ground, houses, or trees that he could see.
As for personal notes, he assures me he is positive it wasn't any mistaken reflection, his eyes playing tricks on him, or a case of mistaken lights, like that of a street light, radio tower, or any known craft, including…

summary: 5 or 6 linked orbs descending
description:
I was sitting on the balcony of a 3rd story apartment, watching stars and planes.
I noticed some gentle movement in my peripheral. I had to focus a bit on what I was seeing. Five to six round, equally sized orbs/circles were gently descending. Their movement seemed gradual. They seemed almost transparent at first, and I struggled to trust whether I was seeing anything at all. Perhaps a slight grey outline to each orb. They almost reminded me of a necklace in that they seemed to be unified in the way they were moving. As I saw it, the space between each was less than the size of one orb. And I the space in between seemed to be closing as they descended. The ends of the “necklace” were wiggling the most. The formation passed out of view, blocked by my roof. It felt that they had passed over my three-story apartment. If so, these were small orbs, perhaps less than five feet in diameter. But perhaps my depth perception was off.
It took me perhaps a minute to stand up and move so that I could peer into the direction they went. I had felt fear.
I also want to be upfront that I have been reading a lot about UFOs and feel that I am perhaps in a suggest-able state.

summary: A huge see-through dark object appeared in one of my photos during an all-night time lapse I was doing.
description: I captured this in Flagstaff AZ near the peaks at 8000' elevation while doing a time lapse to capture Geminid meteors. I was there from 4pm 12-14 until 8am the next morning 12 -15. My camera was set to capture a photo every second (25 second exposures.) I was in my van sleeping when this happened. I only saw what I captured today after going through the images. I have taken tens of thousands of images of the night sky the past 8 years and have never caught anything like this before. Nothing like this appeared in any of the hundreds of images that I took on this night nor has it appeared before or since. The camera was near my van, and my dog in the van would have started barking if anything came near the camera or my van, and I also would have heard something. I have no explanation of what this was. Strangely, I saw or heard no animals on this night, and also not another human soul was seen the entire night. It was oddly dead silent. I have come here hundreds of times the past 10 years, and this was the first time that I captured this.

summary: 4-5 orange solid lights arranged in a triangle shape
description: 4-5 solid orange lights in a triangle shaped pattern observed during a training flight by PIC. The lights appeared to be situated on one airborne craft. The lights observed were not consistent with standard aircraft lighting, space dwelling objects (such as stars and systems), or normal weather phenomena. Observation aircraft altitude 2,500ft; observed unidentified object/aircraft altitude unknown, estimated to be between 4,000-5,000ft. Unidentified object/aircraft was approximately 3-4 NM offshore, and was only observed briefly before vanishing. No movement of the object was observed. No ADSB data received from the object. Sky was clear with no clouds or visible moisture present. Object was observed by airplane CFI during a training flight. The student on board was wearing a vision limiting device preventing them from seeing outside as a training measure. As a result, the student did not witness the unidentified object.

summary: Light was observed, likely stationary then it just extinguished and disappeared
description: I was a passenger with my wife traveling by car to see "The Christmas House" in Inman, SC on Dec 14. I am a retired 29 year Navy vet with heavy aviation background. It was just before official twilight time. As we were heading North on Compton Bridge Rd I noticed off to my right at about 030, my 1330 o'clock relative position, a single light in the sky and roughly 15 degrees above the horizon. Being a licensed pilot and having spent much time flying and in and around airplanes and airports I thought it was just a aircraft landing light and likely heading to either GSP or GMU airports near Greenville, SC. I didn't give it much thought but glanced at it every 20-30 seconds expecting it to likely cross my path overhead. It didn't seem to be changing position or getting any closer after a few minutes so I started to think that it might be further away than I had thought it to be and coming straight at me. I started to watch it for longer periods of time to try and determine a relative motion. I also noticed that the "landing" light appeared to be larger than a normal general aviation aircraft landing light would look like at night from 10-15 miles out. I looked away for a couple of…

summary: AM sighting of a bright intense light that was hovering over tree line and a PM sighting with 2 crafts of the same "look".
description:
Around 7AM on Dec 13th, I was on the front porch of my home and saw an extremely intense light above the tree line on the hole of the golf course that my house is situated on. The trees are roughly 500-750 ft from my front porch viewpoint. It was hovering left and right with periods of standstill.
It was difficult for me to gauge the elevation of the object but it appeared lower than a plane in the sky at the time. Also of note is that there were no visible stars in that field of view, or in my periphery. The only stars faintly visible were directly above my head. With regard to directional positioning, it was just a tad west of the rising sun, but not by much, and was lower than the sun in my field of vision. It caught my eye as it was so intensely bright. It was very mesmerizing. And as it got my attention, I noticed it was periodically emitting a blue light, almost like a beam but more of a tentacle appearance than a typical “linear” laser we think of. The object was relatively stable and hard to get an idea of the exact shape because the light was so bright. However, it looked almost like a pyramid in nature. But would hover around in a small vicinity without much perceived…

summary: Lights appearing and disappearing
description: I looked up and saw 3 dim lights moving slowly from west to east. They looked to be at very high altitude, possibly in orbit. They appeared to jump across the sky but followed a straight line across the sky. I suspect these may be starlink assets. But then a much brighter light yellow light appeard. This light appeared traveling much faster than the other 3 on a north south trajectory, slowed to a stop, and disappeared at the line of wher the first 3 lights had been. The first 3 dim lights were still moving away to the east. A few seconds later, another light appeared, moving in fast from the south. This light was brighter than the first 3, but less bright than the yellow one. This light was dim white, and again appeared moving fast. It instantly slowed to around the speed of the first 3 lights. It went past the line of the first 3 lights, but turned, and slowly curved around to come back to the line of the first 3. It the turned to follow the path of the first 3 lights (the first 3 were now almost out of sight and eventually faded out of view around The Pleiades), this 5th light then also disappeared on the line of the first 3.

summary: Driving up Raleigh road turning right. Right on to Zack's mill road. We saw what look like the planet Saturn. In front of our vehicle.

And it was extremely bright and all of a sudden. It just disappeared. We pulled into a neighborhood after it disappeared to see if we could spot it again and it was just gone.I still don't know. What it is we saw but it was a unidentified flying object! We searched the sky after pulling into the neighborhood and saw 2 planes off in the distance. Not near where the sighting was and they looked nothing like what we saw and there was nothing else in the sky. It was a blue sky and whatever we saw was gone. There was nothing!

summary: Three white lights behind the clouds in triangular formation zipping around in random order

What I mean is if each orb was A, B, and C, it looked as if A would whizz to position B, B would whizz to position C, and C would whizz to position A. This continued for 2-3 rounds before disappearing. I saw it for a 45 seconds in complete disbelief. Once they disappeared I parked my scooter and went inside my apartment building. This was about 20 minutes ago and I am only now processing the event. I fully believe this could be a UFO.

summary: Fast moving object with glittering trail

Approximate Time: 20:15-20:25 (UTC-5:00) EST
Direction of Travel: Northeasterly to Southeasterly
Approximate Length of Sighting: 12 seconds
Viewers: Myself and my wife once I got her attention towards it
Facing the eastern sky from my driveway as we were getting out of our vehicle coming home from dinner when I noticed a fast moving "glittering" trail of red/white/blue moving from Beta Tauri in the Taurus constellation towards the Orion constellation between Alnitak & Mintaka of Orion's belt and down towards the horizon.
In front of the moving "glittering" trail was something that was not possible to make out. The trail extended out in the sky about what would be a 9in. or 22.86cm length if holding a ruler at arm's length towards the sky, and followed whatever object was moving through the sky. This object and trail moved past the horizon.
I wish I had the time to have pulled out my Galaxy S23 Ultra to try and capture pictures/video of this event but it went too fast and I was too excited to see something new in the sky. I could not find any satellite or Starlink trackers that would show any potential sightings at that time as they only…

summary: Bright, slightly shape shifting orb
description: I was driving home from work and saw what looked light an extremely bright star in the sky. However, it was only 5pm and still bright outside. I noticed it move slightly and began to take pictures. My live picture was setting was on for the first image and I was able to break it down into multiple frames when I got home. I was able to take 3 pictures total before it quickly disappeared. I've never seen anything like it. When I went through the frame-by-frame, there are a few frames where the orb splits into two. I have included the three original images, as well as a screenshot I took of the zoomed in frame-by-frame shot of the split. I watched a report from earlier today in Melbourne FL, and its behavior and appearance looked similar, but closer in terms of distance.

summary: Two red blinking lights that moved down. The lights were stationary and definitely not a plane or helicopter.
Flash then light
description: I brought the dog outside this morning and looking to the southeast around 5:30am, I saw a flash of light that looked like a lightning bolt in a perfectly clear sky. But a well-defined flash of light - a zig zag pattern about 6 inches relative to extending your fingers apart to the sky. After the flash, a bright white, round light traversed the sky heading northwest in a straight line but at different speeds at times. After it passed directly overhead, I saw another dimmer white object moving perpendicular to the first object heading south-southwest. Much fainter than the first, blurry-like. This one moved at a consistent pace. After they were out of view, I went inside and immediately checked online to see if the first object was the International Space Station, but I do not think it was visible this morning in my location. I am just an educator who always looks up at the sky, with or without a telescope. My love for astronomy came after taking an astronomy course in college. And this experience is the first time I have felt compelled to report what I saw.

summary: My son told me there were lights in the sky so I came to look. We saw 9 objects  in the sky that disappeared into the clouds.
description:
My son aged 10 told me he saw lights in the night sky that he’d never seen before. I was in the shower and my wife was working in the other room. I came out and saw these orange lights. I hadn’t seen these lights before either. We called my wife in who also observed them. We watched them until they all floated into the clouds and vanished. My son theorized they were Chinese lanterns. Perhaps they were, but I felt it couldn’t hurt to alert someone to their presence. Thank you so much for taking the time to look into this.
PS I have video but the file size was too large so I put some screen grabs for you to see. There was a screen in front of the camera lens but I opened the screen for the end of the video.

summary: It was like an oval shape but bigger on one side with jagged edges.
description: We saw a bright flash like someone took our picture in the dark. After that we looked up and saw the object. It seemed massive in size. The whole perimeter of the object was illuminated with a white light. Oval shaped but bigger on one side and jagged like a rock. It was not moving across the sky like a satellite or space station. Seemed to be moving away. Hard to tell how high it was? It was definitely higher than airplane traffic at 35,000’.

summary: Greyish disc with two bright white lights one on each side on front circumference and multi colored red green lights
description: I was driving from Ludington MI to visit family on east side of state. I was driving on I-96 heading east just passing Grand Rapids on Friday December 8, 2023 at about 9:00pm. In between Cascade and Lowell Charter Township on north side of highway, a very bright light fell from sky. It then slowed and hovered right by highway on north side. It was a thicker disc shape, grey/silver in color, just hovering, with two very bright white lights on each side on front circumference and multiple multi colored lights around back end of circumference, red, green. The lights from the front illuminated so bright, that you could view around it and there weren’t any wings or segmented parts, just disc shape. Appeared to either be shiny or have windows on the side facing us. My son was sitting behind me and was a witness also. We were so shocked and scared that we couldn’t pick up our phone to take photo right away. I begged my son to please get a video while it was still hovering and I driving away from it. We were about a mile down road by the time he was able to come out of a scared mindset to take the video. You can see it on the upper right side of the video briefly. I was so scared and…

summary: My husband and I saw and took a video of a very large, chevron shaped craft with a straight row of lights across the back center.
description: Tonight, on Dec. 8th, 2023, I saw a large air craft in the sky unlike any I have seen before. I saw it clearly. It was a chevron shaped craft, with a straight row of lights in the back. The lights were a greenish blue. The craft looked like dark gray metal. It was flying on a diagonal in the sky through my neighborhood. I called to my husband to run out and he took a video with his phone. By the time he came out, it was farther away. When I watched the video, the lights were behaving differently on the video than I saw with my naked eyes. This has now confused me a bit because now I can't remember how exactly the lights were behaving, but I noticed it was definitely different on the video than what I had seen. He said maybe it's a helicopter or a drone, but I disagreed and said it was shaped like a bat, and very huge, and I had watched it when it was closer and not so far away when he saw it in the cloudy sky. I drew a quick hand sketch of it when I came inside, and sent it to my friend. She found this sight and sent me back similar images. On this sight, I see the chevron as an option and that's the shape! I posted this on my facebook. Everyone is shocked!

summary: 5 second pulsating light low altitude moving steady and fast
description:
I looked up in the sky and saw a low altitude pulsating light moving very fast then disappearing. It was overcast I could see a few stars and they were fuzzy just as this light was. I can see an airplane above I could see the cell towers from bays mountain.
I have seen all hemispheres of the sky. I have seen the Milky Way in Peru because of no light pollution. I have seen rockets I have seen starlink I have seen falling stars I have seen satellites and space stations. I have seen the helicopters and airplanes and drones and cell towers. I have some meteors and comments and eclipses.
This was none of these things.

summary: Amber light. High altitude
description:
I work near a small airport, always we always have a lot of air traffic.
Myself and two of my co-workers were chatting before leaving and an amber orb appeared and traveled over our heads at what seemed to be a high altitude.
There we no FAA lights.
I wanted to explain it as a Chinese lantern but was moving very quickly.  No sound observed.

summary: Saw a non blinking moving light while driving with a possible smaller light descending from it
description:
December 8, 2023 4:47 p.m.
Driving home from work I saw a bright, warm white light above downtown Fitchburg. The sky was overcast and it was the only light in the sky. It immediately struck me as odd as it appeared to be in front of the clouds, stationary and was not blinking. I was driving on 2A heading towards ChapelBarker Hill graveyard. My route took me around the graveyard where I lost sight of it. Headed northeast down Laurel st, I saw it again as I stopped at the stop light. I then noticed the light was slowly moving southwest towards me. I continued to glance at the light as I drove past the shopping center southeast down Water St. At the next stop light, I could still see it through the drivers window which was rolled down. I couldn't hear anything except the noise of the traffic. It was stationary again and I could see what looked like a smaller and much fainter light descending from the main light. It was very hard to make out and looked like it was almost twinkling. I lost sight of the twinkling light when the bigger light started slowly moving, southwest still, over my car. I thought I could just barely see a circular silhouette around the light. Then the stop light…

summary: I’ve seen it before but never recorded it. Pulsing orb with “solar flares” coming from it. Hovers for 15-20 mins then disappears.
description: The summary is pretty much it. I sometimes can’t sleep so I will look out my window and will sometimes see this object, sometimes I see plans coming and going from the airport nearby. This object struck me as different because it doesn’t move like a plane, it just hovers. It always pulses white, blue, and pink light with what looks like solar flares coming from the main body in those same colors. Sometimes it will disappear and reappear within the same second in a different area of the sky and will hover there for a while before disappearing altogether. I can’t tell if it is hovering high above Eastern Lawrence or if it is closer to Kansas City. It doesn’t behave like anything I know. My husband is a retired Army pilot and he says it freaks him out.

summary: Caught on Ring camera, invisible to naked eye
description:
Woke up around 4am to my dog growling and barking. Unusual for him. Checked Ring for people in the yard, saw no one. Noticed light in upper right corner and watched it for a while. It never moved. After 20 minutes I took the dogs out. Saw nothing with my own eyes and light was gone. Saw nothing. Wiped off my ring camera thinking maybe it was condensation. Checked it again when I went in and it was still there. Never moving. Saw arc to left of it.
Live near Selfridge air base but object was still the whole time.

summary: We spotted a bright blinking object in the sky, it did not appear to be moving but was chain thing colors and pulsating rapidly.
description: The object was the size of a large star. It was blinking and pulsating rapidly, and it was changing colors. It emitted all colors of the rainbow. It was not moving, and a shape could not be discerned. It could be mistaken for a star, but I have never seen a star behave this way.

summary: This craft was soundless, seemed to float extremely quickly across sky as if it was water
description: We often enjoy star gazing from our hot tub at night and because my husband works in aviation we like to guess where airplanes are heading and then check them on a radar to see who is closest. This craft was disk or space shaped and was traveling south at a high rate of speed. It was soundless and moved more like it was in water than the sky. It was made of lights but they were not blinking or alternating and were nothing like airplane lights. I would say that it was more or less glowing as it slid across the sky. I first thought it was a shooting star but once my eyes adjusted I realized it was just a fast and unrecognizable craft sliding across the sky. Although it was quick, I had enough time to point it out to my husband and he saw it too and agreed with me that it was a UFO. It’s such a cool, exciting, and eerie feeling!

summary: I viewed the anomaly for about 30 minutes after work and it wasn’t there tonight
description: I got off work at 9:45 and was walking to my vehicle when I noticed a light, then I noticed it was changing color and moving, so I took several videos so I could look at them later and try to debunk myself but I couldn’t. I legitimately think it was something unexplainable and was transfixed on the object to where I stood in the cold for half an hour watching it even though I was freezing cold and tired I couldn’t look away at one point.

summary: Orange lights seen ascending up from great height
description: At approximately 8:40pm I saw an orange light at approx 20 degrees elevation at heading due west at 270 degrees. This orange light was as bright as the star Sirius in magnitude. Beneath this orange light another orange light moved from 5 degrees from the left to 5 degrees to the right of the stationary orange light. This orange light was about 5 degrees below this stationary light. Time taken for this light to travel was about 10 seconds and then it faded out. A few seconds later the stationary orange light faded out. Between three and five minutes later I saw another orange light ten degrees off of the horizon rise in a curve to the left approx ten degrees above the horizon and fade out. 90 seconds later starting in the same location another orange light rises again in a concordal curve and fade in the same place as the first. This happened four times total every 90 seconds. From my location at night I can see planes leaving from Omaha and Kansas City. Omaha is north northwest of this location 90 miles away and Kansas City is south east from this location 100 miles away. The only commercial airport in the direction of sighting is Denver but at 600 miles the distance to horizon is…

summary: Bright lights changing in intensity
description: I observed bright lights from multiple locations in wellfleet. The lights would get more intense the closer it got then dim out and disappear while other lights reappear. I’d usually see three at a time. Sometimes appearing stationary or slowly moving until dimmed out then gone. I’ve consistently observed these types of lights these locations on clear nights the past few weeks

summary: Took my dog out, noticed some objects in the sky that did not look natural, took a video, immediately said to my son I just saw ET.
description:
On the evening of Thursday, December 7, 2023 at approximately 7:20 PM, I noticed some objects that appeared to be moving and then they disappeared. My son used the Iphone technology to enlarge one shape and you can clearly see a Triangle of coordinated light.
I did not hear anything and whatever it was has been posted to NextDoor in Northern Virginia and DC and 10,900 people have not been able to figure it out.

description:
I hope this email finds you well. My name is MichaelMcKinney, and I am writing to bring to your attention a peculiar occurrence I observed in my backyard yesterday.

summary: Another glowing white orb passing over my house
description: After seeing numerous orbs in this area in 2022, this is only the second sighting of them in 2023. I checked my apps like Flight Radar to confirm it was not a plane or weather balloon. I am guessing it was floating above at about 2,500 feet. It stopped momentarily above me, then continued on. I have a bit of footage of it on my iPhone, but i had my dog on a leash pulling me around. I was unable to get in my house in time to grab binoculars, so for this sighting, video is all I have. The orb was identical to other orbs I've been seeing every once in a while. There was absolutely no sound, and there were jetliners to the left of it at a much higher altitude. This orb was glowing and spinning. I wonder in anyone else in North Columbus saw it?

summary: Silent craft with 9 flashing lights was seen on a clear night before the clouds interrupted visibility.
description: I stargaze often and know the constellations to a ok degree and upon looking up I noticed something in the sky looked out of place. Upon focusing my eyes and eliminating the rest of the lights you could very well see the silhouette of a triangle shaped vessel. From my perspective the vessel looked as if it was lowering its altitude and would increase multiple times. It would also rotate clockwise or counterclockwise. Never rotated it's axis. It was simply there. After a while I suddenly starting hearing animals from other properties acres away and even wild animals all howling together which spooked me enough to run inside. While inside I could still observe the vessel. Upon viewing it from inside, I realized not only was there one vessel but 2. The second one was so massive it made the first one look small.

summary: Whille stargazing with nitevision monocular, spotted a curious flashing light that had a pattern to it, wasnt a plane, satellite, meteo
description:
I have spent the past couple years doing my meditation outside and (earthing /grounding to help deal with chronic pain and depression).
About a year and a half back i started seeing in the night sky, flashes of light here and there mostly above 45 degrees.  Some would but dim flashes some would be quite bright much brighter than jupiter or venus. sometimes while the flash was blooming it would collapse and be followed by a short streak of light.
Or there would be several short flashes in a row then nothing again. or nonlinear flashes.. I am a ham radio operator and used to tracking satellites.. At first I was thinking some could be written off as iridium flares, other satellites rotating etc.. Maybe some kind of star explosions?
But the flash streaks I couldn’t explain.. Back then I had no way to capture what I saw as my camcorder couldn’t really see stars very well unless zoomed way in and my cell phone doesn’t really see stars well either.. Too bad because back then I could almost set my watch by the sightings as they were very reliable.. I was fairly sure they weren't satellites as they happened pretty late at nite or at all hours at nite.. From 8:30pm to well after 3:00 am in…

summary: Hovering in place until shooting off southbound and disappearing in a small flash of light.
description: Was in my work truck heading to my very last stop at Dustin‘s barbecue off of Wickham Road when I saw the object seemingly suspended in place, not moving in any apparent direction. Filmed the object for approximately one minute to show its immobility before it seemed to Shoot off directly away from me before disappearing in a small flash of light.

description: I sighted an object that has a body like a small helicopter . It has a long smoky tail and it was moving smoothly westward in a vertical form and there was no any sound or noise.

summary: 4 to 5 lights in the sky to the east of New Hampton IA aprox 10 miles roughly above Lawler IA
description: I stepped outside with a colleague to have a cigarette and noticed a couple of lights off to the distance that seemed out of place. I watched them fade in and out and move up and down at a high rate of speed. After seeing this I cut my co worker off mid conversation and asked if he was seeing what I was seeing. He looked and saw the same thing. A moment later the two lights turned into four and seemed to be flying in some sort of formation but were fading in and out then got really bright before fading out once again. This went on for roughly 45 minutes. There were eight people who witnessed this event. Was really fascinating. The lights seemed to pulse then slowly fade out of existence. They would loop around one another and then seemed to be stationary before fading out of sight. Then moments later be miles away and do the same pattern again.

summary: Standing on front steps of house, looking west. Seen between Mars and horizon.
description: I stepped outside to enjoy the night before going to bed. While standing on my porch stairs, with our dog, I noticed a very bright orb object to the west just above our storage container. I continued to watch it as it morphed into a 5 point star form and split into two seperate orb/star forms while moving from west to east, and then becoming stationary. The dog then hit the door full tilt trying to get into the house, and i noticed thst the only other thing i heard was "whooshing" in my ears and feeling my heart beat. I reached behind and opened the door to let the dog in and called for my bf to come out and see what i was seeing. When i looked back the orbs had become one again, but closer. my boyfriend then grabbed our binoculars to tske a lpok and saw that they were still TWO orbs but very close together to look as one. When i looked through them, i saw the same thing. They never moved again, staying stationary so we went inside. The dog refused to go back outside.

summary: A light grey craft similar to that of a B2 flying overhead Austin, TX, with no apparent lights and sound.
description: Standing outside of my 12th-floor patio in my apartment building, I witnessed something approaching from North Austin with no visible lights (it was past midnight). Knowing this did not match commercial flight routes I had seen previously, I watched it fly almost directly overhead me in a south or nearly southeast direction. The first thing that came to mind was a stealth bomber like the B2, but I wouldn't understand why it was flying so low with no lights. I could clearly see the Chevron shape in a light grey tone, but couldn't discern whether it had a full triangle that was black or a darker color. I watched it fly above me for about 30 seconds, where once it got above I removed my headphones and heard no audible noise. At one point, I almost believed the front of the object changed shape from being a straight-angled Chevron, but I couldn't say this for certainty.

summary: I saw a triangular shaped craft while driving through Payson, AZ.
description:
I was driving on AZ-260 near the RX wildfire, heading towards Holbrook. I looked to my left and saw a triangular shaped craft hovering in the smoke with lights visible (before the 260 Trailhead turn off). There was no noise such as propellers, jet engines, or helicopter blades. The craft didn't move but remained stationary. I later drove back in an attempt to get a picture but by then it was gone.
I later heard a propeller driven plane at 6:10 PM but am not sure if this is related to my sighting.

summary: This was the earliest I've seen one out. Sun was still setting. It was before 5:30,only star out was Venus or mercury.

So ever single night orbs every I mean left going all different directions all different sizes and heights. They only come out very early like 545 to about 7 PM. summary: No sound, projected several bright beams of light from round circle of light into woods onto the ground.
description: I'm an old guy. Was watching TV and noticed a stationary round white light to the N-NE out of my east facing family room window. Didn't really think much about it, thought it was an airplane or helicopter. It disappeared. Seconds later it reappeared and was closer-about 100 yards in the same direction, however it was larger. That's when the white beams of light came on. It was obviously night-time and the lights were so bright they illuminated the entire woods. They weren't normal search type lights-they moved to fast. At this time I went outside for a better look, it was gone, it was dead quiet. No helicopter and airplane sounds. This happened in about a 20 seconds. I guess it might have been an aircraft, but I've never seen anything like this in the past. I believe it was a UFO because there was NO sound at all. I prefer my name not used. You can contact me if this is a legitimate UFO sighting.

summary: A Semi Transparent, White Colored, Luminescent Spherical Cloud circled directly above my home before disappearing entirely.
description: Shortly after walking outside to smoke a cigarette, I felt like I was being watched, so walked to the rear of my driveway, looked up and noticed a small, slightly illuminated, approximately 5ft wide, spherical cloud floating around 23 to 25ft in the air above the front portion of my backyard. The object appeared to be stationary until observed and briefly spoken to (when I initially spotted the object I said aloud "What are you doing?") At this point, the object slowly (about walking pace) circled above my house, then continued circling around the front of my house, circled above the driveway which I was standing on, circled above the home of the closest neighbor to my left, then back around to the rear my the driveway, then proceeded toward the front of the drive, before vanishing directly above my head. While circling over both house, the lower portion of the object was obscured briefly at the peak of each respective house, which verified my approximate observation of it's height. I walked from center to back, then back to front, then front to back, and then directly under the object as it changed direction east, in order to maintain unbroken observation. To be clear, I have no…

summary: We were swimming, I just so happened to look up and saw strange lights.
description:
Me, my children, and family, were swimming when I noticed it first after looking up. I thought maybe I was seeing things until I looked at my sister in law and said- Did you see that or am I crazy?
There were two orbs that were going in circles chasing each other kind of, I’m not sure but they were moving so fast in the sky it looked unreal. It looked nothing like a normal plane or aircraft going by it moved WAY too fast.
By then it went away for a few minutes and I told everyone by this time- even the neighbors came out and saw what ever was moving at the speed of light.
After about half an hour there was no more sight of the orbs.

location: San Cristobal de las Casas, Chiapas, Mexico
summary: Object floated slowly over a radio tower that was decorated with X-Mas lights. It did not blinlk. Too big to be a.drone.

Looking to my left, I glanced at a radio tower decorated with many rows of vertical colored lights for X-mas. Then, a brightly glowing amber object caught my eye. It seemed to be stationary. It was too big and oddly shaped to be a star. It was too slow to be a plane and too close to be a helicopter, because there was no sound. I realized that it appeared stationary, because it was slowly moving the ssme direction I was (west).I stopped walking and realized it was moving in relation to some power cables in front of me. The entire object glowed amber, but bright street lights prevented me from verifying the exact shape. The gendral shape of a diamond or an oval - but from top to bottom, not side to side. After about 2 minutes, it looked similar to a bright star, except for its bright amber glow. By then, it had floared, or drifted closer to the mountains and street lights further down the street blacked out its image. It was at a 15 degree angle in front of me when it became no longer visible. There was no fireworks show tonight as there was 10 days before, nor any exploding bottle rockets ( which…

summary: Multiple unidentifiable points of lights observed both stationary and traveling in the night sky unlike meteor shower or Starlink, poss
description:
While outdoors around 5pm, four people (2 adults 2 children) saw multiple (approximately a dozen) points/ orbs of light in the sky over the course of about an hour. The setting had some urban neighborhood lighting but the sky was clear and dark. The lights were of similar size and intensity. They appeared small, though distance was difficult to determine.
The observers saw a mix white, red and green lights. The lights did not appear to blink though some twinkling through atmosphere was noticed. Some lights appeared to travel across sky laterally, unlike a meteor. Possibly like a drone.
Some lights appeared to hang in the same spot which was hidden in the sky behind a large tree.
Observers have previously seen Starlink, ISS, meteor showers and single drones flying and this seemed different. A large solar flare was recently publicized.

summary: 5+ white lights circling/maneuvering from our perspective over or beyond Malmstrom Airforce Base. Lights changed in intensity as they turned like a landing light would on an aircraft.

I kept waiting in expectation of a logical explanation. None came. I believe there's something besides us now.

summary: flashing object moving erratically/hovering in the sky

summary: I observed an aircraft with two bright lights to be stagnant and hovering over my pasture approximately 100' in the air.

summary: Over a period of a couple hours my parents and I watched a distant light in the night sky make small, cyclical movements.
description:
Around 7 in the evening my mother called my father and I out to the front porch to show us a moving light in the sky toward the south. At first it appeared to be a star, maybe only slightly brighter than the average star. It took only a few moments to realize that it was moving; it would wobble side to side, move slightly to the left, and move upward (either literally up, or north). It would repeat these movements in a cycle over a period of perhaps 30 seconds, maybe upwards of a minute. None of these movements were fast, nor extreme; a thumb held at arm's length would cover the area in which it was doing the movements. It would also dim and brighten slightly, but there seem to be less of a pattern when it came to this. We watched it for maybe ten or fifteen minutes, pretty dumbfounded by it. I thought to grab my father's binoculars to see if I could see any it better, but once I found it using them it was still just a pinpoint of light; I couldn't see any kind of structure to the object which made me think it was really far away.
At this point it was still doing it's little dance, and we got cold so we went inside. Every ten minutes or so I would go back out see if it was still…

summary: following a boeing 737, the ufo slithered in the sky like a snake, there were 4 pairs of red and green lights on the craft
description: i was outside fooling around in the snow with a friend and that friends sister, basically i got hit by a snowball very hard (probably layed on the ground for 20 seconds) then i opened my eyes and saw my friend and his sister leaving, i looked up at the sky and saw a plane (boeing 737 probably) the lights on the plane dimmed and a craft appeared. the craft was long thin and had 4 pairs of green and red lights on it. i looked at it for about 20 seconds then ran to tell my friend and i lost sight of the craft

summary: Saw two tictac shaped objects, silent from where I was, swimming backstroke. 3rd object came shortly after.
description:
Have to assume these were drones, but could not find similar shapes in search. They were flying slowly, whatever they were. Silent.
In the first pass, one was slightly in front of the other, flying along and to the ocean side and just above the Carlyle, a condo building of 3 or 4 stories. Looked like they could have been as large as a small car, but shaped for all the world like a giant tictac.
Route was south to north between that building ( Carlyle) and The Lodge and Club at Ponte Vedra Beach. Closer to the Carlyle, and slightly west of Ocean Blvd. watched them go and went back to swimming.
Then a 3rd one followed shortly after. Might have been 1 minute, might have been 2. might have been a drone coming back for another pass without its friend. Whatever. 3rd one flew on the other side of the Carlyle, west side of that building, just above roof height. Again the path was south to north.
Nothing else happened. No military planes showed up from NAS Jax or Mayport. Assumed if it was dangerous, they would have. Continued my swim.
You see all kinds of stuff swimming backstroke, but this was a first. If I had not been swimming backstroke, I would never have seen them -- unless maybe…

summary: 2 groups of 25silver lights with 1 above the other seen clearly the bottom group faded away before the upper group faded into bluesky.
description:
Thursday Nov.30th, 2023 11:26 am cst Woodstock, IL. I'm looking North out my front window at an airliner high above me (75degrees up) traveling east in clear blue-sky and then another airliner going west came into view seconds later.
That's when directly across my street facing North/3degrees East... I'll say 40degrees above horizon about 5 feet above the streetlight (it was not on) in my clear sight were 2 groups of silver bright lights/orbs (at least 20 in each group) with one circular group above the other in view for only about 10 seconds max when the lower group faded quickly into blue-sky then the group above faded immediately after into clear blue-sky too. There was no motion or movement just a fadeout. I stared for a few minutes and grabbed my binoculars to scan the sky but nothing there.
I checked the time on my phone, and I decided to draw in pencil what was in my memory and write a description on the back of an envelope.
Each circular group was about the size of my index fingernail held out arm's length.
I waited a week to make a report, but I felt that I should still write this…. I told my 2 neighbors and showed them my drawing.

summary: 3 stationary larger lights in triangle shape with 5 smaller lights on the bottom
description: It was very foggy when my husband went outside to let our cat out. He saw the lights shaped like a triangle at a 60° angle. Three larger lights seemed to form the triangle with 4 or 5 smaller lights in between the two larger bottom lights.They were not moving. The moon could also be seen at a higher angle north of the triangle lights. We live on a small lake and there were approximately 20 or more Canadian geese right in front of our house just floating in the water and making no noise. At 6:35 A.M. my husband came and woke me up to see the lights. I went outside with him and also saw the lights. I thought they looked like Christmas lights on the peak of someone's roof. My husband pointed out that they were way too high in the sky for that. We kept going out to check them and could no longer see them by 6:50 A.M. I was able to see them better using night vision on my phone camara.

summary: 4 Objects Moving and Dimming On and Off
description:
Objects were at the 30-40 degrees position off the horizon. They would move at the speed of a small plane it seemed but sometimes move in circles - not a straight line. Event went on for 15 minutes.
There was 1 bright white object that appeared in the sky like when you slowly turn on a dimmer switch for a light. This object would brighten up in the sky, move around a bit and then dim back out and disappear. Then maybe 15 seconds – 30 seconds later, the same object and as many as 3 objects would brighten up at the same time and dance around each other and move to the north slowly but steadily.
After 15-30 seconds all objects would dim back down and disappear.
After another 15-30 seconds the main object would appear again but further from where it was originally. Then seconds after it appeared another 2 objects would brighten up and start moving around the main object in a circular and back and forth pattern.
Objects dimmed out again.
Then after another 15-30 seconds, the main object brightened up and 4 smaller objects brightened up after and buzzed the main object like bees being stirred up. Quite spectacular.
Event occurred for 15 minutes between 3:00am - 3:30am. The same event…

summary: The shimmering silver cylinder was floating in the sky and faded in and out of sight as it rotated.
description:
I viewed the object from the Kentucky Fried Chicken building on William St. in Cape Girardeau, MO. on 11-29-2023 at 12 noon. I first noticed white birds circling a parking lot street light at 2136 William St.. Then, above this lamp, I saw a vertical cylinder shaped object constantly rotating and going in and out of visibility as it turned. It was shimmering in the sunlight with sparkly light and silver spots then completely disappearing and reappeared over and over. It resembled a translucent veil covering a tin can. I estimate the size as big as a box truck. I watched it for several seconds trying to decide if I was really seeing it. I was with my father at the time but he was unable to see it as his clear view was blocked by a sign. When I reached for my phone to snap a photo the object vanished. Immediately, I noticed two helicopters in the area and counted 17 other aircraft within 30 minutes of the sighting, which was weird for Cape Girardeau! I am not crazy and know what I saw. I did check with the locale police department, but they had no other reports of sightings.
I included a pic of the exact location where I saw the object above the light in the center of the photo.

summary: Saw Formation of 6 UAPs in southwest Mi
description:
I was driving westbound on 94 towards Chicago. Suddenly 6 bright lights appeared above the horizon, not moving and in a vertical formation. The lights stayed still for at least 30 seconds and my eyes were glued to them. Eventually after about 40 seconds the top light flickered, then disappeared, then the bottom light did the same thing. The remaining four lights all followed suit from bottom to top in about 10 second intervals.
These lights were not moving at all and appeared very far away in the sky. Even though they were in formation, they were not close together and had significant spacing in between them - which is why i dont think this was Star link.

It was moving East for about 20-25 seconds and then made a 90 degree turn South without changing speed. After about 10 seconds it made a second 90 degree turn back towards its original East direction before disappearing behind clouds. It did not appear on the far side of the clouds. I was able to film the craft using my phone, but I was having trouble keeping it centered so I stopped filming.

summary: Bright deep yellow sphere with red bottom with long yellow trailing tail in appearance of a fireball
description:
At 6:00 am this morning I was out walking my dog as usual. I always find myself looking up at the sky while he is sniffing around. On this particular morning, I looked up and immediately noticed a large bright deep yellow sphere with a thin red bottom, with a long firey tail traveling from the north, heading south. I knew it was not an airplane. I see many planes in the sky coming and going from Midway and O'Hare airports. This object did not have any flashing lights whatsoever. I also knew that it was not a shooting star. I have seen several of those when visiting my parents in Arizona. I immediately thought that it was a comet until it went into a descending diagonal flight, paused very briefly, dropped into a vertical flight, and then flew parallel to the ground heading south. There was absolutely no noise coming from this object.
It was at this point I noticed an area of the sky become distorted and the object flew into it and then disappeared. Special note: This object maintained its original shape and appearance throughout my observation of its flight.

It was very confusing. Then I saw 4-5 of the same kind of lights doing the same thing, but disappeared more quickly than the first one had. I’m unsure of the exact order, but I believe I saw a single light 3 times and a group of lights twice within a 1-2 minute period.

I thought for sure it was going to collide with the Coast Guard. Thankfully, they were much faster than the white cigar shaped thing. The cigar was going so slow that I could not hear the helicopter any longer. I saw it long enough to open the door holler for my daughter to come here close the door turn back around and still see it before it went behind my tree.
The sky was blue no clouds at all, no birds. I could see it through my apple tree branches. It was quite thin compared to the helicopter. The I could see what I can only sense was a window right in the middle, shaped like a cigar. I could see the white all the way around the window. It had no wings, no tail, no sound at all. It was one single object. It was much slower than the helicopter. It had no lights.
I thought if it was an aircraft it would have been…

If it started to disappear behind clouds, another high speed movement to clear sky happened. I called my wife out and she witnessed the same phenomenon.

summary: Glowing bluish white light M&M shaped object ~1 mile above Maine
description:
Was in hot tub, facing North, looking skyward. Low haze, but not super overcast, sky was mostly clear/normal. My wife was with me but not facing in direction to see it.
Object was not there, sky was empty, then object - it was the shape (and at arms length, the size) of an M&M - appeared - fully lit - in sky at ~45 deg. The weird part was it was already moving at significant speed when it appeared. Also appeared to be fully unwaveringly illuminated the whole time with no trails or dissapation. Traveled ~15 inches across the sky in ~2 seconds, from East to West at a downward trajectory. It looked like it was a mile or so away. Disappeared just as quickly. Did not appear to fizzle out, just disappeared.
I have seen hundreds of shooting stars, it was NOT a shooting star.
It was of a size that if it was an object, it was large enough to be seen on radar.

summary: Triangular shaped craft over Route 2
description: I was driving east on Route 2 towards Boston a little after midnight when I saw a low flying craft in the sky a little ahead of me. It was heading in my direction over the highway. It had fairly nondescript blinking red and blue lights on it, and a very bright downward facing white light on the underside of its nose. I assumed it was a helicopter with a search light on, and turned my head up to look at it as I passed underneath. To my surprise, however, it had what appeared to be a V-shaped formation of maybe 4 or 6 lights on the bottom, with the brightest light serving as the center point at the front of the V shape. It did not appear to be moving in any sort of extraordinary manner, and everything that I saw aside from the V shaped formation seemed consistent with it being a helicopter. I was also near Hanscom Air Force Base in Bedford/ Lexington, although the object appeared to be too slow moving for it to have been an airplane. I have seen things that I would generally classify as UFO’s on at least 2 previous occasions, and am generally accepting of the idea that there are things in our skies that we lack a solid understanding of. summary: Dazzling multicolored object
description:
At approximately 11:30 PM I looked out my window and noticed an object blinking multiple lights. First I thought it was a drone.
The object appeared about about a mile away when I first noticed it.
I retrieved my field binoculars, took them outside. What I see is beautiful, multicolored bright, flashing lights all over the outside of the object. Deep deep blues, gold, red, silver, green and white colors.
The object remains in the same spot for over an hour now, no noise at all.
I live in a quiet neighborhood, if it was making noise I would have heard it.
I also thought it might have been a Helicopter, I looked on flight aware and did not see any aircraft in that area.  But it might have been masked also.  It was one of the most beautiful objects I've seen in the sky.

summary: Black Triangular Flying Object with red /white lights moving slowly and heading north
description:
I felt for some reason the need to look outside the window like if something was calling me. I saw this flying object , from the window, at 75 degrees . As soon as I saw it I knew it was not terrestrial. I went downstairs very quickly and outside my house, to track it . It kept flying almost straight and steady, but oscillating a bit. It didn't make sound. It was slow, and I think it flew for about 2 minutes before disappearing behind the front house.
Triangular or hexagonal shape, the colour was black, and it has three lights, they were steady and never blinking. The lights were white and red, and were on the object itself, like you would see on a plane, but there were no wings.
I have actually saw this object more than once, not just in this location. It was not a plane, and it was not a satellite. If it had been a military plane I think it should have made a sound, and would have been much faster. But it was not. So what was that?
