summary: Saw slow moving red light with a bright white center which traveled from the northeast to southwest then disappeared suddenly
description:
While walking from my house to my Garage, saw a bright red (almost glowing) light over the tree line to the northeast. In the center of the light was an even brighter white light which almost had an amber tint, like incandescent light. The light appeared unusually low and moving very slowly, almost as if floating. At first I thought it might be a low flying helicopter but it made no sound and there were no flashing lights or spotlight beam. As it slowly moved over my property, it seemed to be gaining altitude rapidly, but not moving rapidly. I grabbed some binoculars and watched it for 30-45 seconds through the binoculars. There was no shape that I could see, just the light, which was now moving to the southwest and seemed to be much higher than when I first saw it. Then it suddenly disappeared, as if you had just shut the light off. The total elapsed time from first sighting was 2-3 minutes.
The sky was clear, moon was bright, and some stars visible. This is a rural area with very little light pollution. It is also located under the flight path for both SeaTac airport and the Joint Base Lewis-McChord base, which is about 25 miles SW of my location. I see commercial flights daily,…

summary: Two vertical red blinking lights with two horizontal blinking blue lights which took off towards the west at speed.
description: At 5:50 pm, me and two witnesses saw red and blue blinking lights outside my sister's apartment hovering rock solid still, approximately 600 feet in the sky. We watched it and were amazed at how still it was. My friend said it looked like it was on a tower. But there are no towers near there. After about 5 minutes, we decided to leave and see if we could get closer. But as we walked toward my car, it took off at tremendous speed and was a solid, luminous blue as it flew away. There was never any sound. Could not see a solid object while it hovered. It looked solid blue when it took off. The shape seemed oval while it flew away. I did shoot it as it hovered, but if course, it was gone way too fast to whip my phone out again to get it while it flew away. My buddy was blown away and says he's a believer now. I don't know if my sister caught it taking off as she was leaving for another location. She called that location to tell them to film using a DSLR HD camera with a good zoom lens. I doubt they caught it.

summary: While in my backyard, I noticed moving white light in sky, which was clear with no clouds, and very dark out. This light was very bright and shiny, and moved overhead from a W/SW direction. I used my…
Happened to see them, 3 white lights, 1 red
description: I was outside with my children and saw four lights in the sky. The objects appeared to be silver and three had white lights and 1 red. They moved about freely and moderately in speed. Two almost touched.

summary: Very large, 3 pronged, sometimes looking pretzel-shaped, moved in one direction, then hovered in clouds for 10 minutes before I left
description: I noticed a large black object gliding through the sky, moving much more slowly than the airplanes in the area. It appeared much higher than the airplanes too, so it appeared to be larger than a jet airplane. Its shape looked at first like a large bird, then like a Y, and sometimes pretzel-shaped. The shape was difficult to make out. After floating across maybe a third of the sky, it began to hover just below the clouds, and it hovered in one spot for about 10 minutes before I left the area. It seemed too large and strangely shaped to be a drone.

summary: UFO sighting at 1:23 pm eastern time, November 23, 2023.
description: I saw a white object segmented into 2 with dark ring dividing, white glow around outside, moved slowly maybe at a standstill until I noticed and started taking pictures, then sped up, slowed down again, sped up. This slow and fast speed occurred about three times before disappearing! I watched this for about 20 minutes. Clear blue sky with no clouds in sight.

summary: Object with flashing lights takes off. Vertically makes unnatural course correction.
description:
Object was spotted too far south to be UAL1871 or VAL804 and too north to be DHK379
Appeared to ascend to the south of Ferris wheel at nearby amusement park. Vertical ascent and lights made me consider a drone at first, as it was almost disk shaped, but as it moved across the sky I observed it make a number of unnatural course corrections. Lights pulsated around it left to right, red and white lights. Speed varied and seemed to slow down as I called up to it.

summary: Lights rotating in a circle
description: I went out behind my house to smoke a cig. I looked to the north east and kept seeing Something. At first I thought it was a plant or a big star. It is at night. I looked again it was rotating lights in a circle saw at 10 pm and laying down now at 11:03 pm it is still there. Also it moved not far then it moved back almost to same spot. Now it is still to the north but more east now. Very weird looking thought I better report it.

summary: Glowing and no sound, very bright.
Four points of light - kite shapes
description: I saw four lights in a kite shaped configuration, low to the horizon. They looked as if they were covered and uncovered in quick succession before disappearing completely. I have seen Starlink satellites at my location and this was different from the “train” of Starlink satellites.

summary: Abnormal craft that kept lighting up, disappearing, and appearing back up in a different location
description: I was driving in to Dallas on IH45 headed north with my wife and it was a perfect day without a cloud in the sky and the first thing I saw was a light in the sky that I had kinda noted but didn’t think anything of it. Then I looked away and looked up and it was gone so that was my first clue. I told my wife about it. Then I saw it pop up again and pointed it out to her and we were just observing it for a few minutes. We would see it light up then disappear then show up in a different location and move in weird directions and would move in opposite directions. Then I saw it close and got a better view of it but thought it was maybe a plane then it lit up and disappeared again. And then I saw it again and caught a video. In the video, you can see it stall in mid-air, then start to descend, then speed up at a crazy fast speed, then disappear, light up, and disappear again. After we stopped filming, the craft headed towards a plane that was very obviously a plane and it appeared like they almost ran into each other. Shortly after that, it disappeared again and we never saw it again.

summary: Satellite appearance until it suddenly stopped. Erratic movements after stopping in generalized area.
description: This morning, my neighbor and me were on our daily early morning walk, when the neighbor looked up and spotted an object that first appeared to be a conventional satellite in normal flight southwest of our stated location and from 60 to 75 degrees off the horizon, and at approximately 75 degrees, it suddenly stopped. At first we thought we had somehow lost visual contact, because now it appeared we were looking at a distant star. After maybe 15 seconds, it started moving again but in a very erratic manner and in a localized area. Sudden fast starts, sudden stops, sometimes straight, sometimes in arcs. The object made approximately 4 somewhat longer movements over several degrees at super high speeds and in different directions, but seemed to return to about the point of the first stopped. It never proceeded much north of the first stop. During this period, a third early morning walker joined us and watched for awhile. Maybe about the time the third walker left, a conventional satellite of about the same size and altitude and in the same vicinity (6:25?) appeared, moving from South-Southeast to North-Northwest in direction (possible time verification). This may be about the time of…

summary: As many as 4 lights were simultaneously observed corroborated with no less than 6-7 other aircraft on Denver Center
description: Lights observed from the flight deck from what appeared to be slightly above or co-altitude with us in the 30's (32000-34000') from a consistent 280 heading over the 600+ mile flight northbound from dfw to rapid city. Distance to lights could not be determined as they were above the horizon. Lights would fade in from a dim red orange and intensely brighten for about 10 seconds before fading away. Lights would often move in different directions including directions that would not make sense for satellites. It was not starlink or meteors stars or planets as some lights moved upward and others downward towards the horizon. Lights would occasionally abruptly change direction and velocity with the appearance of dancing or rotating around each other. Lights were observed from a constant direction but were in no discernable formation. Witnessed by both flight crew and as many as 7 or more aircraft on frequency transiting from as far as the east coast to over Colorado from what we heard.

summary: Points of light maneuvering in upper atmosphere
description: Flying a corporate jet at 43000 feet on a 290 heading. First saw several lights (usually 2 turning circles or zipping up and down diagonally but sometimes up to 4) at extremely high altitude at great distance at our 10-11oclock over Oklahoma City. So to the southwest of our position. These lights came in and out of sight at about 5 minute intervals for approx 1 hour. Also varied in brightness from very bright to dim with no apparent pattern to that. Always staying in exactly the same place in our windshield so they paved us for at least 400 miles.

summary: Watching fighter jet and saw a group of small white objects far above the jet that quickly changed shape and moved together NW to SE
description: At 10:15am three of us were watching the Luke AFB fighter jet fly over Sun City West. Above the jet was a group of small what objects that quickly changed shape as the jet flew below them. The objects were much higher than the jet. They then slowly changed to a "V" with one side longer, then several shifted from one side to the other side very quickly, not movement a bird flock could accomplish and this group was way too high to be birds. Watched the group from about 60 degrees in NW direction to 90 degrees directly above Sun City West then lost the visual in the sun. The group constantly changed shape. At one point several of the objects broke off from the group and could be clearly seen individually then rejoined the group. The one photo we have is very very blurry. It's the faint white object in center. There were NO clouds in the sky, it had recently rained so the sky was exceptionally clear and blue.

summary: Bright white light that I thought was a planet. Moved to the southeast and suddenly disappeared completely
description: At approximately 6:30 am PST driving west into La Grande, Oregon, I saw a large bright white light that I assumed was a planet. I pointed it out to my granddaughter who stated it wasn’t a planet and was moving. The sky was completely light and no other stars were noted. It appeared to move to the southwest towards us and then just suddenly completely disappeared. No other object was there, it was just gone.

summary: It is just sitting there like a bright star. When I returned with my phone it had moved a little west.
description: I went out front to have a smoke, at 4:03am it was the only thing in the sky, like a star. But it moved when I returned with my phone.. it was round trying to look like a star. But it was too close and large.

summary: An orange light in the sky moving slowly. No flashing lights that an airplane or helicopter would have.
description: I have lived by this airport for years. There is frequent air traffic, but this was different. I wasn't like anything I ever saw before.

summary: 8 ufo in straight line
description: At 6:53 pm Nepali time , I saw Eight ufo like objects passing straight in line . It didn't make any noise

summary: Witnessed approximately 20 bright white lights in a diagonal line across the sky shift to be vertical and then one at a time disappear
description: While driving I witnessed approximately 20 bright white lights in a diagonal line (at about a 45 degree angle) across the sky. They appeared to be about as high as an airplane would fly. Maybe higher. They looked like bright stars (white lights) but much closer than stars. They were equally spaced apart. I pulled over to watch them and they began to slowly move (maintaining their equal distance apart from each other) from their diagonal line into a straight vertical line. The top light then started to move a little bit away from the others straight off the top of the line and then all of a sudden it shot off and away from the others. Then the next light would do the same. When they shot off it was so fast that it looked like a shooting star and disappeared. Each one of the lights followed suit until they were all gone.

summary: At 1st glance lights (4) appeared slightly higher than street lamps but change into just 2 larger bright lights that tilted & vanished
description:
I was traveling North on I-81 in Hagerstown, MD at around 5:15 in slow moving traffic. Street lamps had just come on but it was still light out when I seen 4 lights that may have been in a diamond formation or just a cluster that I thought were just a bit than taller street lamps but were offset a good ways from the interstate. I was never able to pass them, so they were not stationary at all and kept the same height and distance as I drove 8 miles of driving distance.
They continued to travel and I lost sight of them briefly when traffic slowed down. Once the traffic sped up to 50 mph I was able to regain site of them, until I was even with Hagerstown airports runway. The runway is on the eastern side of the interstate, on the western side of the interstate is farmland. Once the lights reached the farmland, they merged into 2 square lights that resembled the Lotto Shoe logo (2 squares joined but with a space) the bottom of the 2 squares was extremely bright. Much brighter than the upper portion.. Then they were gone. I did not see them go up or down or anything. Mind you this entire event lasted maybe 10-12 minutes if that long and I was driving in decently heavy traffic.

summary: Thought it was rocket launch. I have video and photos. A lot of planes fly over here so I know what they look and sound like.
description:
We were sitting at the kitchen counter and looked out the sliding glass doors to a giant light that was green and red and white launching straight into the sky from the ground. Thought it was a rocket but this was Sunday night. Too loud to be a drone but too quiet to be a plane. Slowed down frame by frame in my video you can see it rotating from red light to green light to white light like they were placed on a disk. It was moving fast bc we had to run to the front yard just to catch it. Wasn’t flying in. A straight like either and I had saw a plane go by about twenty min after this. The thing we saw was not a plane. You could see it glowing green past the horizon of trees. Circular for sure with disk like features. I thought it was just a drone at first but this looked like a rocket launch not a drone flying up. Also it was way too high up in the atmosphere to be a drone. You also just feel chills on your neck and body knowing that this is not something you regularly see. I had to stay out there for 20 extra minutes just peering into the sky.
No rocket launches on the 19th.

summary: Large object appeared hovering above Sec. of State bldg then opened and released 4 reddish/orange orbs
description: On November 19, 2023 in Downtown Denver, Colorado me & my partner witnessed a large dark grayish object appearing in translucent looking clouds or smoke above a building directly in front of our balcony. We were staying at The Warwick Hotel on the 14th floor. After the large object appeared above The Secretary of State building, we were frozen in place unable to speak for several seconds then it opened & began dropping out 4 perfectly circular red/yellow/orangish orbs that pulsated and flashed and hovered at first then began to maneuver in all directions (up, down, left, right) forming shapes etc. Neither the “mothership” as we called it or the orbs made any noticeable sounds. As seen on our video footage some orbs hovered while others descended. One can be seen sharply changing directions as it descended behind SkyHouse Denver highrise. Just before all the orbs descended and disappeared from our view behind The Secretary of State building a black helicopter arrived in the precise area the orbs and mothership disappeared and circled for approximately 40mins to an hour. Afterwards time seemed to leap forward 2 hours and a large flock of crows came to the tree directly in-front of…

summary: Saw a moving red disk on 11/19/23 at 5:17 est.
description: I saw what I initially thought to be Venus shining brighter and bigger than usual. Then it started moving fast so I took a video. It was red and spinning rather fast in a zigzag pattern.

summary: 11 objects all the same changing shape and color flying in multiple directions before vanishing.
description: Started off as orange orbs then changed into a saucer shape then back into white lines before changing back into an orb.

summary: Silver egg-shaped reflective object heading south at dusk at an usually slow speed for its altitude
description: At just after 4:00 on Sunday 11/19/23, I looked up because I heard a helicopter hovering around and something caught my eye at a much higher altitude beyond the helicopter. I saw a small silver metallic object moving in a southerly direction. It was hard to track with the naked eye due to the dusk lighting, it was shimmering inconsistently, and it appeared to be reflecting the sunlight much brighter than I have seen from any other object. I pulled out my iPhone, started a video, and pointed it in the direction of the object on full zoom not knowing if it could pick up the object. When replaying the video, I was surprised to see it showed up exactly how I saw it with my eyes. I held the phone as steady as I could (within 1/8”) and I do not have shaky hands. For the altitude of the object, it appeared to be moving unusually slow compared to the speed a plane would be traveling at that same altitude. I live in a rural area between Philadelphia, Atlantic City, and McGuire AFB where most plane traffic is at a visible altitude and traveling in a consistent flight path. This object was traveling from the northwest to southeast, which does not fit any air traffic I have seen before. It…

summary: Spotted at least 11 objects move in sporadically going in multiple directions
description: This was a very bright sunny day clear blue skies as I looked up above my apartment I noticed a large group of what I thought were flares because they were orange and extremely bright. The objects had moved north towards the lake and eventually disappeared within two minutes the objects reappeared and came back the same direction they had just went. They had changed colors shape and size. I went through and took screenshots of the video in slow motion and you can see there was at least three different objects that they changed into including a saucer shape and I had some pretty clear images that looked just like a perfect saucer.

summary: Black triangle object with 5-7 dimmed lights moving in deep space
description: Late Saturday night/Sunday morning I was laying out watching for meteors with my feet facing east, I noticed a swift but silent moving triangular craft swiftly moving from NW to SE direction. It was black, with about 5-7 dimmed lights around the front two sides in a v formation. This was up well above where planes are, moving in deep in space amongst the stars. Within a few second it was out of sight. This is the second time I have personally seen this while out watching meteor showers in the last 2 years

summary: White orb hovering around the sky.
description: White light in the shape of an orb was moving in different directions across the sky for about 30 minutes and then disappeared. It looked like it had white/gold strands coming off of it. It reappeared about an hour later in a different part of the sky. It was flashing red and green and white lights. It then disappeared again.

summary: Grey bicycle seat shaped object with flashing red lights
description:
I was driving on Best Street heading East and saw what I immediately assumed was a plane.
I saw two pinpoint flashing red lights on both the left and right sides of the object (east and West). Then I realized that it was not a plane. I could see the underside of the object which looked like the bottom of a mostly triangular shaped object shaped kind of like a bicycle seat. The grey color reminded me of the color of a jet. The object did not appear to be moving and if it was it had to be extremely slow as it was undetectable from my vantage point. I pulled over to to check the Flight Radar app and the closest plane was shown over Amherst, NY. The Buffalo Niagara International Airport is just a few miles from where I was so I wanted to just assume it was a plane. Planes don't stand still in the air or hover so I decided to report this. I really want to know what it was. I was approaching the turn for the 33 West and couldn't stay pulled over in the lane I was in so I had to drive off. The object was still there when I drove off.

summary: Round light that changed to a small blinking light after rising up into the sky.
description:
It was early evening on November 18, 2023 and my wife and I were sitting in our living room watching the news. Our leather sofa sits perpendicular to our ten-foot living room window which is on the north side of the house facing the US/Canada border. There is quite often activity along the border with drones and helicopters doing whatever it is they are supposed to do so we seldom pay much attention.
However, that evening as we sat watching, my attention was drawn to a round bright light slightly higher than the tree line on my neighbor’s property about a half mile away. At first we thought it could be a helicopter but the light was larger than any we’ve seen before and it was pointed straight at our direction not searching the ground. We watched it for several minutes, musing between each other that maybe it was an airplane. But, then logic kicking in and we could not understand how a plane intending to land at a nearby airport (there is one in Abbottsford and one in Bellingham but neither are that close to us), would be holding such a low and, seemingly, fixed position.
Finally, with curiosity getting the best of me, I got off the couch and walked to the window to get a better…

summary: Metallic UAP or Balloon
description:
Hello NUFORC,
At around noon on 11/18/2023 I heard two low-flying fighters outside of our house. As I was standing in our backyard, I saw two F-35's fly around the house three times over the course of 15-30 minutes. I don't know why there were F-35's here, but Davis-monthan AFB in Tucson is not a fighter base (I was stationed there from 2007-2011). I don't want to assume too much, but the nearest F-35's I know about are stationed at Luke AFB in PHX. Sometimes they will have an airshow or other host nation partners' pilots will train here with some of the U.S. pilots. Either way, when I heard the aircraft outside it prompted me to investigate.
As I was observing them I witnessed two other high-flying jets (higher than 20k ft approximately) that were streaming across the sky. This prompted me to grab my telescope (25mm lens) so I could get a better look at them. As I followed one of them with my telescope I observed a UAP floating in the background (not following the aircraft, but caught my eye). Light reflected off of it like it was metallic. I continued to observe the object for approximately twenty minutes until inclement weather prevented me from observing it anymore. It was…

summary: Clear blue skies. I was pulling out of my property and saw the sphere.
description: The sphere was about 500 ft in the air at about 1,200 yards away. Sitting dead still. Shiny perfectly smooth sphere. Watched it for about 2 mins then it just disappeared. I don’t know if it flew off at super high speeds I couldn’t see or if it cloaked itself. I’ve had other hunters in my club see objects over the years they can’t explain either.

summary: 3 orbs fading in and out
description: I seen these same orbs in August, in Tennesse, same time, same direction. They fade in and out of brightness and will reappear in a different spot and move quickly in any direction. In August they appeared to be playing with each other.

summary: I was filming a video of a night sky and then i saw strange moving object and there's a flash
description: I don't know what i saw but i think it is strange. I was filming a night sky then i saw a strange moving object. I saw the video multiple times yet still don't know how to explain it.

summary: I saw it when I was playing in park with my friends when saw a circle shaped object which was quite fast.
description: I was in park when I saw it. It was a ball type which was quite fast. It went very fast and then it disappeared. My friends and other's also saw it. It was yellow and white and blue in color. It was very different from a normal aeroplane. (plane that carry passengers go around my house) We also noticed that no noise was coming from it but after it disappeared, there was a sensation of heat.

summary: Driving down the dark road.  Observed red lights.  When underneath it was completely opaque and saw blue lights. It was still and silent
description: I made a right on Edworthy Side Road at approximately 6:45pm on the evening of the sighting. I noticed 1 flashing red light a few hundred yards ahead. I have been on this road hundreds of times and never noticed a light before. There are no street lights. I first thought that a tower had been erected, but as I got closer I noticed there were 3 red lights. As I drove almost under it (it was slightly off the road about 40-50 feet in the air), I noticed a set of blue lights on the opposite side of the red. The red lights were staggered, like the middle one was in front of the other 2. The space between the red and blue lights was completely opaque (could not see the night sky). There was no tower, no structure, nothing. Just this floating object that was difficult to make out, other then the lights. As I drove under it I rolled my window down and stuck my head out for a closer look. Again, almost impossible to make out the edges. It just appeared darker then the night sky. As I drove past it, I became frightened and accelerated until the traffic light. There was at least 1 car on the road at the same time as me - driving about 10-20 car lengths ahead of me. They didn't appear to slow…

summary: The craft was totally stationary, totally silent and visible just above a tree.
description:
I was driving home with my wife beside me and spotted something above and ahead of us close to the road. My 40 degree angle of visual contact was becoming more steep as we approached and I turned onto the driveway, causing me to lose sight of the craft. Jumping out of the car, I grabbed my phone from my pocket while running toward the street with the intention of taking a photograph, but it was completely gone when I got there. I scanned the sky and saw only a smaller private jet, which was also white. What interested me most here was the jet's path: its movement was curved and put me and anything directly above me at the center of the near semicircle it was following. It is a good possibility that a person or persons on that aircraft saw what I had just seen. I have a series of photos that can document the curved path of which I speak.
Description of the machine: 
My estimation of the object's size is 8' x 20'. The entire thing had a very white matte finish. There were no markings of any kind that were visible to me. Upon first spotting the object I focused on what I thought of as its front end. It appeared to be a perfect sphere from my vantage point. There were no windows and…

summary: It looked like it was landing
description: We saw this Glass looking sliding UFO aircraft

summary: Triangle shape only saw one light in the front and two in the rear. Was not super high in the air and made a low/soft humming noise.
description: I was standing outside stargazing with my two small children. I noticed a craft out of the corner of my eye and disregarded it as an airplane. My youngest daughter asked “dad, what’s that” I told her “it is an airplane” Then I paused and said “but it’s the wrong shape……with the wrong lights….. And wrong sound” I wish I had gotten a video but at that point it was in the tree line. It moved pretty slow and the sound was a low humming sound. Grew up on Air Force bases. Did not sound like a plane to me.

summary: Large hovering craft, silently floated away when I stopped my car, at night with lights
description: I was driving and saw bright lights that appeared to hover over the side of the freeway. I was on the phone with my dad and hung up because I wanted to film it. It seemed like a low plane at first but quickly I realized I was approaching it, and it wasn’t moving. It was crazy. When I passed it going 40 mph in a 70 I saw the side of it. It was not flat like a drone but more ball shaped? Maybe rectangle? But not flat. It had volume. And it was very large? Truck sized at least. And silent. I pulled over and started filming again and it just started moving away from me opposite direction, along highway. I tried to zoom in on it but it’s very hard to tell in video. It seemed to have two big circles on the back of it, inside where the light was coming from. And that’s the direction it moved. Like big jet engines on the back is what it made me think of. But they weren’t lit up and it was silent.

summary: Object was above arboretum. Moving rapidly sideways and up and down then hovering
description:
Object was white and circular. It made no noise and left no contrail. It moved rapidly side to side and up and down. It appeared to be rotating and there were faint blue and red lights on the outer part of the saucer. No aircraft could have maneuvered like that. Clear sky, light haze, 70 degs.. Suddenly/abruptly it disappeared as I was watching it, just poof, it was gone.
I am a retired Senior Intelligence Officer and am a trained observer. It was definitely not an aircraft.

summary: A small circular UFO that blinked white and black.
description: I happened to look out my bedroom window at around 2:30am and I saw a small circular UFO that blinked between white and black. it moved up and down and left and right and loop-d-looped. The bottom part of my window was covered with a drop-cloth because my parents and I are getting new shades for our windows. I tried taking a video and photos of the UFO but my flip-phone apparently does not allow for that function. I got our binoculars but the binoculars did not work well and I could not get a clear sight on the lense. I had my TV on because I was watching the news. I watch the news in the middle of the night. My parents were sleeping and nobody in my neighborhood was awake apparently. We live in a gated community in Fort Myers, Florida. There is a sidewalk in front of out house and nobody was walking on the sidewalk and no cars drove by on our street. I did not tell my parents about this UFO sighting. I have seen vidoes of this type of UFO sighting that I saw on the internet. It is the first time I have seen a UFO with my own eyes.

summary: Pulsing reddish light that turned to a very bright white light and went straight down for a second and vanished.
description: Walking in neighborhood when at around 9 PM I observed a unique reddish light pulsing (not blinking and not super bright) SSE of me, with no distinct separate lights but seemed more than one singular light, maybe moving slowly or appearing to move slowly because of its trajectory, or maybe it was still, hard to say as I never stopped walking. Its average intensity didn't change aside from the pulsing and I Kept an eye on it as I walked, but the immediate homes I was walking past obscured my view at times. Initially assumed it was likely a low aircraft, as planes are pretty common to see in that general area of the sky and the pulses were at a regular interval - I could also see white headlights of a plane further south down near the horizon. While catching it in a gap between two rooftops in the area where I was expecting to see the reddish light, was a much brighter white light, falling straight down, like a very bright shooting star. I ran to clear the next house (2-3 seconds), but there was no sign of anything in that part of the sky anymore. I continued to scan the sky and watched the distant plane as it slowly approached, identifiable as a plane by the clear individual lights…

summary: Platform type craft traveling low over forest with lights illuminating the top but no lights on bottom, at night.
description:
I was driving with my wife and noticed this unusual object moving quickly over the tree line of the forest preserve.Watching it reminded me of a flat bed truck traveling down the highway at too fast a speed. Since the quality of the light was so unusual and I do not draw well, the image I attached is more of a schematic.The single arrow in front of the craft shows the forward movement. The very back was not illuminated; I represented this by shading that area. The side I could see best had enough light to show a sharp edge, but I had no sense of how tall the side was ...except that it was very close to the trees. I believe I saw two rows of four dim blue/violet lights that nicely light almost all of the platform surface. There was a second, less defined, yet radiating, light source coming from the front in a hue somewhere between a warm white LED bulb and yellow represented by the three grouped arrows. It was a bit brighter in both color and intensity and intermingled with the other color to some extent.
For the question about the size of the object, it was really more like the size of two pennies at something like a two to one ratio.
Even though the sighting was very brief, it…

summary: There would be one,then 2 more appeared,they then would grow in brightness and move away from each other at different speeds
description:
I went out on my back deck that faces north at approximately 8:30pm.
Looking off to the West on my left I could see one bright light,which isn't impressive as my wife and I live 5-10 minutes away from an airport.
There were no landing lights, no strobes.
Just a solid bright white light moving slow.
A 2nd light appeared from nothing below it.
It was dimmer, slightly yellow.
As the 2nd started to rise up, the first light moved to the left, allowing it space.
A 3rd light appeared off to the lower right of the 2nd,and started to rise as well.
The 2nd and 3rd light grew in brightness to match the first light.
They all 3 started to rise higher to about 45 degrees, instantly fading to smaller pin spots that moved off left,and right, at different speeds and disappearing.
I could see this with my eyes.
I ran inside to get my binoculars,and to get my wife to see them.
As we're coming back outside, 4 lights of equal brightness are all moving in different directions at different speeds in the same area
I viewed them individually through my binoculars.
As they moved left and right, they would get dimmer the faster they went,but still visible.
Briefly, a 5th light appeared acting with the same…

summary: I saw a silver object flying SE to NE. No Aircraft running lights.
description: I was watching the sky for aircraft as I often do. I was a TSO for the TSA, and I like to count the number of aircraft I can see at any given Time. I observed a silver oval shaped craft moving quickly from the SE of my position going NE. I am very familiar with the size and shape of most commercial and military Aircraft. This was not any of them. It was moving after dusk with no running lights or strobes. It was at an altitude of approximately 1000 feet. As I watched it for several minutes it simply disappeared. The light didn't fad, it was gone. The object looked to be larger than a commercial aircraft. I judged it to be about a mile or so away and appeared to be the size of a golf ball.

duration: Seems to be there all day
summary: This has been present outside and emits a high pitched frequency. It seems to be able to evesdrop.
description: Round shaped bright light emitting a very high pitched frequency.

summary: Desending.
description: I was walking my kids to the school bus stop for houses down we saw it descending it had red yellow and green lights flashing. This is not the first time I’ve seen it it’s usually higher up in the sky this time it came down close. It’s always out at 6:20 AM. We ran back to the house and it disappeared.

summary: Saw two craft, one approaching from the SW and another about 1500 ft away relatively close to my building.
description: Was in the midst of playing guitar and drumming and was exiting the bathroom when I went to go shut the window and blinds. The angle I was at gave me clear view of the 7/11 across the train tracks adjacent to my building. I saw a cigar shaped saucer with four lights on the underbelly of the craft, and a blue haze was being emitted from the underbelly. I was freaking out, yelling at my neighbor's to look out the window, and it stayed out until others went to observe, but it was still visible as it descended behind the building next to 7/11. It eventually disappeared and no one saw it fly away, but as we awaited it's departure, a second craft came in from the southwest and flew rather erratically and didn't fly like how I traditionally propelled aircraft would. The crafts also exhibited both horizontal and VTOL flight capabilities, with them seeming propelled by the propulsion source on the underside of the craft that emits a blue glow akin to the same glow emitted by uranium fuel rods when submerged in a cooling pool in a nuclear power plant, or like the glow of the tesseract in the Avengers film. A blue glow emanated from both craft's undersides.

summary: Three bright orange orbs levitating then moving slightly and slowly then moving fast and disappearing
description: I can't believe I'm filling this out. I was driving home and saw three lights as I was going up a hill toward the end of the hill at a junction from Nelson Rd to West Rd. I was surprised and thought the lights were a new radio tower or something. It was too close to be the only other lights which are further at a ski place about 6 miles down. I take this road three times a week so it was foreign and new. As I got to the crest of the hill overlooking the field where I expected a tower, there was none, and the objects were just floating. I turned my car southwest on cranston rd instead of going northeast as I usually do to get home to get a better view. At this point I could only see two of them. I was in awe, and had a clear view within my car of one of these things slowly moving east, and the other hovering straight above it, but that one didn’t move, only the bottom one. I was dangerously hanging out around the road and pulled over as another car was behind me and I got out of the car to get a closer look and see if I could hear a helicoptor sound or something as we get a lot of helicopters here. It was completely silent. I was hoping the car behind me would stop to talk about…

summary: 5 objects with white lights hanging in straight line and one with 3 red lights hanging in straight line moving quickly.
description: First sighting was near Ephrata, PA. It looked like a vertical string of several white lights. It seemed to hover or move slowly. I kept trying to see how it was moving. It appeared it was moving East. I lost sight of it for awhile. I was driving North by Northeast. I exited the major road onto a state road. I saw the shape again in the Western sky. It was moving slowly or hovering. I kept trying to catch a glimpse of it through trees and around houses. When I came to an especially clear vantage, I was able to see there were 5 of the lines of light in a virtually straight east by southeast line. At one point I had three in sight. All had been white lights hanging in a vertical line. When I looked up I caught only one still in my line of sight, and then one with a vertical line of red lights instead moving slightly faster than a jet. I think at least one of its red lights was blinking, but I am not remembering clearly now. The white light objects appeared to blink or shimmer. I am sorry I cannot give a better explanation. I want to say they were at a height of 1 to 3 miles. Probably closer to the lower end. I thought I might be seeing hot air balloons, but it was dark, and hot air…

summary: It happened really fast figured I’d report it idk
description: I was watching the stars as I do most early mornings and I saw a really bright ball of light and it zipped by super quick not across the whole sky maybe like a fourth of the sky and then disappeared into the sky. It was only one I’m still very shocked but I saw online it says to report so here I am.

summary: “Falling star” drops straight down then turns 90*, streaks east just above horizon, no change of speed
description:
11/13/23 around 11:40pm, walking dog on farm hilltop, looking south east, a “meteorite” falls directly perpendicular, straight down from above, then makes 90* turn to the east, traveling horizontally ,just above the horizon. The trajectory was the shape of a backwards capital “ L”.
The speed stayed consistent, did not change before or after the 90 degree turn. Like a pinball ricochets off of a wall. This thing moved very very fast in both directions. I was observing a twinkling star in the SE, and the object fell from directly above this particular star, traveling straight down, right into my direct view, making its turn below the star, zipping off to the east above the tree line, horizontally. Very very fast. So fast that by the time it turned and moved east, my eyes were still looking towards the twinkling star, and it moved east, out of my peripheral vision. I then asked Google if meteorites made right angle turns. I was surprised to see that they don’t in fact make those type of drastic turns. About an hour ago, 24 hours after this event, I just saw a news report of a “meteor’ seen last night in Minnesota traveling horizontally across the sky. The object moving across the sky…

summary: 3 stationary white out of focus very bright lights in a line east to west about 6 degrees apart (the width of fingers)
description: I was standing near a south facing window in my house in Northern Pend Oreille County WA. On 13 November around 11pm I saw three very bright Lights that looked like very bright “out of focus” stars in a horizontal line each was about 6 degrees spacing along the ecliptic in the direction of SWW. I thought for a moment that I should take a photo but realized the lights would not make a good photo. They did not seem to be moving. I debated on waking my husband up and instead went to bed. I told my husband about this the next morning and he mentioned that after looking on stelerium that Orion’s belt was in that area but it was not in a horizontal line. Jupiter was visible farther to the west. On the 14th and 15th I noticed military aircraft circling the area south of our house.

summary: Ufo night sky: camera footage
Saw a light go from dim to very bright
description: At 10:20pm MT, I was the Captain operating SWA FLT 4900 MSP-DEN, we could see a light move up in the sky at a rapid speed and go from dim to a very bright light. At one time, we could see 4 lights come and go sometimes moving in a counterclockwise position.

summary: Noticed very bright light to my left as it approached I slowed down the lights got brighter
description: As the lights got closer the aircraft came into view it was large the lights were so bright I had to squint to see the aircraft it was large and very close to the ground as if it was landing. It was not spinning it was hovering the circle of lights was stationary under the aircraft. It did not fly away I was afraid to stop on the dark road.

summary: Light/flying object that was flying at extremely high speed and then vanished.
description: I was driving in my car and looked up with a traveling/moving light caught my eye that was moving really fast. I looked up as I saw it traveling extremely fast in a Western direction. It was glowing blue in the dark sky. Just like that it looked like it just suddenly vanished.

summary: 6 lights following each other descending in a helical path
description: Initially spotted an an altitude of roughly 1000ft queue of 5 or 6 red lights following one another along a descending helical path (100 ft radius).

summary: Triangle black craft
description: I was at work on a break when I saw something out of the corner of my eye. I looked in that direction but only got a split second to see it because it flew behind a tree line. I knew then it was something unusual. I assumed it was a farmer's plane and kept looking to see it come out from the other end of the tree line. Instead, the object came out at a 90-degree angle. When I got my closest look at it, it was about 50 yards away from me. This is what I saw: it was flat, maybe 20 feet in width, possibly smaller, and about 10 feet in height, maybe shorter. It started to rotate in an unnatural way, and when it did, I saw that it was in the shape of a triangle, but in the middle of the triangle, there was another triangle inside that was see-through. The color of it, the best I could describe, is black as black marble and shinier than marble. It looked like all the material was one piece, like no rivets, no seams, just like the craft was made by one piece of whatever material it was. The sun reflected off of it. It made no noise, there were no propellers, no propulsion; it was just floating and rotating perfectly with no disturbance, almost gracefully perfect in its rotation. Then it…

summary: A slow moving point of light, traveling west on clear conditions at high altitude.
description: My mother and I woke up at 6:30 AM and stepped outside. I looked up at the sky to get an idea of the weather. It was perfectly clear and the sun was just barely risen. To the north travelling westward I noticed a small point of light moving too slowly to be a plane and also either too high or too small. I pointed it out to my mother and she noted that also there was no sound. I checked air traffic maps, satellite trackers, and even the position of the International Space Station. None were nearby at the time of sighting.

summary: I rounded the corner of the gravel road, and as I did, I saw what i thought was the reflection of a green rectangle in windshield
description: It lasted a few seconds and very quickly exited at what seemed like crazy speed out of my vision to the left. A vertical green rectangular shape. I thought a reflection of something and dismissed. 2 days later I heard 2 of our employees discussing “did you see that green thing monday morning”.  Which stopped me dead in my tracks.

summary: Bright object with colored lights spotted on sky first still and then rapidly moving with erratic movements.
description: Bright large object with colored lights (blue white red) spotted on sky, lights shining with bright beams. At first , it was hovering in one spot and then started to rapidly move with erratic movements. Lights went off and object reappear on opposition location, very rapidly. The sound was very loud like a big jetplane.

summary: Shape with two points of light at each end at low altitude
description: While looking west at approximately 8:00 pm I noticed a light coming fast from the south to the north several miles away and fairly low. As it crossed my position in front of me I could make out a shape with two points of light at each end. It continued north and then made a turn to the east and appeared to circle to the south as I lost sight of it. The shape was moving faster relative to the planes in the sky as I am situated on a flight path to midway airport and o’hare. I have seen military jets up close and didn’t hear the tell tale afterburners.

summary: Driving at night and saw a green lit object drop down and zoom off
description: My husband and I were driving our family home from dinner at our parents. My husband exclaimed, “look at that!” I looked to where he was pointing and saw a red trail of light zoom off and disappear. It was a very clear night—you could see all the stars. It did not move like an airplane— it did a circular “swoop” before it disappeared. If it was a plane we would have seen it continue to travel off into the distance. My husband said when he initially saw it it was a green lit up object (half circle shape) that very quickly dropped straight down, and then jolted up (to make a “J” shape, before it zoomed off. When I saw it zoom off, it was red—-when he saw it, it was green. I have never seen anything like it. This was my husands second UFO sighting— he saw another years ago and it was similar.

summary: Long group of objects that looked like stars but in our atmosphere. Disappeared quickly and seen black object shooting up.
description: There was like 11 individual stars from when i noticed it. Looked like a bunch of stars but they were in a straight line in groups of 3s. It was a long line spaced apart, i would imagine several miles in distance from the first to the last one. They were bright like stars but appeared low as if they were floating in the sky. It was much higher then a tall voltage line but lower then an airplane. An aircraft flew in between 2 of the points and you could tell the airplane was higher in elevation. After the plane went by then the objects started disappearing 1 by 1. Then I saw a black image shoot straight up between where the lights were, like a shooting star with no lights but going up. Then when they all disappeared, a moment later there was a white flash in the spot where the line was.

summary: Three orbs of blue light flying in a rotating triangle pattern moving from north to south. Moving fast estimated 300mph, or faster than commercial jet.
All white object hovering over West Los Angeles and then moving straight up slowly.
description: I initially thought this was a guy using a jet pack wearing an all white wing suit. The shape was like the Christ the Redeemer Statue. I observed it from the 405 freeway between the 90 and the 10. It appeared to be over Culver City, Cheviot Hills or maybe South Beverly Hills from my perspective. It was hovering and then moved slowly straight upwards. Someone else posted a sighting of this same object but a couple of hours earlier than me.

summary: What looked to be a point very still in sky
description: What looked like a stationary point of white in the sky seemed to disappear and re-appear from site. How ever it was so small in view it’s hard for our eyes to focus on it even just seeing it seconds before. Originally I thought a single object was moving to slightly different points in the sky. But the last time I saw an object it very much slowly drifted across the sky. By the last time seeing it/them I believe it was a sort of balloon at high altitude. And I feel now thinking about it that there were 3 separate ones that went by during my observation.

summary: Descending blue/white orb
description: Descending blue orb appear out of nowhere, shined bright blue/white light, briefly intensifying. As it moved in falling arcing motion from left to right (west to East) across horizon (viewing north from south of object’s position), its light intensified and it had a short tail that appeared to be the same light as the orb itself, then it extinguished in the air.

summary: Woke up Saturday night.  Pain was gone in my hip and buzzing sound above home. Strange green blue scanning light went thru home and outside.
description: Did not see craft was in home when green blue light like a scanner came into home and all of outside too scary also saw something big floating outside home thru drapes .

summary: Triangle shaped craft that moved like nothing I’ve ever seen.
description: While driving with my wife we both saw what at first appeared to be a large helicopter moving horizontally across the sky , it quickly turned and came straight at us and went right over head and we saw it plainly. It was moving like something out of a sci fi movie and was triangular in shape with what looked like a green and red arrow lights underneath. Definitely not a drone, helicopter or airplane. Just after we saw it my wife said , watch out for that deer crossing the road. It wasn’t a deer and we can both only describe it as a mix between a llama and a hyena. Don’t know if the two are connected but that’s what we saw. Was looking for a place to pull over to try to get a pic or video of the craft when we saw the animal then decided to just get the hell out of there. Rural road and we weren’t taking any chances.

summary: a drone or what appears to be an aircraft of some sort has been hovering every night at the corner of N. Craig and baum boulevard
description: it's white and is larger than stars and is seen nightly between the hours of 9pm and 10pm est hovering over the building of moorhead tower apartments or across the street from the building; as you walk down the street, the object appears to follow you; when you stop moving it stops moving; at times it is seen hovering directly over the building; numerous tenants in the building have observed this and classified it as a drone of some sort

summary: I saw a HUGE triangle craft with at least 7 bright white lights in a perfect “V” at the front and no lights on the backend of it
description: I was walking my dog with my son like I usually do around 9-10 pm and my son said “look dada” and he had pointed out a flying plane that you could see the red blinking lights and such and I’d say 4 seconds later, I looked away and looked up again and i see a HUGE triangle ship “gliding” across the sky. It was flying above the plane my son had pointed out and it was completely silent. The lights were bright in a perfect shaped “V” on the front of the triangle and it was flying about 78 degrees from the horizon so it was kinda above me. It was so big and I stared at it in awe and I had goosebumps and I felt happy as hell. Never in my life I have never seen anything like that and something that HUGE going across the sky and I say it was “gliding” because it did not move like a normal object. It seemed to go across the sky so effortlessly by just simply “gliding” on it. Lasted a solid 10 seconds max but that’s being lenient, it went across the sky really fast until it got out of my view across the top of my apartment building .

summary: Rhythmic Pattern on Lights on Large Circular Craft
description: 9:24 PM Nov 11,2023 Highland Village Texas. We were driving home and saw these strange lights in the sky behind the clouds. We stopped and observed the lights from the side of the road for about 3 minutes. There was not the tell tale sign of a ground based spot light or laser from the reflecting on the clouds, but these lights were behind the clouds. The lights moved in a specific pattern. First we saw two lights and then it would dance in a shuffling back and forth revealing four or five lights approximately, then one or two sustained lights on the far side and then sequentially shine one light at a time around the full circumference of the craft. A full light cycle lasted approximately 10 seconds. We saw four such cycles. I estimate 12 - 15 total lights around the circumference, but I could not see the backside. Our friend observed the lights from a different location independently from us and sent us the attached clip, he was much further away from the lights than we were respectively and captured less than one full cycle.

summary: Unidentified lights flying above.
description: I did not see these live. These lights were caught on my Ring doorbell camera and I noticed this four hours after it had happened. Four bright lights flying, no noise and fading one at a time and three of the lights were flying in a triangular motion. No other reports of sighting from local news websites.

summary: CCTV camera oriented South-East, capturing an object moving South to North direction.
description:
On November 11th 2023, between 6:36 39s and 6:36 43s PM, a fast-moving light, captured by my CCTV IR camera in Marquette-lez-Lille, appearing behind trees, at an estimate speed between Mach 2 to 4.
The object has been globally following an S>N trajectory.
Trees (poplars) are between 30 to 50 meters away from the camera, and they're very high (25? 30 meters?)
I was watching at the screen when it appeared, in a room with an open door to the outside, and no noise was heard at this moment.
After checking flightradar.com, there was not flight in the area possible to be mistaken with this objects.
On the original recording, flights before and after can clearly be seen as a reference to compare. The sky was clear on that day.
A bright star can also be seen in this footage, on its logical position for that day.
The object is clearly moving behind the trees, and can't be a bug in the IR light.(IR exposition doesn't exceed 20 - 30 meters).
Unclear which object the witnessif referring to in video.

summary: Floating rectangle with 3 lights
description: Last night, I had a wtf moment, still not sure what to make of it. I have never seen anything I could not identify before. I've been outside day and night my whole life, never seen anything strange. On my way home from Portland around 630pm or so, I was about halfway home and south of Windham a few miles, on a dark two lane road through rolling small hills, no shoulder, forest on each side with sometimes trees hanging over the road. In a break of the trees, out my front windshield at about my 1 o'clock and above the tree tops, I saw a vertical object just floating in the sky (it was not moving) about 1k ft in the air, maybe a little lower. It was hard to tell how far away it was from me but probably less than 1/4 mile. Because it was hard to tell how far away it was it’s hard to tell how big it was but im guessing it was between the size of a Chevy Suburban and a city bus, maybe bigger if it was standing on its end. It was backlit at the top like there was a light behind it and then facing me were 3 lights in a vertical row and I believe they dimmed and brightened in sequence. Because of the light behind it I could see the outline of it so i could tell it was an elongated…

summary: I walked out of my garage looked up at the sky and saw a triangle of three lights two green and one white .
description: I had been texting my friend after putting away the dogs in the garage and I walked outside and heard what sounded like a plane. I looked up and saw a triangle of three green and white dots steadily moving across the sky. I tried to take pictures but they wouldn’t turn out and the UFO looked like a blob on camera. Soon it was out of sight Begins trees and I no longer heard it.

summary: Saw it as I was heading home,it felt like something was digging around my head but I got a photo
description: It looked like the ufos you see in movies and was moving horizontally and the lights flashed then paused for a few seconds then flashed again, like a pulse. When I tried getting pictures, my phone started lagging as if something was preventing me from getting an image. I definitely observed one but as I watched it, it felt like something was in my mind. It disappeared and I went inside. Despite how far it was, before and after the encounter I could and can still smell a burnt metallic scent and I can feel something pulsing in my head, the same rhythm as the ship was. This isn’t the first time I have seen it, in fact it is the fourth time. However I dismissed it the first few times

summary: Large unidentifiable aircraft flying. The UFO disappeared on in front of my eyes.
description:
At first sight I thought it was a helicopter low in the sky, traveling south east. Then the UFO quickly descended to the height of a 40 story building. At lower elevation the sphere looked like the size of a bicycle.
The object swiftly fly east towards an apartment building. Then the object descended down towards the building, as I watched it disappeared in front of my eyes.

summary: three orange balls of light going east to west one at a time at about the speed of a jet.
description: The was no noise as I am used to seeing jets go over. These had no noise and did not change their path. Each seemed to originate from same area of the skyline and disappeared in the same area of skyline. They were about 20 seconds apart from each other. I have seen many things but not like these.

summary: Fast moving bright light overhead. Not a normal aircraft! Then disappeared. Clear night.
description: Bright light overhead, clear night. Fast moving, disappeared quickly while still well above horizon. I don't think it was a meteor or aircraft even though this is the flight path for our municipal airport. Had headphones on couldn't hear if it made sound.

summary: Bright light ball.
description: I was getting out of my car and looked up and saw a bright round ball that speed away south extremely fast and disappeared. It did have a light trail when it accelerated.

summary: 5 of us (4 Adults, one (1) 7 year old. Flew over at about 300-750 ft altitude
description:
Firstly, this is fresh. This literally just happened 1 hour ago.
4 adults and one 7 year old child saw the following.
My wife, daughter and I were dropping off her friend at her house in the country by Dixon, CA. We arrived at approximately 6:45PM on 11/10/2023. It was dark and the sky was mostly clear with some scattered clouds. They live in the country and there is very little light pollution. My daughters friend ran in the house as soon as we arrived. However, we stay on the porch talking we her parents for 10 minutes or so like we always do. Suddenly, we heard the oscillating rumble of an aircraft coming from the northeast (more east than north). I immediately noticed the rumble was deep but I assumed it was just a low flying life flight helicopter coming to land at its home at the Nut Tree Airport which was just a few miles away. However, as it got closer the house literally began to shake (Windows, glasses on their laundry room table tops, etc.) Still thinking that it was a helicopter I instinctively looked up as it began to fly over.
At first I couldn't make out what I was seeing. It happened all at once and it was a wave of visual mathematics that my mind was working to…

summary: Basketball sized ball of light, about the same brightness as a flood light flying low and slow.
description: Driving east bound Friday November 10 at 6:13am on highway 285 near the intersection of S Sheridan Blvd and Highway 285, I looked to my left (north north east), and there was a large ball of light. The ball of light was approximately the size of a basketball with a dark core, the majority of the light coming from the outer edges. It was moving too slow/low to be an airplane in this area. It was significantly brighter than anything I have ever seen in the sky (while flying or on the ground). If holding an object at arm’s length away to cover the object, it would be the size of a basketball. It looked like there were multiple lights on the outer edges of the sphere when looking at it. The color was a bright white with the middle of the orb a darker color. There looked like there was an aura around the object, I'm not quite sure how to describe it. It looked like when you can see the heat around a hot oven after opening it. The middle was not black but there was significantly less light coming from the middle. When I grabbed my phone to take a picture of it, it became significantly smaller and dimmer before it disappeared. It was light outside when this happened and I could not see…

summary: Alien standing on the front porch
description: There was a reptilian looking alien thing standing on my front porch. Head shape changed smaller to large, neck was vibrating, had a gold orb thing floating around. Boyfriend couldn’t see him at all when looking directly at it.

summary: My boyfriend and I both saw a bright large light that appeared to roll a few times
description: It appeared to be flying toward us with a single bright light then appeared to roll a few times with 2-3 dots of lights that streamed down from it, then began flying north with a tail that seemed to drag behind it

summary: Lighted objects "dancing" and performing seemingly impossible aeronautic maneuvers
description: Passenger aircraft cruising at FL34,000. I was a crew member that entered flightdeck mid-flight. Two other crew members pointed out the 4 lights they had been watching for 45 minutes. Lights flying in circles vertically, horizontally as well as tight zig zag patterns, then flying straight upward. The circular motions were like a dance. No regular patterns, but incredibly fast maneuvers. The lights would disappear and reappear occasionally. The altitude of the objects was unknown, but they were so high that they never left our view during that time. I watched them for 15 minutes before allowing another crew member to observe as well. As our pilot said, "no aircraft exists that can perform those maneuvers." Four crew members witnessed.

summary: Spotted 5, stationary, glowing objects over Skagit Valley
description: I spotted five round, glowing red craft hovering over the Skagit Valley, when looking eastbound from Fidalgo Island. They did not move. All stayed in formation and kept an even distance from one another. There were two, noticeably larger ones of similar size to each other and three smaller ones around the same size. An aircraft passed by during this time, but they did not react to the aircraft.

summary: They were in a circular formation. There might’ve been two clusters, but that’s because I was at two different places for it.
description:
I was walking my dog with my father on the loop around my neighborhood, hidden oaks and basswood streets, when we saw a ring of 11 white orbs. We live in Eden Prairie, MN.
I was watching from in front of the entrance of my neighborhood and the sidewalk/path near it.

summary: Long slow moving straight line of lights that change color and shape that dim like a light bulb
description: Standing in the Wendy's parking lot looking westbound over the Chase Bank parking lot at approximately 6:45 p.m. on November 9th, I witnessed 19 lights in a straight line appear out of the dark sky slowly float eastbound. The line of lights slowly changed brightness like the dimming of a dining room light in different sequences and then in gradation from one end to the other in a repeated pattern. As the single line of lights traveled eastbound overhead and higher into the sky the 19 lights starting at the most northern point started to dim out of existence until the last light went dark. This display of lights occurred for approximately 5 to 10 minutes.

summary: We were on our way home from the VA Hospital.
description: We were on the way home my wife and two children, the lights appeared in the sky, we talked about it, took a photo and kept going home to look up what it was we might have seen.

summary: Very slow fading orange circle that didn't appear to move.
description: While traveling South on the Foley Beach Express, we observed at first one orange circular light in the southern sky. This orange light would appear for about 10 seconds before slowly fading. A short time later we observed two orange lights in the same position. These lights appeared then faded in about 7 second intervals. After their third appearance, these lights faded and did not reappear. These lights did not seem to change position at any time. We estimate their location to be somewhere over the eastern side of Gulf Shores, Alabama.

summary: Observed an anomaly of lights in the sky
description: It appeared fixed in the black sky for 15 seconds. I was driving and couldn’t pull j er due to traffic. I rounded a bend and it appeared in a different area of the sky at the same elevation. It’s possible it was in the same location and just appeared to move due to orientation of the road but I don’t think so. Then it simply disappeared

summary: Series of lights moving slowly across the sky in a stright line. Most of the lights were solid but some were blinking.
description: A straight line of lights were moving slowly across the evening sky. Never saw anything like it. They all moved in a line following one another, some were solid and others were blinking. Only lasted maybe a few minutes if that. Their were many and not a small amount again moving in a straight line, slow!

summary: 2 gleaming white objects flying in formation across the sky
description:
My mother and I saw several objects in the sky at approx 430pm this afternoon November 9, 2023. It was about 80° with mostly clear skies and some stratus clouds way up. They were heading about 30°N and flew across
half the sky for about 30 seconds while we watched from the dock. Waaay high up - they went into super high stratus clouds towards the end but we could still see them through the clouds for a bit. I saw 2 aircraft with no wings - but there was something folded over on the sides. And they were big enough that we could see that detail from that high. I saw the 2 aircraft flying in perfect formation, but one of them kindof twisted and looked like there could be two craft on top of each other, then they merged again. They gleamed white in the sunlight. There was no trail behind them and absolutely no sound. Mom agrees that we have absolutely no idea what they were. My father was an engineer for the Air Force and designed several planes, including working on the B2 stealth bomber, so my mother and I are both familiar with different aircraft. We currently live near NAS JAX and are used to seeing all sorts of aircraft, but these were like nothing we have ever seen.

summary: There was a black but yet reflective basic saucer shaped UAP.
description: Sighting was viewed from my back yard. Visible just above the tree line looking to be but only a few city blocks away was one reflective black UAP. It zig-zagged about left to right and up and down for several minutes I'd say about 4 or 5 minutes. Then it just disappeared NOT zipping off but just diapering, poof gone!

summary: A silver metallic disc rising vertically from the ground.
description: On my way to work I saw off to my right a silver metallic disk like craft rising vertically from the ground. It seemed to be half a mile away rising from an open field. I watched it until the nearby woods obscured it. Once I got clear of the trees I stopped to look for it but it was gone. The disc was flat with a slight bulge in the center top. I could see the sunlight reflecting off the outside. I drove back and forth the same way the same time over several days trying to see if it was caused by the rising sun but I never saw anything like it again.

It got slightly brighter as it moves towards the south. There were no other lights on this orb and not a visible craft.

summary: silent as in no air moving at low speed moderate altitude

It was almost the color of the the night sky, although a few shades lighter. Said craft then traveled southwest towards downtown and blended in with the lighter pitch of the city lights. The event was approximately 45 seconds in duration at approximately 2132 hours.

I went inside and around 9:20 I heard a loud aircraft and felt my house shake, so there may be another one flying around, or the same one.

summary: Three bright white lights in a non-equilateral triangle formation. Close enough together and large enough to not be satellites/planes.
description:
After dropping off a friend at his house in northern Everett, WA, while still sitting in my car, I saw the objects through my open window towards the south. There were three bright white lights in the sky approximately 35-40 degrees above the horizon. The three lights were in a non-equilateral formation and slowly moving independently of each other. They were much brighter and larger in the sky than any star, planet, or satellite I have seen. Based on the brightness and apparent distance, they seemed too close together to be landing lights on three separate planes and too far apart to be lights from a single plane. They also did not resemble flares in any way.
I watched them for about 1-2 minutes before pulling away and for some odd reason I did not think to take a photo or a video. Once I got home, I saw on Facebook that 2 other people who live in the area saw the exact same objects and one of those people took a good video of the objects while driving in the same area that I had been in when I saw them.
After thinking for awhile at home, I remembered that about 30 more to an hour before the sighting, I had been sitting in a church in downtown Everett, WA and I had heard the…

summary: Large helicopter chasing an amber glowing orb
description: I was walking my dog in the Woodcreek North neighborhood with my wife around 8pm. We heard a LOUD helicopter flying overhead which is common in the area, but this one was much larger than any I have seen and a lot louder. It was too dark to make out if it was military or not, but my hunch is that it was. Way out in front of the helicopter was a glowing orb (amber in color) just flying, not blinking. The helicopter was in steady pursuit but not gaining on it. We watched for a good two minutes until both were out of sight. The objects were probably about 1,000 feet in elevation.

summary: light appeared/turned on and traveled instantly many miles. not sure if it turned off or disappeared due to distance
description: Driving south on 4910 E County Rd 64 and suddenly a light appeared several hundred to thousand feet above me. My windows were up and I was unable to hear anything audibly. Also, there was no visible lights leading up to this point and I had been on the road for 1/2 mile, since the nearest exit (278). The light instantly travelled in the straightest of lines thousands of feet to a couple of miles before turning off or disappearing. All of this took place in less than 2 seconds. I've seen hundreds of shooting stars and this was nothing like it. I jokingly told myself it was a farmer with a drone observing his fields. After dinner, I found articles talking about the mystery lights in Eastern Colorado that people have been reporting. I've only lived her for 2 months, so I had never heard of such. One of the articles mentioned this web site and I am her to make a report. There is no way this was a shooting star or a drone based off of current known technologies due to the speed it traveled.

summary: 3 separate moving craft spotted between 5:36pm and 5:45pm, all coming across the sky from a similar point of origin and disappearing

I then noticed a smaller object in the sky that was maybe the size and shape of a matchbox held far away. It was glowing white in color, with a slight bright yellow hue to it. As the plane appeared to be flying Southwest, the object appeared to be flying towards the plane from the Northwest in a Southeastern direction, and appeared to almost intersect with the airplane at one time. It looked like they crossed the same point in the sky from my eye line, but the object appeared to be much further away than the airplane.
Not more than a couple minutes later, I noticed another bright object of similar shape and color flying in the same path as the previous object. They both appeared to get smaller as they flew into the Southeastern sky until they were no longer visible. I had eyes on each for less than a minute with a clear blue sky and no cloud blocking the view.
At 5:45 I noticed I spotted the third object flying across the sky from the same origin and direction as…

Each large bright white light rotated in various directions. It had 2 beams of light that darted around downward & turned on & off. After about 20 minutes, it began to lift up farther into the sky & then swooped upward. It then shot straight up into the sky towards the atmosphere & disappeared.

summary: An oval-like light shot across the sky from north to south within 3 seconds.
description: I was walking my dog down the sidewalk, around 12:40 am. I’m not sure of the exact time, but it was at some point between 12:30 and 12:50. The light was oval-shaped, but it was more like 2 curved lines that didn’t quite meet at the north and south ends. I was startled by how fast it was, faster than a commercial airplane. Within less than three seconds, the light was past my point of view. It also seemed too close to the ground, maybe a bit above the cloud line, to be a satellite. It was fairly cloudy, but not overcast, and all I could see of the object was the light. It was also quite windy, so I’m not sure if it made any sound. The light itself was a soft white, with a hint of yellow. It reminded me of a ring light, in terms of its brightness. It moved straight from north to south, until I couldn’t see beyond the tree line in the neighborhood. I’m not sure of its exact size, because I couldn’t tell how far away it was, but I would guess about the size of a plane. As for my own background, I’m a 30 year old woman. I wasn’t tired when this occurred, since I’m used to being up late, and I was sober.

There was also occasionally a very small faint white-blue flashing and faint reddish flashing lights too. It appeared to hovered and would very slowly move up and down and east and west several times. I watched it until 1am then went to bed. She watched it until 2am then went to bed with it still there in the sky.

The craft moved to my right (westbound). Due to tree coverage, I lost sight of it quickly, to which I never located it again, maintaining visual contact for less than 10 seconds. While it appeared very low, it is difficult to determine distance, size, and speed, given the relationship between those factors. I did not hear any noises, however I was at speed on the roadway inside a vehicle.
I am privy to what helicopters and airplanes look like in the sky, frequently working alongside medical flight crews in the area, and where nearby airports are, making me somewhat familiar with common areas of the sky in which low air travel is common. This was unlike anything I had ever witnessed.
