summary: Object was briefly stationary, before traveling in an apparent fish hook shape. Then vanished.
description:
Had arrived outside my home at roughly 8:26 or 8:27pm on November the 5th, 2023. I had parked my car in the street, with the driver's side facing South. I had gathered my things and stepped outside my vehicle. When I closed the door, I had been facing south. A single, large orb of white light was spotted in the Southeast, above a neighbor's house. It appeared to be stationary. The orb then began to travel east, accelerating as it did. The object then made a fish hook maneuver down and then towards the West before vanishing from sight. There were no other witnesses present, and the entire event lasted less than a minute in length. Other than the sight of the object and the fish hook path it took, nothing else was deemed unusual.
Observer is a white male, in his early 30s. Does not have superstitious or supernatural proclivities. Has observed meteorological phenomenon in area before; including comets, meteor showers, and a shooting star. There are also several airports in the region, as well an FAA tech center. There is also occasional air traffic from Coast Guard aircraft.

summary: Shiny silver sphere reflecting the setting sun moved south away from my viewpoint
description: First noticed in the sky as it was shiny and not moving. No chemtrails like 3 other high altitude airplanes in the sky at the time. Mentioned to other parents. Took 3 pictures roughly 30 seconds apart until it disappeared from view keeping the same plane in view for correlation. Best view is in first picture where the shape can be discerned well.

summary: Metallic spinning object twinkling in the sun. Spinning consistently with what looked like lights as well.
description: An object was crossing the sky in a seeming straight line and consistent slowish speed (a plane flew lower and went much faster). The sun was reflecting off the object so it was bright but it was spinning so it was twinkling. No sound. A plane flew under nearby it much faster and louder. I noticed it on the horizon and watched it cross across the sky above me for at least 5 minutes. Took a cell phone video which also seems to show it was spinning. No spoke or trail behind it. Thought it may be a balloon but appeared higher than the plane and also would have had to be very large to be visible from there. Also it was at a consistent speed and spin, not appearing to be in the wind.

summary: We have been seeing a white orb along the orbit of Venus nearly all day and night.
description: We have been seeing a white dot kn the sky approximately at sunrise everyday, whenever it is dark or dim out. It is stationary, doesn’t twinkle or flicker, and is in the exact same spot everyday. A thin shell also appears on the ”corona” of the object. On November 14th and 4th, the object moved southeast, but not too much.

summary: 4 circles traveling at an insanely high speed relatively low to the ground. They were traveling together with some space in between.
description: See above

summary: The object was picked up on my ring. Which I thought odd and assumed it was possibly someone's drone until I saw the duration.
description: It was recorded on a ring, flying low. It was more of a triangular shape. The object moved at reasonable rate so I thought until I saw the duration of time that passed. I also have screen shots.

summary: Object very bright, changed shape and colors, height, direction
description: Very bright white light through leafless tree. Gained elevation and omitted blue light. Changed shape and direction. There is a cell phone tower with a blinking white light because the red light burned out. Thinking it was observing the cell tower.

summary: Object changed shape, color, height, direction. Would morph, brighter, dimmer. Sighting ended as it spun and seemed to disintegrate
description: My first report was hurriedly done and pics were trapped in my camera. I watched a very bright light through our leafless tree for a couple minutes. I called my husband and we watched together a couple more minutes with binoculars. My husband saw a blue aura. I saw a blue light burst from upper left of object. I got my canon camera and took still shots and 2 videos for 5 minutes. Object started below the trees and then went high. Would go farther than closer. Sighting ended as it seemed to spin and disintegrate. An hour or 2 later a chopper flew over and headed east to where we saw the object. There is a cell phone tower with a burned out red light. When that happens a white light blinks like a strobe light. We wondered if the UFO was attracted to the cell tower. I inquired at the sheriff’s office about any reports. They said no. I didn’t leave my name. Area is sparsely populated.

summary: Bright light behind fuzzy cloud.
description: @1730 .Dark,no clouds. Milky Way present. Son and I heading back to hunting camp. We noticed a very bright light that was directly behind a cloudy,or,hazy substance. There were no clouds . Clear night. This light was coming over Sheep Mountain. Coming from the North and NorthWest. Approximately 15-20 thousand feet in altitude. We were approaching Sheep Mountain to our North, North West. Nearest town from the approach angle is Gunnison, Colorado. Hunting camp near Sheep Mountain was @10,100 feet in elevation. Sheep Mountain is over 13,000 feet. We first thought it was a plane's nose light. Thought it was odd about the haze in front of this light. Son turned his headlamp on,and, this object veered to our left,gradually. Travelling South to SouthEast. Saw no id lights,and, no noise. Did not see an object. Light went off,and sky was clear. No object. Other hunters did not see,or, hear anything.

summary: Bright silver object that looked almost like a star.
description: I was driving home from work, and I noticed a bright silver reflection in the sky, I thought maybe it was a plane or helicopter but it appeared to not be moving and after starting for a few seconds I began to wonder if maybe it was the North Star because of how bright it was. After about 15 seconds, it broke into 4 other bright silver reflecting/star like light and then appeared to vanish or camouflage to the sky. It has me so perplexed.

summary: The craft was on a southeastern direction. The craft was at the altitude of passenger aircraft and traveling at the same speed as one.
description: It didn’t make any noise, it is very quiet in Silverwood. There weren’t any contrails. It didn’t have wings.

summary: Silver round ball in sky heading towards Fond Du Lac county on 23
description: My husband and I were driving back home on I43 near the exit for 23 when my husband got my attention to an object that was a sphere and silver and shiny, had to be of decent size in the sky. After a minute 1 round light turned on that was white in color, for a few seconds we lost site of the image and when we seen it the sphere was entirely black and going behind a cloud until it was gone. Was moving slowly, then would hover for a few seconds. It just vanished. Watched for it on 23 and seen nothing more.

summary: Late at night, was flashed through window
description: Curtains were open, blue object had no sound and hoovered long enough to flash me with white beam through window, then floated away. It was very late at night. Will take lie detector test. Other things have been happening too, since the incident. I have audio I'd like someone to hear.

summary: Flying triangle
description: Three circles (they seemed to be pretty big) arranged in a triangular configuration supposedly of one object. Fast as hell. Didn't made even a little bit of noise

summary: My mom walked outside she saw something in the kept looking seen it move and do odd things then I started recording it
description: I seen the light do multiple things disappear come back go into mist shoot up real quick start falling down look like it was blowing up it was crazy it changed colors went into different object shapes legit crazy experience I have it all on record

summary: 7 or so bright orbs traveling in formation and as they got to the big dipper changed into V-shape and disappeared.
description:
My son says Mom, what’s that and I look up to see about 7 round white orb looking objects traveling in a straight line formation but, as they approach the big dipper "handle", they changed formation into almost a V-shape, and they disappeared. No noise, no wings, no smoke. I tried to get my phone one but, they were gone. It would be easier to draw a picture of what I saw to explain it better.
I tried to check satellite websites for any launches (I've seen the satellites in the sky when they launch, and it was nothing like that).  I tried to check for any possible military training because we live next to a small coast guard base and 3hrs away from Joint Base Lewis McCord military base but, I couldn't find anything saying that they had training that night. Also, I've seen/heard a lot of military aircraft fly by, and these were completely silent. If I wasn't looking up, I would have completely missed them. The only noise was from other people on the street saying, “Oh my god, what is that!”.
I waited to report this because I assumed an article would come out saying they had satellites, trainings, or something to explain what I saw. Obviously, I'm no expert but, I know what I saw.…

summary: Rectangular light fixed in the Northwestern sky for over 3 hours.
description: My wife and I were sitting outside giving out Halloween candy to the kids when I noticed a bright rectangular white light (with binoculars looked like two lights on top of a long bright light) to the NortWest. Wind blowing at ground level but rock steady. Maintained the same position for three hours before it became too cold and we went inside. Airplanes flying over and under. Clearly not an airplane or helicopter or consumer drone (no drone can hover for three hours). I am a retired police officer with an aviation background and hold an FAA Commercial Pilot certificate.

location: Anchieta, Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
summary: I have being recording these objects over all airplanes near Salgado Filho Internacional AirPort. Footage reduced 8 times . iPhone XR
description: I have being recording these extremily fast flying objects for the past 2 month. I have 14 vídeos using my iPhone XR at 60fps . In this footage a football shape object appears from the right then flyes in front of a plane then turns left going over the road. Speed of the footage reduced 8 times .

summary: A spherical bright light spot that moved faster than planes at that altitude.
description:
I was on flight NK2060 MCO-BOS seating on 25A (window on Port side of the plane) enjoying my vacation. The descent had already started and we were around 15 minutes from landing. I estimate the altitude should be around 6000 feet. I was looking at the window and recognizing other Aircraft models that passed by (I like to do that since I work at an airport and I’m interested in planes). I recognized several of them, but suddenly I saw this spherical object reflecting very bright white blueish light going SW direction. I mean it passed in the opposite direction we were heading and I could see it for about 7 seconds and I didn’t have enough time to grab a camera. It passed by us I would say not more than 1 mile below and 1 mile East and moved at at least double speed of other aircrafts.
It had nothing to do with any aspect of an aircraft.

summary: Highly reflective slow moving object.
description: Too high to see a shape but below the clouds. I took notice because the sun was reflecting erratically off of it and was very bright. Unlike it would on a plane. Though it moved about as fast a plane would be moving at that altitude so I thought ok maybe a plane until. It was heading west at first for about 1 and a half minutes then took a sudden turn to the north east for a minute. It then took a turn to the north east for a minute then again to the north until I could not see it anymore. Not 5 minutes later a military highflyer left a white stream across the sky headed the same direction. Not much of a sighting I guess but I really don't think it was just a plane. Wish I had more to report.

summary: Saw a fast moving object.
description: While waiting in front of my house with my two kids and wife for school bus to arrive, we saw a fast, shiny, object moving high in the sky. The object had no white streaks, or flashing lights the way a jet does. It appeared to be moving very fast then it slowed down and then it moved fast again.

summary: Seen bright white circular object above clouds. Traveling at a constant speed. I pulled over to take video.
description:
Bright white chrome ish circular object. Traveling west to East. At a constant speed .high above clouds foor 8 mins. I could not get on video.....I was on crafts street in newton Massachusetts.
I checked with flight app at same time. No planes or helicopters in my area at that exact moment.

summary: Saw red blinking lights in formation evenly spaced out and blinking in synchronized manner.
description: Several lights about 6 or 7 blinking red and appeared to be evenly spaced and and blinking in synchronized manner from right to left. Appeared to be all one solid piece by the blinking and spacing all moving evenly across the sky. Obtained some video of it. If lights were one solid object then this object was massive. Estimate about 300 yards across. Disappeared as it floated out of sight moving west toward Orange County Ca.

summary: A big ship like an egg but oval with lights on the bottom
All three edges of triangle glowed blue. Horizon to horizon-5 seconds. No sound at all.
description: see above

summary: White light moving across sky expels plume.
description: White circular light moving in what seemed to be a fog on a clear night. It moved across the sky staying as a white circle for a few minutes. It appeared to stop, change shapes, get brighter, then a plume expelled from it. Before the plume happened you could see a perfect circle in the center, inside another circle. There is a moment before the plume that the white light reforms as a triangle inside the circle. Then it started to head away from us and became dimmer.

summary: Bright large round object that projects some type of cicular wave fying by
description:
I routinely record timelapse of sunrise and sunsets. Great condition to see 'red skies" on Monday so I broadcast the sunset live on Instagram and also recording a timelaspe to post later. Stopped all recording after sun was down. Still really clouds flowing so I started a new time-lapse 7:37pm - 10:34pm. Downloaded the file and did a quick view before deleting as intended. The flying object showed up a 7:54. I'm close to a small aiport so I'm seeing planes all the time gut nothing like this. I looks huge compared to the other planes flying by that night. It caught my attention immediately and then it does something that projects forward that resembles a sonic smoke right.
Captured on a Wyze 2k camera with timestamps.

summary: A light moving southwest to the east then changing to a southeast heading
description: The light seemed to be flying through a cloud, had a haze around it and seemed to be a directional light changing where it was pointing a couple of times. I am an air traffic controller and the light was verified by a pilot but not seen by our radar services. When the light got south of the airfield it had a seemingly burst of gas the shot out in front of it like a cone shape and then the light slowly faded until it was spotted again about 30 seconds later further to the southeast looking more like a bright star while moving and faded out very rapidly after about 10 seconds and then faded again until it was no longer visible or observed.

summary: I saw a yellow light. It blew a smoke ring as it left the area.
description: I was in the Dollar Tree parking lot waiting for my kids to come to the vehicle and I noticed something out of the corner of my eye. I turned to look and saw a smoke ring blow off of the light-yellow orb light. By the time I got my camera up to video, the light had moved away but you can barely see it at the two sec mark traveling away in the video I took. It made no noise whatsoever. You can hear the toddler in the vehicle saying something about fireworks. She thought it was fireworks, she saw it as well. She is only two but she saw it. The light looked large and nearby, smoke ring looked very close not far away in the sky so it was either very big and far away or it was local. It was large when first spotted and moved away quickly after the smoke ring shot out.

summary: Hazy light in sky blows smoke ring
description:
Myself, my husband, and a friend saw a hazy light moving through the sky at high speed. It started mid sky moving toward the horizon. The light at its core appeared to turn occasionally but the haziness around it never faded. At about 25 degrees in the sky, it released a puff smoke but in front of it, not behind it. The puff of smoke turned into a massive smoke ring which it then proceeded to move through. Near the horizon, maybe 10 degrees it completely disappeared. It didn't fade out, was just gone. It was one light, white, with a bright light at the center.
The stars were perfectly clear which is why the hazy light stood out. Planes and satellites were also viewable and perfectly clear. I've attached a video and you can even see the stars and the difference.
My husband unfortunately stopped recording right before it released the smoke.

summary: Saw a very bright light, pushed out halo of light
description: My wife and I saw a very bright light south of highway. Light was moving SSE. Light appeared to be behind mist as if in fog, but no clouds were in sky. Witnessed a plane fly in close proximity to bright light but did not have the same hazed effect. Object appeared to increase in speed after plane went by. Object suddenly grew in intensity of brightness then appeared to pulse out sphere of light that could be seen growing out from center like a ripple in a pond. Got binoculars on object as it was going over horizon at a very far distance. Could see two distinct lights. Called parents later to discuss. They live south of Pagosa Springs, CO approx 8 miles. They said they and my brother saw a very similar object about 30 min before we did. Said they viewed with binoculars and the object had what appeared to be a tower on top with multiple squares of light. Had a large rectangular or possibly cylindrical light source on bottom that was source of most of the light. They described the object pushing out light more as if it was pushing out mist that was lit up by the object.

summary: Fuzz ball coming from the west. Other stars , planets were sharp. Fuzz ball passed heading south east.
description: Just one object moving southeast. It’s like it had a cloud around it.

summary: Glowing pure white circular orb with halo and small brighter circular center that comprised about 10% of the area of the orb.
description: The object was a very prominent pure white orb with a contiguous white halo and a brighter circular center about one tenth its overall diameter. It was seen for about five minutes traveling through a clear dark sky prior to the moon rising. The object, including its halo, was about the diameter of the mid-day sun. It was traveling at a constant pace from West to East approximately 70 degrees up from the southwest horizon. The object appeared to be within the atmosphere. An approximation of its size would depend on its altitude but it was far larger than a commercial aircraft, satellite, surveillance balloon or meteorite. An approximation of its speed would also depend on its altitude. If it was flying at 30,000 feet I would approximate its speed as twice to three times that of a commercial jet or military transport. If it was in orbit it would be traveling about the speed of a satellite. The speed, altitude and trajectory did not change during our observation of its path. Additionally, there was a narrow diagonal, linear white light, separate but in close proximity to the orb, emerging upward at about 1:00 to 2:00 and about equal in length to the diameter of the orb including its…

summary: 1 orb with hazy aura
description:
Aura was around the object, no clouds were in sight so it is unexplained why it looked like that,
Moved at a low-high rate of speed southeast

summary: Glowing object in the sky with a slightly erratic flight pattern moving from SW to SE
description: I left my daughter’s house and saw a glowing, round object in the sky. It didn’t have a defined shape. It was moving from SW to SE in a slightly erratic flight pattern. I knew it wasn’t a plane because it didn’t have any of the blinking lights that planes have and it didn’t have a contrail. I took a photo and then a video, both with my iPhone. I phoned my husband, we live next door, and asked him to come out quickly to look at this object. He agreed that it didn’t appear to be a plane. The object went out of view after a couple minutes due to tree and building obstructions. If you look carefully at the video, you can see that sometimes it moves slightly up and down and then straight. I didn’t look carefully at the still photo until the following day, October 31st. When I enlarged it as much as I could, I was a bit shocked by what I saw. The photo is why I am contacting you. The object has an irregular shape and seems to be emitting its own light causing a glow. There are three “lines “coming down from the shape. It’s just really strange. I showed this to several people and we all agree that it’s certainly not a plane. I would love to know what you think it could be. It appears you…

summary: Fuzzy Soft White light traveling ESE
description:
I was on my outside deck setting up my telescope. I do astrophotography. Facing S, I looked up and noticed this Fuzzy Soft White light moving E then SE for about 30 seconds to 1 minute. Not one cloud in the sky. This is the second time I have seen the same object in the same or close location. The second time I had my wife as a witness.
The first time I saw it, about 2 weeks prior, it only lasted about 5 seconds and disappeared. I couldn’t believe what I had just seen. The sky’s were totally clear except for the far E. The object appeared as though it was behind a cloud bank, maybe trying to cloak itself to keep from being identified.
We have dozens of planes flying each night close to our house and this was no plane, not even close. It was about about the size of a dime or penny held at arms length.

summary: I large light, no blinking lights, obscured by a fog in the sky moving to the southeast with no sound. 360 deg pressure wave dispersed.
description: On October 30, 2023 at 6:51 PM, I arrived home and as I got out of my car I noticed a strange light in the sky above my house towards the west. It was rapidly getting dark and this steady glowing light that was slowly moving to the southeast was obscured by a kind of fog even though it was a completely clear night. There was no sound at all emanating from this object, there were no other lights and no blinking lights like a plane. I got my wife from the house, I took 1 picture and thought I started a video but actually didn’t. Ugg. We watched it drift over us and towards the southeast and it was hard to tell how high it was with this weird fog around it, 2000 to 5000 ft high maybe. At one point a jet flew between us and this object and the contrast of a completely in focus commercial jet and this weird silent foggy light. Right at the end as it was about to go out of sight we both witnessed a 360 degree, what I would call a pressure wave, emanate outward from this object and a fast pace and dissolve. That pressure wave was the absolute most unreal thing I have ever seen. It then continued out of site to the southeast over the Manzano mountains. This was no balloon, it's not the…

summary: Slow moving light with antenna in back while moving sprayed particls in shape of smoke ring/circle in front/downward of it.
description: Was watering plants in back yard saw light above/south in the sky moving east from the west. Did not look like any plane or military aircraft. Had no noise. Called a friend outside to take a look at it with me. He did not know what it was. I went inside and grabbed my bird watching binoculars and looked at it some more. It had no shape just a round light but on the back of it there was a stick like protrusion at a 45 degree angel. It looked like a folded up umbrella or a parachute that failed to inflate. The protrusion seemed very rigid and did not change shape. It was headed SE over KAFB or four hills and I saw it emit a spray in a round shape like a smoke ring. In a slightly down ward angle. The spray/emission was much bigger then the light that produced it. I then proceeded to access my roof (took one min)to get a better view and it was gone.

summary: White circle with green light flying downward then horizontal and quickly beamed out of site.
White orb disappears
description:
I was standing in front of my house looking up through the oak trees that line the street. I was looking up through the branches on a sunny day with the sun being blocked out by the branches. I was watching pollen, bugs, spider webs, and other Earthly objects moving through the trees. I noticed a white orb moving in a llinear line going from south to north but changing path from flying straith to erratic to stoping and changing directions and moving in ways that none of the other objects I had been watching for ten minutes by the trees was. This ggot my attention so I began to watch just this object (it was near the sun so it was hard to observe without the the tree obscuring the sun.
The object stopped as if it new I could see it and I was trying to ascertain the distance to the object (former military with the Cav scouts so I am good at ffiguring out how far away something is) the object imploded on itself and disappeared right before my eyes. The object never mad a sound or left any sort of contrail. The object was moving behind everything else that I was watching.

summary: Was working in the field looked up and saw what seemed to be constellations in the sky and told a friend to see what I see
description: It was like looking at the night sky but in the day time. From about 30 to 40 objects as if they were forming patterns in the sky. Then I took out my phone and filmed for about a minute and 15 seconds. Incredible.....

summary: Looked up into sky at the moon, saw a whitish-silver, rounded double decker bus shaped object flying in a northern direction
description: This morning at 7:55 AM I was walking my dog and looked up into the sky and saw the moon. I was standing on Spring Street at the corner of Fourth Street at that time. To the lower right of the moon there was an odd shaped flying object in the sky that was clearly visible and not a plane. It was whitish-silver in color, it had the appearance of a solid object that resembled a rounded edged double decker bus. At one point it briefly changed shape into a flatter version within a gray cloud of dust then returned to the rounded double decker bus shape and the gray cloud of dust disappeared as quickly as it appeared. The object flew in a northern direction for approximately 5 minutes as I walked along the street with my dog and then it disappeared from view when the bright sunlight struck the object as I reached the corner of Spring and E. Morehead Streets. When it was visible it was extremely high in the sky and there was no exhaust trail.

summary: Appears to be an Alien I took pics of in the sky
description: This is not a hoax!! I would never report something fake!!!! I was sitting in my SUV at 8:12 pm on Oct 29, 2023. I noticed this light in the sky and it was moving. It was circular and moving around. I thought oh its probably a satellite. So, I used my iphone 14 pro max and zoomed in 15x and took some rather unusual photo’s. Some were taken with flash off and some with it on. I noticed when the flash was on and I was snapping pics the object got closer to me. It looks like an Alien being born. Not sure about the mans face but, that was taken at one point aiming right at the object. I put a few pics on a UFO facebook group and people were making fun of them. I took them down. I did not alter these photos at all. I would take a lie detector test to prove it. I am baffled as to what this is and what this means. Any thoughts??? I actually got scared and ran inside the house. I watched and took pics from 8:12pm to 10:55pm.

summary: About six lights in alignment with lighted straight line connecting each one.
description:
I do not know how many objects it was. There appeared to be about six lights in a row that were connected to each other by lighted straight lines.
It disappeared instantly after about five seconds of noticing it. I wondered if it was a reflection, but it was dark, the moon had not risen above the horizon, and there were few vehicles around me. I was traveling at about 8:00 p.m. northbound on Interstate 15 just north of Holden, Utah, Millard County. I can submit a drawing if desired.

summary: Two orbs seen floating at a high altitude not moving them slowly moving and then dissipating
description: We saw one orb appear at what seems a very high altitude followed by another orb appear in the blue of the sky. There were no flashing lights however the color changed from white to pinkish red then slowly moved until out of sight.

summary: Son playing outside , witnessed object
description: My son witnessed a black sphere or orb flying in a solid path over trees over our yard. It is a windy day and it was not a balloon swaying in breeze. It kept a direct path and speed without deviation. Seems to have a faint white sphere around object and put out a pulse shockwave around it twice in sequence as it traveled . Object flashed a sort of shockwave sphere around it not into the entire sky.

summary: Large, quiet, triangular craft flew over 2 witnesses at 05:30 on Sunday morning, off the central southern coast of England
description: In the early morning of Sunday 29 October 2023 at a mid-point of 05:30 for 4 minutes (between 05:25 earliest to 05:35 latest), an unusual large triangular aircraft (Vulcan bomber sized but just a triangle - no fuselage or front cockpit) was seen clearly by two observers as it passed over West Cowes, Isle of Wight, UK. It was on a flight path from the south south-west (e.g.direction of Brighstone, IOW) going over West Cowes IOW where the High Street meets Birmingham Road and went away toward the north north-east (e.g. over The Solent sea channel and toward Netley, Southampton). Only the lights were seen when it first appeared but the whole solid triangle shape emerged as it approached us and passed overhead. Elevation when the lights alone were first seen in the clear, dark sky was ca. 36 degrees according to my inclinometer (below Venus and the Moon), which puts it at about 1,200 feet altitude, then it overpassed us and the solid grey triangle shape showed against the night sky and could be seen clearly. It had non-conventional (illegal by CAA standards for port and starboard illumination?) navigation lights: green constant strip-lights along both wingtips and a powerful red lamp…

summary: I went to take a photo of the full moon, thought I saw a star, went to show my nephew and it dropped from the sky.
description:
At 4:16AM in the morning of October 29th, 2023, I decided to take photos of the full moon + clouds. I took the photos and noticed, what appeared to be a star to me, a singular, bright light, maintaining one spot for over 5 minutes. I went inside to show the photos to my family, talked for about 5-7 minutes then brought my nephew outside to see the moon/clouds. I pointed out the “star” to my nephew, and not soon after, we both notice it quickly drop down from the sky, at least 200 feet, then go straight back up, above the clouds.
I looked at my photos and noticed the object was hanging directly below cloud cover, right on the edge of the cloud. I know it wasn’t a plane, it maintained the same space for an extended period of time and the speed it accelerated to as it dropped would be unmaintainable for an aircraft (possible a missile could maneuver like this, but it couldn’t sit stationary).
The object was in the western sky, situated to the bottom left of the moon.

summary: Large bright solid white round object with orange light surrounding it. Silent no trail
description: Object moved slowly to the north east direction. Object made no sound had no trail and promptly disappeared before my eyes. Extremely bright, the size was slightly smaller than a basket ball appeared to be perhaps a mile overhead. I am prior army and have never seen anything like it. Was not a typical meteor or fireball as some might try to say it was.

summary: UFO hovering above vicinity of local park.
description:
Waiting for a bus. Spotted UFO immediately hovering over vicinity of St. Clair Reservoir Park. Took six pics on iPhone 6s. Distracted enough to not think of taking a video. After about a minute or two, two groups of young men came along sidewalk and gathered to wait for the bus. We talked briefly and no one could come up with an idea of what it could be. The head and tail were changing colour from blue to green. The head at times looked like a v-shaped jet plane and then would morph and go out of focus to more of a blob shape. Sometimes the head was a bright white colour and then it would change to the same colour as the tail. The tail was moving somewhat and had separate lights within it. Advised by admin. of UFO UpDates to report it.
Update from witness: This has been explained as a kite with leds.

summary: We saw something that looked strange in the sky.
description: I have video and pictures but what I saw with the naked eye is something I never saw before.

summary: 5 objects total, 3 went into a triangle and all faded. Not helicopter, drone or plane as this was above LGB flight path.
orange ring blinking, does loop de loop then disappears
description: Left my house and noticed Venus or whatever in the sky and stopped to admire what I thought was also Mars and got in my car. Realized that the orange thing was too big to be mars and kept staring as I was leaving neighborhood, which is when it started blinking briefly. I stopped my car at the exit of the neighborhood and noticed it was dark in the middle, as opposed to a solid orange circle. The orange ring did a loop and slowly moved southeast before disappearing. Forgive me if this is too hard to believe but even the deer were fixated on the orange ring.

summary: giant ship very close
description: I saw a giant long rectangular ship, formed as if they were joined segments, emitting a wave and turning off our cell phones, we lost track of time because it was day and when we started walking it was night, what surprised me was that it used an effect strange from a well-known movie, it became invisible like the predator movie and made a sound and became invisible from the ends inwards

summary: Object at about 3000 feet
description: At first I thought it may have been a bird behind a tiny cloud but then it changed direction at speed and move way too fast and was way too high. It went left then right and veered slightly. It then just disappeared completely in a blue sky. I watched for any more sighting and nothing. it was in the South. I'm not entirely sure what I saw but thought it best to report anyway.

summary: 2 amber orbs moving silently across the sky, orbiting each-other as they moved north
description: I was on my Tablet watching YouTube, when I went to open my window for som fresh air. I stopped to watch an airliner passing by since my home is under the traffic lane of an airport, so I like to plane watch frequently. I noticed what I originally thought to be another airliner, so I turned my attention to it. That was when I realized it did not have any navigational lights. I am familiar with what satellites look like and it did not match up. To add to that, there was a second orb which orbited around it as it moved across the sky. They made no noise, whereas I could clearly hear the airliner. Both of them were moving across the horizon at what I believe must have been supersonic speed. The entire sighting lasted approximately 2 minutes. During that time, crickets which were making noise outside had stopped entirely. Everything was dead quiet, I could hear my circulation.

summary: First, I thought of the position of the planet Venus at that time…until I took enlarged pictures…
description:
From 1978 to this day, I believe I saw 3 UFOs (Unknown Flying Objects). One when I was an ATC (Air Traffic controller) in the Air Force, another one when I was a Flight Attendant and another one as a Certified Flight Instructor (CFI ) pilot. Those UFOs had different shapes such as diamond shape and croissant shape.
Last night, I woke up at 5am. I saw a bright light in the sky from my bed. I leave by the Lake Pend’Oreille in Sandpoint, Idaho. I walked to the balcony. First I thought it was the position on the planet Venus at that time (5:10am). Considering the rotation of the Earth, that “thing” was not moving. Then I began to take pictures with my cell phone. And this is what is appearing (see pictures)!
I leave the analysis and conclusion to the experts. But please let me know the verdict!

summary: Falling Fire Ball Disseminates into Five Hovering Orbs of Light

I turned to walk towards the gate, facing southwest towards San Diego Harbor and noticed what appeared to be a meteor falling in the sky. It was very bright and falling more slowly than I would have imagined a meteor to fall and I kept staring at it in awe as it continued its decent in the nights sky. I had watched for about 30 seconds and yelled to my neighbor who was also walking her dog to look up in the sky. She asked, "what is that?" and I began filming as best I could. The tail of fire had begun to descend beyond my line of sight due to the tree line ahead but just as it neared the tops of the trees, the fire separated out into 5 rays of falling light and then began moving into a more horizontal formation which clearly became 5 separate hovering orbs of light. 4 of the orbs began moving west across the harbor and 1 orb can be seen moving west and then shifting towards the east. I ran down the street to get to a place with an unobstructed view of the harbor and only one orb remained for a brief moment before disappearing towards the…

summary: One craft stopped and vanished, a second encircled the area while emitting flares
description:
At the time of the sighting, approximately 12:35pm, the skies were clear with 10-mile visibility conditions. I was, for a second time today, walking laps around my backyard to stretch my sprained left hip muscle, which is why I wasn’t at work. Now what I’m about to write might sound strange but considering this is my fourth or fifth sighting to leave me baffled, I’ve actually come to expect these types of sightings in my every day life. Specifically in the San Gabriel Mountain area near Pasadena I’ve witnessed dozens of craft that may very well be balloons of some sort since most that I see travel extremely slow and reflect the sun’s white light to appear like stars in the middle of the day.
As I paced in my backyard and turned to face the mountains, a dim gray-colored craft flying west to east caught my attention for some reason. It seemed to be at or above 30,000 ft traveling as fast as a plane, but I like to test things now by “transmitting” a telepathic thought out; something along the lines of, “If you can hear me, stop and reverse course.” I then used a helpful technique of finding a nearby tree branch as a reference point to not lose sight of crafts flying through cloudless…

summary: Enormous white triangle craft with point straight down.
description:
A friend and I were walking a dog on east bound US Forest Service road #336 heading toward Apache Lake AZ from the Mills Ridge Forest Service Road #429. We looked up and saw an enormous white triangle craft oriented with the one point situated straight down. The craft appeared to be a bit longer than wide. In three seconds the craft narrowed and then disappeared - it did not fly off. One instant it was there and the next instant in time it was not there.
The craft was enormous as we could compare it to the mountains on the east side of the Salt River Canyon. It was about 1/3 the height of the mountain side which mountain is estimated to rise 2000 feet from Apache lake level. I estimate craft was between 500 and 1000 ft in length.
The craft was approximately 2.5 miles from us as measured on Forest Service map. From this close distance it was simply enormous.
There was no noise, sound or exhaust from craft.Color was a milky white with sharp distinct edges. No lights were observed and craft was not reflective. Weather was clear and the temperature was in the 60s Fahrenheit.
Sighting spot: (33.6731349, -111.2189123)
Craft spot: (33.6572906, -111.1776200)

summary: Solid white glowing silent orb, traveling E to N with no aircraft of any kind in the area
description:

Wind 5 ssw with gusts up to 15mph; Visibility 25 mi. No transponding aircraft over that area (see Flightradar24 video attached). Started roughly in Pisces, above Jupiter, and ended video in or just above Perseus (checked SkyView app). The distance of the orb would have been far out of our city and beyond the next town easily. The only aircraft transponding was directly above my head (which I heard while taking the video, and saw above me). I recorded the video with my iPhone 14 Pro Max, from my front yard.
Solid objects in video include house, tree, and stars.
No SpaceX launch tonight (Oct. 21st was most recent launch).
Also checked FindStarlink map, and heavens-above to see Starlink video launch map, nothing in this area of the planet. FindStarlink using my coordinates shows nothing visible tonight (see screenshot).
Live Space Station (ISS) Tracking Map shows ISS was nowhere near the U.S. (see screenshot)

summary: It was more of an upside down pear shape. About 75 ft in the air.

Myself, along with four other adults and multiple children witnessed an upside down pear-shaped object. The object was on a straight line trajectory coming from the south and going north/north west. It was moving at approximately 30 miles an hour, and maintained the same altitude and trajectory from the point of time when it entered to the time it exited line of view and exited our line of view. It was very clear that the object didn’t have any sort of wings or propeller system. The object also made absolutely no sound. The object also never deviated from its course in either direction or altitude. It looked like a black colored object and wizard right by us overhead. There was no shiny or metallic color to it as in a mylar balloon. It was also small. It could not have been more than 4 ft in height and diameter.
Original report said it was 20 "years" away.   Perhaps they meant yards?

So no point or side was a leading edge as it came in my direction. It flew with the bottom slightly angled/elevated so that I could always see the three lights on the bottom.
As the Triangle got almost overhead I heard what sounded like a very vague HUM. It was so soft that had there been any other noise I would have never heard the hum. I am not sure if because it was so vague that there was a “pulse” in the hum. It was difficult to tell since it was so quiet. As the rotating Triangle began passing overhead it slowly turned in a more Eastward direction. It was such a gentle slow turn, while rotating and so huge. It was stunning to watch.
As the lights at the…

summary: At @ 9:45 PM last night, my husband called to me to come out to the yard to see 'a light.'

My husband called to me to come out back last night (@9:45 PM) to 'see the light." What we saw was three (3) lights in a circle enclosed in a circle. My husband said he saw it 'move jerkily back and forth, and then stopped moving. When I got there, it had stopped moving and I saw those three lights, and then they disappeared and the object we saw was one bright light.
At that point, we started guessing what it could be...Airplane was ruled out, it was not moving, no noise, it wasn't a copter, for the same reasons, it wasn't anything we could figure out, including a satellite. We both started taking photos with our cell phones and later I was back in the house, I used my finger to spread the light in the photos closer in.
It was an amazing blob of light, and in each frame for each photo, they went from a point of light in the sky, to these amorphous blobs of light, very bright and pretty stationary in the sky.

description:
@ approx: 19:44hrs as I were doing not a thing specific to anything, just sitting and ping! up overhead high altitude (above 20,000ft say) from the N -dir- did fly a single dimmer, (in comparison to prior reports) by observation, spark! it flew in a mostly S.E. -dir- veered to starboard (RT) -noticable- and continued on. It started to 'dissolve' IMO which has presented prior to indicate that the craft is preparing to blip! out of sight. This particular craft did not. It flew on a bit further then as they typically do in their subtle nuanced way, demonstrated an intense glow! all at once, very very quickly!! followed by a dimmer yet as subtle glow! muted in appearance fast fade away! and then blip! gone...
Followed up by at approx: 19:50hrs did fly a second single dimmer spark! from the W to overhead from my seated, static position on Terra Firma facing in a usual S.E. -dir-. It flew on its trajectory JRA (Just Rolling Along) in the early dark nighttime sky until out of my observable view. I did not get up off the deck and give visual pursuit... -fin-
* in closing this report I did wish to add a particular 'thing' I've noticed prior during the time these more recent events reported…

summary: Star objects moving through sky on irregular tracts.
description: Over western Riverside county south of city of Riverside west of March ARB. The video was taken with a Pixel 7 phone camera.

summary: Multiple Star objects flying in different tracts.
Objects in pics not seen during photography. Noticed next morning when reviewing.
description:
I've sent a few pictures that I think you might find interesting. Or at least give a plausible explanation. One is a close up of the object in question and the other is the actual photo of the sunset with the object upper-center-left appearing as a small dot. The third is the object closer and has moved to upper-center-right. Please note: neither my girlfriend or I noticed the object when the photos were taken. Not until this morning when I was looking at the pictures did I see them yet they are clearly visible.
Look forward to hearing from you and hearing what you think we are seeing here.
Location: Nimitz Beach, Oahu, Directly across the street from the US Coast Guard Station.
Date: 21 October 23
Time: ~6:00PM

summary: Have 4 pictures that appear to see a craft enter our atmosphere at a tremendous speed, stop just above the horizon and fly north
description: The object was not seen by the naked eye. It was no lens flare, and have the photos to prove that a cross shaped object makes a rapid decent and gets closer goes over our heads and keeps flying north. It was the middle of the early evening. Still plenty bright out. The photos capture the crafts path over the course of a few minutes. Again, neither of us saw anything in person. But then looked at our photos later and really dug deep into it.

summary: 20 to 30 balls of light
description: Just a number of lights in the sky doing 90 degree turns. Just darting around going in a north to south direction.

summary: Two objects going opposite directions crossed sky
description: Looked up due to airplane noise. I did see the airplane but also saw white objects. Only took photo of one. The just crossed the sky until out of sight

summary: Heard loud crash and then saw object fly by.
description:
I was sound asleep, probably about nine in the morning and was awakened by a very loud crash noise. I live near a fighter jet training Air Force base so I am used to loud planes flying over quite often - sometimes very low. This noise was much louder!! Honestly, it sounded like a crash.
I jumped out of bed and ran to the window and saw what looked like a missile flying by. It was bullet shaped, metallic looking silver gray, and moving quite slow at a very slight decline. It was flying at about my eye level from the house and then disappeared into the trees.
I waited to report this because I thought people would think that I am crazy. I have never seen anything like this before in my entire life. I hope this information is helpful.

summary: Checking out Venus this AM and huh?
description:
Sitting at one spot familiar to myself (again) & it's going on 03:00AM and looking to the S.W. at I believe Venus? *checked with Earth Sky.com it was Venus, and to the right of the brightly glowing Venus his morning and a solid black shape, like a US state shaped (Utah, NM?) appears all of a sudden now!, entirely noticeable and really really black. Like if you know what a shadow entity is then I'd equate it to that as a solid, initial reference and blips out.
Almost immediately following to the left of Venus/star a super faint flash, spark! of a thing. - and done-

summary: It is moving above me, this is not a star...sometimes light are frashing from the light like a flash light
description:
It looks like an oval form and with pinocle, I think I see something next to it that looks like metal.  It stays still until I start trying to film it with my phone, then it moves quickly.   It move so fast like nothing I have seen before.
It stays very still now..like it is watching me ..or this part of the world..very scary..actually. I have movies and pictures..  I can send them.

summary: Diamond shaped appeared out of middle of sky and stopped after a short drop and hovering in sky for about 30 to 45 seconds
description: Looking in the west facing sky.  A diamond shaped craft in very bright white light appeared out of middle of sky and dropped to a stop hovering for 30 to 45 seconds then just vanished.   Upon arriving home did see in sky a similar shaped light just stop and moved very slow

summary: Diamond shaped appeared out of middle of sky and stopped after a short drop and hovering in sky for about 30 to 45 seconds
description:
Driving west on wildcat canyon road in Lakeside Ca, I saw a Brite white diamond shaped craft appear in midsky dropped down and hovered for 30 to 45 seconds then just vanished.   Upon arriving at my home about 20 min later in La Mesa ca I noticed a white orb moving and diapering in sky the a similar diamond shaped craft with brute white lite in western sky just staying stationary for 15 min then vanished.
Note if you called me I mistook your Washington number for a telemarketers
So please call again
Thanks

summary: Saw it directly out of my front door, so I went outside to start recording
description: Before the video starts it had a bright red and blue trail , which you don’t see anymore throughout the video.

summary: Bright red flare streaking across night sky leveling out, and then leaving atmosphere with great force.
description: A bright circular light with red flare spotted high in the sky with a slight decline. It leveled out as the flare diminished into a short but persistent tail. It then changed direction slightly then when went upwards with great force with a visible orange ark in front as though it was going too fast. Similar to the look of an asteroid entering the atmosphere it behaved the same as it went upwards back into the the sky and eventually too distant to see into space.

location: Grand Canyon-Parashant National Monument, AZ, USA
summary: Unknown dash of light appearing in remote webcam stream.
description:
Dark Sky footage at one of my weather stations captured an unexplained image. This Image is an 8 second exposure that repeats every 5 minutes of the night sky at a remote weather station site. Upon reviewing the timelapse, I found one image displaying a point of light traveling 60-80 miles in that 8 second exposure, along an irregular pathway. I welcome further review!
See the public footage here: (odd image occurs at 12:37am on Oct 21, 2023)
https://webcam.io/webcams/P1j5xz

summary: It was 8 bright lights in the sky
description: There was 8 bright lights in the sky they hovered in one spot for an hour. They started going out 2 at a time every 30 minutes. I also have pictures of the objects.

summary: There was no sound .never ever seen this before .I'm 49 years old
description: My husband was outside .he came in and said come here quick. It was like balls moving staggering quickly then disappearing.. it was at least 15-20 . What in the world are these.

summary: It was not a craft. More like laser light repeating in same pattern. In the same location. Starting and stopping. 9-10 times.
description: It made me think of the China satellite in China. At first we thought it was a shooting star. But the light repeated the same pattern from the same start point to the same end point at least 8-10 times. It didn't move that fast. And was faint. And when the faint cloud seem to pass we could no longer see it. It was a consistent and purposeful duration. I think a laser from a satellite.

summary: 2 orbs first seen by 2 people then chevron craft seen by 5 people
description: The two orbs were seen to the north. Two people saw this, one went to pull out a phone to use a planet finding app. By the time the app was ready the orbs were gone. All five people are looking to the sky now and one says “are those birds”? We all looked to the west and could see a chevron shaped objet with 3-4 lights on each side traveling southbound. It was a few thousand feet away; I have seen planes fly as close as this was and their was no sounds and it had a consistent speed that was slower than propeller aircraft and faster than geese. We all watched it go out of sight behind the trees.

location: Brentford, London Borough of Hounslow, United Kingdom
summary: Two spherical shapes attached and rotating
description:
I noticed what I thought at first was two escaped balloons, but as it got closer it looked like two balls attached and rotating round (almost like bicycle pedals). I took a video and the people I showed it to suggested it might be a drone, but having finally looked up different types of drones, here don't seem to be any like this.
The video won't upload so I've attached a screen shot from it

summary: Hovering about mountain
description: As we were driving, I noticed a bright object hovering above a mountain. It wasn’t moving and it was very bright. After telling some people about it, I found out the same object was photographed in Soda Springs two days earlier. We compared photos, and they seem to be the same thing.

summary: This showed up on a photo I took, never saw it in real life, was only in one photo
description: Was taking pictures of Lake Superior and later when I was looking at the pictures this red thing was in the photo. It was in only one photo, my wife and I never saw it in real life. It would have been very easy to spot with sunshine and 0 obstructions. I took several photos quickly and this was in only one. If you have any idea what it is please tell me, thank you.

summary: 3 lights appeared in the sky and flew in triangle formation & then disappeared one at a time
description: I enjoy coffee every morning while watching the sky. I look for different celestial objects and the international space station. I even have an app that helps me understand what I am seeing. On the morning of October 20th at approximately 6:45am I was stargazing and enjoying the view of Jupiter. Suddenly 3 lights appeared in the western sky between Jupiter and the horizon from my vantage point on my front porch. The 3 lights were moving North in a triangle formation for about 1 minute. I tried to grab my phone to record, but when I looked back up 2 of the lights had disappeared and then the 3rd light disappeared. The lights did not fade or leave a trail. It’s as if the lights were snuffed out.

summary: One continueous light with dispersed red and white lights, moving on line, not inline, SW to NE, low altitude
description: Long string of bright yellow light with dispersed dots of white light and one red light on left end of string as it moved across the sky from southwest to northeast. Yellow string moved as a broad front, not in a linear fashion (similar to a starlink as I understand it), along the axis of advance. Absolutely silent as it moved. Altitude estimated at 2000 to 3000 feet. Shape of the line appeared to change, as can be seen in the two pictures attached. Multiple images of the yellow line in the pictures are due to camera shake during pro-longed exposure. Unfortunately, the entire line of light is not in the pictures due to haste in grabbing the camera and taking the pictures.

summary: Hovering Star
description: Object is hovering and moving circular and zig zag pattern. It's a bright white light with a rainbow aura. Object came from the west. It was moving east but has been hovering for 1 hour.

summary: Dark black triangle, large, silent, three red lights, one on each corner, fast… very fast, completely silent
Dimly lit triangle shaped lights
description: I was working night shift on break at work in the Spokane Valley when I looked up and was gazing at the stars. When I noticed movement out of the corner of my eye, I then honed in on a triangle shaped group of 3 lights that were very dim, no brighter than the background stars, that was definitely closer then the stars, moving rapidly while rotating slowly. No flashing lights or sound was emitted.

summary: My daughter and I were walking our dog down our block around 10:20 p.m.
description:
I glanced to the the sky and witnessed a white glowing orb with a soft blue hue. There was a black line dividing the orb, making it look like a hamburger.
I looked away. But then, my daughter asked me "do you see that?" So, I glanced up to the sky again and watched an object pulsate in a wave like pattern down towards Earth. It had beautiful white lights that would appear and then disappear as it was moving along it's path. It was absolutely beautiful.
My attention suddenly shifted as I (we) watched a dark black triangle move across the sky. It had a few of the beautiful sparkling white lights, but they disappeared as it turned into a deep and dark black color. It got very close to us as we stood there watching it fly by. My daughter said it was the size of a commercial air plane, but what I saw was much smaller. The only reason I could see it at all was because of it's deep, rich black color. It was absolutely silent as it passed us by, us, which was odd and absolutely amazing!
In total, my experience lasted approximately 5-10 seconds. But, it felt much longer, like slow motion took over from start to finish. I told my daughter that I felt like I was hypnotized as we were walking…

summary: We saw an oval shaped object in the sky, no lights, more like a faint glow of light around it, then it became a triangle
description: At the end of our street I noticed an oval shape surrounded by a faint wavering light. It was directly above us, moving like a floating feather, or like a snake. We watched it come down and circle around, becoming a very large black V with no lights. I honestly don’t know how I was able to see it with no lights on or around it, I can’t explain anything about it.

summary: 3 very bright lights directly south, colors not typical, gave a strong feeling immediately
description: My girlfriend picked me up to go to the store. As soon as we started heading south we noticed 3 very bright lights in the sky, flashing colors not typical of aircraft, satellites, planets or stars. I immediately had a gut feeling I knew what it was. Upon driving to the store to get a better view, I noticed they changed positions slightly. Once at the door I was able to locate them again and finally snap a picture with my phone that has 100x zoom. As you can see, the light pattern is not typical of anything usual. I proceeded to try and take video, but my camera can't take video at that zoom level. We went into the store and came out. They were all gone.

summary: Saw a perfect skinny rectangle flash at me 2 times with a bright white light
description: Went out as usual to look for satellites and shooting stars. looked to the NW direction and saw a skinny horizontal rectangle flash at me twice with a very bright white light. The light was perfectly contained within this rectangle. There was no glow around it or leakage of the light. I thought it might have been a blimp about to light up a sign but there was nothing more. No planes in the sky, no noise.

summary: At personal storage facility, getting some fresh air and...
description:
At approx 19:44hrs I had stepped outside the storage facility I have storage at for some fresh air and not doing anything specific and flash! stutter...stutter...stutter...flash! fade to black, yet there's like this dark very dark blue-ish/brown coloured cloud barely barely visible IMO that its hiding and dancing around in, the flash deformed or morphed? into a spark! now & I can barely see the spark! now, flash! (like seeing fluffy broken cloud cover and this object is 'presenting' itself as, for whatever reason) is done and that spark! is now fading, fading fading as it 'flits!' here, 'flits!' there. Like a peek-a-boo! game, from up high. *Points upwards. Not too high an altitude, not typical high altitude trucking along craft(s) or objects IMO. Maybe 10,000 to 15,000ft. in altitude. Until not viewable from my line of sight looking to the S-SW at the storage facility... outta nowhere blamo! that odd cloud like formation (mostly coloured dark brown, dark blue against mostly black/dark sky) dwindled and faded away as well. Something was either up there and BIG maybe supporting those craft/spark! objects?
In closing, for whatever its worth. The immediate (1st) and only impressions…

summary: Orange fiery objects flying low in a procession
description: October 19, 2023, 7pm. While driving home in the evening I saw an orange glowing object flying low. I initially thought it was a drone on fire. I parked in my driveway to get out and get a better look. I saw multiple silent orange objects flying northwards in a staggered line, possibly about a dozen. A neighbor walking his dog stopped to watch and my wife came out to look. I went back indoors and didn’t have a good count of the total number of objects. Videos attached from iPhone 15 Pro. Living near DC, I can only assume the objects might be military?

summary: Circular white light rising fast from the desert straight up into the sky out of sight.
description:
Looking out the back window of the house a white circular object rose into view. 1st-second, I thought someone released a balloon that was reflecting the late day sun. That thought was immediately dismissed, it was not drifting or wavering in the air. 2nd-second, I thought it must be a drone. That was also immediately dismissed, it was rising straight up very fast and I thought; “can a drone rise that fast”? I said to my wife; “what is that”? I got up and quickly went to the back window…it was already getting to the height of my 10ft tall patio awning. I had to bend over to keep it in view as it rose so fast. At that point I thought; “what the heck, this is fast” and it was above the awning out of sight. I felt it sped up as it rose. I immediately opened the sliding door and went out and scanned the skies. It was gone. Being aware of drone battery life, I stood for a long time scanning the area to be sure nothing was returning to the town area. Nothing came into view.
Here is some reference information. I am very familiar with aircraft in the sky, have built WWII model airplanes growing up, built and fired model rockets (kits and home-made designs) growing up, worked for Northrop…

summary: Metallic object with two metallic round ends with a thin body
description: Metallic object with two metallic round ends with a thin metallic body was observed. The object in question was metallic in my opinion since I feel that it's reflection camouflaged with the sky. There was no clouds at the time and the figure moved slowly from right to left as I drove towards it, and disappeared almost immediately after approximately 4 seconds.

summary: Took 2 pictures of chemtrails. Looking back I caught something in the second photo.
description: I was taking pictures of chemtrails when I noticed an object in one of my pictures. The object has black in the middle, triangle and circle shaped. Zoomed in looks like a panda. Pictures were taken back to back. A plane can be seen with object.

summary: Star-like object was flying in a circular pattern before shooting off across the sky.
description:
October 19,2023
05:51
Clear sky, many stars visible. Stepped off my front porch and looked upwards, facing south-by-southwest, when I saw an object, star-like in appearance, flying in a tight circle around the star Aldebaran of the Taurus constellation. I only witnessed this strange behavior for a second or two before the object suddenly stopped and took off in a straight line to the left, passing through the center of the Orion constellation and continuing on until it was out of sight. It took 45-60 seconds to cross the sky, moving at what seemed a slower pace than when it was circling the star.

summary: From 10:00PM 20231018 to now 5:00AM I’m hearing a craft sounding like airplane or thunder depending on volume which keeps fluctuating.
description: Since around 10:00PM 20231018 I have been hearing a type of craft outside of my home in seaside California consistently. I first looked at the weather because when the craft gets loud it sounds like thunder but some times with my high pitched frequencies. It’s has been sunny all week and continues to be sunny last night and today. Then I attempted to record the sound although difficult to fully pickup from the inside of my home. I explored the possibility that it could be a military craft, but the sound which can sound anything like passing cars on a highway, to an airplane flying over head, to full blown thunder has lasted over 7 hours so far staying in the same location. I am not entirely sure what it is but I could not help but to feel anxious as I’ve never experienced sounds like this coming from what seems to be nowhere. I have not been able to sleep more than 3-4 hours tonight because of these sounds and I think an investigation is definitely worth while.

summary: While operating an airline flight at 37,000’ both pilots witnessed three lights at very high altitude moving in random patterns.
description: While operating a B777 from HNL-DEN at 37,000’ both the Captain and I witnessed what appeared to be stars moving at a very high altitude and distance. We were approximately 50 miles SW of Las Vegas at about 0300 local time. The lights appeared to be SE of our position. All three lights were observed to be moving independently in some type of pattern. The lights were the approximate size and brightness of the stars in the background and were steady with no flashing that we typically observe on aircraft. They would each move relatively quickly in one direction for about one minute and then reverse course and move in another direction. We observed this phenomenon for about one hour. We questioned Los Angeles Center about high altitude military activity but they were not aware of any. After about one hour two of the lights continued northbound until they were out of sight. The third light remained for about 20 more minutes before heading southwest bound and disappearing. Over the course of the hour we travelled approximately 500 nautical miles but the lights never appeared to get any closer to us.

summary: Irregularly, blinking and varying in intensity, until disappearing.
description:
Looking East, South East, from a half mile in from the ocean, I saw two blinking lights, varying in intensity and with an irregular, non rhythm/mechanical blinking pattern.
Each one alternated when it was blinking. This lasted a few minutes then it was gone, but there was no directional change.

summary: Bright object hovering overhead expanding and turning and changing shape. flashing lights at times. A streak across sky
description: In sky above me in SE portland oregon. I first noticed bright light in sky hovering at 10:35pm and when I zoomed in saw it changing shape and size. A streak went across sky from one end of horizon to another. From north to south. A friend an hour away in newburg about same time saw bright light across sky too. I have video and pictures of everything but the streak

summary: V shaped lights, below clouds. Perfect v but lights were staggered just a little bit
description: It was so quick, I looked up and pointed with my right hand with my daughter in my left arm and said “what the ((deleted)) is that”. It’s cloudy out, enough to not see any stars. It was below the cloud line and huge! It was 4-6 lights on each side of the V with one light dead center of the V. One side was a little bit longer than the other and the all of the lights were off center just a little bit in a zipper pattern. I’m the time it took me to say “what the fuck is that” it appeared and disappeared. Seemed to have been moving very very fast and so smooth. I’m in awe. Agin multiple lights on each side shaped as a V with one light in the center and the rest staggered just a little bit. Very low, very fast, and extremely quiet. I’m so sure of what I seen when it disappeared my wife and I looked at each other with a daughter in both of our arms and she said “I want to go inside now!”. I googled “v shaped lights in the sky” and the phoenix lights popped up on Google and I swear to you that’s exactly what it looked like almost so perfect only difference is that it was right above our heads. Not off the the east or west or north directly above my head at least when it disappeared.

summary: Bright circle in the sky.
description:
Noticed a very bright light in the sky. Called my husband to look at it. He thought it was a star. It was not flashing. It stayed still for about 2 hours. When I looked worn binoculars it appeared there was a red light on top of it. So that rules out a star. I searched google and it stated nasa has a satellite that would be in view for about 10 mins. Then continued to observe and around 11/00 or had moved a bit east. I did not want to look any longer because it was absolutely terrified.
I then planted myself in the basement with no lights on just the tv. As I viewed the cameras set up outside I saw quite a bit of activity. Around 6:00 am I went upstairs and looked out through the blinds and saw 2 bright lights moving very quickly coming towards my house from the north. I saw a few houses down across the street, on a ranch home roof beings jumping and waiving at light coming towards them.
I also showed my husband on the ring camera a large shadow on door on my living room. When I went back to view the footage that I observed on fhe love views it was not there.

summary: white roundish size object captured on doorbell cam
description: On October 20th 2023, I examined my doorbell camera footage from October the 16th through the 19th and discovered a bright light the size of an aspirin over to the south/southwest direction from my home. As it ascended, the roundish white light seem to have shifted direction away from me because the size immediately shrunk, but still ascending. As the object got to the top of the video, I noticed another smaller bluish/white orb following behind it.

summary: Incredibly active evening, looking up higher, high
description:
Sitting, settling in for the evening at familiar spot (homeless status) and again, for whatever reason I whip my gaze upwards, high to observe a single 'spark!' coming from the N dir. on a trajectory heading mostly S-S.E. -dir- just rolling along up very high in the nitetime sky and as it continues on its path it disintegrates (crumbles apart) before my eyes.
Craft #2 showed up approx 2-3mins later coming from the N -dir- again a single bright spark, high altitude trucking along and it veers to starboard (RT)) and does start to dissolve and then -blips!- itself into blackness. *I have witnessed this same maneuver prior and it is astonishing each time.
Craft #3 showed up approx 2-3mins later coming from the N -dir- again a single bright spark! on the same trajectory to the S - S.E. and again vanished after a time flying above. *there IS a bit of confusion, on my part here as I had no battery on my mobile, in the field, yadayada -excuses- and the objects kept appearing and moving and and and... meaning? All 4 craft of this design (single bright spark!) disappeared in a different mode all four times on 10-18-2023 and I might not have #2 & #3 modus operandi exactly correct, RMK
**in…

summary: Saw 3 solid lights in the shape of a big triangle, hovering, silently
description: Driving down the hill from the center of town, on the way to pick up my wife from work at Christopher heights, me and my children saw three solid orange lights in the shape of a big triangle hovering silently in the sky for about 5 seconds then we could not see it any longer. After waiting about 15 minutes for my wife we headed home the same direction we came, again seeing the same lights hovering over the old state school grounds where there are two new rotaries. I pulled into one of the rotaries to stop and look at the craft it was very big was not a helicopter or a plane and had like I said three orange solid lights shaped like a triangle we watched it for about 2 minutes before the lights just went out and disappeared.

summary: Flashing Objects in Sky Middle of Day
description: I was driving my daughter home at approx 12:15 pm and saw what I thought were pigeons moving erratically in the sky. Upon focusing closer, I could see they were way too far up to be birds. I pulled over to observe- they were flashing and moving in the sky, about 15-20 of them. They did not look like drones. I called my husband who was at our home about three minutes away- he went outside and saw them as well and was confused as to what they might be. I first contacted a local news station who replied to my submission but that was all I heard from them. Then I posted to instagram to see if anyone could suggest what they were- people seemed just as confused as me. I posted to the Next Door app to see if anyone else saw it, not one person. I then called the Riverside Sheriff to see if they had info or anyone had reported it and they had no information. I have no explanation for what these are at this point and would be so grateful if you find out they are not UFO’s that you let me know as I am creeped out!!

summary: Incredibly fast object moving from NW to SE .15degree l think, no satellite
description: Same as above: object appeared as l turned my head to the SE. Bright light at approx 15 degrees shot towards the SE horizon and disappeared in less than a second

summary: Clear Sky - Object moving from North to South
description:
Exiting home front door - Walking towards my Car - Home faces South - Absolutely clear sky with lots of stars -
Suddenly overhead I saw a brilliant Round White Glowing Object that traveled instantly from the North towards the South until I could no longer see it.
I saw No Aircraft within my viewing areas. Per my perspective it was not flying within our air space , It was way way out there.
The object size was about the size of the head of a pencil eraser. The outer edges of the object seemed to be rough, Not a smooth edge.
FYI - I have lived in this area since 1957 (Space Coast) Worked @ space center years ago - I have witnessed many many launches.

summary: 2-3 flying objects that did not move much that were close enough to create a bright flash of light that fell vertically down & vanished
description: I returned home around 2:30 am & in my window saw 1 aircraft that I assumed was a plane. I watched it for several minutes & when it continued blinking colors I grabbed my binoculars & saw that it was not a plane. It had stopped moving when another craft appeared near it. I woke my partner up & we ended counting 3 crafts near, but not next, to each other. They were amongst/hidden by clouds for a couple minutes, however, you would still see the lights. After watching for 30 minutes we witnessed a bright light shoot vertically from in between 2 of the aircraft’s down toward the ground. The light disappeared & we had not heard a sound or any news reports. We watched them for a total of 3-4 hours before fall asleep. We assumed they remained in the sky.

location: Columbia - Fort Meade Area, MD, USA
summary: A egg shaped object, glowing with a small contrail, shot through the sky heading Northwest. It seemed at a low altitude
description: I was driving North on 95 around 1:40 am, heading to a job in Owings Mills. Suddenly an object caught my eyesight as it went across the sky. It was an egg/ orb shaped object, glowing and went through my whole eyesight of the sky within 3-5 seconds

summary: Large orb / crescent light traveled from south to north for a few seconds then appeared to dissipate above our heads.
description:
Many other people in the campground witnessed it as we could hear people hollering from all around.
The sighting seemed more like a light and less like a craft.

summary: Two bright white pulsating objects quite a distance apart quickly closed in and came together or came very close,, then pulsating cease
description: Same as above,, I edited my photo in stages by continuous screenshots by sharpening and reducing brightness,, screenshooting my improvements gives me the ability to use my iPhone 14 editing tools to a further degree,, iPhone processes photos like a picasso painting in low light

summary: Three series of 3 slightly yellow/ white,lights spaced wide apart that then became one bright light, then went back to three..
description: I saw a series of three sets of individual lights close together that were white yellow in color but widely spaced apart. The first two lights in the series of three were small and one larger. This was true of all three widely spaced sets of lights. The two smaller lights moved forward and became one light and they did this in unison constantly. Hovering of the lights lasted about a minute and a half at about 11 o’clock in the sky. Then the lights went slightly to the northeast and then straight up and disappeared. There was no sound anywhere. I had pulled over my truck and turned off the lights, and got out, so I could see them better. There were no lights on in my vehicle to reflect on the windshield and almost no lights to reflect in the surrounding area except way behind me.
