My first thought was to get my wife and have her look, but then I decided a picture first might be a better idea. After I took the picture, I went in to get her; it was gone before she could look. The color seems to be lit from the inside or from behind. By the time I could get my phone out, the clouds had covered a substantial area that was previously exposed through the hole in the clouds. I don't think it was a light from the ground because the clouds would reflect it. the lighted object seemed to be in the cloud. I thought it was interesting and unusual enough to submit it.

summary: Tumbling large red circular shape that was changing shape and moving NNW and didn’t appear to be too far above the ground
description:
Spotted as I was coming down Dixon, it was ahead of and above me on that road, traveling or rather tumbling and was emitting a dark red light from within. It looked transparent and seemed to have small points of red light within it. The inside area of the outer shape seemed to be illuminated, which is what made me think its light was internal And coming out of a transparent object. I’ll try to draw something and attach it, but I’m no artist at all.
There was no discernible sound, but there was some general noise from traffic around me.
The craft was oval or oblong, an odd roundish shape that was either changing or tumbling as it moved smoothly in a straight line.
Its edges weren’t static, but also not undulating - this is very hard to describe. If you could imagine a sentient blob from a Hollywood movie, more round than any other shape, and it’s exterior was bulging or being pushed out from within slightly but constantly in various directions, it’s like that. But it also appeared translucent and not solid. I just now remembered a cartoon from a couple decades ago called Aqua Teen Hunger Force, which has a character called Meatwad. It kind of moved like Meatwad does in that show.…

summary: Saw a bright blue light that looked like a star, thought it was weird so I pointed it out.
description: So myself and the two other witnesses were outside our place of work moving some stuff around with a forklift. I turned around and was walking back to open our gate to go back inside and I noticed a bright blue orb in the sky which I thought was a star and was confused because it was the middle of the day. Once I noticed the light it brightened then went out, but I could see what looked to be a stick standing on its end up and down in front of the cloud. I pointed it out to my coworker who was standing by me and asked if he saw what I was seeing and as I pointed it out to him it brightened itself back to the bright blue light then went out. Around that time as it’s drifting with the clouds to the north I assume trying to hide itself another coworker on the forklift drove up and asked what we were looking at and I pointed it out again and it did the same thing again and then disappeared into the distance with the cloud. 20 to 30 minutes later an Air Force aircraft showed up and was circling the area we saw the craft for like 20 minutes before just flying off.

summary: On October 10, 2023, near Calabasas Peak, pulsating blue light, observed a silent, disc-shaped object with a pulsating blue light
description:
Weather Conditions: Clear skies with good visibility, no cloud cover, and a new moon.
Description of the Object: The object was disc-shaped with a diameter of roughly 30 feet. It had a metallic surface with a silver hue and emitted a pulsating blue light from its underside. It made no sound, and it didn't have any visible propellers, wings, or engines.
Trajectory and Speed: The object was first noticed hovering about 300 feet above the ground. It then moved in a nonlinear pattern, making sharp turns and changing speeds abruptly. It accelerated rapidly and disappeared from view within approximately 30 seconds.
Duration of the Sighting: Approximately 1 minute.
Witnesses: The event was observed by four of my friends, who were camping in a rural area.
Physical Effects: No immediate physical effects were reported. However, both witnesses experienced a feeling of unease and mild headaches following the sighting.

All 3 of us have seen Starlink satellites: these were 100% not that.
These did not cross our clear view of the horizon. These were leaving into space.

summary: My wife and I saw lights in a craft coming out of a Mexican restaurant in Marietta Ohio.
description:
Around 6:55 PM October 10th 2023. My wife and I were leaving a Mexican Restaurant restaurant in Marietta, Ohio I saw a amazingly bright flash that continued over my left shoulder towards the Southwest.
The bright object in the sky was the color of the sun. The object was a shiny metallic and cigar or tictac shaped there was one bright orange orb as well.
The light I saw was the color of the sun setting so I believe it was a reflection of the Sun shining off the craft. My wife and I could tell for a fact that was not an airplane or drone. Would've been too high for a drone and to eradick for an airplane.
In faded in and out and moved super fast to different parts of the sky for the next 2 to 3 minutes. It was way faster than an airplane could fly, it was so beautiful.
My wife didn't see the first flash but saw everything after that.  She saw it a few times before it faded out as the sun set.  It was much larger than an airplane and would stay stationary for 10 to 30 seconds before shooting across the sky without contrails or noise.There was actually an airplane overhead at the same time with contrails and it looked completely different.

summary: An unusually bright orb of light floated stationary in the sky and darted away in an instant at an incredible speed

The object stayed stationary for 3-5 mins and suddenly darted away very fast similarly to an object being yanked by a string. Was very odd and different from any aircraft that has been seen above our property. We get lots of planes and drones and such but never seen anything like this

summary: Very large dk grey object in sky north of my position approximately 1-1.5 miles N. Insight 10 sec, pulled onto side rd to get view gone
description: Heading east on rt 172 just passed 183. Came downhill into valley and saw a very large object in the sky directly north approximately 1-1.5 miles. Object was dk grey but appeared to have white in it. Sky was light grey overcast. Object kinda looked like a 3/4 front view of a military destroyer. Hard line separation on bottom like the waterline on a vessel. The object rose up roughly 1/3 of its length then tapered back down for 2/3. It appeared for closest frame of reference to be about as long 2-2.5 Goodyear blimps ( which is fairly common to see in the canton/Akron area. This was not the blimp. Saw object for approximately 10secs as I slowed way down. No spot to pull off. Went out of view for 5-7 seconds as I pulled onto side road and came over a small hill(40’ rise). Object was completely gone. Noticed no movement from object while in sight nor any noticeable sound. Rough location would be 3/4 mile east of 183 , north of 172 1-1.5 miles and approximately 3.5 miles due south of homeworth Ohio. This is a route I drove every day for 4yrs straight and again for the last 5 months.

summary: Doughnut shape basketball size slow flying
description: We saw one of these over Bournemouth flying from west to east towards the direction of Hurn airport, following the course of the river Stour.  First sighted them over near Longham Bridge.  Tried to take a photo but couldn't zoom in enough.  It looked and flew exactly like this, like a doughnut shape tumbling end over end.  No fans, no propellor, no sound or lights or exhaust.  Thought it was a balloon to start with but there was no string and was flatter than what a balloon would be.  It wasn't flying erratically, it moved as if it was being powered.  There was no wind either.  Never seen anything like it before, it is interesting to see others have seen such phenomena in other parts of the UK and the world!  Not saying its aliens or anything but definitely "unidentified"!

summary: A reddish orb light was traveling silently from the East horizon to the South West horizon under the cloud cover in about two minutes.
description: On the evening of October 9th at about 8:52 PM I was walking across the tennis courts to my room when I noticed a bright reddish orb silently approaching from the east horizon. At first I thought it was a plane but it didn’t seem quite right so I took out my iPhone 13 and began recording as the orb crossed over head towards the south west horizon below the cloud cover of night. At some point in the video I zoom in. It took about two minutes for the object to cross the entire east to SW horizons before it was completely gone and out of sight. The flight pattern did not appear to be entirely straight either. At times it appeared as if the object took a “C” or “S” pattern as it traveled across the sky. I noticed this before I started filming and it shows a little bit of its pattern in the recording as well. I filmed for about 1 1/2 minutes before setting the phone down to watch the orb disappear in the SW horizon. If this is a UFO sighting it would be my first. I am 39 years old. As I watched the orb silently cross the sky, I was filled with curiosity for what it is.

Then i had my girlfriend come back over and said the same commands out loud and she saw it react as i specified although it was less dramatic as when i was just thinking. I ruled out astigmatism because no other stars seemed to move. The object looked exactly like the other brighter stars in the sky. The movements were very fasy, split seconds, but i had no way of telling how big or how far or what the object was. After 20 minutes i had to go somewhere so i left hoping it would be there when i got back but it wasn't. I had thought to it as i left 'Dont get shot down just playing with me!' Then i listened to 'Comfortably Numb'. Range of movement: 1 inch if you hold fingers out towards sky. I was in a front yard about a block from western bluff of island near town of Winslow and the ferry dock. I was looking west in direction of water and ferry route. The entire object was light, indistinguishable from other bright stars in sky. I would like to be contacted by an investigator only if there were other similar reports.

summary: Orange lights in the sky with smooth but random movement that joined in formation to form a triangle, then accelerated away from us.
description: I work medevac and fly on a pilatus PC-12. We were en route from Salt Lake City UT to Idaho Falls ID. We started tracking a series of lights (3-4) to the North East of our position around the time we hit the Idaho/Utah border. One of the lights appeared to have a parallel flight trajectory to the east of us off our right wing. It was several miles out. We radioed in to the SLC ATC and inquired if there was any traffic in our vicinity. We were instructed that there was no traffic. No other aircraft responded on the radio about being in the area. There was nothing on radar or a transponder signal. Eventually the light disappeared, but reappeared at a higher altitude, and there was 3-4 lights moving at a speed not consistent with any aircraft that we would be familiar with moving in random but smooth patterns. We were at 20k feet. These lights would fade in and out and all have different vectors. Eventually they all met up, formed a triangle formation with 3 points of light (one on each corner) and one faint light in the middle and it moved up and vanished. We landed at Idaho Falls and still noticed 1-2 lights at a time coming down (possibly through the atmosphere) flying in random…

summary: Reflective Orb
description:
I live on a small farm. We are always outside looking at the stars, as we are able to see constellations easily with it being so dark and far from city lights. On October 8, 2023, my family (husband, mother in law and son) and I were in the front yard just stargazing. What looked like a star was moving extremely fast while the others were still. I kept my eyes on it because I thought it was a shooting star. When it didn’t stop moving, I realized this was no shooting star. It wasn’t a plane, there were several of those out as well, all which had blinking lights. This had no blinking lights, and I watched it move SEVERAL miles in probably less than 10 seconds. Then it started moving in circles, very big circles, then it moved up, down did zigzags and this was all within just a few seconds. I sent my husband in the house to get a flashlight. As he was shining the flashlight toward the area we were seeing this at, the light reflected off a shiny “orb”. I had my phone out videoing the whole thing. We never could find it again.
Later that night, I spent HOURS watching this video. Slowing it down, changing the saturation. What I found was much more interesting than what I had originally…

summary: 15-20 clear, metallic orbs gathered at tree line, pulsed light in unison, left together, totally silent and disappeared.
description: It was dusk, just around 6pm on Saturday, October 8th in Wichita, KS. I was sitting on my back patio on a beautiful early evening. Our backyard has some trees on the perimeter but is mostly clear so that the sun can shine on the pool. Out of nowhere, I noticed at our treeline, which isn't extremely high, 15-20 clear, metallic orbs that were descending lower together. The formation were lines of 3 and 4, coming down together, like Space Invaders(pardon the pun). They were not in one long chain, so this was no Starlink. I couldn't believe that I actually had time to count them or that I was seeing so many at one time. There was absolutely no sound, so this was not a drone. They were self propelled and not swaying with any wind changes, so not a balloon either. They hung there for about 5 seconds and I got the feeling that they were checking me out? summary: I observed a black object appearing to rotate clockwise without sound as it moved West to East, reflecting sunlight periodically.
description:
I first observed the object in the Western sky above my house, appearing more distant than a passing plane which was moving North to South and initially believed it was a Bald Eagle changing courses in the air due to a seemingly black body and a white "head." As I continued to watch the object, I could tell it was lower than the plane had been, was dropping altitude and appeared to be a tumbling black triangle or other polygonal shape before settling into one altitude which did not appear to change in any meaningful way.
The object was moving West to East at a slow pace, without jerky movements and produced no sound. After it passed above my home and some power lines, it appeared to be rotating clockwise and was now a diamond shape like that found on an engagement ring. It passed above a nearby cell phone tower (~200ft high) as it continued East.
As it reached a nearby highway (from what I could tell distance-wise), the object began tracking South. Still rotating and no marked change in speed. Direction change wasn't abrupt or concerning in any way. Throughout the viewing, the object would reflect the sun but seemingly only on one side as it rotated.

summary: Saw a bluish green gumdrop shaped object flying probably around 1000 feet. Flew off at an incredible speed west towards the horizon

Flow flying air planes and helicopters are very common in this areas and I see them on a nearly daily basis but this was very clearly different to me and my passenger. The object moved so fast it was hard to get a clear image of what it was but it appeared to be a gumdrop shape. No noise was heard and the light was not bright enough to illuminate the ground but was a stark contrast to the black starless night sky of Atlanta. The object seemed very large. I was traveling west approximately 70mph and the object flew past at a speed seemingly hundreds of miles per hour. summary: 12 or more dim lights in a perfect chevron or boomerang shape

I was observing the night sky for only a few moments, when I noticed motion in my peripheral, to the north and about 80 degrees up from my location in my back yard. It was 12 or more very faint points of light forming a perfect chevron or boomerang. I watched the shape move in a linear constant speed from East to West with no sound. At first I thought it could be birds migrating, given its apparent size and silence from my perspective. But its shape was perfect and its path was perfectly straight. I could detect a shape that was greater than just the points of light as it passed over the stars, again like that of a boomerang or plane wings with no fuselage.
From my perspective, if the form were a known aircraft, it would be most similar to a B2 Bomber. However, if it were a conventional aircraft, it would have been no more than 1000 ft above the ground. Which would have produced immense sound.
Lastly, the appearance of the shape was mildly streaking or fluid in its motion. Almost like it was passing just below the surface of water.
I observed it for 10-15 seconds, starting at approximately due north of my location, until I lost sight of it over the West horizon.

summary: Five family members observed black, S-shape object, rotating counter-clockwise, due east, over Epping,NH.
description:
On the evening of September 29, 2023, my wife and I met our son at the Park-Ride parking lot in Epping,NH, about 6:30 PM where we picked up our two grandchildren, ages 10 and 13. There was plenty of daylight. Suddenly my wife pointed out the passenger-side front windshield and said, "What is that flying up there?" It took me a moment to see exactly where she was pointing, but then I saw what she was talking about. A flying object, in the shape of a pudgy S, was rotating counter-clockwise on its axis, moving unswervingly due east, at a constant speed. It was black. There were no observable lights. There was no detectable sound. All of us watched it until it moved out of sight, not climbing vertically, but moving on a steady, horizontal path. One of us watched the object through a spotter scope for about 20 seconds.
On the website reddit there are several postings about a black, rotating, S-shape object.
If you Google "UFO, drone, or weather balloon above Reagan National Airport" you will see a video that matches exactly what we saw flying over Epping on September 29, 2023.

description:
One object spotted in North/Northeast sky from the intersection vantage point. Clear day and no other clouds or objects visible in the vicinity. Traveling on the highway for most of the time it was witnessed, so I could not take a photo. The witnessed and elapsed times are estimated.
The object appeared circular with two shiny, silver dots on opposite sides of the circle at a ~150 degree angle to the ground. It appeared to have an outline of a circle, but clear in the middle. The sky was visible there. I am not good at estimating distance or size, but it was around an inch wide in the sky. Seemed to fly parallel to the ground for 30 seconds (after I noticed it), then descended quickly along that same angle. Dots were moving and one suddenly disappeared leaving a short, thick condensation trail in the sky. The other dot was less visible, but still moving and descending when I lost sight of it as I moved with traffic.
I work in a staff position at a university.

summary: Saw 3 bright orbs stationary in sky while landing at DFW
description:
Saw three UAP / UFO orb shaped bright lights aligned nearly vertical in sky while landing at DFW Airport. The 3 lights / orbs seemed stationary until the top orb seemed to suddenly jot to left for few seconds before disappearing near the end of my sighting.
Video attached.
In the video, you can clearly see some type of regular aircraft moving from right to left through the bottom of light formation. But the 3 bright orbs never moved. Once the aircraft passed through a good distance, the top orb seemed to flicker to left in sky and simply disappear from view.
The orbs were 3 different colors. The bottom was a beautiful deep orange amber hue in color, the middle orb was a very light amber/ more yellow in color and the top orb was more white -incandescent color.
Sighting took place while we landed at DFW and we were taxiing to the terminal. It only lasted a few minutes because I lost sight once the pilot made a sharp turn. I was sitting in front left side of airplane - so I believe the sightings were in SW (more West) direction looking outside airplane window.
My husband and I both saw the lights.

summary: Orange orb chased away by airplanes
description: In the evening three of us were outside smoking and looked up to see an orange orb flying across the sky. It was flying northeast in one direction seemingly above the house line in the distance but closer than the red flashing aviation ground poles on the hills in the distance. It was flying straight until an airplane started going toward it's direction. At that point the orb turned at about a 45 degree angle and dimmed away into the distance directly away from the airplane and us and disappeared in a matter of seconds. After that we saw about 30 airplanes heading in that direction but we live near two airports a private local one and one air force base within a 30 mile radius. We always see Cessna planes and jets but this was decidedly different. Every other flying object we've seen we can also hear before they're in eyesight and well after they're out of sight, but before the other planes showed up, we heard nothing. The orb was silent the entire time it was observed.

summary: UAP fly by 6 F-18s in formation

A couple days later I’m reviewing the footage and as it’s in slow motion I see an object dart across the frame passing the planes like they’re frozen still. The object looks to be about a third the size of the planes and the dark shade is the same on both the object and the planes. It’s going so fast, unless you know where to look you won’t see it!

(We do that, grab videos then take screen shots) Later that day reviewing photos I was trying to find a good screen shot from the video, as I slowed the video down there was a spec in each frame of the video. I blew it off at first but it looked as if the spec was following a track/pathway. Each frame the spec/sphere/shape moved and looked a bit different and followed a path with a slight turn/arch in the last couple frames. This video is shot with an iPhone14Pro while we are traveling at least 75mph. I will send you the original video but you don’t see it until the speed is decreased. I would have never seen this if I was not editing a random 2 second video, just for a decent photo. It’s pretty remarkable that this 2 sec clip might have caught something. Definitely hesitant to send this is, because as it is odd it also could just be a bug, bird or debris. I…

summary: A light show in the early morning hrs...wow
description:
Bogey! At approx 04:23hrs looking up at the cloudy early morning sky from behind Starbucks spot prior, mostly S - SW at a really bright appearing star or planet or other?¿ at a very very high altitude *checked with saved Earth Sky emails and not a thing jived for bright objects in the early morning sky in that direction, no known planets or stars mentioned. Will attempt of course to decipher at a later point in time.
And huh, as I sat there and the broken, rolling cloud cover doing its thing and just below the bright object in the early morning sky, at a very very high altitude there all of a sudden! appeared a faint 'flit! flit! flit!' of a spark practically asking, "do you see moi?" and then of course cloud cover made it go bye bye.

summary: High speed UFO Sighting
description:
While out in the yard with the dog, I glanced up at the sky and notice a dark colored elongated teardrop shaped object speed through an opening in the clouds. It was moving at a high rate of speed, reentered the clouds and was gone in seconds. The object's flight paths was from West to East and south of my location. I didn't hear any sound coming from the object and there wasn't any contrails or noticeable means of propulsion. No flight surfaces where visible and the object appeared to be larger than normal air traffic common to the skies above my home. If I had to estimate, I would say it was about twice as long as an airliner.
I was unable to take any photos or video due to the briefness of the sighting. But I did think to take a photo of the sky for reference of the object location and cloud formations present during the sighting (making sure to capture landmarks).
I immediately went in the house and did a sketch of the object. It was flat black in color like a weathered car bumper. I will attach the location photo that I took for reference as well as the sketch I did.

summary: Bright light that changed color and faded on and off.
description: I was leaving to walk my dog when I saw what looked like a meteor by its brightness. It did not move like one but did maneuver in the sky with some speed. It was going north to south then stood stationary. It would change from bright white to orange the fade out. Then repeat. As it was faded out, it maneuvered further away when dark then reappear in another spot illuminated again. Looked like it could have been a very large drone, but it's range of travel seemed unlikely to be a personal drone. It eventually remained lit and returned to the north off into the horizon and left my sight heading towards North Shore of LI / Connecticut. I recorded 2 30 second video clips. Also this was 100% not a plane or helicopter. I had full visual of all the plane traffic in the area and they all were at the correct altitudes for arrival into JFK. This light was intense. You can see airplanes and a star in the background of the videos I took.

There was ample daylight still as it headed west, but no telltale sign of any type of aircraft body. It remained a dull orange colored orb as it flew out of sight.

description:

Whilst walking home just after midnight I observed some lights in the sky to the West. Due to the number of street lights where I was I walked towards a retail park where it was a little darker to get a better view. I observed a bright light in the sky which illuminated the surround clouds. Its altitude did not change it was not a comet or meteorite in the atmosphere. There was 3 objects which circled around each other, at times their altitude went a little higher and they made a C shape at one point, was very bright. I managed to film but as this totally caught me by surprise and I am not use to recoding much on my phone especially at night I did not make full use of the zoom feature. I recorded a 5 minute video 2x zoom but too large to upload its nearly 700MB and took some photos which have attached. I did not observe any noise from the distance I was from them which I estimate to be 4-5kms.
I am trying to keep anonymous if you want the video email me.

summary: A bright big white/ yellow moon like craft hovering in the sky. When spotted me started moving towards me, i had to run.
description: I was out for my usual walk and noticed bright light behind the trees. I thought to myself I didn't realise it was a full moon. I thought i might not need my torch afterall. As i was listening to an podcast i carried on walking behind the trees then i wondered where did the moon go. I thought perhaps it was the street light i saw. I wondered now where the moon was. I now keep seeing the moon like object ( very big and bright) one minute in my left, next minute on my right and i thought to myself moon can't change the position so fast. I started following the object until i got to an open farmland, then object started coming towards me . It was huge, bright and round . I started running as fast as i could. I turned around twice to see if it was behind me and it was keeping up with me. I ran into a lane leading to houses to catch my breath and went home. This was something i never saw before. Moon like huge moving object.

summary: 6 rectangular lights in a straight line moving across the sky
description:
I was elk hunting in the mountains near Rollinsville, CO on Monday the 25th of September. At around 2110 hours, I stepped outside of the cabin to brush my teeth. It was a clear dark night with all the stars visible. I was looking at the big dipper when I saw 6 or so rectangular lights appear in a linear formation equidistant apart. They were moving west to east at commercial airliner cruising altitude but faster. I watched them for about 5 seconds or so then they started to disappear one by one. Unfortunately, it happened too fast for me to retrieve my cell phone and take a picture or video.
An investigator can contact me if they wish.

Size approximated a bright star. Speed was faster than any satellite we've seen. And they disappeared when approx. overhead. Within a minute or two, from the same originating spot, one took off at the same speed towards the SE. We lost count but around six to eight repeated with about 30 second intervals. The last event was two pair on the same track as the others. They made no sound. My wife and I both clearly saw the objects. She thinks they were meteors - after some research on Utube, I saw nothing similar via video or by verbal description. I'm not sure what they were. Contact me if you wish.

summary: Ball of glowing light slowly circulating the water before immediately submerging.
description:
As we began the descent from Bristol Airport (UK) to Dublin Airport (Ireland), the plane turned left, and there was a glowing orb above the water. The orb was approximately 10ft above the water and was slowly circulating. After 15 seconds, the orb instantly submerged into the water (a quick 90-degree turn downwards). It didn't slow in speed; it just shot down quickly. The ball/orb was consistent in its movements, circling in a perfect circle.
I can't say how large the object was, but it was large enough to be viewed from an airplane during its descent (we weren't majorly high at this period either). The object was a circular white object with a warm yellowish glow.
I've run some obvious explanations through my head, and it wasn't a reflection from something inside the plane. The flight was almost empty on the flight back, so I experimented with light reflections in the window. The reflective lights didn't have the same brightness and depth as the orb. There wasn't any double/triple light that you'd get from triple-barrelled airplane windows. On the same return flight, some lights from outside the airplane reflected off the engine. That type of light wasn't what I saw above the…

It then slowly and silently floated from southwest to southeast of my location, taking a curved path across the valley

summary: Expanding and contracting distant white object
description:
A stationary white distant object that changed shape and size was observed in the sky by two witnesses. Initially it was slightly brighter and larger than Venus, which made the two witnesses (husband and wife) take notice because it seemed unusual and out of place. Multiple times the object changed shapes, expanded in size, and shrunk back down to its original size. The camera was a Samsung A11 smartphone which was zoomed to its maximum during the whole time images were taken. The other witness was watching the object unaided, and also with binoculars, and independently verified what he saw confirmed the behavior of the object as shown by the images. After about a ten minute period, they stopped watching and walked back into their home perplexed by what they both saw.
This report being made on behalf of the witnesses.

summary: 3 individual bright flashes of light and a separate large orb of light.
description: I am an Airline Pilot flying a Boeing 767 from Memphis, TN to Charlotte, NC. All month the same other Pilot and I have been witnessing strange lights in the sky. On this particular early morning, we had two more strange occurrences. The first happened at cruising altitude. I can’t recall if we were at 34000 or 36000 feet. We were scanning the skies because we have seen numerous strange light occurrences all week. They have always been small lights appearing and disappearing that seem to be in outer space. This one was different. Within 5-10 seconds, right as we were looking outside the left window of the aircraft cockpit, we both saw 3 separate very bright flashes of light in the same vicinity of each other that were bluish green in color. They flashed in sequential order then never reappeared. About 20 minutes later, on our descent into Charlotte, NC I saw a small white light from deep outer space that quickly flew towards my side of the cockpit on the right side until it appeared as a large white orb then vanished. It started as a small light like a shooting star, then within 3-5 seconds it was a large orb that felt like was within 5-10 miles from us. The orb was about the size…

description:
Last night there was a line slightly curved in the sky with what appeared to be a haze only in the line. One broke ranks and zoomed to the right in the haze then the whole thing vanished. The rest of the sky was clear and without aircraft until they disappeared. Then suddenly there were at least 6 aircraft.

summary: This thing was moving Northabout as fast as a small airplane but it appeared to be tumbling and not traveling in straight line.
description: I was inside the Mukilteo ferry terminal when I saw a dark object moving North over South Whidbey Island. That is about 3.5 miles from where I was. It was probably 500 to 800 ft above the Island. After watching it for a few seconds I could see that it was not an airplane. There were no wings or tail and it appeared to be tumbling as it moved forward. I alerted a young lady that was there and she snapped these shots. At that point it had made an arcing turn to NE and was about over Hat Island when took them. Unfortunately when you zoom in they get blurry. It then continued in the direction of the Tulalip reservation and disappeared.

No noise and all air traffic seemed to stop before and during the event. After the event you could hear jets from Nellis Airforce base. Recorded video of the event. description: My dog was walking through the yard. Then stopped and looked around. Not a usual thing he would do. After a couple of seconds of looking around, he looked up when a beam of a lighter blue light struck him. The light was visible for a second or two. Then he ran inside once the light flashed on him. summary: Nineteen independent red lights appeared in sky
description: Nineteen independent red lights appeared over the ocean in sky well above horizon. They appeared in random spots and had no tail like a flare or fireball. They they disappeared after 20-30 seconds. The lights were not in a line and not all at the same height but well above the horizon.

summary: star like but not
description:
myself and my fiancée were out watching the stars .... it was a clear evening with multiple satellites and aircraft going over.
Being from the UK im used to light pollution so this was very special - no light pollution at all!
my attention was drawn to what at first appeared to be a satellite - it was about 30 degrees above the horizon and was brighter than previous satellites. It was traveling from the NW towards the North at a 'normal' satellite speed.
However - it was bouncing / jumping up and down. I would describe it as having a similar appearance to a trace from an ECG monitor.
I asked my fiancée if she was seeing the same as me and she confirmed that she was.
i know what a satellite looks like - i know what starlink looks like. I work at an airport and am familiar with all known aircraft.
I have no idea what this was......

summary: Lights disappeared one by one
description: I’m from Florida, and familiar with starlink. Naturally, I assumed it was starlink at first. But this line of lights was not as many, and disappeared one by one. It only lasted 1or 2 min max. By the time we drove out from under trees it was gone. I tried to take pictures, but couldn’t get them without the flash hitting the windshield. I took two. They are terrible photos. But the last remaining light, clearly has a small light shining down under it. Not the blur from the street lights, a light coming out from under it. This was a really distressing scenario to my mum as she felt no one would believe her, though she told us and we could see from the picture something weird is going on.

location: San Rafael (Lucas Valley / Marinwood), CA, USA
summary: About 20 bright lights floating inline
description: Observing about fleet of 20 bright lights floating inline from west to east (from ocean to in land) over Lucas Valley / Marinwood. Lights were a size of stars in the night sky, and the fleet of light was moving in sky with equal interval between each other, in very straight line like a military unit. But, by reaching some abstract and invisible point in sky they become disappearing one after another (not all at once). Unfortunately, a camera on Iphone 12 is too weak to make recording of those light in night sky.

summary: Saw an object approx 15-20K feet that appeared to be rotating in a shere
description: This object has been routinely spotted this summer on clear nights. The object in the enclosed video slowly ascended straight up out of view, but danced around from side to side-it appeared an object like a saucer -was both spinning in the sphere and moving 180 continuously in the sphere This is my first time reporting but on June 2nd I got a clear view of a saucer that was much lower to the ground through my field binoculars. I believe the saucer is creating some kind of magnetic field as it navigates our environment which is not visible to the naked eye during a daytime sighting. In the evening the lights of the saucer allow for a view of this magnetic field as its lights bounce off it, creating the view I am uploading tonight. I have seen this object at varying different altitudes all summer. eventually lights will dim as the object decides to take off. This appears to me to be the same type object our Navy has been spotting and recording. If you have good binoculars, when the lights dim for departure a saucer can be seen in the sphere. We dont fly aircraft in pitch black at 40K with the cockpit lights bright, you can not see well out the window. I believe the same applies…

summary: Initially noticed something hovering then I started paying attention and watched the next night when the sky was full of movement
description: The first night I only noticed one oblong shape hovering. The second night I was more aware and the sky was full of movement along with many in different shapes ( triangular, oblong, circle, sphere) hovering. I even seen beams of light scan around the said UFO's. I noticed something falling from the sky on several accounts As I was sitting out watching the sky I heard tin crashing in a neighbors yard. When I looked in that direction I seen something that seemed to be crawling and the eyes were like lights. Then I heard dogs barking in another neighbors direction when I seen the same lighted eyes except this time it was walking with a slump. I will be watching tonight but I have no camera to take pictures or video. I do apologize, I wish I did.

location: Sosua, Puerto Plata Province, Dominican Republic
summary: We saw a family of "sky rays" feeding in the clouds
description: We were taking down our clothes drying on the balcony and looked out over ocean and saw six to eight giant rays at least a mile in diameter with a larger parent with a tail like a sting ray feeding in the clouds. They are translucent like a jellyfish and could be made of water vapor. They move around the sky resembling rays, jellyfish, and protozoa so they are from this Earth. I think they migrate every September to the Puerto Rican trench.

summary: I felt compelled to go outside around 10:15 PM and I saw these reddish-orange orbs in the sky.
description: I was outside viewing about 7 or so before I ran inside to grab my cell phone, it was in my room so grabbed my mothers. I filmed for 6 minutes or so, ran back inside to get my mom to witness and handed her her phone. I ran to my room and grabbed my phone because its newer so I figured it was a better camera. I sent the video to my cousin who is a sergeant in the marines and asked if these looked like drones, flares or something else military oriented. He said: "I have no clue what that could’ve been. No way it was a drone or flare with the way those were moving that’s really cool though." While sky lanterns are illegal in FL I know people will break the law so entertained these objects could be that, but in one video an orb disappears then reappears in the 6:04 video (within the first 17 seconds or so), and the lot of them move backwards. It was not breezy at all out, you can see there is no movement in the treetops. I suppose a pocket of air up high could have caused the backwards movement. Here's a Youtube link with all of the footage stitched together unedited: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VwRtWfXbF2c

summary: All sorts of lights showing
description: I'm seeing a mixture of lights that seem to follow a circular pattern around like red and green beaconing lights with white lights and it just moved probably a good few feet or so from previous location.

summary: One bright, shiny fuzzy spark JRA...just rolling along
description: Bedding down for the night (currently homeless) and got laid down on my back looking up at the stars from my not comfortable sleeping position and bogey!, from the W - N.W. did fly one single BIGGER, brighter, fuzzy (kinda) spark. It trucked along as they typically do. It was such an obvious UAP (to me) that I did emote (mental telepathy) out loud!, to any/all parking lot users within mindshot to, "look up! There's one!" It continued on to the E - S.E. until out of my viewable sight. -end

location: Around Ashland or Thornton, NH, USA
summary: We saw an object we couldn’t identify over the highway it hovered for a moment moved slightly and disappeared suddenly
description: We saw the object hovering and then disappear. My significant other is ex Air Force and didn’t recognize the object as having any light pattern he was aware of. It was high above the highway in the mountains and it suddenly was gone. The aura was visible when I enlarged the image I took with my phone. I am not necessarily requesting to speak with an investigator but would be happy to if the investigators have questions.

summary: Slow Moving and well lighted object in the shape of a very long ladder with length of three football fields It was huge.
description: Spotted around 8:35 pm by my friend when moving the car into the driveway of the house. After approximately two to three minutes, all lights on the craft dimmed in sync and were no longer visible. No clouds in the sky. He called me to come outside to see what he saw. I came out and saw the craft. I went back inside the house to get a camera and when returning to the driveway, the craft was no longer visible. My friend is a huge UFO skeptic and saw the same thing and swears by it as well.

summary: Bright star like appearance then disappears
description: 8:16 pm Saturday night, September 16, 2023 - UFO spotting in Indian Lake, NY - an extra bright light moving vertical relatively fast (at first thought it was a satellite), but then started going back and forth horizontal and then began to fade and disappeared.

summary: 2 Flashing orb/cubes caught circling each other, then going to a wider diameter, then separating and going off in opposite directions
description: At 8:15, I noticed two bright lights in the sky circling each other in a tight circle, then into a larger circle. Then the two lights went off in opposite directions of each other (one SW and one NE). I was able to take a pic of them close together, then the second video shows them going away from each other. The third 44 sec video is of one of the crafts/lights leaving. When you zoom in, the object is flashing multiple colors and seems to be rotating/tumbling. No sounds came from either of the crafts and no vapor trail or any obvious way of propulsion.

summary: I witnessed an object pacing, and exceeding the speed of, the International Space Station.
description: While observing the ISS passing overhead, I saw a star-like object travelling parallel to, and just north of the ISS. It was perhaps 5 degrees north of the ISS, and "pacing" it in the sky. It was pulsating in light intensity, about 6 times in the 40 seconds of observation. It's speed was about double that of the ISS. It went out of view in the northeast, as did the ISS.

summary: UFO seen following and then passing International Space Station.
description:
My wife and I were watching the ISS fly over our house. Suddenly we saw another light rapidly coming up behind the ISS, on what appeared to be the same path as the ISS. The light then caught up to and rapidly passed the ISS, at which point we could tell it was quite a bit higher than the ISS and much, much faster.
The light passed above and just slightly to the left of the space station, and quickly disappeared behind the clouds. We watched the ISS for probably another 45 seconds to a minute until it also went behind the clouds.

summary: Short downward Flash like meteor, then stopped and became a pulsing sphere, and moved across the sky ESE direction
description: I am including additional photos, to a previous post. On September 16, 2023 around 8 PM, I witnessed a short downward flash in the night sky, which turned into a pulsing sphere, that traveled across the sky in a southeast direction. The video is a bit shaky because I was going down my driveway to get a better view with my video phone, and I was able to later review in detail. I’ve enclosed the original video, and some enlarged photos from frames, which are pretty INCREDIBLE.. Aside from the changing colors, there appears to be possible rims, split shapes and something inside another photo but very faint. I hope this can be reviewed.

summary: Short flash like falling star, then stopped suddenly as a bright orb and started crossing sky southeastward
description: I was ready to leave my driveway around 8pm on Saturday September 16, 2023 and was startled to observe a short flash, very defined light burst where I looked up to the left in the dark sky, which appeared similar to a falling star but much shorter and wider, and probably a mile high. It then stopped and turned into a round bright light. I grabbed my phone, and started to video. It was spherical, like an orb, and moved steadily across the sky going south and east. It was also very high in the sky and I was able to film about two minutes on my phone camera but the video was a little shaky because I was walking down my driveway to keep filming it because it was going behind the trees, from my view. After I could no longer see it to film, I reviewed the video. The zoomed in shots are of a sphere, that changed colors, including golden yellow, light blues and light red, and one photo (if clear, looks like something sitting inside?) Definitely not a plane, lantern, or drone. I will include the video and the zoomed photos I have from screenshots of frames. I don’t know if anyone else in the area saw this, but I did call the 8th Police Precinct. The area was initially approximately 40.729…

summary: My 7 year old took a picture of this fireball he saw in the sky. By the time he came inside to show us it was gone.
description: 7 year old and his friend noticed a fireball in the sky while jumping on the trampoline. It was just before sunset. They took pictures and ran in to tell us but when we went to look it was gone.

summary: Thought it was shooting star, no sound. Stopped/hung in mid-air. 3 red lights, turned green. Lights turned white then flew west.
description:
A nice night, my husband (former Air Force) and I were on our deck enjoying the night. He looked up and said "Look! A shooting star!" I caught it flying diagonally downwards from the east (about a 30 degree trajectory) and it just stopped. The "tail" of what we first thought was a shooting star dissipated very quickly before it stopped in mid-air. Just a small dot of light. Then three steady, round red lights poof! went on. It just hung out there, perfectly still, in mid air for about a minute. Then the lights turned green for a few seconds. The lights went white and it sped off west. We lost sight of it behind the trees. There was no sound, no chem trails, no light trail. No craft in the sky.
We unfortunately did not get a picture. We weren't quick enough. But I can draw a diagram to figure the distance and size.

summary: Item, larger than an eagle, traveling eastward (and potentially a little north or south), not moving upwards or downwards in the sky. It appeared to be flying lower than planes that were landing…
Near midair collision between tow plane and orb
description: While towing gliders, descending through 2000 ft, a grey ball was encountered on opposite course. The object was at same altitude, approximately 50 meters away. I was in a shallow left turn setting up my approach, and the orb was spotted very close before merging to my right. When seeing it was not a bird I turned right (to end up on a crossing course) to be able to keep my eyes on the object. At the point of least distance between us I could see a matte grey color (seemingly) perfect spherical shape, and i followed the object as it drifted of to my right out of sight. The sighting lasted ca 4-5 seconds in total. It was mid to dark grey, and did not have a shiny appearance. My airspeed was 200kmh. The objects speed is impossible to estimate. The merge happened fast, and when turning to a perpendicular heading it was seen floating away at some speed, although possibly simply at the general wind speed. I did not see anything inconsistent with a party balloon, besides the seemingly perfectly spherical shape. The object was travelling northbound, pretty much from the direction of a town, and did not seem to ascend or descend. I got a clear view of the objects color and shape and can…

summary: I got up to use the bathroom and saw bright lights near my window that were beyond anything I've seen
description: near my window that were beyond anything I've seen. Lights varied from green, blue, red and white. It flashed away quickly and dissappeared after several hours of staying in the same place.

summary: I seen some sort of insect mantis looking being

I saw these orbs look like it was in a triangle form and a being above it that looked like some sort of insect or praying mantis with two glowing lights on the face but it didn’t have a face and it looked like it was holding something.

summary: I have been witnessing strange lights almost every night sometimes in the sky, sometimes in the woods or on the ground.
description:
I have been witnessing strange lights or orbs (I’m honestly not sure) for over a year now. They are sometimes white, sometimes flashing different colors. They seem to stay in a generalized area for the most part but will bounce around. There are times that they move significantly. I’ve caught on film throughout this past year many things I cannot explain. I’ve shown people that don’t understand it either. In one picture you see a white ball looking object on the ground in front of the shed. I was outside on the porch smoking a cigarette when I looked and noticed something seeming to glow. I then took a video and showed the people whose house it was and they had no explanation of what it could be. We were on a dirt road with no neighbors anywhere near us so it wasn’t some ball from a neighbors yard or balloon or whatever.
The videos are anywhere from last July- yesterday. I would love for someone to come witness this that can give me some sort of peace of mind about what I’m dealing with.
There are many videos some hour or longer, in which case a couple times I have lost spurts of time. I have no recollection of those minutes that pass.
I should note that I have never felt…

summary: Orb or disc hovering by Buckley AFB at night
description: I was leaving Aurora, Colorado, heading south on E470 towards I-25. It was around 12:20 am on September 16th, 2023, that I noticed something flying in the sky maybe less than 1000ft in the air. I’ve worked in both military and private aviation and noticed immediately how strange the lights were for the craft. It had very bright white lights that were doing a wave-strobe effect to it, looked like the white lights were rotating around the craft while strobing. It also had two bright reddish/orange lights on the top and bottom that were pulsating with intensity. When I first noticed it, it seemed to be passing my field of view quickly as I was driving, but then it stopped moving and stayed still. It then started moving slowly towards Buckley Air Force Base on the other side of E470. I tried to watch it longer, but I was also driving on the highway and nearly got into a crash because it was hard to not look at this thing. As I moved closer to I-25, it went closer to Buckley and then it left my field of vision. Because of the time of night and highway lights it was difficult to discern any real shape to it, but it did have a pale blue glow at the bottom of it.

summary: Orange glow bright then it turned itnto orange glow with tail and the tail had hint of green and then yellow. Looked like it blew up and then fell.
It was long and slender and appeared to be a solid, brilliant red that terminated in a distinct "V" shape at its rear end.
description: As the UAP rose it seemed to alter direction which caused it to straighten out in my line of sight and thus condense to a departing rear view only or it could have begun to cloak itself. Either way, it moved quickly toward the E/SE until disappearing.

summary: Lights moving diagonally thru Big Dipper, disappearing and seemingly ‘reappearing’ at the start of the line
description:
I was at a concert with my friend rj and we were sitting at a picnic table looking at the stats during the break.
I noticed a satellite moving diagonally up to the right through the cup of the Big Dipper, then noticed one behind it at a fixed distance moving at the same speed. I assumed it was the Starlink satellite train and told rj “I think I see starlink” and pointed it out to him.
He had an experience once when his friend Cody and him saw Starlink, Cody freaked out and said it was a ufo, but RJ looked up a video of Starlink and showed Cody, so RJ has seen and knows what Starlink looks like.
We then watched and noticed there were three four or five dim lights following each other in a straight diagonal light. The light in the front would quickly fade our when reaching around the middle point of the cup of the Big Dipper. We noticed they were fading in in the start of the line, below the bottom left Star forming the bottom of the cup of the dipper, moving steady at a steady brightness and suddenly fading out near the center of the cup of the dipper. This went on long enough for us to have a whole conversation about what we were seeing. I would guess 90 seconds to two and a half…

summary: straight line of object rising in the sky
description: was out smoking and witnessed a line of object rising into the sky looked like an ir flare however it was not falling it was rising

summary: Bright orbs
description: Starting around 8:30pm on 9/15 and 9/16 multiple uap sightings that were sporadic in a 1-1.5 hour period. They start as orbs through the sky sometimes multiple moving together non blinking lights and we are in a rural area with not much air traffic. They are traveling at a high rate of speed but will fade out. What really baffles me on 9/15 there was a string of blue lights around 10+ that were traveling through the sky in an upward motion but sideways (completely different look than starlink) they were spaced far apart but consecutively following one another in a straight pattern. I went out the evening of 9/16 and witnessed the same thing with multiple orbs traveling through the sky around 5 individual ones and again saw a string of crafts traveling straight up in the sky coming from what looked like bottom traveling up one after another that lasted 5minutes. I don’t know what’s going on in our area lately but it’s incredibly exciting and if it continues happening I think this is worth investigating.

summary: We witnessed a low flying object approaching slowly from the west going eastward, while I was driving home on 9/15/‘23 around 3:30 P.M.
description: While driving up a hill and approaching our driveway, I noticed an object flying low over the neighborhood houses. As it came closer, I noticed that it was not a plane nor a helicopter and it was not flying south towards the Tucson airport - which is the usual flight route for planes. Instead it was flying over the back of our house and going east towards Mount Lemmon. Immediately, I knew that it was unusual and I asked my husband to look at it and tell me what it was. He told me that it was a UFO. When I parked the car in the garage - the silvery looking disc/object disappeared from view. We were both in shock. This happened on Friday afternoon at about 3:30 P.M. September 15, 2023 in Tucson, Arizona.

duration: Over an hour and a half
summary: Moving light amongst the stars
description:
At 530 in the morning, my wife and I went for a walk before sunrise. On our way home, we noticed a light in the sky that was moving in a weird direction. Stopping and observing for a moment, noticing it may be a drone we continued on our way asking who would be flying and why since we live on a farm away from people. After using my military training and using flight apps available nothing was in the air above our location and the light was moving in a non aircraft way. After arriving home I watched for a good 10 mins before grabbing my phone and started taking pics. I then zoomed in and noticed something not of this worlds. After recording it and taking pics, the craft hung around until about 705 in the morning when I left to bring my kids to school. I showed other members of my family and asked others what they think of the pictures I saw. Most agree it is something they haven’t seen.
The object in the picture is possibly a Death Star looking item. Lights seemed to be the color of the bottom with possible rotating light. The light was constant on the bottom and was still bright after the stars were no longer available. The craft did maneuver in a zig zag quick circle pattern.

summary: A distant orb makes several different changes of direction, and then speeds off.
description:
It was approximately 5:17 a.m. on 9/15/2023 when I was outside my house taking my morning stretch. As I leaned back and looked into the sky, I saw a distant light/orb moving across the sky (it was still quite dark out). At first I dismissed it as the ISS drifting along its orbit, but then the orb started to make turns and moves. I dashed inside and grabbed my phone and was able to take one video of the orb (I have an iPhone 14 Pro Max). The uncut video is about 40 seconds long, but the orb can only be seen in the first 15 or so seconds.
As you can see from the video, the orb really starts to make some moves at around the :03 second mark, and then it does several turns before zooming off and vanishing.
I have attached the uncut original iPhone clip. I also retained a professional video editor to enhance and cleaned up. I attach two of those clips provided by the video editor. The enhanced version really shows the details of the moves the orb makes.
This is not a hoax and I provide the raw, untouched video.

summary: Blinking lights in the sky
description:
I noticed a light in the sky. I didn’t think anything seemed out of the ordinary because I was near the Lubbock airport. However, then I noticed the light was not moving, where as a plane would. So I started to pay closer attention. I then noticed the flash pattern and colors weren’t the typical pattern and colors of the planes I’m used to seeing. It also dawned on me that it’s 4 in the morning and the Lubbock airport doesn’t have commercial flights arriving or departing from about 1 am till almost 6 am. At this point I’m really curious, and I also notice, what seems to be two more lights flashing in the sky. So I started recording. My best guess is weather balloons or drones. However, I would like to report and if possible find out the logical explanation for these lights.
In total there seemed to be three objects and they were flashing red and yellow/orange. I could not make out a distinguishable shape because it was night time.
https://youtu.be/LYPZbkmeJd4?si=bBoOnin8ZW7SSTK1

summary: While driving, a giant, bright neon green fireball/sphere shape w/irregular edges flew downward from the sky south to north
description:
On Thursday, September 14 at approximately 11:55 pm while I was headed home, I was driving west on Butterfield Road right before crossing Naperville Road in Wheaton when I witnessed a giant, neon green fireball/sphere-like object with irregular/jagged edges leaving a long trail of green behind it flying angled downward from the sky traveling south to north - right behind/above a stripmall where TJ Maxx and other stores are.
I had my windows rolled up, but didn’t hear any sound.
It disappeared behind the buildings and I couldn’t tell how close it was, but it seemed like it was right in the sky in front of me up ahead.
I heard no sound of impact.
The whole event was only a few seconds as it traveled extremely fast.
It was the most surreal and bizarre thing I’ve ever seen.
Only 1 other car was driving next to me at the time with no others on the road.

summary: 2 Cloud-like chevron/ V-shaped objects pass over house about 30 seconds apart
description:
I was star gazing with a friend late in the evening on September 14. The weather was clear, but with some clouds and an occasional thin haze that is common in coastal Florida drifting by. Overall the viewing conditions were good, the stars were clear and there was no moon to be seen. The area I was star gazing from has a mostly unobstructed view of the sky except for some trees to the west.
There was a lot of aircraft activity that night, with a military drone doing lazy circles overhead but slightly to our west (this is not uncommon in our area as we are close to several Air Force bases and the drones are often overhead at night). The drone was easily visible by it's flashing navigation lights, and the humming sound it produces. Additional military jets were flying around, often visible but more often you can just hear the sound of the afterburners in the distance. I assume they were running some exercises that evening. We also spotted at least one commercial aircraft (assumed) flying high and along the standard east-west path they fly.
Around 11:30, my friend pointed to the north and asked 'what is that?'. I focused my eye towards the area he was pointing and saw what looked…

summary: Glowing orb which suddenly vanished.
description: I looked out of my glass deck door and saw a glowing light which looked odd and not like an airplane. It looked orange and white. I ran to my room to grab my phone and caught it on video for a few and then it disappeared. I also saw aircraft activity near it but this did not resemble an airplane or helicopter. The encounter laster about a minute or so after I saw it but it could've been there longer. I also have been noticing other glowing strange lights lately plus extra airplane activity and saw another white round glowing light last week but it was moving slowly. My and my girlfriend both saw the one last week but the one tonight I saw alone. This one looked lower to the ground and closer. I also noticed my outside flood light which hasn't worked in 2 years flicker for about 2 hours a week ago which I found strange.

summary: Saw four large rectangle shaped white lights hovering in the distance.
description: Was driving home, stopped at a red light when I saw four rather large rectangle shaped bright white lights hovering over a tree line in the distance across a field. I rolled my window down, heard no sound and the objects didn't appear to move, just hover. They were evenly spaced, rectangle shaped and extremely bright with a fuzzy haze around them. I drove home and immediately told my friend what I had seen. Someone I told suggested it was starlink so I looked that up and not only was it not visible in my area at that time but it looked nothing like it.

summary: Suddenly appearing bright light similar to that of a star.
description: It was late between 9:30 and 12:00, I went outside to smoke before going to bed, and I looked up into the night sky and it was completely pitch black, and suddenly the sky wasn't pitch black anymore there was a bright star hanging in the sky that wasn't there a moment ago. The light at first was a pale orange, like orange cream that turned into a brilliant white light, it hung there for a few moments and then started to strafe across the sky until it disappeared into the horizon, and it kept the same speed and it kept the same direction and it kept the same luminosity the entire time that it traveled across the sky, it didn't flicker it didn't blink it didn't do anything, it just moved across the sky in a straight line.

summary: I was chased by many orbs and other types of craft throughout an entire night driving through the mountains.
description: To much to write. It was very traumatic.

description: Golden circles suddenly appeared and then suddenly disappeared.

summary: light like orb move quickly upwards, bright circle, simple wavy sides, very bright, movement, disappeared, no clouds
description: On back patio looking north sky high in the sky a moving orb of light quick and then turning into a brilliant glowing circle of white and the some blue with movement on the sides and then disappearing. No clouds. Seemed not too far away, and it could have been large.

summary: Very bright, reddish-color light in the sky, start and stop swaying motion, then dropped straight down toward horizon and disappeared.
description: I was on the phone with a friend, just passively watching the night sky (as I always do when outside at night), and noticed a light in the sky I first took for a star. The object was hovering. Then it moved left and right in a lazy, swaying kind of motion, before pausing, and then dropping straight down at a very, very fast pace toward the ground. The closest analogy I can muster is that it was like watching a duck falling out of the sky after being shot, it just dropped plumb down from its original position. It disappeared from my view behind a building, but the object had to be quite far away. It was along a line between Mt. Holly, NJ and Rehoboth Beach, DE based on comparisons between my Night Sky App, my phone’s compass app, and Google maps. I tried to find reports on the news, or videos on social media, but found nothing. It would be extremely hard to believe that no one else had seen the same phenomenon.

summary: Still bright light, stayed still for a while, started to flash and move in odd ways
description: The white light was hovering, looked like a planet at first but extremely bright. I tried to guess then planet, pulled out my phone to check the star map to confirm before realising it was total cloud cover overhead. As I went to take a picture instead, the light started flashing and moving. The white light continued to flash and other lights began flashing around it in many colours. It began to move quite quickly towards us, then changed direction unbelievably quickly and sped off in the opposite direction. It disappeared after a couple of minutes, but not because it travelled too far away. It just vanished. There was absolutely no sound whatsoever. I never managed to get a photo as it was moving too quickly and changed direction too quickly.

summary: Saw a cigar shaped object flying overhead had no wings and no audible sound
description: At 5:30 pm I saw a white cigar shaped object flying over head. It appeared to be around same height as other planes fly frequently over our house. It was white had a black band around middle. It made no audible sound and could not see wings or a tail. It was not far enough away that we wouldn’t be able to see these things. It moved along at around the same speed as other aircraft till it went behind trees and we lost sight. I’m sure this was not an airplane. If relative to a star or the moon it would be the moon. Could see no lights. It was in the east sky and headed north east as best I could tell.

location: Sukhothai UNESCO world heritage site, , Thailand
summary: A Star like object, oval on magnification of photo.
description: PS I have cropped and sharpened image using an AI image enhancement programme. It was a UAP because it made a loud electrical humming noise.

summary: A Star like object, oval on magnification of photo.
description:
A Bright star in the sky appears on photo. I know it was a UAP, because it made a loud electrical humming noise. It travelled overhead, and I took a photo, unfortunately , without a telephoto lens. summary: Object flew past our aircraft at 10,000 feet within 200 yards of our right wing.

The object was approaching us rapidly about 200 yards north of our position. We were just south of Bass Lake, Indiana and north of Wheeler Airport (IG05) at 6:49PM EDT.
We both were shocked to see an object at our exact altitude and so close to the airplane. We contacted ATC to ask if they had seen anything on their radar. They indicated they did not have anything showing up in our location but had indicated there was a commercial aircraft 30,000 feet above us.
They asked us to describe the object. It was of metal material and color. It had a sphere on the top with what appeared to be a black visor across the facing position. Under the attached sphere were three attached rectangular cubes stacked vertically. The entire object appeared to be about 2-3 meters in vertical length.
No obvious form of propulsion on the object. It was moving horizontally at a high rate of speed or at least it appeared to be, however we were also moving fast so…

summary: Light in the sky moved zig zag pattern
description:
It was early morning and very dark. The light in the sky was first observed as it moved from the western sky and was moving east. It looked like it could be a plane as it was about the right height. It looked like it could be a star as it was a single light. It glowed the same color as a star would. There were no additional lights associated with the object.
The object moved faster than the planes we typically see pass overhead and it moved in a zig zag pattern as well as moving in a straight path from west to east. At one point I observed them in a ring formation, with one sphere making smaller circular motions within the larger one. They left my view in an erratic fashion. They were moving too quickly and irregularly to be balloons or other floating debris, and they were seen clearly enough to determine that they were not drones, planes, or birds. the video attached shows the only video that captured a sphere definitively, and it can be seen changing course and leaving to the west.

Then the object continued at a rapid speed on a direct straight line and after about 15 seconds it just disappeared. It could have been less than 15 seconds but it was as if time slowed down. summary: A large slow moving flaming red/yellow orb with no trails
description:
Object flew west to east slowly flaming for 5-10 seconds. The flames were condensed,were compact with no trail. It was red yellow and white and after the flames went out it was red white round and pulsating. Slow moving and seemed to slow down and change direction. I saw the Starlink reentering earlier this year, dozens of satellites, asteroids and meteors and this had none of those characteristics.
I did get my phone out in time to catch a video of it for the last few seconds of visibility as it seemed to be listening and then turning sharply right before going out of view

summary: It had lights on front edge. Had a star looking thing above it was black triangle no lights underneath very high in sky.

I think it was in our orbit very high in the sky.

summary: Large, disc shaped, brightly lit, silent craft hovered approximately 100' above our car.
description: On the morning of September 04, 2023, at approximately 2:30 in the morning, my passenger and me saw a brightly lit object traveling towards us at approximately 100' as we drove East on Prospect Avenue in our car, away from the Estes Park Medical Center. Given our proximity to the hospital, we assumed it was the medical helicopter with its landing light illuminated preparing to land there. However, as the craft approached us, we realized that it was much too large to be a helicopter, it was disc shaped with bright, white, hazy lights around its perimeter, and it was completely silent. When the object and our vehicle caught up with one another, we came to a complete stop as the flying object also stopped and hovered silently above us at approximately 100'. It was a very large disc that was very brightly illuminated with white lights, and it hovered completely silently. After watching the object for approximately five minutes, we became a little concerned as to its intentions, so we decided to depart, and as we did, it also silently and rapidly flew off. As a private pilot myself, I am certain that it was not a craft developed or operated by humans.

summary: Multiple lights, triangle formation, releasing smaller lights, moving very fast.
description: We were standing on our back porch watching in awe as dozens of tiny red and white flashing lights zoomed across the sky into triangle formations releasing what seemed to be smaller red blinking dots. The lights were moving at least 10,000 miles per hour disappearing and reappearing almost at random. We heard cows screaming at one point which is strange because we do not live near any cows. While admiring this sight they all suddenly disappeared and didn't show back up. Before that happened one of the lights moved at least 25,000 mph away from something almost as though it was fleeing. This object seemed to be larger and brighter than the other ones. I also felt a presence of being watched.

summary: Bright intense orange fireball behind a rocket or jet possibly leaving a solid light trail of bright orange similar to a fighter jets

Bright orange fireball visible but rocket/jet not visible just the orange glow that left a straight intense orange trail as the object traveled from SW to NE that traveled at supersonic speed and dissipated within 30-45 seconds as it traveled beyond my horizon (oak trees blocked view as it traveled northeast).

Watched the star for 2 minutes, while it slowly became brighter and brighter eventually being brighter than any star, then suddenly it let out a bright flash, and then zoomed off in a straight line until out of sight. Some confusion whether it was the evening of September 2nd or September 3rd.

summary: Saw a large red object in the sky, it turned and looked like fire was coming out the back the it started moving then disappeared
description: Husband was driving down 275 and I was looking at the moon and noticed a very large red orb in the sky. At first thought it was a planet or star but it was too large. Then i thought it could be a plane but there were no blinking lights and it was completely still at first. I kept watching and it turned and was it then looked almost like an L shape. I saw what I believe were bright red lights and it looked like there was fire coming out of it. It started moving across the sky trying light behind it and then suddenly completely disappeared. Don't know if this matters but I was feeling symptoms of anxiety a few minutes prior to seeing the object.
