summary: Five Red lights moving in strange patterns
description: At first it was just one big red light and it wasn't moving. I thought it was a bright planet, so I took out my nightsky app and it was not showing up. So I keep looking at it, trying ti figure it out. And then four more appeared. They all lined up from left to right in a diagonal formation, and then they started moving around up and down and seemed to be forming patterns. This went on for about 15-20 mins. I fortunately found a neighbor at the very end, who at the end saw just the one bright red light and he watched it go poof...just disappeared. The other red lights all traveled to a spot in the sky, and one by one they disappeared into that location.

summary: A straight line of moving lights
description: At first I thought it was a Starlink satellite, but I checked, and none were supposedly in the area. I was showering outside, looked up, and thought I noticed Orion’s Belt. However, I quickly realized that Orion’s Belt is not 12-15 lights long. Perfectly straight, I witnessed 12-15 “stars” moving jointly across the sky. With exactly the same luminance as the stars around it, these 12-15 “stars” were perfectly equidistant, slowly trudging across the night sky. The lead “star” would disappear, and a trailing “star” would appear. I thought it was Starlink, but again, supposedly none in the area. I have never witnessed a ufo before, and made sure that I was seeing what I was seeing. I was calm, and of sound mind. My eyes were not playing tricks on me. Nude, I yelled for my father to “come outside quick. Hurry! Come quick. I promise I’m not wasting your time. Hurry!” He came out, and as I was nude, I would only have done this if I really was sure that I was seeing something “otherworldly.” I told him to look up, and he tried to see what I was experiencing. However, my eyes were acclimated to the dark, and his were not. He was watching a tv show in the dark, but it was not the same as…

summary: White light disappeared
description: One stationary bright white light in the sky, took off northwest at an extremely rapid rate (much too fast to be a commercial flight) north west. The light had a long bright white trail and then the light and the trail disappeared from the sky at the exact same time

summary: A line of 10 or more stars that moved in a line and suddenly vanished one by one above out heads.
description:
"My wife and I were on our rooftop in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, when my wife noticed a string of lights high in the sky, moving rapidly. I exclaimed, "Wow, I think that's Starlink!" I quickly reached for my Sky Guide app and opened it, but to my surprise, Starlink did not appear on the app.
Just as the lights passed directly over our heads, they began to vanish one by one, disappearing into the night sky, very near the star Rastaban.
Intrigued, I immediately went downstairs and checked the Starlink tracker, only to find that Starlink satellites were nowhere near this part of the planet at that time."
Even though Sky Guide and the Starlink Tracker did not indicate anything, this sounds very much like Starlink.

location: 7 miles north of Benton, PA, USA
summary: String of white lights seen by 5 people sitting on outside porch
description: Long line of white lights going northeast to southwest and faded away

summary: A line of approximately 20 moving stars
description: I noticed a line of approximately 20 perfectly aligned star objects moving south to north over my house. They were at a very high altitude similar to a satellite but moving at a faster speed. I called my wife out of the house and she witnessed them also. The transit lasted about 1 minute before going away. I have seen satelites passing overhead before but nothing like this. We really did see this.

summary: Formation of Stars, that moved like missiles?
description: We walked outside and we could see all the stars more than usual. On the left hand side of the Big Dipper, there was a formation of stars in completely geometrical vertical line once we started asking eachother if we were seeing the same thing it began to move still within a line formation but it appeared like they were missiles coming at us. We let off a firework or two once we realized they were coming towards us because we were outside for Labor Day. Once we lit off two or three they stopped coming forward and got back into a line above our heads and then disappeared one by one. Now im not sure if this was starlink as there was a launch 3 hours after this happened but I doubt it due to the way they were moving like projectile missiles at us. i have seen starlink before and it was not like this. We tried to video the event but it wasn't showing up in the video, the fireworks didnt even show up in the video. It was spooky.

summary: saw 3 bright white orbs flying in a straight formation that looked like the center of Orions Belt
description: Wife, daughter, and I stargazing from our campsite. I work in sales at a large multinational investment bank and wife is Oxford post-grad Product Manager at a public utility. I saw what at first believed to be Orions Belt, distinguished by it's bright 3 star center, until I had a vertigo effect and realized the 3 solid bright white (not yellow) orbs, which looked like stars, were moving. I couldn't believe what I was seeing, I asked my wife "are you seeing this?". My wife and 5 year yo daughter seeing it too. If they had not moved, they would otherwise look like 3 bright stars in the sky, such as part of the Orion Belt constellation. They moved quickly, in a straight line, each orb equally distanced from the others, faster than the speed of the international space station flying overhead. No noise. No trail. We lost our vantage point in the trees, so we moved, and expected to see the 3 lights in the next clearing but they did not return. This was the most bizarre thing we have ever seen, and likely ever will.

summary: I saw a very large green Diamond shaped object traveling at warp speed
description: A very large green Diamond  shaped spacecraft was seen traveling through outer space at warp speed. The front of the spacecraft sparkled as it tore straight through the atmosphere. The sighting took only 1 to 3 seconds and the spacecraft was gone into the Universe! The background of the witnesses is a retired US Army Warrant Officer who is full of honor, truth and integrity.

summary: I was on my boat and I saw one light moving that was not a plane because there was no flashing lights
description: I was on my boat looking at the stars and I saw this light that was moving very fast and I thought it was plane then relized it disappeared and didn’t have a red and green light on each side or flashing. It almost looked like it was camouflaging as a star.

summary: 3 lights hovering in air forming triangle shape, turned vertically and separately descended to ground
description: In car, riding back home. Saw 3 lights hovering in air, that formed a triangle shape. The lights were very bright and flickering. All the lights disappeared for a few seconds, and just one light reappeared. Over a few seconds all the 3 lights reappeared but began to separate further. The lights then formed a vertical line, with each light descending to the ground at separate times with a visual tail. Very odd, neither myself or husband have ever witnessed anything of this sort.

summary: S green objects flash and travel across the sky In a wooded area
description: My wife and I were traveling, driving on rt.1 North, outside of Smryna, Delaware, and out of nowhere on the opposite side of the highway,in a wooded area and over trees, was streaking a green light, but then it faded out. I asked my wife did she that and she said yes. We wanted to make sure it was no flare. She agreed that it was different.

summary: diamond shaped glowing green and white
description: I was on hwy81 when I saw this odd shaped diamond that looked like it was shot down from the sky above me going towards the shell on 20 next to subway. But right before it could hit or touch down from anything I could see it completely vanishes. Like a black hole type of gone.

location: Port Macquarie, New South Wales, Australia
summary: Moving extremely fast from north to south, nothing detected on flight radar or star map
I spotted two objects flying fast in the same direction minutes apart.
description: I spotted the first object flying very straight and fast. I tried to get my co worker to see it but she did not spot it. It vanished from my sight and I was not able to get a photo. She went inside and I sat back down and looked back at the sky. I saw another object in the same spot flying in the same direction. I quickly snapped some pictures of the sky with my phone. The objects both looked the same. They were white looking in the sky. They made no sound I could hear and it was very quiet where I was. They did not appear to have wings. There was no sign of exhaust behind them. They were tic tac shaped and looked longer when I was looking at them in the sky than they do in the photos. They moved as fast as a jet plane and flew very straight and smooth. They both seemed to vanish around the same spot. There were no clouds in the sky.

summary: Bright orb light moving thru the trees and into the sky

I videotaped it moving up thru the trees and up to the sky. It would flash in my direction.Almost blinding me at times. It took 7minutes to come from the middle of the trees to the sky. I zoomed in repeatedly and even showed the sky and stars in comparison, as it was like nothing else in the sky. It appeared round very very large and bright. When I zoomed in you could see objects spinning around it and glowing rainbow like colors at one point when I zoomed in it went to a rectangle shape that is yellowish. When it was in the trees there was no land near it or past it. It was at least 40 to 60 foot above land in the trees, then slowly moves thru the tree line and then above the trees. It eventually went farther up into the sky and got smaller and smaller as if it was moving further away. There was no one around that area and it was just as the sunrise was happening.
Venus rising

summary: Spoted an object in the sky immiting LED-like light, around 6 am on Sept 3. The object did not move around but it seemed change shapes

The object was bright, like a LED light in the sky. it did not move around, but it seemed to change shapes, circle, cigar, corn, etc. However, I have vision issues, so not 100% sure about the shapes. It might also be caused by clouds: at times, the object was shadowed by clouds. It stayed there for about half an hour, may be longer, because I went back to sleep when it gradually got day light outside. I took a few pictures using my Google P7 phone. See attached.

summary: A light or ball of light gliding over the trees at plane level. No flashing lights.
description: I woke up around 4:15-4:25am to feed our cat. Went to shut a window my daughter left open since it was getting windy out. I look up to the right and see this light that I thought was possibly a plane or helicopter until I saw no other lights on the craft. Couldn't see the craft either as it is too dark out. But I told my daughter to look at it and tell me what she saw. She is skeptical but she did agree there were no other lights on the moving light just the one solid light moving at a steady pace high above the trees but definitely was not a satellite. I don't really know how else to explain it...

summary: Very brief flash of neon greenish light
description: While driving on a rural highway, I looked up into the sky and saw what could have been a shooting star in a linear path as all are; however, it was not a white light. It was a neon greenish light that only lasted seconds. I have never seen a shooting star that color before.

A shooting star or unknown aviation air craft. Ascending from the ocean up into the sky.

summary: Lights appearing and looked like they were blinking/watching me
description: Looked up after getting off work at the night sky admiring the bright full moon and witnessed lights appearing out of thin air a few formed triangles. These lights were not FAA lights with the typical red and green flashes. These lights appeared out of thin air and blinked. As I gazed more and more, even more lights appeared. I do believe I genuinely witnessed an incident. I seen strange things before and tried to get insight into it but no leads. I truly believe we as humans have been visited and are continually visited by an advanced biological entity. I have countless experiences of what I seen over the years. What happened at the small Missouri town during an outdoor football game truly secured my personal research. I know they exist and they may very well be living amongst us humans. I do not have physical proof but will be working on getting that taken care of. I know this is very wordy but I know what i saw over these years and no government entity can tell me otherwise. Please take my inquiry as serious as a stemi.

summary: Two flying objects with bright lights on the front and red and green lights on the wings
description:
We (a young married couple) saw two motionless bright lights in the sky on our way home from a friend’s house. Even though the lights didn’t move like a plane, they were not stars. They were much too bright to be stars.
After a while one turned to the east and started flying in that direction. After it had turned, we could see that it had 1 red and 2 green lights on either side. In the meantime the other light had begun to ascend and descend in elevation in an up and down motion. Eventually the second light also suddenly veered off to the east and revealed the same light pattern as the first.

summary: Two bright, unblinking white lights flying toward me rose, banking together then phased out followed by two smaller lights on horison.
description: A friend and I had just packed up our kayaks after paddling on the bayou St John. I was shaking my friend's hand good evening when I saw behind him two bright white lights. They looked to be less than a mile away above City Park, coming toward us; roughly the width of a commercial plane's wings if it were very near. The lights were unblinking which is why I pointed it out to my friend. As we stood watching and wondering what aircraft had those lights, the lights rose together and appeared to be banking like a plane then phased out as if they flew behind a cloud bank. I could still see stars where the lights disappeared so there was no cloud. There was no engine noise of a commercial jet. We stood and watched to see if they would re-appear and that's when I saw two separate, unblinking lights on the horizon above City Park that raised and faded out one after the other.

summary: Large Triangle Craft Plus 2 smaller fast crafts or orbs
description: Taking my dog out I saw a triangle of 3 lights. There was another 2 lights/orbs/craft that was zipping around sometimes near the triangle, sometimes directly in the middle of the triangle craft, then nowhere, then near the ground. I thought at one point there were 3 zipping around but I'm not sure if the 3rd craft was a plane, a star, or part of these 2 craft. Sometimes that light (zippy craft) would blink out and reappear in a different location but always around the area of the triangle. At one point the other light passed between my line of sight and the triangle's bottom light and when it did that light on the triangle either went out or was obscured by this other craft/orb because for 5 seconds that light could not be seen. Seen in Mary Brickell Village Miami, looking out to the South West. I switched to video mode but my phone was too dark to see it well so I just kept clicking away in photo mode. My phone was at 5% and the screen went dark but I kept clicking away until it died. After 12 mins the 2 zippy crafts couldn't be seen any longer Then 3 mins later they disappeared, I did not see them leave a trail or shoot off, they just blinked out and were gone. My phone died a…

summary: Low flying swarm of crafts flew over fast with one flying solo out in front of the pack. Altitude was between 1000 feet and 2000 feet.3
description: We were sitting around a campfire at our lake property in Salem S.C., when a swarm of UFO’s came across the sky. One craft was ahead of the others, and the total count was around 15. We immediately thought about filming it but both realized our phones were too far away. We watched as the swarm of crafts flew across the night sky silently. As the approaching about 3/4 the way across the sky they simply faded, and disappeared. The entire incident only took 8 seconds. My wife and I just looked at each other spellbound, on what we had just witnessed. The swarm of UFO’s all were flying in a perfectly straight line, with the one being out from, separated from the pack. We know for certain these were not satellites. They were too low and too bright, and too fast. The fact that they vanished into nothingness was the thing that really stood out in my mind.

summary: 23 bright lights traveling in a straight line from north to due south
description:
23 Lights traveling at an estimated elevation of 3 to 4000 feet all in a straight line following each other. No blinking lights, no formations and NO SOUND.
Lights traveled from north to south in a straight line. Lights were separated by a short distance allowing me to count each light.
No trailing lights, no flashes, no up or downward movement. Intensity of lights were that of a 100 watt light bulb at 20 feet.
Each craft had one bright light.
Viewing these lights occurred on a clear night in warm temperature, no obstructions such as trees, housing, power lines etc… I used binoculars to view as well as the naked eye. No camera available.

summary: Unnatural object with 3 bright lights flying extremely fast
description: Me and my girlfriend saw 3 bright white lights flash past so fast it looked like the light stretched. It flew past in a split second east of City Road in Walton at around 300ft heading southbound towards Liverpool. Sighting only lasted a split second but it looked as if I may have been triangular with the position of the lights, two at the back and one central slightly in front of the others which seemed brighter. No sound was heard.

summary: Small, singular orange lights appearing out of nowhere in sky, one after another, flying close together at points. 10+ in total.
description: I often see airplanes in the sky out my window (close to major NYC airports), and I know what they look like. I was in bed looking out my window tonight when I noticed 3-4 small orange lights spanning the sky. I initially thought it was just airplanes in formation, but they kept coming from the lefthand side of my window (some from high up, some from lower), much closer in succession than airplanes should be. At one point, two even appeared to merge (or get close to it). I have lived here for a while and never seen anything like this. I took a video in which at least two actual airplanes are captured amongst these lights, and they stand in stark contrast. There is more than one blinking light, I can see the shape of the airplane silhouetted, and they follow a clear, straight, predictable path. These lights kept appearing for at least five or more minutes, gradually either blinking out or going too far away to see, and then stopped coming as quickly as they appeared. So strange!

summary: 2 orbs descending
description: I saw an orange ball drop down out of the sky behind the neighbors roofline. And at the same time saw a bright white light drop straight down behind some trees. We were inside so didn't see where they came from. It was dusk so could still see light from the sky and these were very bright.

summary: Flashing lights floating up and disappeared in random order in sky.
description: White orbs floating in random flashing and moving slowly. 9 orb looking objects some would dissappear and re appear. It was cloudy and no other stars were in the sky. Very bright light. Took video of it before it disappeared.

summary: It came out of nowhere went to the east maybe 3000ft in the air then disappeared
description: We were outside looking at the stars there was still a little bit of dusk left to the southwest of us with a few clouds but clear sky right above us with lots of stars. Then all of a sudden these orbs appear out of nowhere going faster then anything I have ever seen in my life in a formation to the north east for about 2 minutes max then it disappeared. Once they were gone all of sudden these weird clouds appeared over us with a trail following the exact spot the orbs were.Then after I took pictures of the sky u can see the trail they left and the clouds that appeared out of nowhere. All of the dogs in the neighborhood started barking. In one picture u can see this object that looks like cylinder shape.

summary: A UFO appeared at high altitude moving slowly or possibly not at all. Shape is like no other that I have seen in sky.
description: I was walking my dog and noticed a strange object in the sky. I wondered if it might be a weather balloon or test military craft as I live near Travis Air force Base, but I’ve never seen anything like it before nor have I seen anything like it after. summary: White spot in sky from east to west stalled when nearing a commercial airline then rapidly disappeared

At one point appeared to near a commercial airline where it slowed then continued flying out of site. Moved too fast for anything I can associate with. Object was bright white perfectly round appeared to have slight distortion in shape of triangle like a cylindrical tail so to speak. No visible trail or evidence was left behind. Unfortunately we were so mesmerized by the object we did not get any pictures.

summary: White motionless dot in a clear blue sky which disappeared and reappear two times in different locations in a linear path.
description: I was walking my dog at approximately 11:00 am on September 2, 2023. It was a beautiful clear day. There may have been a few wispy low level clouds that I noticed earlier during the walk but at the time of my encounter there were no visible clouds. I reached Latitude 35.655348 Longitude -78.350902 and was climbing a small hill north of a small pond next to Triangle YMCA when I looked NNE and saw a hawk in a dive approximately 30 degrees off the horizon. Behind the hawk, I saw a small, oval, white “orb” for lack of a better description. It was slightly larger than a sesame seed held at arms length. I wouldn’t have paid any attention to it, but the movement of the hawk caught my eye. Otherwise, I most likely would have missed this. In fact, initially I thought it was a white bird, perhaps fighting with the hawk. I lost visual sight of the hawk because it blended in with the tree line, but the white orb sat motionless in the sky. I used to be an aviator with the US Air Force and I am used to spotting objects in the sky and familiar with their movement patterns in order to de-conflict traffic. This object was behaving abnormally due to its lack of motion in the sky but honestly, I…

summary: It was moving approx 10,000 to 15,000 ft. @ high speed, no wings and it was climbing rapidly toward the northeast.
description: I was in my back yard watering plants when I heard a large jet to my south banking toward the east. I was trying to see the markings when I noticed another very large cigar shape craft to my right traveling @ a high rate of speed with a climbing attitude. This cigar shaped craft did not appear to have wings or any to stabilize its flight. It was coming from the northwest gaining altitude as it traversed. Living very close to DFW airport this did not appear to be any aircraft I had witnessed in the past. Also, as former military I was trained to identify several aircraft as an Antiaircraft missile team chief. The altitude I would estimate @ first sight was 8,000 to 10,000 feet and as I watched it gain altitude till vanished it traveled several miles. Weather conditions were clear sky, no clouds. The object made no sound as I observed it. I have no pictures and rely only on my profession training to observe and identify aircraft.

summary: Saw non-equilateral triangular shaped craft twice, a few minutes apart, that disappeared in a bright flash.
description:
Driving down route 29 towards route 66 I saw in the sky, very far and very high, what I thought was a plane. There were several planes in the sky but this one was a mirror for the sun. Eventually it caught the sun in such a way that there was a bright flash, and the craft was no longer visible.  There were no clouds and thus I found this perplexing.
A few minutes later, just as I passed under 66 and approached an intersection I saw it again, only this time it was flying just overhead < a few thousand feet. Once again it flew in a plane like manner until the sun caught it and there was a bright flash / glimmer, and it was gone. This time, I was certain it was a UFO as it close enough for me to determine a triangular swept wing shape.  It did not seem as if it sped off at an incredible speed, rather that it became invisible.

description: We were camping. I woke up at 4:30am and saw a large, bright craft at high altitude fly across the sky at the speed a bit faster than a passenger jet airliner, then it stopped in place for at least an hour. There were no trails or erratic movements. It was almost a full moon, so only a few stars were visible, but this craft was bright and highly visible, about 10x brighter than the brightest star. I watched it from within my tent for about an hour before I fell asleep. I was looking at it in a South-South East direction at about 60-70 degrees up from horizontal. In the course of the hour it seemed to move westerly at the same rate the few stars I could see, so it was stationary with cosmos and not the surface of the earth. Though it was at high altitude I took a photo and when zoomed in, it was fully lit up and oblong shaped, horizontally.

Se avistaron Una serie de órbitas de luz (6 destellos) cruzaron a través del cielo nocturno, desde un horizonte hasta el otro.
Lo más cercano a como lo podría describir es que se veía como cuando en las grabaciones aceleradas del planeta de ve registra el movimiento de las estrellas como líneas de luz que cruzan el cielo. En cuanto pasó dicho acontecimiento, se fue la luz en el poblado y algunos motores se descompusieron.

summary: Bright orange red light, appeared to be half moon, but was in west sky, just over a treeline
description:
Let the dog out approximately at midnight. The "moon" was so bright it appeared to be a harvest moon, but the color was so bright and reddish in color. There was no sound. Moon appeared to be stationary above the lake. The shape was not fully rounded - more half to crescent, yet 3-D. Watched it for about a minuted, then took a picture to share with my family. Picture was taken from inside a screened in porch due to elevation when attempted to take picture outside that area.
Returned inside, thinking it was just a pretty moon. Asked my adult son to look at the "moon" that it was really bright. When he went out, he could not see anything. I returned outside and could no longer see anything.
I looked up moon rise and set times and it did not appear to correlate with this sighting.

summary: Several groups of lights moving in orbiting formation and erratically changing altitude impossibly fast
description:
I'm a commercial airline pilot for a Canadian airline with over 10,000hrs of flight time, but I've never seen something quite like this before...
We were flying from Pakistan to Afghanistan at 32,000ft (a lower altitude than usual for us due to turbulence at higher altitudes) along the standard commerical airliner route through the Himalayas.
We observed three to four bright lights at very high altitude moving in an orbital pattern initially and then they slowly transitioned to a vertical diamond-shaped formation (two high and two low moving up and down )  The position of the lights and the intensity of the illumination was curious because the altitude appeared to be very high (at least twice our own) however the intensity of the light was much brighter than you would expect viewing from that distance.  (The same intensity as if we were viewing landing lights of another aircraft from quite close)
If these were military aircraft, it is unlikely that they would be operating with lights on, and if they were it certainly wouldn't be that bright.  There is a possibility that the light was afterburner glow from fast manoeuvring fighters but again, operating constantly in full…

summary: The object hovered about 45 minutes around Atlanta Airport. It turned three colors solid red, solid green and solid white.
description: The object hovered about 45 minutes around Atlanta Airport. It turned three colors solid red, solid green and solid white as if was mimicking a airplane. It appeared 8/ 24 and again 8/25 same time and continued to hover.

summary: Stationary strobing object
description: Slightly left of the moon, observably about 200 miles, object is not seen moving, strobing luminosity

summary: There’s a flashing light next to the moon. It isn’t moving
description: My buddy and I we’re leaving the gym at night when I looked at the moon. I noticed a flashing light next to the moon. It was twinkling like a star, but it was too bright, and then too dark to be a star.

summary: An bright oval shape object hovering in the middle of two mountains
description: While doing a walk with my family up a hill from which you can see the Lockheed Martins campus, I notice the strange bright object that at first look to me as an airplane from a far. What struck me was the fact that no aircraft (commercial) can fly that low in that location and it wasn’t moving, it was still in place. I quickly tell my wife to see if she can see it and verify what I’m seeing, but as I tell her I notice it move a “step to the left” (as I’m looking at it from my perspective). We she couldn’t see it so we decided to continue moving forward up the hill to get a better view, when we get to the top it was gone. As we continue and I’m telling her I notice a sphere shape object (white dim/translucent white)near the lower peak of the mountain, to the left (my viewing perspective), I quickly tell her to look and used some black birds flying near as reference and at the moment that she looks that way, it quickly started disappearing, like it did starting from my left (viewing perspective) to the right gradually whilst becoming more translucent until it was gone. It was in a matter of seconds. It’s like it knew I told my wife, because it waited right until she look at that…

summary: White tic tac looking object in sky
description: I saw all white tic tac shaped object moving across sky in blue sky. It was traveling faster than I’d expect N airplane to then it appeared to quickly slow speed. Trees got in way of view and after few seconds didn’t see it anymore. There were no wings to object. I was able to take video just at very end of seeing it. I have the video but I’m not sure how to upload here. I also took screenshots from the video.

summary: We were driving back to our apartment from Costco and I noticed what I thought to be a plane. Looking closely I noticed it was round
description: My girlfriend and I had just finished shopping at Costco in the University Village in Chicago. Shortly leaving the store I noticed what I believed to be a plane from a distance. I assumed it was a plane because we see many planes land to OHare and Midway. However, looking more closely at the airplane I noticed that I was round and did not appear to look like a plane. I pointed out the object to my girlfriend while we were driving and she insisted that I record it. I filmed a couple of seconds of the craft before it became obstructed by a building near us. The craft seemed to be pretty far from us but zooming in on the video I noticed that the craft was clearly round. I don’t know if this was a drone or blimp because it appeared to be much larger and going much more fast.

summary: Red pinkish glow vanished
description: Looking out side window of house facing south. I see red/pinkish thought strange not Venus. Lights dimmed then intensified. I turn my head to look at my garage. I turn my head back facing south. It’s gone.

summary: My Grandson was taking shots of what seemed an almost clear blue sky which in itself is rare in Ireland! when this object appeared, there was no sound, and no visible trail of any kind, we check to…
Cigar shaped green light moving slowly through the sky
description:
I was van camping with one other friend in the top carpark at Bigbury-On-Sea (what3words exact location… ///reporting.stored.deduced). I was on my laptop in the back of the van with my friend, it was around 11 or 12 at night when my friend opened the side door to go to the toilet. He immediately shouted to me “Quick shooting star!” I hastily climbed to the door to see, when I noticed immediately that it was not a shooting star it was moving far too slow for that. I shouted to him “that’s not a shooting star I think that is a UFO” I quickly jumped back in the van to grab my phone to take a picture or video but by the time I had grabbed my phone it had gone and there was nothing to be seen. (I’m not sure my camera is good enough quality to pic it up anyway as it was very dark outside). We looked around and listened for a good 5 minutes to see if it reappeared or see where it went but it had vanished with no trace. My friend had a much better look at it and for longer than me. I estimate that I only viewed it for no longer that 5 or 6 seconds.
It was a very clear night with very little cloud cover, no wind or rain but there was some very light wispy clouds dotted around the sky. The…

summary: Red/orange in color, silent, non blinking, linear path with no change in color or size.
description: I witnessed the object coming from the south, it was solid in color, orange/red, it was not blinking as a plane or helicopter would. It had a linear path and traveled at a constant speed. There was no sound at any point of travel. It was rapid but constant. It appeared round in shape. Orb, not disc. It was bright. We live west of Rickenbacker International Airport, we see planes all day long. This was no plane. My wife agrees.

summary: Slowly rotating disc-shaped object witnessed hovering at Apache Power Station 8/23/23 @ approx. 9:15 PM.
description:
Having recently seen the related Congressional hearings on unexplained aerial phenomena, I said a heartfelt prayer, asking to never witness such a thing. Fifteen minutes later I was approaching the Apache Power Plant on Highway 191 when suddenly 4 or 5 lights appeared just in front of, and above my car. These lights looked the size of the balls they attach to the power lines so I thought they may light up at night. But they were too close together and they do not light up. So, I then thought it could be a kite with flashlights. It was dark and any craft was unseen through the glare, but as one light would disappear on one side, another would appear on the other. The lights seemed to be equatorial along the edge of a very slowly rotating disc, where it took approximately 15 seconds for all 4 or five lights to reach the backside. After about 180 decree rotation the lights disappeared for 10 seconds then reappeared, continuing as before.
I was wondering if my heartfelt prayer has anything to do with this sighting.
The two cars in front of me may have witnessed this, as well.
The next day I tried to notify the power plant and the Sheriff's department but was not taken seriously by…

summary: Saw craft overhead red lights changing from 2 to 3 triangles together
description: I was on my backyard deck with my dog just as a clear night settled in. I noticed a triangled red light set just above the horizon from the east...as I watched it, it began to rise in the sky (or had been moving straight at me) and began flying at me at a quick speed. As it started to fly directly over there were at first 2 triangles, red in color, then it looked like there were 3 red triangles flying side by side overhead. As I was watching there were 2 triangles flying directly back east a bit more to the north. I was a bit shaken because I had never seen anything like these things before. I ran in to get my phone to get pics if it came back and accidentally (or my phone had)woke my husband. He eventually came out as another set of red-lighted triangles (2) flew overhead from the east but he said it was a plane. It didn't look like any plane I have ever seen or ever flew that low east to west over our home. They were huge. And we live northwest of a small airport and Interstate 88. As that one disappeared, I saw one more set maybe a mile south of us fly west. Was there noise? I couldn't say for sure because of the noisy interstate but there was no normal hum of an engine had any…

summary: Bright objects that caught my attention since I had never seen planes like this before.
description: There was one, followed by another one and then four together like a square, followed by four more in a single line. Then, one by one, each flew higher into the clouds until out of sight. They appeared be bright yellow in color.

summary: Every nite there is anywhere from 6 to 10 objects scattered around . They will sit in one spot then fly to another they are very bright
description: Sum appear amber . You diffently tell them from the stars .. they are low in the sky . Very strange things to see . Very curious wat they are . It's also as though sum stay on same grid but all move up down in an out . It feels like they are observing but I could be wrong but they are there . Check it out yourself . Sum fly around no flashing lights but do have sound .. Sum have flashing lights . They are not planes ..I watch them nightly . Please give me an opinion of wat it could possibly be .. kinda scarey .

summary: Noticed a high flying glowing object higher and slower than a plane
description: A silent, glowing, oval object was seen. It was slower and higher than a plane.

summary: Orb hovering above the moon, slow descent straight down, hovered, then disappeared
description:
Large enough to look like a planet, we saw an orb hovering above and slightly to the right of the moon.
Seemed ‘normal’ for a couple minutes until it started a steady descent straight down, halfway to the horizon line. It then stopped, hovered, in one place, reducing size for about 30 seconds before it disappeared.
No visible trail. No wavering. Movement seemed direct and with intent.
Very odd indeed.

location: Nelson, Caerphilly County Borough, United Kingdom
summary: Hovering above the field
description:
Lying on the grass in a field with a friend watching the clouds. Saw a long silver cigar shaped object just hovering above us. We just lay there and stared at it for about five minutes then it suddenly accelerated and shot off to the left of us and disappeared from view. It was very, very fast and disappeared in a matter of seconds. This happened back in the 1960s probably around 1962. during the school holidays.
There were no lights and no sound

summary: My cousin and I see it everytime we go west on the 210 freeway staring in Irwindale. We can see the flashing light change colors
description:
This happens everytime I go to work at around 10 40 am. On the 210 freeway going west. It started when me and my cousin enter irwindale and ends as we get close to Monrovia. We notice it flashing colors starting red, orange, green and then blue. It is so bright is shines through the day. The flashing color light use to last about 30 seconds but gets shorter everytime. I pull out my phone to film but because my phone is so old, the camera takes a minute to load so I end up missing the light.
The light seems to be happening in the San Gabriel Mountains close to those spires at the top of the mountain where the old observatory is, I would assume but looking, I could be wrong.
We have only seen this flashing colored light 3 times this year.

summary: Saw an Oval Shaped Metallic Thing
description: I was travelling South from South County Regional Park towards Carmelita Street... I happened to look up and noticed an Oval Metallic Thing traveling very fast from West to East at approximately 9:11 AM. At first, I thought it might be a plane as there is a small airport nearby. I looked away for a brief second and it was gone. After thinking about it more, I realized the craft was flying too low and too fast for it to be landing nearby... Nothing like I have ever seen before. This craft did not have wings.

summary: Bright white, like two cigars one atop the other with a seam where the con cavity met. Silent, moving very, very slowly.
description: I was fishing on Shelter Island pier around 9am when I spotted the craft. Brilliant white. Headed very, very slowly between Point Loma and North Island Naval air base. Not a plane, jet, drone nor blimp. Never have seen anything like it. Silent. Could not judge size, didn’t know the distance from me. I watched it in amazement. I then leaned over to get my cup of coffee (one second max) and looked up and it was gone. I mean gone.

summary: Second morning this week, flashing different colored lights, same location
description: Before sunrise for the second morning this week I saw this seemed to be a round object moving quickly around with different colored lights, stayed in the same place. Unbelievable, this is out of this world!

summary: Woke up and looked out of bedroom window. Blue sphere hovering in appox same spot, then dropped out of site. Color lightened upon drop.
description: I would like to upload the video i captured at a later date as I need to get it downloaded from my phone to a device. Pretty decent video footage!

summary: I am a security guard. Was on patrol and observed lights in the sky to the northeast.
description: Saw stationary lights in the sky northeast of me. At first I thought they were the lights of a cell phone tower. But I know the area well and there was no tower in that direction. Observed lights for about 23 minutes. Lights remained stationary for a long time. Then they shifted very quickly to the right. And again remained stationary. I was able to take pictures with my cell phone, but It’s an old flip phone and doesn’t have a great camera. At the end of the sighting the lights moved away to the north out of view. This movement was extremely fast. Almost in an instant. That the thing that astounded me about this sighting. Is how it remained stationary for so long. Then in an instant it moved. First to another position in the sky. And then out of sight. Is speed was incredible. For the entire encounter the lights were silent. I worked in the airlines for over 20 years. I’ve worked security for 3 years. I’ve never seen anything like it. From experience, I know this was not plane, helicopter, and it moved too fast to be a drone. I’m stumped.

summary: Green light in the sky
description: I was sitting at my home watching TV and a flying helicopter could be heard approaching my property and shook my house I immediately ran outside at 12:28 a.m. in the morning to see what was going on if it was like flight or something serious some sort of emergency and saw this helicopter over stretch of miles has it passed my house and made a complete circle and then I noticed it was chasing a green light as it streaked across the sky and disappeared and reappeared several miles further away the green light and the helicopter chased it off in the distance and then roughly 20 minutes later the helicopter reappeared near my home close enough for me to hear the helicopter and then I saw the green light reappear again and disappear as it seem like the helicopter was chasing it.

summary: Bright light with shooting star sped to a dead stop hovering strobe.
description:
I saw a bright light flashing, moving from south to north in the eastern sky. Approximately 45-55 degrees above the Horizon. Then suddenly it shot like a shooting star 10 to 20 degrees (at least from my perspective angle) to a sudden dead stop seemingly almost above me. It seems as if it was just a few blocks away or over down town, but seemed like it was only 500 feet above the city! It then began to flash a single bright flashing light every second to two second intervals very steady pace. Not making a single sound! Where it just hung out stationery for approximately ten minutes or so, silently. I called my neighbor out to watch it and witness it too. Which she did.
Behind and above the brilliant flash I could see what seemed like a large bay window. Like maybe an observational window. It was an aqua color.Then it after what seemed like about ten minutes or so, it slowly went out of view behind the building as it moved in a N.E. direction. At first I went back to my porch then decided to walk all the way over to where I had last seen it going behind the buildings. I briefly saw it again but as it kept moving I lost sight of it. So I went back up to my porch. Next thing I knew it…

location: Derby, City of Derby, United Kingdom
summary: Semi transparent blue rectangle, speckled blue, moving fast, 2 miles above, disappeared above our heads after moving 10 miles roughly.
description: Only explanation could be a projection as it moved faster than anything else possible. However, we can't stop light by our scientific understanding to date..

summary: Appears to be military HAARP antenna being towed by unknown vehicle. Seen them several times-flies like a dragon kite.
description:
Looks like antenna system being towed across sky at different altitudes.
Others are ball shaped vehicles with circular vapor trail through atmosphere.

summary: Faint white circled object flew in a straight line. Stopped, became extremely bright and flew straight up and disappeared.
description: My wife and I were sitting outside on our terrace approximately between 7 and 10pm. I was looking up at the night sky enjoying the view of Mars. At around 9:30pm I noticed an object cruising at a very high altitude between Mars and the first star of the big dippers handle. I first thought that I was watching a satellite, but it's speed was too slow. I showed my wife what it was I was looking at and when I pointed it out right before the first star of the big dipper the object stopped. Within the next few seconds the object got very bright and shot straight up and disappeared within a few seconds.

summary: Was moving laundry, sudden instant quiet. usually i look up and see bats flying around eating bugs. i looked up and the sky had a aboration(?) similar to a distortion but see through. dont know how…
description: in the past i had a similar encounter near the old satellite box trail off hicks road. i was early 20s and i thought i saw something similar but i was approached by unrecognizable "beings". i could not see them, they were blurry or see through. i ran and jumped into my car and took off. i never really thought about that and i repressed the whole incident thinking i lost time. i did lose time. i didnt think anyone would believe me. i had the same feeling today when i saw this triangle type craft. maybe not so much a triangle but one with rounded edges.i didn’t see any "beings" except when I was 21 or 22 when that happened. The thing was I knew I was being watched. And this was like 10-15 seconds long today. When it left all the natural sounds returned. I could even hear the bats above me flying around. I have experienced this "dead sound" before but never looked around and saw anything. This brief absence of sound always is accompanied by cold sweat and extreme fatigue.i only connect this weird feeling when it happens and then I never talk about it at all and I forget. I thought I had to write this down at least once.

summary: bright erratically flashing object that left a strange line in the sky with one of its flashes
description:
A bright flash in the sky caught my eyes. I looked and saw a white light silently travelling across the sky from west to east. It was blinking erratically sometimes barely visible and then sometimes flashing very brightly. One particular flash actually left what looked like a relatively-large slightly-erratic solid illuminated yellowish-orange line in the sky. It looked like long exposure photography. It was visible for the time the light was lit during that flash, perhaps a second. The line was the length of maybe a quarter of the diameter the moon appears in the sky. I've never seen anything before like that in real life. The light continued moving in a straight line toward the East, blinking erratically with mostly dim blinking which made it hard to see as it traveled away.
I often watch the sky at night and see many planes and satellites at night and this definitely wasn't a plane. The flashing was irregular and I can almost always see the red light on planes and distinguish the different lights. It did not appear to be a satellite due to the blinking and the strange line artifact.
Afterwards, just to be sure, I thoroughly checked my glasses' lenses for scratches, thinking…

summary: Large metallic craft stationary with long grey windows across the center
description: It was just there stationary for a few minutes then moved right and disappeared into what I can only discribe as a port hole . There were no lights or sound . It seemed to be possibly as long as a football pitch.

summary: Ring camera captured 2.5 hour video of bright triangle moving across the sky
description: Backyard Ring camera captured 2.5 hours of video footage of a bright triangle moving across the sky from 6:30pm to 9:10pm when it traveled out of sight behind my neighbors house.

summary: Going very fast.
description: White pill traveling E to W North of Vegas 12:30 PM

summary: Flashing different colored lights, hard to tell shape since was really high up in the sky. I took a 14 second clip of it as well.
description:
Saw it far above in the sky, was flashing different colors - I took a 14 second clip with my iphone 14 pro max and zoomed in as much as I could.
This was at 5:23 am - I was headed to my gym. I saw this right before entering my car to leave for the gym.
I saw no other aircrafts visibility around this object.

summary: Saw a ( fire ball ) moving WNW to SE in a horizontal direction
description: At 2:33 am pst, as i was going to my bathroom on the second floor, i looked out my window saw a ( fire ball ) with trailing red and orange flames moving from WNW to SE. I thought it might be an aircraft with flaming engine or maybe some kind of space junk, i estimated my sight was 45 degrees horizontal plane. This object was moving in a horizontal direction for about 11/2 minutes before the flames went out. After the flames went out there was a small bright dot with a faint glow behind it that continue for 3-5 minutes moving SE. But after this, a lower orange ball of light appeared well below about 10 degrees horizontal plane, that appeared to circle for 30 seconds and disappeared.

summary: Shiny objects on the sky
description: I saw several times 2 different lights appearing and disapearring on the sky. They came together, overlapping and after that disapearred.

summary: A triangle of lights with no sound and faint went across the sky super fast one of the lights in the back dropped off and caught backup
description: A triangle of lights flew fast across from west to east over Bozeman with no sounds and so high it was faint one of the lights went back off formation then caught right back up

summary: Saw a bright steady moving light.
description: On August 21 At 9:52 PM in Mineral Bluff, Georgia I saw a golf ball sized white object slowly heading east towards Murphy, North Carolina when I zoomed in I noticed that it was very brilliant and changing.

summary: At sunset hovering slowly just below the clouds
description: It was slowly hovering above Queen Valley AZ, just below the clouds which were more solid and shaped like a submarine stretching to the west. It was motionless when i first saw it then it slowly moved Westward, Altitude approximately, 3-4k ft up, No shape of wings of aircraft or bird. Just oval/oblong dark. It began moving slowly towards Phoenix to the west, It did pick up speed but not too fast. Faster than a single engine airplane can go but slower than a jet. It kept close to the bottom of the cloud for cover. It finally disappeared into the cloud bank far to the west. I did not take a video as I was too stunned to believe it myself. Most importantly, it was dead calm silent at that time and I could hear nothing.

summary: I was walking my son to the bus stop for school .. and he said look momma .. dat star is moving .. so I looked up .. and I automatically thought it was a plane then I immediately realized it wasnt ..…
A line of lights, too fast and bright to be Starlink.
description: At first I thought it was a bright satellite. Like ISS bright. Then another came behind it. After that one three more. See the attached pic for an approximation. The first one was a bit ahead of the other four. The trailing four were equally spaced apart. I loaded Stellarium to see what satellites they were but there was nothing at that particular time. So either I saw new sats go over that I've never seen before (highly unlikely), or I saw something else. There was no sound from aircraft engines. This was not a Starlink chain. They were too large, too fast, only 5 of them, and the distance from the first to last covered too much of the sky.

summary: UAP caught on game camera IR mode
description: UAP caught overnight on game camera along with picture of buck. Image has a bright orb to the left with a trail & larger circle extending above the buck’ head. This is not in an area where someone would be hiking (especially at night) and the buck does not respond to the object. The camera is in IR mode at night. There is no artificial lighting In This area and no power sources.

summary: Definitely not a plane, a drone, a satellite, a helicopter. Very tangible and unexplainable. Visible to the naked eye.Recorded on video
description:
It was very bright, (much brighter than venus at its brightest), and looked like a pulsating orb of blue white light. When moving, it left a streak or a trail of light behind it.
It hovered beside a visible star in the sky that night and that is how it caught my attention. I only realised it was more than a star when it started to move.
Its movement was at first very slow and it did not pulsate at all in the beginning. It moved upwards and curved gracefully around its position in the night sky without deviating far from where i first saw it.
A few minutes passed and it just looked like a very bright object in the sky moving around up until it stopped near where i first spotted it, hovered without seemingly moving an inch, and then shot across the sky to the left on a very straight level, so fast that i almost lost sight of it. A trail was visible to the naked eye and this is when it started to pulsate in lumination and change its colour from white to whitey blue. A visible ring of light around the centre mass seemed discernable to my naked eye. It stopped seemingly immediately and just stayed there, before flying up at a fast but slower speed, gracefully arcing back to its…

summary: Round craft in the western sky with a crescent on the right side. The crescent broke into two parts, moved around and went together.
description:
The craft was round in the western sky. It had an orange shaped crescent on the right side of the object. The crescent went from bright to dim, broke into two parts, moved away from the main craft, then moved back to the main craft, went back to a single crescent, and got brighter again.
May be the moon partially obscured by clouds.

summary: Saw a bright red light in the sky that was completely silent and still. Moves slowly and erraticly and then slowly moved away returned
description:
Saw bright red light in night sky, sitting stationary with the light not blinking. It then began to slowly almost bounce around in the sky, move to the west and stop again. Here the light blinked a few times, but not like an aircraft. The light would completely disappear for 5 to 10 seconds and then return. It then rapidly moved out over the horizon.
It returned 15 minutes later and repeated the same behavior as before.
Now, on the 24th, it returned again. This time it appeared in the West and after floating about as before it moved in a winding pattern that took it directly over my house. I could see no details other than a bright light, and strangely it made no noise whatsoever. It was maybe 500 feet above my house and if it was a helicopter or airplane I would have clearly heard it. It moved slowly into the East and vanished in some clouds. I have been an active star gazer since I was 10 years old starting with a three inch refractor telescope. And, before this I have never seen anything I could not explain like this. I've seen many amazing things over the years. But until now I could explain them all

summary: Bright light not moving in straight line which goes off then comes back on moving in different direction
description: Looking west we saw a bright light. It moved slowly for about 15 seconds then went out. A few seconds later the light appeared again, but was traveling in a different direction. There was only one light seen at a time. It did this maybe three times and then it stopped completely. About a half an hour later but looking straight up and more northeast, it appeared again. It did the same routine as described from the first time. I’m on my deck watching planes, helicopters, tracking stars and satellites every night. This wasn’t any of that. It was also not a shooting star…I am very familiar with those.

summary: Went outside and there was a ball of light with a disturbance surrounding it hovering and flying then it disappeared. Came back blinkin
description: I went outside to see about the tree line a bright circular object that had like a force field type deal around it and some type of disturbance swirling around it. It started to fly away and it disappeared. I then called for it to come back and I’m not completely sure if it was the same thing but then 4 appeared directly above me hovering and started blinking as if trying to communicate to me or to eachother and then disappeared.

summary: Floating Orb in sky under cloud
description: Driving and saw stationary/floating bright light under clouds. Light was twinkling bright white & stayed there for about 45 seconds to 1 min. 1st witness was driving and called attention to it. Passenger in vehicle noticed it as well and thought it was strange. Didn’t want to freak kids out in the back so we underplayed it but they saw it too. It eventually twinkled out and disappeared. About 5 minutes later, the same orb returned for about 30 second in the same space of sky. All four people saw it this time, the same exact hue of light, and we caught a short video of it.

summary: High Flying orb
description: I saw a bright orb, white in color, shimmering across the afternoon sky. I jokingly told my 6 year old it was a ufo thinking it was just a high flying plane, as well as pointing it out to my aunt. I tracked it northwest across the clear afternoon sky until it looked like it came to a stop above the house. It sat there and it started fading out until it either disappeared or I lost it in the bright blue afternoon sky.

summary: Black spherical object
description: Our back garden faces south. Approx 70 degrees up from horizon, this object I spotted with my partner against a cloud initially. Ran inside and got my phone to record what I could. Speed appeared to be constant until end when I felt it was accelerating and changing direction slightly. No sound. Object was black, spherical, no wings no vapour trail and not anything I have seen or could recognise. The snap shots of the object in screen shots appeared to show a slight halo or could just be the image distorting at max zoom

summary: Object stayed in one place in the sky for around 20 minutes then disappeared.
description: Was sitting on the balcony having coffee. This object was flashing different colors and seemed to be changing shapes possibly. This stayed in one place for around 20 minutes. I had to go in to get ready for work, looked out the window and it was gone.

summary: Got up for whatever reason, went out to the balcony.
description: Got up for whatever reason i dont know, went out to the balcony, Look straight ahead and immediately seen green flashing light. It changed intensity and size. Then suddenly flew straight up, and then after moving a little bit maybe 30 feet to east horizontally and getting bigger again. It just suddenly took off fast. To the southeast towards dresden.

summary: Weird light in the sky mimicking a star or airplane

summary: Large craft, roughly the size of an SUV. No wings or propellers.
description:
While making deliveries on River Road, I saw what I thought was a drone in the sky. It was large, roughly the size of an SUV, and hovering between 70 to 120 feet in the sky over a department store. I pulled over to watch it, but didn't think to take pictures because it had red flashing indicator lights on it, which I took to mean it was following FAA regulations.
It began to suddenly drift toward the east hill, moving at maybe 30mph. I began driving again but couldn't find it on the other side. It didn't make any sound, and the more I thought of it in retrospect, it bothered me how big it was. I've never seen a drone that large, and though it was dark, I made out no wings or hoops that might have held propellers.
It was shaped like an oval, but it had sharp edges along the front and back, almost like a car. In addition to the red light that seemed to flash every few seconds, there was a white indicator light as well, but I don't recall the frequency with which it flashed.
I called the police station later that morning and they didn't cite any other reports. I know it wasn't a plane or a helicopter. And I'm yet to see a drone that's more than 15 feet long.

summary: Viewed stealth craft in night sky
description: My son and I were viewing meteor showers the night of 8/13/23. At appx 11pm we both saw a craft moving north to south at a high speed. It flew along the east side of town. We estimated 1500 to 2500 ft high altitude. It appeared to be tracking another aircraft. We observed it moving over Springville, at which time visibility and detail of craft improved long enough to see that it was clearly a stealth craft of human origin, but flew silently and without visible propulsion. I was able to see it clearly for several seconds. It resembled the stealth bomber (B52?), however with a much larger fuselage and shorter wings. It had no visible signs or markings. It continued over Spanish Fork, where it suddenly made about 10 circular loops (maybe .25 to .5 mile diameter loops) at extremely high speed...we calculated that each loop lasted appx 1 to 1.5 seconds. After the 10th loop, it shot due south over the southern mountain ranges at an incomprehensible speed and disappeared. My 24 yr old son, a UVU college student, witnessed the event. Neither of us has ever seen unidentifiable objects in the sky, and have always been skeptical of such things. However, there is no doubt we saw a stealth…

It was hard to count all the lights to truly put a concrete number on it, but there were at least 4, but likely 5. The weirdest part is that the area between the lights looked blurry. It was not a solid object, at least what I could see. It looked blurry, as if you were looking at blacktop asphalt in the distance on a super hot and sunny day. I was able to watch it for about 7 seconds before it passed far enough to fall behind roof of the home next door and out of my line of sight. Over the course of those 7 seconds, I blinked several times - to ensure I was actually seeing what I was seeing. It, whatever it was, was not high enough to blend within the stars or where you would see a satellite - it was closer than that. Maybe just beyond where you’d imagine to see a cloud. I’ve seen starlink before and this was not it. It was not nearly as long and there were…

summary: Ball of white light turning reddish amber.
description:
I got up early around 3:45 am to watch the meteor shower. I was out for 45 minutes and saw approx. 12 meteors and 2 LEO satellites. About 4 am looking north, I saw in a ball of bright white light rising straight up in the sky. At first I thought it was another satellite but as it was rising it turned amber/brown then deep red and finally just faded out or blinked out.
I'm 61 years old and have seen many meteors and satellites, planes and drones but never anything like this. For the record, there is an airport north of Chewelah. But again, this was no airplane. I may have seen a ufo a long time ago when I was a kid with my family but don't really remember. I've always wanted to see one and am a big fan of Peter Davenport. I remember hearing him on Art Bell years ago and wondered if he was still manning the reporting hotline.
I had no missing time and I know it's not much of a sighting but for me it's a big deal. Thanks for all the hard work you do. Keep up the good work!
Ps
If you have any other questions feel free to contact me anytime.

location: Frontenac State Park near Lake City, MN, USA
summary: Extremely bright blue light traveling slightly upwards before disappearing and leaving a trail in the sky.
description: My fiancee and I were sitting at the entrance of the Frontenac State Park Campground at 3:05 AM CST, photographing the perseids meteor shower facing mostly NE over the Mississippi River. We both observed an extremely bright ball of blue light (it lit up the sky for a brief moment) appeared in the sky, SE of our location. It traveled a short distance, traveling horizontally with an upward trajectory, lasting 2-3 seconds, before emitting an intensely bright light and completely disappearing from view. It left behind a trail, resembling smoke/clouds, which was light in color, that lasted approximately 10-15 seconds before it dissipated. No sound was heard during the event. The sky was very clear with very little to no light pollution from surrounding cities.
region: Frontenac State Park near Lake City, MN

summary: 6 or more flying craft moving extremely fast and capable of changing direction quickly. Emitted weird light.
description: Went to cosmic campground to watch meteor shower. Noticed what we first thought to be helicopters on the NE horizon, maybe 20 miles away. Looking at a map later we decided they would have been flying near Eagle Peak. From about midnight till 2am we watched these lights- several flying crafts that had speed and ability to change direction inconsistent with helicopters or army jets. They would speed up, change direction, slow down, hover, and drop very quickly. They were staying in one specific area, as if surveying a canyon. Sometimes they would fly in pairs, other times no formation. Usually we could only see 2 or 3 at a time but briefly saw as many as 6 at once. They emitted an odd light that would dim and get brighter, and then disappear for several minutes. We watched for 2 hours trying to come up with a logical explanation, and could not. A few commercial planes passed by the area, and the lights became inactive while planes were in the vicinity. I wouldn’t say that there were lights on the objects as much as they created light, more like an aura. The hue of the lights changed, but not rapidly. They were for the most part white lights, but at times had orange or blue hues.

summary: Saw two separate sightings about 30 mins between. The first was two discs and the second was a triangular shape.

They were moving faster than a plan but stayed close enough in the atmosphere for us to see each sighting for about 20-30 seconds. Craziest experience for all 3 of us by far.

summary: Lights appearing and moving very fast
description: Witnessed from 32.74532, -116.13906 viewing in a due north direction myself and 5 others witnessed lights that were very bright (some not as bright as others) enter atmosphere along the horizon adjacent to the Big Dipper constellation between the hours of 12:30am-3am August 13, 2023. These lights made geometric shapes, re-aligned to make other formations and also witnessed 5-6 appear and move down towards horizon (coordinated group) then make a sharp high speed right turn in perspective of the viewing position. These lights appeared to be some white and some red and seemed to stop once the Big Dipper constellation moved past the horizon.

summary: While hoping to see meteors, I observed a light at a high altitude making odd maneuvers.
description: I first noticed the light when I was looking up at the stars, as at first I thought it was a very bright star. It started to hover in a circular motion and sometimes move in quick bursts, but would generally stay in the same spot. My backyard is underneath a flight path and this light was well above any planes flying over that night and stayed in this general spot for the entire time I was outside (~30 minutes). This light did not change colors but would have a rhythmic blinking pattern.

summary: Green flash amongst the stars
description: We were watching the sky for the Persied meteor shower. Clear sky, no clouds or moon out. We just saw a shooting star and pointed it out to each other. As we were pointing, just to the left of where we were looking we suddenly saw a green flash. For reference, It happened to the left of the Big Dipper. It was circular and small from our perspective, but the size of the bigger stars in the sky. It was like a camera flash. Very quick. There was a pause, then it happened again about 4 seconds later and that was it. No craft, no plane, not a comet, just a small green camera flash in outer space.

summary: Bright Orb observed at Bill Briare Park
description:
I began walking the track at Bill Briare Park at 11:00 PM. Weather was scattered clouds, no wind, no moon in the horizon. The park lights were off. The park was slightly illuminated by highway lights from I-95 and Summerlin Pkwy.
At approximately 11:25 PM, while I was at northside of the track (at 36°10'45.6"N 115°14'51.0"W ), I noticed a large bright orb moving south quickly below the cloud cover. I estimate that the obect was between 100 and 300 feet above my head, and it entered and left my line of sight in two to three seconds.
The orb was larg, possibly the size of a small car. It emitted a constant bright orange-white light. It did not blink. It left no tail which is why I've dismissed the possibility of the orb being a falling star. It made no sound. It moved to quickly for me to take any video or pictures.

summary: Starlike light moving erratically, north and south, back and forth, but moving at different speeds toward the west, overall.
description:
Myself (male, 50s), my son (male, 30s), and two grandsons (15 and 11) were in the back yard, looking up at the sky for the Perseid meteor shower (which wasn't very active). My 15 year old grandson noticed the "star" moving erratically, first. After a minute or so, we all saw what he had seen.
I was laying in my zero gravity chair, facing the east, but looking straight up. The "star" was directly above us... maybe just a little east of zenith. The "star" was definitely not a satellite, as I have seen many of those before, and understand their movements. What we were seeing was what looked like a star, but it was moving (not at a steady speed) toward the west. It appeared to stop quite often, but not for long. It would also move from side to side (north and south), while still moving in a westerly direction. Sometimes slowly, and other times a little faster. After watching for about 45 minutes, I had to move my head backwards to the point where it became uncomfortable.
All of the other stars in the sky were still in their same general position, but the one we were watching had moved considerably. I also have a tree in my back yard that I could use as a landmark. After about an hour,…

Kind of hovers and slightly moves around but stays generally in the same place. Almost seems like it has a crescent shape, oriented w/concave upward, at beginning but could have been glare from window. Stays for about 20-30 min, no real change so eventually go to bed. One party steps outside but doesn’t hear anything. One party doesn’t think this one is as weird. Need to ask Jeff neighbors if they have a drone.
8/15 same thing but started out smaller/further away? Not crescent shape at beginning. Around 1140. Eventually go to…

summary: Gigantic green holographic object appeared to travel towards is in the sky before slowly changing course and disappearing
description: Object was seen in the night sky at approximately 10:30 on August 12th or 13th. We were looking at the Perseid meteor shower. Our home is located on a mountain and we have a 180* view of the sky. My husband and I observed a giant craft, larger than any aircraft or satellite I have ever seen. It appeared very large and very close. It was traveling toward us at a slow rate of speed. As is came closer, it slowly turned right and disappeared. It was green and holographic in appearance. The shape is hard to describe. It looked like three or four objects that may have been square or spherical. They were linked closely together. We tried to tell ourselves that it was Starlink, but after seeing the Starlink satellites recently and reviewing online images of Starlink, we have ruled out that possibility. We have no explanation for what we saw. It is the second unexplainable phenomenon we have observed in the last 6 years of living on the mountain.

summary: White light moving up, down, sideways then disappeared.
description: It was a beautiful, clear, fairly still night in Manzanita so 4 friends and I decided to turn off all the lights on my beach house deck and watch the Perseid meteor shower. We’d been sitting for an hour or so gazing at meteors, satellites and an occasional plane pass over when I gazed to the East/slightly SE about 1/3-1/2 above the horizon at a group of stars (I don’t know much about astronomy so I don’t know what stars they were) and saw a small white/silver pinpoint of light, not much bigger or brighter than a star, suddenly appear moving in that area. At first I thought it was a star but it started moving erratically, although rather slowly, up, down, sideways, back and forth. The nearby stars it was moving around stayed stationary so it was obviously not a star. I have no idea how far away it was or how fast it was moving. 2 of my friends also saw this light and while this was happening we talked and agreed this was not looking like an airplane or helicopter and was definitely not a satellite or a meteor. And then it just disappeared. I stayed out and watched for another hour, and though the meteor shower increased, I didn’t see anymore strangely moving lights.

The 4 lights were very bright and formed a triangular shape. Then the object began moving towards the highway and crossed right above us slowly and we heard absolutely no sound. It crossed over us (and other cars) and then quickly speed off in the distance—no sound, and moved very quickly. Myself, my Husband and two teenagers were driving home from a soccer event—it was something we’ve never seen before and we all said “is that a ufo?” I believe it was!!! It was scary and also fascinating we couldn’t take our eyes off it.

summary: On AA Flt 4244 ATX-ABQ, saw cylindrical object flying past my plane same level going opposite direction fast! No tail fin, wings.
description:
I boarded American Airlines flight# 4244 from Austin to Albuquerque. Flight left late. We took off around 5:16pm.
I was seated on the outside seat looking out the next seat window in front of me admiring and studying the interplay of light and dark on the cloud formations below us. I am a amateur painter and was studying the clouds and how to paint them. When suddenly within my field of view, I was seated on the starboard side of the my plane, Seat 21D. I saw this large white cylindrical object at our same level. It was flying in the opposite direction traveling extremely fast. I saw NO markings, windows, cockpit windows. I saw no tail fin, wings nor engines. No propulsion trail nor engine on rear like a rocket. Yet it was shaped like a rocket but flying perfectly horizontal and in the same plane as my flight. Hard to guess how far away it was. But it was close. Perhaps a ½ mile or less. (?)
As it past from one window then to my seat window, I immediately popped the slide shade up to see the object speedily passing before my eyes. The sighting was no more than 3-5 sec. But, I saw the object. It was as if a plane was flying with out its wings and tail fin and no markings or windows…

summary: While driving, I saw a dark metallic orb hovering above the tree line.
description: I was driving, headed from the I-405 towards Ocean Ave on Wilshire Blvd in Santa Monica, CA around 4:00pm. It was a bright sunny afternoon with no clouds in the sky, and suddenly in front of my car maybe 50 ft above the tree line I saw a perfectly spherical orb hovering. It was almost black against the sky, but had a slight metallic sheen to the surface. It was hard to tell whether or not it was moving, but it appeared to be hovering at a fixed altitude as I was driving. It quickly passed out of my view as I was realizing what I was looking at, and when I looked behind me expecting to see it in my rear view as I kept going, it was gone. I didn't see it again.
