description: They also would dim out regularly, and reappear like a dimmable bulb, but they would be in a different pattern, sometime close together, sometime a few degrees apart. First on Tuesday and then tonight. Same stretch of road, 2 or 3 am. I had to exit off I 77 and take my semi to the shop around the Jonesville/Boonville area. And on my way home I stopped at a couple places that face north on highway 67 east, to see if I could get a video, but no luck. I will report again when I run this route again.

summary: 1963, summer, daytime, small oval object with dome & maze-like bottom sailed noiselessly over my head
description:
1963. (Can I report?) I'm only 10 y.o., daytime, probably summer. Austin, Texas.
Playing chasing running tumbling outside with cousins & neighborhood kids, caught sight of an object coming toward me, stopped, watched it sail toward me slowly & just over my head, noiselessly (maybe just the slightest of a hum), & flew on down the neighborhood street until I could no longer see it, straight line.
It was small, dark grey, oval, metallic, thicker more squarish sides, with a dome on top. No lights, no windows, no noise, no wind or electrical effects felt underneath as it passed just above my head, I just stood gaping, following it with my eyes, just a foot or so, above my head!
The underside was very maze-like.
It sailed on down the neighborhood street until I could no longer see it, although I strained to follow it with my eyes.
No thought of yelling to other kids, Hey! Look! Or of running after it, to follow it, just kind of stunned, I guess. Took about 45, 60 seconds the whole incident.
None of the other kids seemed to notice it!
Thank you for your work. And for considering my old sighting. I've never forgotten it.
Life went on, maybe other "things" paranormal. Finally started…

Immediately afterward, we began to see what appeared to be jets coming from the east, one after the other, heading in the direction of whatever we saw. We counted 15 jets total and we are not in a flight path for planes. We also checked to see if it was possible that the object was the starlink satellite but it was located elsewhere at the time.

Within the time of my observation, the object went from large to small then it was gone. There were no obstructions within the line of sight of the object. No clouds, trees or mountains. I was driving on S 23rd street between the atlantic ocean and the intracoastal waterway when my son spotted something in the sky; I pulled over to have a look. We both saw approx. 8 round white lights/objects all flying through the sky from the northeast, heading in a line at a very high altitude and moving rapidly given their apparent altitude.
The lights all moved in a line in formation; they moved together in unison, so that it appeared as if they were all tethered together. The movement was similar to what you would see observing the tail of a kite in the wind, or a rollercoaster. The objects continued heading southwest until they disappearead behind a large cloud. I think observed flashes of light in the clouds. I have a video of the flashes in the clouds but could not get the camera out in time to ctch the object.
Also, these lights did not look anything like starlink satellite pictures I've seen. Instead, they looked identical to the lights observed over the Fukushima nuclear disaster site back in 11' (the daytime video). The lights were each relatively large given their distance in the sky; they were each roughly 0.5 cm in the sky (from my ground perspective)
This sighting…

summary: Saw what I thought was a satellite, but it stopped. Moved around then remained stationary. Got my camera and the video is really weird
description: I like to watch Seatac air traffic from my deck. About 2 am I was sitting out there looking at clouds and a light caught my eye WAY up high. Moving at a pace like an international flight, west to east. But it was too high to be commercial jet so thought it was a satellite. Until it stopped. It kind of moved around a bit before becoming stationary. Weather balloon? Are they lit up and look like stars? Got my camera, iPhone 14pro plus and started recording. Saw a flash to the right of it, which was really odd, but nothing else interesting. Looked back at the video to see if the flash showed up and zoomed in a bit and oh man. I could see more flashes around it. And it looks like the orb is flashing, or is emitting energy or something. It was just weird then really started doing flashy stuff (you’ll see) that’s freaking not normal. No clue what it is, but it’s really weird. Saw something similar the end of June. Thought it was one of the planets to the west, but it was too bright. Decided it was a jet coming in from the ocean. It just stayed there, so I thought damn, it’s way out there. Then it turned like it should, I could see the red lights on the left side. Ok good. It’s a jet.…

summary: Driving vehicle across I-10 bridge, and noticed light moving across sky at high speed. Light did not leave a trail. Similar size as to stars in the sky. Light moved at high acceleration and speed.
A light traveled horizontally at high speed beneath and through the lower part of nearby thunderstorm clouds.
description:
A close friend (professional photographer) and I (retired peace officer) were on the balcony of a condo we had rented with our mates in Ocean City MD, while severe thunderstorms were coming a little further west towards the mainland. I was filming the sky from my Galaxy S22 with the hope of capturing beautiful flashes, while my friend was taking pictures with his professional camera for the same reasons. I took seven short videos spread over about 20 minutes, mainly observing the image on my mobile screen until the worst of the storm had passed.
Back inside the condo, I quickly reviewed the video footage, looking for finds that would have "dazzled" me, but from my very small screen, nothing too exciting, especially compared to the photos taken by my friend. But, watching the very end of my last video, I first thought I saw a tiny light moving quickly from north to south. I looked again and then showed this to my friend. I then transferred the video to my laptop which is old, and although the 13.5" screen was quite wider than that of my S22, its poor resolution did not allow to distinguish a constant or even solid shape. Neither one nor the other had noticed the stealthy passage of…

It was much faster than terminal velocity and from my position in the Northern most part of Vancouver Washington, it appeared as if the object was at least as far south as Portland Oregon. I would guess that the object was at least same size as a Boeing 747 given it's relative size to it probable distance from myself.

During this time, we observed multiple identifiable airplanes, we could hear them and see the blinking lights on them. We do not believe that what we saw was an airplane.

summary: Many non twinkling white lights no tail no engine sound then lights out.
description: On 8/7/23 I was out with my horses when I saw this light in the clear night sky (it appeared like a led shop light...long.. no tail) around 9:15 - 9:45pm coming from the west heading east. Not going upwards or downward....level with the ground. So I just stood there and watched. I did not have my phone on me and I thought about getting my husband so he could see this...but I was afraid I would miss something. As it (only one craft) got closer I could see the lights...lots of them. They were like spot lights (white no flashing) based off the lights it appeared to be rectangular about the size of 7 airplanes. No sound, very graceful, moving slowly, appeared to be slower than the airplanes that are always going by my place. It had these spot lights on its side spaced evenly apart in a straight line, then a spot light above and below streaming at an angle (not straight up or down). Appeared to be at a lower altitude then most the airplanes too. Then it was like lights out, it all went dark. I saw a email on 8/8/23 am about the Falcon 9 that was launched out of southern CA. About the same time. I Looked at those pictures thinking this would explain what I saw. This was nothing like…

summary: Looking west an enormous, segmented, well lit green craft, flying low, centipede like, appeared bit by bit. Disappeared the same.
description: Headed out back to water the plants, I scan the night sky as always. Suddenly, appearing as if from a cloud, a centipede like, segmented, well lit with a green hue, each segment sort of square. Rounded front and rear. Appeared segment by segment until a full, long craft appeared then seemingly "flowed by" for about 7 seconds, disappearing towards the slight southeast, segment by segment. It was oddly low in the sky, I could see the stars above it. I see many small planes in our local skies with an airport roughly a mile from my home. They fly low and they were in the sky at the same time tonight. This was clearly hundreds of yards above at most, and enormous. Wide, but longer. Kind of like a bunch of train car bottoms lit up green, with some additional patterns, from underneath, but flying silently above me. It had to be seen by others. Brief, but enormous and well lit. Terrifically bright against the sky in the background. So low anyone outside looking up at that moment surely witnessed it as well. I clearly, rationally viewed this UAP directly above my home in Upland Ca this night of 8/07/2023. I've always believed, have often watched the skies and now have been completely blown…

summary: Red orb came down from sky, then went straight back up into the sky
description: I was driving southbound on Missouri Avenue in Clearwater, Florida near the Clearwater/Largo city limit. To my slight left, I saw a bright red glowing orb come down from the sky in a rectilinear fashion, then subsequently rise back upward again in the same manner. Sort of like an elevator. From the naked eye, it didn't appear to have a trail like an asteroid would. It happened very quickly and as I was driving, so unfortunately I was unable to capture the event and even if I could I don't think I would have been able to capture it quick enough.

summary: Perfectly circular black orb, in northern sky

I did not see it approach—one moment it wasn’t there, and the next it was—in the span of one blink. I could tell it was quite a distance away and at enough of an altitude that because it was at the top of the visible sky, through the passenger window, with me sitting in the driver seat, the size proximity was roughly that of a half dollar, indicative of a fairly sizable object, at a great distance. What struck me so eerily was that the object completely lacked 3 dimensional shape. It was the darkest black I have ever seen, almost appearing as though a hole had been cut in the sky. There were no discernible features of any kind and, as mentioned, and was so dark in contrast to the sky that it made my eyes physically feel strange, and immediately gave a sensation that “this does not belong here”. It stayed stationary for approximately five seconds and then shot directly upward and out of field of vision, at a rate of speed that it almost appeared to…

summary: Saw 3 red dots in the formation of a triangle that were slowly moving, independent of each other, then disappeared.
description: I was looking across the field that’s in front of my house, and right above the mountain range (Appalachian mountains) were 3 red dots that appeared to be in the formation of a large triangle. The lights were moving slowly and independently of each other. I quickly went back inside to grab my mom to show. By the time we went back outside (only a minute later) one of the lights was gone. We watched the last 2 lights slowly move and then fade away, possibly as result of there being heavy fog and clouds rolling in. In total it lasted maybe 10 minutes or so. We had tried to take a video, but couldn’t capture it in time. I am 24 years old and frequently observe the sky and like to take pictures of the moon and stars, but I’ve never seen anything like this before. The map image included shows exactly where we were standing. The small red dots indicate roughly where I saw the lights.

summary: Oval UFO over the 14 freeway that floated above the freeway
description: On August the 6th at around 9:15/9:30pm on the 14 freeway (CA) going towards Santa Clarita, from Acton (around the more mountainous area) I saw what I first thought was a blue shooting star. As we drove closer (finance was driving) I saw that it wasn't a streak of light but a bunch of blue lights (some small some big, but all in a row). As we drove closer, the lights and the out line of the ship around it became more clear. It was a long rice grain shape with the blue lights in the center of it looking almost like windows (?) it also was about the size of a football field. It was hovering above the desert/cliffy area on a slant (it was in it was not straight it was at a 45 degree angle) on the right hand of the freeway. I kept staring at it panicking and sticking my head out the widow to get a better look. It moved and hovered over the freeway and and within seconds the lights turned off in a row and it completely vanished. I know others saw it, as i looked at the truck behind us and saw the truck driver sticking his phone out the window towards the sky and other people in cars sticking there heads out the window. The freeway wasn't in traffic but was densely populated.

summary: Glowing orb followed by a flashing light and a dim orb off center of main orb.
description: At first glance I thought it was a satellite. The object was glowing with no flashing light. As the object grew closer I noticed it had an additional light following just above it but dimmer. 10 seconds later as it got closer I noticed it was being followed by a flashing light, approximately 200 to 500 feet from the first light orb, as the orb was directly overhead the flashing light vanished and the orb continued on a straight path through the sky.

summary: Was uncharacteristically outside late working and noticed how clear the night sky was, looked up and saw the craft and started recording.

If there is a way to use my gyroscope data to show how I was orienting my phone that would help. summary: High Flying UFO almost collides with another high flying UFO
description: On walking around the French Quarter with my friend, who was another witness, I noticed a high flying light in the sky that appeared to be near low earth orbit. At first I thought it might be a satellite, but I noticed that it seemed to be making slight direction adjustments on its path. It must have been moving very quickly because it was out of view in about 2 minutes and I watched it go across the whole sky. At about 1 minute of watching it, I noticed another UFO coming from the opposite direction in an almost perfectly intersecting path with the first one. By the time they were near each other, they were EXTREMELY close to actually colliding. If this is a satellite, I find it very irresponsible that the people in charge of these would allow them to fly this close to each other at those speeds. If they hit, that could cause major damage on the ground. Due to the flight adjustments the first one was making, however, I highly doubt it was a satellite. They just appeared to be bright lights high up. I also witnessed another similar thing not far from there with another gentleman the previous week.

Would’ve thought it was one if it were stagnant too. It wasn’t twinkling, & looked like it had a warmer light color. It kept going down in the horizon, further away from us as it got increasingly harder to follow with our eyes. It didn’t move like a plane, and it was faster too, not crazy fast looking from our angle. It went behind a cloud and didn’t reappear sadly. Was too tiny to catch on our phones.

This thing made no sound and was not a balloon. This thing was on a straight path and moving FAST.

The object displayed a fast and very sharp bright red and white flashing that seemed to obscure its hidden structure or framework. Typically, aircraft that I see have very steady flashing running lights red on the underside green on one wing and a very rhythmic white flashing lights on each wing tip. l was able to quickly grab some video of the object. Words do not do justice for what the video shows. When my phones camera app opened, I had to switch to video. The first 5 seconds show the craft moving from west to east, and the camera with no zoom activated is pointed in the general direction of NYC which would be more towards the upper righthand side of the frame. I was shooting from inside my house so tried to use the middle of the window frame to steady the phone. I used my thumb and index finger to do a pinch of the screen and zoom. When I do that at 5 thru 9 seconds, I lose sight of the object. At 9 seconds I move the phone and the zoomed image appears in the lower lefthand corner of the screen. summary: 9 Fireballs/Lights Seen to the Northeast of Wilmington NC
description:
Just before 2am on 8/6/2023 I spotted 9 objects in the sky to the Northeast of Wilmington NC. I first spotted two objects, one trailing the other from West to East. The speed of the objects made me think they may have been some types of Satellites as their speed matched other known Satellites and the ISS track speeds.
The appearance seemed to suggest one of two things, either sunlight reflection off of a Satellite solar panel or the emission of thruster gases. The objects were moving too slow to be Meteors. Upon checking my security camera playback, I noticed that there were multiple objects traveling in the same general direction (West to East) that I had not seen before or after the two objects I saw with my own eyes. Some of those objects were traveling across the path of the previous objects (going South to North). They were in the same general location in the sky looking Northeast from my location.
I have previously seen multiple similar events over the last year and made an attempt to validate these objects with known Satellites but no data matched the events. The brief flash of light on these objects had a fade-in/out effect and an average duration of 5 to 7 seconds. They…

summary: We saw a low flying light that definitely was not a plane.

The object was also flying lower and faster than when planes are at their cruising altitude. The part that weirded us out was that as we were passed by the object. We did not loose sight of the light until it dipped below the horizon miles and miles to the east of us. Where if it was an airplane we should have lost sight of its front light.

summary: String of vertical lights varying in color and size
description:
Supplementing my first report to include a depiction of the object(s) i saw (see attached).
Sat Aug 5, 2023 (night time/not certain what time it was though). Standing out on my back patio balcony (2nd floor apartment) I saw a string of lights which were standing vertical but at a slight tilted angle and moving from the sky toward the earth at a rapid speed. I couldn't tell if it was one object or many but i saw approx 5 - 6 lights. All appeared to be round in shape but the first light closest to the earths surface was a brilliant orangish or amber color and all subsequent orbs of light were whitish but they varied in intensity or hue from the one before it as did their size. The object, whatever it was, fell from the sky like a firework but much faster and with zero noise or light trail/tracer.

I work for American Airlines so i'm very familiar with all kinds of aircraft but commercial aircraft especially and this or they were no commercial aircraft. I can't be certain what i saw but I'm certain it was no airplane!
My initial thought was that someone had been popping fireworks primarily because of the way the object(s) appeared to be falling from the sky. It seemed to me and according to my compass the objects appeared to be falling in a SE manner towards…

summary: Fiery "ball" object seen way up in the distance - it hovered in one spot, then moved to the east maybe 1000 yards and paused again.

I took a photo at 10x zoom, and it still looks like a fiery sphere-shaped object, though when I zoomed in to 100x zoom, it appears to be more rectangular with a darker center (giving me the thought that this object is outputting a very strong coronal glow. After taking the last photo, the object disappeared 10 seconds later.

summary: I spotted 2 red Disk Shaped UAP's, Northglenn, CO, 80233
description: At approximately 8:25pm of August 5th, 2023 I spotted an interesting looking cloud because of the sun setting, it was black with rain and had a red under coat to the cloud, so I grabbed my glasses to see it better. As I was continuing toward the back door of the house, I spotted 2 red looking (possibly from the setting sun as well) rounded air crafts that did not produce a doppler effect like I would have expected from the typical air traffic in the area. I continued to watch, and saw that one craft ascended towards the clouds further out of sight, as one continued their expected trajectory forward. The one that stuck around started to bank, and I saw it rotate its axis to reveal that it wasn't spherical, but flattened on this axis, making it look like a disk but at a 80 degree angle or so (not exactly 90 degrees). I have a lot of air traffic around my place, and I have never seen something that high up in the cloud line move that fast, without any sound. I did see minimal streaking following the crafts, but it did not linger like a chemtrail a typical air craft would leave behind.

Saw metallic cigar shaped object approximately above Norwalk, Ca sitting stationary for duration of about 30 seconds
description: Daytime sighting with clear skies. Object looked to be stationary in the skies over Norwalk, ca for the duration of the approximately 30 I was able to keep in view while riding in the back seat of friends car traveling on Hwy 91 east. Object appeared to be metallic and reflected the sun strongly at the end of sighting due to angle of sight. It looked to be cigar shape but not completely uniform. I got a good enough view for a long enough time to realize it was not a plane or blimp due to the irregular shape, metallic finish and the fact that it did not seem to move at all while hovering at approximately 500ft-1000ft above the city. The distance from me was just enough for my eyes to not completely be able to focus and understand exactly what I was looking at but to me it's what I know it wasn't that only leaves an anomaly as a explanation. I believe many others closer could and should easily have long duration of views of this object and I'm curious to see if similar reporting are sent in by any one else that witnessed the same object.

summary: Crescent / Boomerang Shaped object
description:
I walked outside to try to view a thunderstorm that was to the north, just east of the Great Salt Lake. Told my mother who was standing outside with me that there was supposed to be a meteor shower soon. We watched the skies for roughly 3-4 minutes before she headed back inside. I looked up and in the dark, I could make out a craft of some type but could not determine what type of craft it was, as it had no lights on it and it moved silently. It seemed to weave into/behind the clouds, trailing/moving the clouds slightly as it moved through them and and I lost sight of it very quickly, it almost appeared to cloak itself as it moved south west.
This object was too large to be a bird based on the size of it near the clouds, it also moved in such a way that would not possible for a bird in the strong winds while ascending.
The best way to describe the shape is an amalgam of a crescent, a boomerang and a V in one shape. One single object with what appeared to be sections on the body which I imagine is where lights or some sort of multi-point propulsion system would go underneath.

summary: Saw very bright, large-ish dot that collapsed to smaller dot and disappeared

It is eerily dark outside and feels oppressive, probably from the high pressure system moving in. I walked back up on my porch and turned around to look back out over the yard and I saw a bright light, a warmish shade of bright bright white, brighter than anything else in the sky or around me. It was not terribly far or high, and looked like it might be over the river or just past it, and not even as high as the hill behind it. (Crane Hill, Unadilla). It was, from my perspective a bit smaller than the moon would look. It held for just a moment and then shrank down into a smaller dot, perhaps half its original size with no change in brightness or color. Then it simply vanished.

The speed was still equivalent to a plane or low flying bird, but the two round "wings" still made no sense. The object/s appeared hazy or diffused. As I observed the object it made a tight U-turn at an estimated speed of 2 to 3 times faster than it's straight line speed. The object did not bank as it turned. The two round "discs" stayed together as it turned. The object continued travelling south at the same speed as it's previous northbound speed for 7 or 8 seconds, then accelerated immediately and left at an astonishing speed in a SSE direction. I watched the object as it sped away until it was out of sight. My entire observation lasted approximately 20 seconds. The two discs (possibly orbs) stayed in the same side by side configuration during the entire time that I observed it. I was not able to photograph the…

All three of these lights were stacked very nearby one another, and moving together. I assumed it was a plane and then a firework, but I noticed no sound emitted whatsoever, during or at the end.
I only realized it could not have been a plane nor a firework once it was gone. Firstly, the formation was moving horizontally across the sky at a low altitude. Secondly, the lights moved together in a line and then seemed to separate and then “fizzle out” before leaving my field of vision. Due to this I thought it could be a firework… But a firework lit on the ground would not have the chance to travel so far horizontally, and at such great altitude. It would also have made some noise —this was silent.
I was…

summary: Object in sky that was stationary, then gone completely
description:
We were fishing (trolling and heading south along the west shoreline when I spotted what I figured was a plane, but it was stationary and did not move. I watched for a bit, then asked my husband if that was a plane. He looked up, said, not sure, there are binoculars in the compartment, take them out and see.
I retrieved the binoculars and looked up and saw a blurry shape with multiple edges, like distinct extended shapes from the top, bottom, right and left. But because it was blurry, I looked down at the binoculars to adjust the focus, looked up again, and it was gone.
We both noticed it gone, and came across a man with his son or grandson on the dock fishing as we were passing by. We asked them if they saw the UFO, jokingly. The man said yes, but nothing else. The child did not say anything.
We continued on our way, with me glancing toward the sky the rest of the evening, but no more sightings of anything.
Later, my husband said he thought it was cannister shaped with his naked eye.
It was a clear evening, no clouds.

summary: I saw a large black rectangular object hovering in one spot for a few minutes and I saw it fly off into the woods.

I was in Mill Creek, NC, not far from the fire station and I stopped in the road because I was about to take a left turn onto a long driveway.
As I turned my head to look towards the driveway I was shocked to see a very large and thick rectangular object hovering directly over the driveway in-between the trees on either side of the path.
The object was a solid black color but had pairs of small round lights on its top both red and blue. The lights had a very soft appearance that grabbed my attention, especially the light blue light. They appeared grouped together side by side on each side of the top of the craft. The back bottom area had larger white lights. The top of the object had a sharp angular structure that lended itself to one end of a parallelogram.
It just hovered there for what felt like a few minutes. What kills me is that I had forgotten to charge my phone at work that day and it had 1% AND had flown into the floorboard as I was driving before I arrived in Mill Creek.
I was shocked, in disbelief and I just kept saying, "What the #@$# is that!?" to myself audibly. I stayed stopped in the middle of the road and stared at it. Then it very effortlessly just began to glide…

description:
It was a sunny morning and I just finished my usual run by the river Tisza, in Szeged, Hungary. As I approached the Flood Memorial (coordinates: 46°14'43"N 20°9'0"E), the square around the statue was quite empty, only cars were driving by. I checked my smart watch and saw: 8:55 AM. "Oh, no! - I thought. - I'm gonna be late from work!" This is when I looked straight up (I wonder why...?) - and noticed a red, metallic sphere flying above my head. It was about 10 meters high, to me it seemed like it was basketball-sized, but I can't be sure of its exact size because there was a neutral blue sky behind it.
The sphere gave out no sound. The shade of red was #ff0000. It had no visible motor, wings or emission. It was so close that I could see it's not a helium toy balloon, nor a real balloon. It seemed like a drone - except I've never seen a silent, dull metallic sphere drone with a homogenous surface. I saw no letters, camera or light source on it. I was so surprised! It sort of gilded with an even speed.
After a few seconds of trying to compute the sight in my head, it became apparent that this object is totally unknown to me. So I decided to take a photo of it. While I was struggling…

summary: After observing a Space X launch from 100+ miles away, after ~5 minutes post-launch, 2 orange orbs appear and disappear. One at a time.
description:
I was enamored by a visual in the sky at 11:00pm, in an Easterly direction. It looked like a meteor casting a "dust trail" in the atmosphere in the shape of a star. This slowly moved North, from my right to left. To the right of that, was a "firework" style light show behind it, in a single spot not moving.
I presume this to be the Falcon 9 Heavy far away from me. I'm in Gainesville FL, and the Space X launch is at Kennedy Space Center, over 100 miles away. (I didn't know this at the time of viewing)
Anyway, 5 minutes after the sky clears up from that Space launch event, I drove a golf cart away. I glance in the general direction again (East) and now, much closer to my location, appears a pair of orange orb/spherical lights in the sky. Slightly south from my perspective of the Space event, these entities are moving slowly Southward. They formed a diagonal line going up and back. Not more than a moment after viewing, the front light disappears, followed by the second light, mere seconds later.

summary: Red light that appeared high in the sky, grew in size and then split into 15-20 individual red lights, then vanished.
description:

I pointed out that the Moon was higher up and while I showing her the Moon, the object split into a bunch of red "stars" and grew to about the size of the Sun when it is on the horizon.  There were probably 15 or 20 stars all arranged in a circle.  They then expanded outward slightly and intensified their illumination and then vanished.  The lights seemed to be at an altitude of about 10,000 feet. The whole event lasted about 30 seconds, so I didn't have time to get a camera or go outside.

summary: Saw a light moving so FAST then it began to dim before lighting up again and we saw it start flying in a tight S pattern
description:
My wife and I went for a later than usual walk with our dog. Right before we were got home, my wife points out a light in the sky and asks me, “Is that a plane?”
I look up and see the bright light, and I start my process of elimination. I’ve many times looked up hoping to see something that wasn’t a satellite or airplane, but often to my own disappointment, I can quickly figure out when that’s the case. Then, the light begins to dim, so I think space debris, and then it lights up again, changing direction by around 45°. At this point I’m still thinking shooting star or something. Until it started to light and dim over and over and we see it flying in an S shaped path. My wife and I both noticed between its bright cycle would almost be a dim red/orange light.
Eventually it went past the horizon of the mountain and we lost sight of it.

summary: 3 craft in formation
description: At 8:02 PM on Monday July 24th 2023 while at my son's Little League baseball game, I noticed, initially 2 oddly shaped objects flying overhead from the south, the objects appeared over the tree line (for a moment I thought the objects were powered parachute type ultra-light aircraft however, I quickly realized they were moving too fast and maneuvering oddly), they were dark gray or black, they had definitive lines of structure to them. One appeared to be an inverted pyramid, or upside-down top, this object looked as though it were tumbling forward, then would rotate / spin, the next object (in trail) appeared cube/diamond like, with curved edges so that when rotated at times would appear to be almost spherical, exhibiting similar flight characteristics. At this point in time another parent and I made eye contact, she said "tell me I'm not the only one seeing this", (2 other parents also witnessed this event and all were perplexed). At this time the third object came into view, further to the west, appearing to be higher in altitude and moving faster. This object appeared to be similar to object #2, it gained on the first 2 objects and then held in a loose formation, the formation…

summary: White silent oval 60 degrees above ground visible from the 3rd Floor
description: I was back in Ouray Sunday evening July 23rd. Monday morning, my husband & I were closing the 3rd Floor balcony door s facing toward Telluride to the West & the upper windows facing South to seal in the cooler air against the heat without AC. I saw the whitish, squashed-football craft, the same type as I saw in Texas, June 6th, silently making its way from the West to the East until it disappeared over the Eastern Ridgeline towards Cascade Falls. I pointed it out to my husband , then went to the next Southern Window to watch it pass out of view over the East Ridgeline about 60-80 degrees above ground. It surprised me that it was similar to the silent Oval craft I saw in Texas June 6. The skin of the craft was whitish, almost translucent & refracted or reflected the light. It would have blended in with clouds but we have 300 days of sunshine in Ouray & the summer monsoons happen normally between 2-4 pm, so they're were no clouds to hide behind. It took about 38 seconds to travel 40 degrees across the sky at a silent, steady pace. I have seen the jet fighters shoot the Narrow Ouray Canyon on 4th of July from South to North & every sound echoes & reverberates through the Ouray…

summary: Spherical object, varying heights and speeds, seemingly responsive to our presence.
description: Three witnesses saw the same thing. Whitish yellow sphere seen shining through densely forested area. Object then climbed to a height above the tree line, and then took on a bouncing, stair stepping-like pattern as it made its way toward the lake, along the tree line. Followed what appeared to be the shoreline at a rapid rate. Object had differing levels of flying heights, abrupt speeds and stops, seemingly aware of our presence. Silent movements. Everything was silent; even the frogs. The object flew toward us from across the lake after pausing, in what seemed like a response to my brother saying, “Hey!” My brother said, “Hey!” a second time after it had paused, and that’s when it abruptly flew toward us from all the way across the lake. We ran inside our cabin (like that would somehow provide safety, we joked afterwards), and the object remained at a height of about 10 feet off the ground. It then seemed to float alongside our cabin and then vanished from view. We can not explain it and have ruled out any reasonable speculation of what it could have been.

The cloud appeared to move in the same direction as the object as the cloud expanded, similar to someone blowing a smoke ring from a cigar. From my viewpoint, I was seeing the cloud almost edge-on, but off enough to see clearly that it was a ring-shaped cloud.
My two best guesses for what I saw are: A - a satellite bouncing off the upper atmosphere, and some part of it triggered a transonic induced…

summary: A large yellow-green ball of light plummeting very fast and suddenly disappearing while still high in the sky
description: It's very hard to parse out an objective description of this event from what I perceived to be happening. As I was driving west on interstate 70 approaching Limon, CO, my attention was drawn suddenly to what I thought was a large object falling at a very high speed. It seems silly, but my first thought was that a meteor was plummeting toward the earth. From my perspective, it seemed to be moving from east to west, from behind or above me to my fore. Due to the speed with which the object traveled, I thought it must be near the ground; I thought it was going to hit the ground very near me, and I instinctively prepared to brake or swerve. The logical part of my mind thought of an airplane crashing, but the color was strange, a bright yellowish-green, and the light was round and too large for the height I perceived. A yellow-green meteor is the best way I can describe its appearance, but there was no visible trail or streak. When it seemed to be a couple of seconds from impacting, the light just disappeared. There was no dimming, no alteration, it just turned off like someone had flipped a switch. I hope y'all have an explanation, because I'm really freaked out right now.

I kept an eye on the lights as I drove south and after a few minutes (meaning a few miles of road) I passed under them, with them still evidently stationary. The lights appeared to be in clusters of two, in a T formation; I could not tell, against the night sky, if there was anything between or among them, but it seemed like there was the dark outline of a craft between the lights.
As I drove south, I kept the lights in my rear view mirror, and they didn’t seem to move until I had driven another 5+ minutes/miles and the road had turned. I was unable to find a place to pull over to take a photo or video.
I asked my friend who is an ATC and he said there was nothing on radar in that area. However, a friend who lives nearby said that Sikorsky helicopters had been spotted in the area earlier circling (he had taken photos). Whatever I saw I am highly confident was not the running lights of a helicopter based on both…

summary: Object moved in straight line, "disappearing," then coming back, shimmering brightly, not in reflective pattern, very high in sky
description: At approximately 10:45AM I observed an object in the sky from my kitchen window in my 3rd floor apartment in the Edgewood neighborhood of New Haven, CT. The object caught my eye because it occasionally shimmered very brightly. It appeared very small because of how seemingly high in the sky it was (above where I would expect to see an airplane). It moved slowly in a straight line, much like when you see a satellite at night. I watched from the windows and lost site of it several times, it seemed to disappear into the blue of the sky. Then it would come back along the same trajectory that it had been traveling. It appeared to be a rectangular shape, in an upright position. However when it shimmered it was so bright the shape could no longer be understood. The shimmering did not seem to have a consistent pattern. It would occasionally shimmer at seemingly random intervals. Today's weather was warm with a bright blue sky, not a cloud in sight. However, I do wonder how the objects extremely high altitude would affect my eyes interpretation of reflections. It continued moving at…

summary: Something in the Sky east of North Battleford

Please note, during this 280 km trip on highway 40 East I saw no other cars other than my own in either direction.
Approximately 25 - 50 kilometers east of North Battleford, I looked up into the black sky and saw an object which resembled an aircraft perhaps 2 kilometers above the ground. However, it was flying to low, to slow and the light formation on the front of the vehicle which appeared semi - spherical had an odd red light off/on formation I had never seen before. Please keep in mind I am driving about 100 km an hour down a remote highway and this object is visible in front and above me. I had to constantly look up for several seconds then down again at the road for safety reasons. I was trying to identify this vehicle in my memory bank when all of a sudden it displayed an orchaestra of blue and white light so bright the entire shape of the craft became visible in the dark sky. It was at least as long as a 747 jet and…

I was completely sober and scared to death and just waiting for the thing to go away. I don't know how much time went by but it seemed like an eternity. I don't remember falling asleep but I woke up the next morning and spoke to my brother and boyfriend about this and I have never forgotten.

summary: Saw 3-4 extremely bright flashing lights traveling north about 1/4mi per second
description: Traveling south bound on CR 13 near intersection of CR 36 in Weld County. My wife was driving and I was front seat passenger. Our adult daughter was in backseat with toddler granddaughter. We noticed an extremely bright light directly parallel to us to the east. It was around 1/2 mile away and approximately 500-1000’ ft above ground. The lights had a strobe type effect because of the brightness and were traveling northbound around 1/4 mile per second. There were a total of 4 lights/clicks. Anyone up around 11:30-11:40PM on Saturday night would not have missed this. Have not ever experienced anything like this and we all three looked at each other wondering what we just witnessed.

summary: Bright light flared up almost directly overhead and trailed northeast. Several minutes later, small light craft advanced to location.
description: Large sustained flash of light over us phased out after nearly 10 seconds and reduced to a pinpoint of light. After some moments we noticed several points of light moving toward where the original light flare had occurred.

summary: Craft was low overhead, made no noise. Made almost a right angle turn, never slowing down. 3 blinking lights
description:
Was on my 9th floor balcony at around 9:30 PM on July 22, 2023. As I looked up, I saw some craft with 3 blinking lights on the bottom. The blink frequency was around 1 second or less. The colors were red, and either blue and white or both white, and they were very bright. Since it was dark, I could not make out the shape too well, but the blinking lights lit the craft up enough I could tell there were no wings and it seemed triangular with maybe a dome on top. I say a triangular shape because the three lights appeared to be in a triangular pattern.
I could tell this was flying fairly low, and I heard no noise at all coming from it. I watched it for about 10 seconds when it suddenly changed direction by 90 degrees and headed in the direction of State College. I watched it for another minute or so until it vanished over the horizon. I had a strange feeling in the pit of my stomach that this was not something I've ever seen before. There may be a terrestrial explanation for it though.
I did have my camera with me, but I was so enthralled by watching it, I forgot to get any pictures at first. By the time I thought of it, it was far enough away I didn't think it was worth taking.

summary: One green light in the sky. Stood still. Then moved north at an incredible speed. Steady light. No plane. No satellite. No sound.
Night, blinking lights, traveling ~200MPH, about 10 - 20K feet, "Zig-zag-blink-flying"
description:
I was floating in the resort pool at night, and saw flying in the sky:
(1) small craft, looks like a drone, blinking light, not flying very fast, heading toward the gulf. Suddenly, it disappears, then reappears about fifty feet to the side. This is what startled me. I would assume this was drone, but it just "zig-zagged", moving faster than light for a split second before reappearing, slightly skewed from its original trajectory. It did this a couple more times before it was out of sight.
About 10 minutes later I see (2) more of the SAME craft, flying next to each other. These DO NOT "zig zag fly" --- they fly in straight line, in a pair, toward the gulf. I start to believe these are just drones again, but then I remember how the other "zig-zagged" and I don't know what to think.
I wasn't going to report this, but about 2 weeks later, I am still bothered by it, and I feel compelled to report this for national safety.

summary: Leaving the Maverick, looked in the sky, saw a white shape flying north maybe 500 feet in the air, maybe 20 feet diameter going fast
description: Working for a IF City department, leaving the Maverick on Sunnyside and S Yellowstone walking north to the truck with two other coworkers. I looked up and saw and object and said "what is that?" The other two looked up and saw what I was looking at. It was all white, and round. The underside appeared to be grey maybe due to shadow. The shape to me looked like a somewhat flattened ball. It was maybe 500 feet in the air and headed in a northward direction at a high rate of speed. We watched it until it traveled out of sight to the north. Maybe 10-15 seconds total. It did not make a sound. I immediately pulled out my phone and checked the Flight Radar app and there were no planes in the area. One guy I was with agreed it was a UAP. The other one is very skeptical. Doesn't think it is a UAP, but has no idea what it could have been. If it was that low, we should have heard something. If it was higher than I thought, it was going at an incredible speed. I did not think to try and video it at the time. I wanted to take it all in with my eyes. I don't care if I'm contacted by an investigator, but this is mainly for documentation.

summary: Saw flying rectangular metallic object then it vanished into thin air
description: Driving out of the mountains last week I saw a metallic flying object that looked like a flying toaster but larger. It had a dark area to the backside or left on the object. When I stopped my truck to record it the thing vanished in a blink of an eye. There were no clouds in the sky or trees in the way to block my view. It happened so fast my son did not see it. The flying object was only 300 feet high at the most. It was moving fast laterally like it was paralleling our trucks travel direction observing us. I took a picture of the sky where I last saw the object after it disappeared. I stood there for a few minutes trying to figure out where the thing went or see if it was going to reappear. No sound I could hear like a plane. Right after it disappeared there was a white jet or drone that flew overhead where the object disappeared from. The drone looking thing was high in altitude compared to the flying toaster shaped metallic object I had seen. The flying toaster object was approximately 20 ft long and 10 feet tall. No flashing lights but there was a dark area on the back or left side of the object. It was traveling fast from my left to right in the sky.

summary: Light was traveling along route with a commercial airline then suddenly vanished.
description:
On the evening of July the 19th, I was outside at approximately 10:00 PM gazing upon the southern night sky. I noticed that about three to four, what appeared to be, commercial aircraft lights. Only one of the aircraft was following a rather typical flight pattern and that is what caught the attention to that of my curiosity.
The three lights that were out of the typical flight patterns, are what I was watching. All three were at about a 30° angle from the south sky. One was traveling east and the other two were traveling west, with about a 4° gap spacing between. While watching the two lights traveling westward, the one lighted object, which was in between the other two lights, simply just vanished before my eyes. I've ruled out an iridium flare, for I am lucky to have witnessed one in the daytime years ago. I would also like to add that the lighted object that vanished, never had any flashing anti-collision lights.

summary: Blinking light, sounds/language not recognized, and shadowy figures.

After turning up the volume, we hear what sounds like computer noises and what can seem like a radio communication sampling of voices, but not one word can be understood. This motion infrared camera kept going off and in some of the few second clips, we can see shadows. I have those clips to share.

summary: Fast and steady star height object with a tail.
description:
Started off as a red dot with a tail and quickly gained altitude. Then was a bluish dot around Star height with a parabolic tail. There was only one. I was out walking my dog when I thought I saw a shooting star. My mom and I were walking our dog and she stopped to look. Then another man down the street stopped to look. We watched the red dot shoot into the sky, then it briefly disappeared. Then, it returned but was a light blue and had a bluish, parabolic wake behind it rather than a tail. My mom is a middle age professional and I am a student. I have experience in both rocketry and planetary science, but have no clue as to what the object may be. My mom thought it looked like a rocket, but I checked and there were no recent launches to my knowledge. After some time it truly disappeared and we continued our walk. We then noticed a helicopter circling our area, which is unusual as it is a safe suburban neighborhood. My dog was acting weird the whole walk but I’m not sure that he saw it.

summary: Looked like a single star or satellite flying overhead.
description:
Last night I was sitting outside waiting for Starlink. It was supposed to pass over Duarte California at 9:22 pm coming from Northwest to East. At 9:12 pm, I saw an individual object coming from the West and heading slightly Southeast. As the object got closer to me, I could see a white light behind it. That light was very bright white emitting in a large fan like pattern. I know Perseid is here, but unlike a meteor, this object was moving fairly slow, and it was visible to me for a couple of minutes. This was very visible over the Los Angeles area. Surely, I can't be the only person to have seen this. I took a short video of it with my camera phone. I don't know why, but the video shows the object as blue, but it was bright white. And it doesn't really show the large fan like light that it was emitting behind it. FYI, the horizontal white line in the video is just the telephone pole wires. It looked like a comet to me. Please let me know if you determine what this was.

summary: UFO leaves atmosphere from San Joaquin Valley, in Tulare County.
description:
Standing outside, across from Big Bs truck stop on Front st in earlimart, ca, looking west, south-west, toward nothing but farmland, I saw what I believed was a firework going up. It had a orange-yellow glow to it, similar to the yellow light emitting from a farm home just below the area the light came up from, at least from my perspective. The light seemed to get brighter, realizing it seemed to be pointing in my direction, I figured it to be a drone from some jerk messing around. I turn my body to it as the light seems to be coming towards me. At this point, it's obviously too high to be a drone, so knowing this, I figure it came up from the horizon from further out than that house. But being in the San Joaquin Valley, I know the mountains are all around, so distance wise, I know it came up from the valley somewhere and am pretty sure it didn't come from over the mountains that are to the west.
As the light sort of got brighter, still shining towards my direction, a red dot started to appear. Then, as quickly as it was seemingly coming towards my direction from the west, south-west direction, it started going south, and rising upwards as it went almost straight to the left after…
