summary: Black, spinning orb rising
description:
I am speaking for the witness, who is my 9 year old son. He was in the back yard playing with the dog when he observed a black sphere. There was sufficient features that allowed him to identify what appeared to be rotational movement. He was adamant it was not a balloon. It rose straight up and disappeared from sight. Insufficient information to determine a rate of speed or guestimates on initial altitude, or an estimate of size. My son and I are familiar with aircraft and fly regularly. At risk of sounding bias, his observational skills and ability to identify makes models and years of cars way exceeds my own, and though I am a UFO enthusiast and experiencer, he has spent the last four years telling me I am delusional, and so for him to say he wanted to make a report... Well, here we are. He would not entertain balloon, helicopter, or air clutter as an alternative. The precise time isn't known but reasonably between 1900 and 2000 hours. The date is accurate, as his experience occurred after our evening call. We speak daily, remotely. I live in Texas.
He observed an aura around the artifact. This is not something I have discussed with him.

summary: Reflective disk in broad daylight, headed at 11 degree bearing (south, slightly west)
description:
I was driving southbound on Woodman at 5:31 PM today, July 19th of 2023 (writing this at 6:35 PM). Saw a shiny, reflective disk (shiny but shadowed on bottom) just like the one at 4 minutes, 13 seconds in The Phenomenon by James Fox. Was heading south, slightly west, away from Wright Patterson Air Force Base. Disk appeared to be roughly 300 feet in the air.
I could immediately tell - this was absolutely not a plane. Regardless, all options must be ruled out, so once I got home (15 minutes later), I checked numerous flight radars to see if there were any planes passing the surrounding area in said direction - nothing, at all.
Object was not visible for approximately ten to fifteen seconds due to trees, after which I pulled into a very open parking lot in attempt to relocate object. Was completely gone, not visible whatsoever. Weather had clouds in the far distance, but was (still is) fairly clear in my relative area.
I've seen things that were "hmm, that's kinda strange… could have a prosaic explanation I'm just not thinking of…" before. This was very, very obviously not a plane. There was no exhaust emitted from this object whatsoever. No trail. It was very, very obviously not a…

summary: Metallic sphere sat motionless in the sky on a fairly windy day
description: I spotted a metallic sphere in a clear blue sky in the middle of the day. It was fairly windy and never moved. I was with a group of about 20 friends and only one other person was really able to see it because the sunlight was really bright. It stayed there for 2 hours and some time after it was gone. We were at approximately 7,000’ elevation and the object was 2,000’-3,000’ feet above us and slightly to the east.

summary: Bright white orb traveling very fast quickly changing directions
description:
I saw what I thought was a plane or helicopter then realized it was traveling backwards the lights were behind it. It was moving too fast to be conventional aircraft and it changed direction too sharp and fast. I considered it to be an asteroid or something like that but I went up in elevation and I’ve seen haley’s comet and Halle bop they never changed elevation.
SpaceX launch from Vandenberg

summary: object had 'fins' so not an airplane
description: one object flying way above where airplanes fly (tho airplanes may fly lower here when coming in for a landing) - bullnose cigar shape had upper and lower fins or 'wings' - not like an airplane. flying east/southeast at 7.27am 7/19/23 about the speed of an airplane

summary: Flashing blue light, very bright,
description:
The light appeared to the south almost centred on the vertical, looking East
Moved from a SSW position, 45 degrees from horizon to a NNW position at 30 degrees on the horizon.
At first we thought it was a comet but it was too close, left no trail and was clearly within the Troposphere.

summary: yellow to white round light came from the sky and travelled parallel with the mountains.
description:
yellow to white round light came from the sky and travelled parallel with the mountains then then simply disappeared, it seemed to be about a mile distant and a complete guess of altitude would be 2000ft which is far below the mountains that would be to the objects immediate left, or behind it from my viewpoint.
it was hard to discern color, it appeared to be both white and yellow during the one to two minutes, the disappearing in the air was most unusual as it was obvious that the object was on the same side of the mountain range as I was.
I had gone outside to collect laundry I had left to dry in the sun on chairs, I just happened to remember it before bed and didn't want to leave them out all night.
Note: I did not include a phone number or my address as I dont want to be contacted, I just wished to relay what I saw as it was so unusual......it was no plane or helicopter, there were no clouds, and the moon wasnt out yet.

summary: I saw a UFO for summer; a brief UFO visit
description:
My name is PJ. I live in Farmington, New Mexico with my dog. On July 18, 2023, we experienced a "visit" from something completely unfamiliar to me; something we had never seen before, something apparently not of this world.
The day of July 18 passed like any other day until around 9:15 pm. It was late dusk, and my dog was outside sleeping by the front door. I was inside piddling around. Suddenly, the dog (who hardly ever barks) began furiously barking and snarling. My first thought was he was being attacked by a rabid animal, or something similar. I opened the door to see what was happening. The dog was looking skyward, snarling, barking, and snapping at the air.
Then I saw it. There in the sky in front of me, just a few hundred feet away, was some kind of metallic craft or vessel with bright lights on it, silently floating by. It was moving approximately 15 mph heading east, about 200 feet off the ground. It had no motor nor propeller; no visible means of propulsion. Its design was simply ladder-like in appearance; not like an A-frame type ladder but like a ladder with parallel legs. I could see the surface of the craft was made of what looked like brushed stainless steel. There…

summary: An irregualr shaped object with two streams of smoke or fire coming out
description: We noticed the craft immediately because it was something neither of us have seen (we live near several airports) The irregular object was heading upwards to the sky and appeared as if it was spinning. The strangest part was that there were two lines of either smoke or fire coming out of the craft. We lost it when it went behind a cloud. Almost immediately after a giant aircraft looking plane passed the ufos line of motion.

summary: Short track of bright light that disappeared
description: I was sitting on my porch watching the sunset and I saw a bright ball of fire come down and then quickly go back up. It disappeared with no trace. I kept looking to see it reappear or to be recognized as a plane. The shape it made was like the letter U. Reminded me of a shooting star in color and brightness.

summary: Slow moving high altitude blinking object suspect satellite
description: Myself my son and wife were siting on a bench and my son noticed the object. Will try to attach video. More videos available

summary: Was watching ISS live stream and these lights drew my attention
description: On the NASA ISS live feed, witnessed these "lights" that seemed to flee once ISS was close. Could be a lens thing with the cameras? However the way they moved was unusual. The ISS and NASA feed went offline very shortly after.

summary: Bright red to orange light.
description: Was walking dog around 11:35 pm. Bright red light caught my eye I would estimate at 2 to 3 thousand feet high. Watched it slowly move across sky glowing red and sometimes orange. As I'm watching, wondering what the heck I'm seeing, it suddenly disappeared, as if it slipped into another dimension, like flipping off a light switch it just turned off. I stared at the spot hoping it would reappear. It didn't go into a cloud because where it disappeared there were no clouds, just starry sky. Very exciting and interesting. Don't know what it was,,,but I saw something and it vanished as I was looking right at it! No sound at all, completely silent.

summary: Yellowish/white orb appeared and shot toward the ground at almost 90 degrees then disappeared
description: I was smoking a cigarette and watching the sky, a very bright orb appeared at what I would guess was between 5000-10000 ft and shot toward the ground almost at 90 degrees and disappeared before it would've passed behind a short building in front of me. It was extremely fast, no tail like a meteor, no change in brightness or sound. The best way to describe the orb was just like the intensity of a headlight on a car straight ahead of someone, but it shines in all directions. Lasted about .5-1 second. I am a nerd who plane watches, sky watches, and am very mechanically inclined and have good reasoning abilities. This was very straightforward in terms of what I saw, but I can't explain what it was, it was like nothing I have ever seen. About 30 minutes there was a LADD FAA plane on adsb exchange doing a low circle in the area I observed the orb.

summary: Rectangular Red Light Object Seen in Andersonville
description: I was driving west bound on Lawrence and saw two red objects in the sky. They were slowly moving, rectangular/diamond shape, and lit from within. It almost looked like two car break lights because of the shapes and light. I hit a red light at Clark and the objects moved behind a tall building. When the light turned green and I passed the building, the objects were gone.

summary: Bright U.I.O
description: I was sitting on my roof with my neighbor and we saw a bright light. As it got closer, we realized it was not a plane, helicopter or jet. Just fast moving bright object. Hard to get a decent picture.

summary: Flying light
description: Watching the evening sky and notice a white light hovering. It slowly went behind the house. Then reappeared as a flashing white and red light across the sky. It was low flying and flew from east to south. I actually thought it was a plane until it came to a stop almost in the center of my vision and turn a sharp right turn. Then it disappeared.

summary: We saw a long white tic tax type cylinder with rounded edges hovering above the tree line.
description: My kids and I were carpooling home in 2 cars from St.Louis, MO to Springfield, MO headed west on I-44 when we saw a long white tic tac type cylinder with rounded edges hovering above the tree line. I instantly turned my phone towards it that was on a mount and I thought started recording. I first spotted an enormous long cylinder shape right above the tree line probably less than a few miles away. I noticed skydivers parachuting near by and thought this might be the plane that dropped them but then noticed the object was too far away from the skydivers to have dropped them and the more I looked I noticed the cylinder object was about the length of several large airplanes, and obviously not a small plane to drop skydivers. I would say the object was half a mile to a mile long. It was enormous in length. Solid white, with rounded ends, like a giant half mile long propane tank hovering in the sky. I was blown away. I went over a hill and the object disappeared behind the tree line, when I got over the hill the object was gone. The skydivers were still there. My teenage son who was driving behind me, called me on my cell phone right after it disappeared and said Dad did you see that!…

summary: Hovering, spinning, shiny object in the sky.
description: Looking out my office window, at approximately 10:13am (Pacific), I noticed something curious in the sky. At first it seemed as if it was blinking or flashing. After watching it for a minute or two, and as I began filming it with my phone, it looked more like a metallic object catching sunlight. Also, as I zoomed in with my camera, there was a distinct appearance that the object was spinning. The object looked to be very high up – at, or most likely much higher than the commercial planes we often see. A few minutes after I stopped recording, the object seemed to elevate quickly upwards, then hover in place for a bit, then lowered again, and at one point seemed to move north/away from us. Eventually, after around 10-12 minutes, it seemed to move in a westerly direction, disappearing from site and into the clouds.

summary: Saw the object flying low from west to east south of my position
description:
I was driving to work in the morning and I saw a dark object which shape was unusual.
The object was far so I was in a red light so I grab my phone and zoom in in a clear space between the trees to record. I thought I had video mode, but I took some pictures instead

summary: Bright white thing above the horizon, it was morphing into different shapes while flashing very bright white & two red lights (fixed)
description:
On Monday night, 17 July 2023 about 1am, I couldn't sleep so went downstairs to get a drink. Looking out of my kitchen window I observed a very single intense white light with two red lights attached to it due east from my house. I would say it was about 5-10 miles away sitting just above the horizon. It was moving across my field of view from right to left at a steady speed.
I got my binoculars and looked at it more closely. It was very weird. The red lights were fixed and not blinking but the white light was dancing on and off, up and down, round and round, sometimes it would partially disappear, only to re-appear dancing and morphing its brightness and shape. I would describe it as looking like 'electrical plasma'. If you can imagine electricity charge similar to lightning trapped in a glass sphere but in this case the object was not rigid, it was deforming its shape and orientation as the electrical white light pulses bounced around the inside.
I watched it travel across the sky towards the town of Moffat and then disappeared from view. I returned to bed puzzled by what I had seen.
I also saw another similar but static electrical object in the sky from my house in June 2023…

summary: I saw a slow moving bright white ball heading North, it took a slow 90 deg change in direction then accelerated into the cloud cover.
description: It was bright white, silent and moved slower than any sort of aircraft If seen, had not other coloured lights just bright white orb. It moved from south to north direction, took a quite sharp turn to the east then it accelerated into the clouds. The sky was clear but beginning to cloud over at the time. This is the second time I’ve experienced this white silent low altitude orb, first time was in Kamloops BC.

summary: Multiple sets and single lights that would move rapidly, slow down, or "stall" then rapidly accelerate "up" and "away"
description:
It was a late evening / Early morning Summer July 2023, We were at a rented farm house for a party. As everything was coming to an end a few of us decided to step out in to the field and look at the stars. The area we were in had little to moderate light pollution so being from the city we were very happy to see more stars than we normally do. As we were looking out we saw shooting stars, satellites and planes (tons). As we looked to the north (basically the Lat and Long given) between two hills we saw what we thought were a formation of satellites. However as we would watch them we started realize that they behaved way differently and changed. The shape and color was unknown however they projected very bright lights from each craft. they were at least 100 + miles away or more, approx 20 to 40 thousand feet off the ground. Based off the curve the earth and distance.
At first the lights stated in a single file line, one by one they would travel across sky from our left to right (west to east), the same speed and same brightness and would appear and disappear at the same time. I am a bit of an aviation nerd and I have a flight radar app. I used this app to see if there was any…

summary: I was taking pictures of bald eagle with my phone. Didn’t realize I took picture of object until I got home.
description: I spotted a bald eagle during a walk. The sun was very bright and I was trying to take photos of the eagle on my cell phone. I didn’t realize I took picture of object until I got home and saw the photos.

summary: Cluster of star like lights, in a soccer ball like pattern moving in an arc from west to see. Not a string of lights, a cluster.
description: upon closer examination, in an orderly, not necessarily v-type formation as we first thought, but more like a soccer-ball pattern. Like I said, this was fairly dense, dim, but very well defined, and star-like in appearance. I cannot stress that enough. When we first noticed them they appeared to be coming from the left, or west, (we were walking on a paved farm road in wide open fields going almost due north, and moved in and arc toward south south east, fading out of view, blending easily with the stars. Soon after we noticed a brighter light moving at about the same speed from west to east, and as suspected THAT light was just the ISS, according to the iss tracking app. I've seen starlink formations, this was not a string of moving star like lights moving in a line, this was a cluster. Moving as a round-ish group, more ore less, hard to tell. It was organized in an organized, geometric, soccer ball like (organized triangles?) formation. They did not blink. They could easily be confused as stars if you didn't notice them moving against all the other stars in the sky. We've seen things come into the atmosphere and burn up. Sometimes quite a bit. We know what a meteor shower looks…

summary: String of lights that look like stars, traveling at fairly slow pace, and then disappeared someone else, in Graniteville had to seen i
description: There was no lights in my town due to a power outage fairly large town. I tried to record what I saw, but it was a string of 20 to 30 lights in the sky much brighter than stars, and they were just going like a train for 25 to 30 seconds then they just totally disappeared. I tried to record my phone would not pick it up. It’s something I’ve never seen. Looked liked a plane, pulling a banner but it was so bright, and then just disappeared one by one in sequential order no clouds at all in the sky I could see every star. I don’t know what that was but it was nothing I’ve ever seen, but it was big or a lot of them.

summary: The ufo slowly crossed my night sky and then I lost it
description: After watching my video in slow motion, I can see flashing red and green lights

summary: Random Orange Haze Around Black Haze In The Center Of The Sky.
description: So me and my buddy were swimming in a pool when all of a sudden, we look up and we see a spotlight. This spotlight looks like a cone coming down from the sky, and then there's a bunch of orange haze around this one black cloud with, like flickering lights on it, and we are like, huh? So we keep staring at it for about minute and a 1/2.

location: Lake Mcconaughy (Cedar View Beach), CO, USA
summary: Lights hovered over lake and disappeared within seconds
description: We first thought it was a shooting star, as we paid attention it got closer and we saw a shadow right behind and our 11 year old was able to see a little more detail.   We have researched starlink satellites and it’s not what we saw. It’s disappearance vanished in a blink of an eye.

summary: Massive rectangular UFO/UAP, like a flying skyscraper that passes over our car and vanishes. It was unlike anything i could imagine
description: Driving west on US 64 from Folsom Capulin NM where it’s a Bortle 1 and at the time around the new moon and I noticed a fuzzy finger like object that wasn’t supposed to be there in the sky, Northwest of us. I pointed it out to my mother who was driving and as it got closer at first I thought it to be starlink and even said so to my mother, but then it kept getting closer and closer until almost right in front of us in the sky. A huge rectangular object standing straight up like a building. It had red lights that ran down the middle, the body a type of green with rectangles on either side of the red lights which were also a similar shade of green. Along the sides between the rectangular areas and at the base and tip of the object were little yellow type lights. I was in such shock and had a small flicker of fear that I couldn’t take my eyes and mind from it long enough to take more pics and video it with my phone but it happened so fast and had thought it starlink. As it passed over top our car I looked out the sunroof and to my surprise it was now laying flat, parallel to the ground and was rapidly vanishing from front to back as if cloaking. It made no sound, had no signs of…

summary: Fast Moving UFO.
description: UFO came from the West traveling extremely fast. It was erratic and changed direction from ascending to descending in a matter of seconds. Looks like it disappeared then came back before disappearing to the NE.

summary: Oblong craft no noise and no lights
description: Oblong craft with no wings or balloon, came straight towards me but heading more on my right side parallel with the Vrysoulles Freneros road. It was really dark and the only reason I saw it was it was high enough to catch some rays from the sun over the horizon. It was flying directly into the dark side of the planet and I saw it coming from the horizon about 2 miles away. I estimated it was 100-200 feet long and at a height of 2000-3000 feet. There was no noise and no lights just the suns reflection. I thought it must have been supported by a balloon, but I could not see one. I estimated the speed at about 300-400 mph

summary: Cylindrical with bright line across the bottom
description:
- Cylinder shape with bright white line across its bottom.
- Moving slowly from West to East in light North wind.
- Sighting happened just after nightfall, object's shape was barely discernible against the sky's last twilight.
- Object located 8.3 km away from the Athens International Airport, at approx. altitude of 1.5 km above ground.
- Estimated size was (much) larger than an airplane, with no wings, exhaust, blinking lights, or noise present.
- The usual air-traffic to-and-from the airport was flying much higher, and didn't seem to notice or get bothered by it.
- Faded in the distance after approx. 4-5 minutes.
- Two eye-witnesses. Didn't catch any photos/vid because we were too busy trying to figure out WTF was it that we were looking at.

summary: Hovered, descended and ascended quickly, hovered, then disappeared
description: In the span of about seven minutes, I witnessed a light appearing in the shape of tic-tac, hovering for several minutes. It suddenly took a sharp turn and descended quickly at a 45 degree. After nearly losing sight of it behind the mountain, it split in three sections and quickly ascended back along the same angle. The tic-tac went back where had been, hovered a couple minutes, then quickly disappeared. A minute later, another section suddenly disappeared. The third section then disappeared behind the mountain. These pics and videos are in chronological order. (Unfortunately, when it first descended, I forgot to push therecord button.)

summary: Saw 2 balls of light close together. Flew off into distance. A 3rd one came 30 seconds later into the same direction
description: Standing outside- saw 2 balls of light with a 3rd ball 30 seconds later. All went in same direction

summary: I saw a bright orange light in a circle shape. It changed in color to a bright red. I tried to capture image on my cell but it did not.
description: Bright red circle did not show on my cell phone images only visually. On my cell camera images appeared as a white very small circle as if the moon had shrunk to a smaller size. When I looked at the cell camera images I could see a bright red ring around white circle. ALSO a red line appeared through the white circle. As it got to a deeper brighter red IT just VANISHED.

summary: The small image was at .5x zoom, the larger pix was at 10x zoom.
description:
The last 2 pictures that were takes, the sky was definitely red that's when the image that I was photographing, disappeared.
Naked eye was was a cluster of white lights.

summary: Metallic looking disk high up in the sky amongst clouds. Dome top is reflective in nature with bottom spherical shape dark/shaded. Upon closer look at photo, there appears to be a turret like bubble…
Black metal sphere with a red flashing light appeared suddenly in my window, it was hovering and wobbling
description: I recall seeing a tiny black dot in the distance appear and move very fast from left to right in a straight line. A second later a black metal sphere with a red flashing light appeared in front of my bathroom window where I was showering. It hovered and was wobbling a lot from right to left and left to right, but stationary in the same position just wobbling. It looked like a bomb was my first thought. I ran out of the shower screaming for my boyfriend to come look. He saw it for about 5 seconds then it was gone in the blink of an eye. He ran outside to look for it but it was gone

summary: Large cigar shaped object floating left to right across the sky at high altitude
description: I was standing outside of holiday inn express looking towards the mountain to the northwest of town when I saw a reflection in the sky, I pulled out my phone and zoomed in on it to see that it was a very large, metallic cigar shaped object that was moving from left to right with no visible signs of propulsion.

summary: The object was moving extremly fast left and right, and there were bright lights (yellow-orange).
description: When I got to the room, I saw a strange light. I walked to the window and immediately saw very strong lights that were somehow spinning. When I looked once, I saw a very small disc with round rotating lights. Then it was as if this object detected me, came a little closer and started measuring me like a laser with this light.. It moved extremely fast, a little up a little down, left and right. I thought I heard some kind of buzzing. It was an amazing experience and I know what I saw, I'm sure it was something extraterestrial. And there was my cat in the room, she acted very strangely, and she hid under the bed. My boyfriend was at the bathroom at the time, i. called him on the phone. He didnt answer. When he got in the room, he saw what i saw but just for a few seconds. Then the object dissapiered. He looked on the phone, and there was no missing call from me. He said he felt strange in the bathroom, like the time stopped.

summary: Bright light flew in straight up for 5 minutes before taking off over lake at unimaginable speed
description:
My friend and I noticed a light brighter than anything in the sky stagnating over Winfrey Park at White Rock Lake. We were too far to see anything with the naked eye, but the light was insane. After about 30 seconds, it slowly flew to directly across from us, over a neighborhood, before it began a 5 minute flight directly into the air. It was at a gradual pace, still much brighter than anything in the sky. We never saw it on the ground. I have a video of it flying. After the 5 minutes, it flew towards us over the lake at a speed that I couldn’t even imagine.
Spacex launch form Florida

summary: Looked like asteroid but wasn't one because it re appears and keeps moving
description:
I was going on a midnight walk when i looked at the sky and saw what initially looked like an asteroid burning up while entering atmosphere but then realized it couldn't be because after i saw streak of fire behind the ufo it briefly disappears then re appears and continues moving then when moving a haze or aura appeared trailing behind the moving object
SpaceX

summary: We saw so many crafts flying through the sky, followed by sometimes completely creepy
description: Not only did we see things flying through the sky for hours above the Sol Duc river, we also had strange phenomena happen at 11:30, 12:30 and 2:12 am involving a bright flood light type light shine on our tent ( remote camping ) without a sound. Every time my husband got the tent window unzipped it went off. I was truly and still am petrified about what happened that night.

summary: 3 Reddish orbs seen hovering over east Catasaqua
description: Both me and my girlfriend were in the car driving home from a baseball game when we mutually observed 3 red/orange craft in the air hovering at about 500 feet in a stationary triangle-like formation. The 3 craft then began to drift slowly to the east, when 1 by 1 they began to fade into the night sky. My girlfriend was able to take a pretty good video as well as a photo of the event and has left us very convinced of what we saw.

summary: Strange Changing lights in the Eastern Sky
description: My wife and I live south of Watkins, Mn on a farm slightly higher in elevation than much of the surrounding area. We have seen strange lights when looking to the East, generally towards the Buffalo area. We have seen these on multiple locations all times of the year. Typically they are white to red in color and varying in intensity. Sometimes they hang out for several minutes other times it for a brief moment. Almost always they will just vanish without moving much. They will show up just above the horizon, maybe a finger or two width from our vantage point. We have seen as many as 3 of these strange lights at one time. We have had multiple friends and family that have been with us that have also witnessed these strange phenomenon. Most leave unsure of what they just saw. We moved into this place in the fall of 2019 and have seen them the whole time, the latest sighting was just a couple weeks ago on July 15th 2023. We were hanging out with a friend of ours at our grain bin bar that has a view of the eastern and south east sky. We saw these lights on and off for a couple hours. Our friend had not seen these lights before and was surprised to hear how common of an occurrence this…

summary: Looked like ISS maybe mag.0 from the star Arcturus passing Vega disappearing into the eastern horizon.
description:
We were out just before the international space station was to fly over at 9:50 PM Pacific time.
At 9:46 I noticed what I thought was the ISS near the star Arcturus (too early) and it was flying straight east the only thing different this object covered the sky from Arcturus to the horizon in about one minute, it takes the international space station 11 minutes to cross the sky. I checked all my online star maps- looking at recent launches and I don’t have an answer,
Its description, About mag 0 maybe -1. No sound No course correction. looked like a satellite. (Just so it’s not from North Korea)

summary: Bright object moving at high speed from west to east before instantly making a 90° turn and accelerated into space dissappearing.
description:
I with other witnesses were having a conversation while looking up at the sky when we saw an object that seemed odd. It was just a bright light moving from west to east across the sky at what appeared to be an extremely high altitude. However it moved faster and was brighter than what I have normally seen from satellites. As it gained more attention from the group the objective instantly made a 90° turn to what looked like straight through the atmosphere with an acceleration that I have never seen in my life. I was transfixed and shocked and confirmed others saw what I had just seen.
Fortunately I also had my girlfriend on speaker and she could hear the others confirm what I saw. Now I'm not sure if what happened next was right before or right after the object accelerated away an orange stationary orb appeared in the sky. It was just stationary and silent before just disappearing.

summary: We noticed round blurry object in clear sky bouncing and shifting locations.
description: While having diner, people around us noticed blurred white circled unknown object bouncing in the sky and changing locations fast, being seen on one location standing still, then shifting to another location in the sky. Sometimes it was very visible and sometimes it looked like "it dived deeper in the sky". We were surrounded by people seeing the same object and seeing yesterday's article about British pilot seeing the identicaly described object in the Slovenian sky, we decided to let you know that we also have it recorded. It was definitely not any light play in the sky, as the sky was clear and just before the sunset, the object was strangely changing locations in the sky. In first and second second of a video you can notice whitish circled object on one location, and in 11th second it being seen northeast from the initial location.

summary: A green light meandering in the tree line west of my home. as i watched it, it became aware of me and hid. another showed up.
description: I was standing outside my home on the west side smoking a cigarette being directly between my house, and a strip of trees that separates the adjacent home. As I was smoking my cigarette, I noticed what I then believed to be a neighborhood drone, or the direct neighbors drone, meandering in the wood-line approx. 10 yd. high and 12 yds. away. The craft as essentially invisible with a prominent, yet soft, green light at its center. I had guessed the craft was helicoptering to stay aloft, but it made no sound, and no mechanical movement was observed. As I watched it, it became aware of me and began to watch me through the darkness. I felt no danger whatsoever. Soon the light, as it swayed and bobbed almost imperceptibly, hid itself from my direct line of sight by placing a very skinny tree between itself and myself. I honestly found this humorous, as if it were a game, but then I was still thinking it was a drone from a kid. I would walk forward somewhat and again have line-of-sight on the green light, and it again would softly and slowly position itself with another skinny tree between the two of us, perfectly breaking line of sight each time, with no accidental deviance to reveal…

summary: Unidentified S shaped flying object spinning across sky
description: We noticed a strange metallic object reflecting light in the sky and spinning around and drifting. It looked to be the same distance away as the jet planes we also saw flying that day, but further away than the planes taking off from the nearby SeaTac Airport. Based on this distance it was around the same size as a small jet plane. It was S shaped (letter Z, number 2 or 5, etc). It spun around but did not follow the same direction of the wind that the clouds were being blown in. It changed direction, descended a little bit once, changed direction again, and then ascended out of view. It is unclear if the lights that we were seeing were from the aircraft or if it was reflecting sunlight, but it did seem to be propelled by its own power source.

summary: A brightly lit object flew very high and suddenly disappeared without a trace. I checked on Flight Radar and there was no aircraft near me.
description:
Saturday, June 15, 2023, around 17:10 WITA in Bali. As I finished swimming at the beach, I bought some meatballs and sat down in the beach sand. Unaware, I looked up and saw an object flying very high. It had a bit of shine, like light was piercing through it (transparent), but it was still visible due to light refraction. I observed this object flying for about 1 minute and then it suddenly disappeared without leaving any trace. I tried to continue watching, but the object had completely vanished. I am a person who doesn't believe in such things until I see them with my own eyes. I didn't manage to capture it with my camera, as I didn't want to lose focus on the object and my mobile phone camera was not good enough to photograph it. I really love space, that's why I always observe the sky. Sorry for using Indonesian language to explain the situation.

Appearing Helicopter like as it moved slowly southward; it then stopped and hovered for about 8 - 12 secs. It then moved again slowly in a southern direction(4 - 6 secs) and then stopped again hovering(5 - 8 secs). It then began to travel west towards me(2 - 3 secs); and then bank to a northern direction while increasing speed( 2 - 3 times faster than a standard commercial passenger jet). It then adjusted its heading a final time while increasing speed again; to a north east direction leaving a plume in its wake - disappearing below the Tree & roof line of my neighbours property. It didn't seem to change its altitude during the event. Incredible

So bright we could see it clearly from almost 10 miles away. It was gradually descending, all the time bobbing up and down. From our perspective, it was going slowly. If we were watching a car for example, I would have estimated it as going about 5 mph? It was slow. They move in many different ways, steady flight, stationary to quick erratic movements, up/down/left/right in seemingly random ways back and forth. I made my wife watch them too to confirm I’m not crazy, even though she hates the idea of UFO and wants nothing to do with it, even she can confirm the things I saw, we even watched a moving “star” disappear in the blink of an eye (clear sky, no clouds, it just vanished)
I’ve also seen them move in weird rhythmic bursts, like a water bug floating still on the water then a quick jut forward, and then again a second or two later. They are hard to see but I have watched faint orbs move around the bright stars, like moths around a porch light, back and forth.
I have also seen more “shooting stars” than I ever have in my life, but these are faster with shorter…

But tonight was something different I was looking at what I thought was a star, until it started moving then my mind jumped to satellite. But it was anything but, it started to move fast and sporratically. Taking sharp turns, up and down, left and right, I took my phone out and started recording as quickly as I could. It was also strange to me that my phone camera wasn't picking up any of the other stars and yet somehow had no issue seeing the one light in the sky I was trying to record (thankfully) I ran back into my house to get my cousin to come out to be extraordinarily sure I wasn't going crazy. But by the time we made it back out of the house to look, it was gone, so much for an extra witness. Now I regret taking my eyes off of it.

summary: Dark sphere crossed highway ahead of me, turned right and quickly disappeared
description:
I am a 67-year old woman residing in Kailua Kona, Hawaii. This morning at roughly 10:20 AM (give or take a couple of minutes), I was stopped at a traffic light on Hawaii 19 at the intersection of Kealakehe Parkway. It was a clear day, blue sky all around.
Waiting for the light to change, just looking out the car window, I saw a dark-colored sphere in the sky moving quickly from East to West. My initial impression was that it was not a plane, wrong size/shape. Then I thought of drones, but it was moving way too fast to be a drone.
The sphere passed across the highway and then turned right, heading North. It suddenly shrank from view, reduced to a pin-point size and very quickly disappeared. I have never seen a plane or other flying object disappear so very quickly.
Here in Kona, I live at an elevation of 1,500 feet above Kona International Airport, so I’m very familiar with seeing all sorts of commercial planes, military planes, private planes and helicopters. This resembled none of those.
Also, in this area we never see aircraft flying east to west, as Mount Hualalai rises 8,00 feet from the ocean to the east.
I would estimate the total time from noticing it until it disappeared…

summary: Traveling orb plus a ‘star’
description: I was sitting on my front porch which faces south. Several strong thunderstorms had already rolled through the area, the sky was heavily clouded and all was quiet. I was looking above the line of trees which are on a hill about 100’ in front of the porch. Suddenly I saw what looked like a large bright star and in front of and to the side of the ‘star’ was a blueish/white orb in front of the clouds. From my perspective, it was about 1/4 inch in size…larger than the ‘star’. The ‘star’ blinked out and the orb began moving southeast into the clouds in the direction of Long Island Sound. It was hard to judge the distance to the orb…possibly 1/4 mile. There was no sound of a small light plane or any other other aircraft…only quiet.

summary: I was driving west when I saw a massive craft with lights on its wingtips fly extremely fast in the same direction directly overhead.
description: I was driving west near the intersection of W 116th St. and Ditch Rd. in Carmel, IN when I saw a massive craft directly overhead that was flying extremely fast. It was also traveling west like I was, so it came from behind me in the east. It was just after 1 AM so it was difficult to make out the exact color of the craft, but it appeared to either be black or dark gray. The shape was clearly that of a chevron and it was the size of at least several football fields. The wingtips each had several lights that interchangeably swapped between red and green at a very fast pace, about several times a second or so. It was only visible for several seconds before it disappeared into the distance; at first it was just traveling very fast, likely faster than the speed of sound. However, it became increasingly faster the longer it was in sight. Ultimately, it was so fast that it looked as if it left an after-image and just otherwise vanished.

This first encounter lasted about 5 minutes.
Roughly 20 minutes later, the international space station flew bright in the sky as it headed north. Within just a few minutes we saw what we believe to be the same cluster of lights as before but directly overhead heading in the same direction as the space station. They could have been mistaken for satellites except their visibility would come and go. Their movement again was sporadic with variable speeds.

summary: Large object hovering over roadway ~.5 mile ahead of me for 1min, then disappeared.
description:
First saw the object through a cluster of trees while driving south on I5 in Arlington WA. The object was not moving initially. After taking exit 208 I immediately noticed it’s shape being far different than any kind of blimp, balloon, plane, or helicopter I had ever seen. At this time it began traveling to the west. Based on the size and distance I would estimate the speed to be somewhere around 30-50 mph. I took mental notes regarding its physical characteristics, and was even able to take a short video while the object was stationary. I soon lost sight of it after driving through a wooded area. As I emerged from this wooded area, the object was no longer there. Within 30 seconds of its disappearance I called my partner and told her I saw a something I could not explain. When asked to describe its shape and flight characteristics, I was unable to recall any details aside from that it was black and slightly larger than a school bus. I was certain that I would never forget the objects appearance, but after only 30 seconds I could not recall any of the specific details I had mentally noted.
Note from investigator: July 13 2023 at 3 PM witness saw a school bus size object over I-5…

summary: Very bright orange ball of light passing from the southwest to the northeast over Hutto, Texas
description:
I walked out onto my east-facing, third-floor balcony at approximately 11:00 PM. I then saw coming from the southwest a very bright orange ball of light.
The object was traveling at a steady pace in a straight line toward the northeast, passing right in front of me, and my brother who walked out onto the balcony behind me. It was about 70 degrees up, and looked like it was at about the altitude of a small aircraft such as a Cessna.
There were no blinking lights, and no sound. There was no change in the intensity or size of the light (as big and bright as an airliner's front landing lights) until it had traveled far off to the northeast, at which point it became small and faded out of sight.
My brother said he thought it was a satellite. The object was traveling at about satellite speed, so he may have been right, but I have never seen one so big and bright, nor one that gave the impression of not being in orbit, but rather so low and close in the sky.
I checked the trajectory of the International Space Station for the time of the sighting, and it did pass over the Austin, Texas area at about the same time (11:06 PM). However, it was reported to fly over at only 18 degrees above…

The orbs were about the size of basketballs and not moving. The orbs were in a perfect diagonal line about 20 feet apart from each other. I slowed down as I passed and looked back and all of a sudden I saw only one orange orb and it suddenly shot across the sky and disappeared and in less than a second it was completely gone! This is the first time I have ever seen anything like this so I researched it and found that Howard County Indiana has had quite a past with these experiences. summary: An object in the night sky over Raleigh during a thunderstorm, that was definitely NOT an airplane

It then started moving Southward across the sky, before growing fainter and turning red before eventually disappearing. In the first video I captured, I stopped filming when I could no longer see it with the naked eye, but it was still partially visible on video up to the end.
A few minutes later the object appeared again in the exact same spot, and made the same Southward trajectory before disappearing - but this time it vanished almost instantly rather than fading.
I live close to the RDU airport, and I can tell you that this object was absolutely not an airplane. In fact, I realized that no airplanes were taking off or landing (which I can see from my window) in the minutes leading up to this object appearing and about 20 minutes after it disappeared the second time. Then a line of airplanes began landing - as if the pilots were told to stay out of the airspace until it cleared.
I captured one photo and two short videos of the object. Also for reference, I included a…

As soon as I focused on it, the lights in the house flickered and it expanded and faded to an orange glow similar to candlelight, remaining steady for the next 30 seconds or so before disappearing all at once. Immediately before it disappeared, I spoke aloud, saying, "Leave us alone, you're not welcome here." This incident occurred while I was attempting to find information relating to several previous unsettling experiences I have had with entities; I will note that I have never seen something I would consider a UFO before this, only entities (which I have not reported because I worried I might be labelled as a schizophrenic), but I have felt as though I was being watched for almost my entire life, often by an invisible observer which I was absolutely certain was above me despite having no evidence. My mind was confused, it then disappeared again and 2 seconds later appeared where I first saw it, I ran inside to get my binoculars which took me approximately 6 seconds but there was nothing else to see except the single star . It has blown my mind a little as I've never seen the likes of it and I love looking at the stars but this was strange.

summary: Rapidly moving bright light curved and faded into nothing
description:
At approximately 11:38 PM ET, we, my mother and I, both saw the same light due West of our location in Reno, Ohio. We are located out a county road in a semi-rural location. We are very familiar with aircraft seen regularly in the area as we are due Northeast of the Mid-Ohio Valley Airport (KPKB) as well as being avid skywatchers of satellites including the International Space Station (ISS) and meteor showers/"shooting stars". This was none of the above.
In the course of seeing this object or light appear in the sky due West of our location, it seemed abnormally bright - brighter than Jupiter or Venus or even the ISS. We figured that it might be landing lights on an aircraft, but no marker or strobe lights were visible - not red, green or blue. This was a bright 'white' light.
What was most unusual about this light is how we could make out against the twilight or airglow that the light was curving rapidly in an 80 to 90 degree turn that would have made its position going from a Northerly route to a Westerly route from our perspective. It made this trajectory move quickly in what appeared to be an area much smaller than the curve of the turn radius of most aircraft large and small…

It looked kind of tube like, with no rhyme or reason about which end the tail came out of. This all happened in about 15 seconds, then the craft zipped across the sky heading towards the lights I believe were coming from Essex Junction or even Burlington with a very long tail. I now can rest easy, I KNOW that UFO'S exist. I'm shaking like a leaf as I type this, I'm still in shock. SERIOUSLY, WHO do I call to report this? VTANG? The Burlington Airport? The media? And there is no possibility it was a drone, or even a group of drones. Or fireworks, satellites, or even Starrlink. It was a UFO. HELP!

summary: Flying low there's two spheres one on top of the other. They go sideways and upwards towards the sky. In the end they take off quickly
description: I'm not sure if this is an actual UFO, and I anyone who knows what this is to let me know in the comments. At first I thought it was a helicopter carrying cargo, which would be a rare sight around here. I then realized that was no helicopter, and it was definitely not an airplane of any kind. By the end I completely lost sight of it, but I kept recording with zoom trying to see if I could find it again as it was almost impossible to do so with the naked eye at this point, but I could not find it and gave up. Later that same day I was checking the last video I took (the one where I couldn't find it, and I realized that for a fraction of a second you can see it very quickly go left, and then right in a spiral motion right before disappearing. Thank God I have the building wall to the right in the shot to prove it was not due to a camera shake. The most logical explanation would have been a balloon, and I genuinely thought it was until I realized how it takes off at the end. I cut that last part and added various versions of it by the end, zoomed in, slow motion, black and white, and color corrected. Any other logical theories are much appreciated.

summary: Three ‘dull-like stars moving slowly to form a triangle, then 22 more appeared.
description: Our 14 yo boy spotted the 3 starlike dull stars moving slowly between the Big Dipper and the “W” in the sky. He pointed them out to the three adults and we watched them for several minutes as they formed a triangle. After that, I (g’mother), saw another coming in from the area of the Big Dipper. Then the 14 yo yelled, “another!” There was a ‘lighter’ area of the darkness of the sky, not actually a shape, just a somewhat lighter spot where it looked like the objects were coming from. There were 3 adults, 4 teens and 2 children who watched 11 objects come from the ‘dull’ spot. 15 objects in all as they formed a straight line and headed past the ‘W.’ I have looked at all the photos of ‘Starlink,’ and these were none of them.

summary: Fast moving object in the sky. Red and green lighting. Another object came out of it, same description.
description: I was watching fireworks when I saw a strange object flying in the sky. I thought it was a drone but it was too high up. It moved up, down, and side to side really fast and had lights blinking. I saw another one fly out of it and disappear. The lights went out a few times on it. The lights started going really fast and were mainly red.

summary: My fiance was at her mother's house ,she noticed this in the night sky it was not the moon .
description: Started as a circle bright as day in the night sky to the north east slow moving was not the moon after 10 minutes, it began to flatten out ,at which point another craft or object separated from it and headed towards the ground/horizon the main craft that flattened departed in seconds literally vanishing , no red blue yellow or green light like those on planes drones or helicopters were observed , no reports of local military exercises in the area ,or plane crashes . It was not fire works the main object or craft climbed in altitude faster then any military jet ever observed it covered over 3000ft(rough estimate in seconds before vanishing no sonic boom or sound of after burners like those on military jets which can be heard over a mile away further when going away from point of observation. Animals which are normally heard at night were extremely quiet, horses across the way weren't making a sound also unsual.phone signal also was lost for about 20 to 30 seconds after the high speed climb.

summary: Craft and orb watch the fireworks, defy laws of nature, then go their separate ways, then suddenly dissappear.
description: Observed a bright stationy light white when observed though telescope was 4 lights it was just hovering apparently watching the fireworks a red orb joined it. At some point the red orb sped away very fast toward the north, went straight down come backup then off two west stopped went back to the east at high rate of speed went straight down and was moving one moment then gone the large white object still hadn't moved. summary: Hovering craft with flashing lights which then silently zipped due east, out of sight.
description:
This sighting time is approximate, as the observers were outside during 4th of July fireworks celebrations (which were focused in the western night sky, close to the horizon.
The physical characteristics of this object were unusual. Three flashing red lights in a vertical formation bisected the object and would light simultaneously. It also had 2-4 horizontal green lights which flashed opposite the red lights. There may have been persistent green or yellow lights on the object along the horizontal axis.  It hovered in the sky, about halfway between the horizon and the North star in the southeastern night sky, for about a minute. I stood near two power or cable lines to verify the object was not moving.
It looked quite small in the sky, about the size of a typical jet (many fly over the city at all times of day and night), but jets do not hover in position while flashing lights. It appeared larger than any stars or planets in the sky. Similarly, planes or helicopters at the altitude of this object (if it was of comparable size, which is impossible to verify without a better sense of scale for the object), are audible above the city, even over the sounds of fireworks.
Suddenly, the…

summary: Gradient circular changing colors of light with random spurts of faded white behind cloud and moving with it.
description: I witnessed a strange thing tonight from my backyard in northwest Reno. it was behind a slowly moving cloud. it was round, translucent and changing colors from blue to red to green and it would also be moving with the cloud. pretty high up so it was too high up and too late on a weeknight for it to have been some kind of drone color light show plus it was behind the cloud and faint. it would randomly shoot out faded white sorta roundish shapes that would roll through the sky like there was a dome or something it reminded me how a kaladiscope works as the cloud slowly dissipated so did the colors. then I went inside. very strange

description: Looking down the street, about 300 feet away, in the back of a eucalyptus tree, I saw a large glowing blue square, divided equally in 4 parts. It looked to be about 8-10 feet across and about 30-40 feet from the ground. Suddenly the top right square emitted a very powerful, bright and beautiful blue light. After about 3 seconds the light stopped. There was nothing behind the tree, whatever that was had gone. There was enough light in the sky to see if something had been there.

summary: I saw a cataract like anomaly in the sky. It was still for a while and then slowly dropped from the sky.

summary: Red light and flashing green light moving rapidly across the sky too fast for a plane, and behaving unusually.
description: I was with my family a group of about 25 people standing on a path above Upper Oso Reservoir, at the southwestern most end, watching fireworks directly south across the canyon. I noticed a red light coming from the direction of the fireworks and rising into the sky. It had a green blinking light next to it. At first I thought it was an airplane, but I noticed it was moving very fast, much too fast for a plane, and appeared lower than a plane. It moved toward the group and crossed nearly overhead. Its arc appeared to break slightly to the west more than once, and this movement was unlike that of a plane. The most unusual behavior was this: when it was more or less overhead, the blinking green light split into two lights, which separated and moved forward and away from the red light in a "v" pattern before going out. This happened a few times before I lost sight of it behind a house. At that point I saw a that gentleman behind me watching it as well, and I said, "what was that?!" but he said nothing. I don't know if anyone else saw it. Everyone was watching the fireworks. I did not mention it to anyone, and have been looking for other accounts online, but have not found any. I do…

description: On July 4th 2023 I was on my way to Walmart with my wife and kids. While driving I noticed a flare of orange and gold color in the peripheral of my left eye, when I looked I saw a small object moving through the sky from east to west (right to left). I then pulled the car into the center lane and took two pictures of this object and I also recorded one video. Once I realized that I was holding up traffic, I pulled into the Sonic parking lot and attempted to visually relocate the object but I wasn’t able to. summary: While waiting for a 4th of July fireworks display to begin, I and 3 friends noticed a blinking green, sometimes red, light in the sky.
description: The object hovered in the same spot for maybe 10 minutes. I would look at it off and on. I also took a 10 second video. It was very stable in it's position. I saw nothing beyond the blinking light. (I think I would have noticed the bodyframe of a helicopter. But only that one blinking light was visible.) The light was greenish in color, though at one point it turned red. I did see it move, quickly, and to the left. Then it suddenly came to a dead stop. To my eye it did not maneuver like a helicopter. It was too rock steady. And it's start-stop maneuver was too crisp. I stopped looking when the fireworks display started. About 10 minutes after the start of the display I remembered to check for the light, but it was gone. (My video is not very dramatic, but please note the small blinking light a little above the big tree that sits center-left in the video frame.)

summary: Object witnessed, Edmonton AB, July 4 2023
description: The time was about 8:45pm, still full daylight and the sun was pretty west. The object was moving from east to west, and below the cloud-line, (although there were not alot of clouds around, only to the west, so the object was mostly seen in a clear sky.) The object moved silently, in a fixed position, (meaning it did not rotate in any direction), maintained a steady speed which was not particularly fast by any means, and also maintained a straight line with no change in altitude, or side-to-side movement, indicating it was not being affected by wind gusts. Its lack of any kind of movement other than its straight path from east to west allowed me to rule out balloons and birds, as well, I ruled out it being a drone based off of the fact that it stretched such a large distance in its path, and in my admittedly limited knowledge of drones, there is a limit to how far they can go, (and I believe there are some laws about drone use in the city.) To the naked eye, it looked like a black blob, I estimated the size would have been the same as a small vehicle. There was no sun reflection, (although the sun was on the opposing side to where we were), nor were there any lights.

From what I could see they were white/silver round balls with a black stripe running down the middle (horizontally) They were scattered and in no sort of pattern, I did not see them arrive nor did I see them depart. They were not moving the entire time they hovered about 300-400 ft. from the ground. My wife didn’t really believe me at first but I said if they disappear in a few minutes it might be UAP/UFO related and then sure enough gone without a trace. I had looked out the window previously and did not see anything like that but it was a bit cloudy on this evening. I am very interested in our solar system and what is beyond I am always scanning the skies day and night so this is a rare moment for me. The entire situation lasted roughly 10 minutes, unfortunately I didn’t have my telescope properly prepared for such an event. In the image provided I have shown the radio tower in the SW direction from…

summary: White strobe-like light moving at very high speed with instant acceleration and deceleration, with instant 90 degree turns.

Suddenly, from its stationary position, it moved E at a very high rate of speed, accelerating instantly, moving out from behind the wispy cloud I first noticed it in to a clear spot in the sky. It traversed approximately 45 degrees (from 000 to 045) in approximately 1 second. It then stopped instantly, was stationary for another second and then immediately moved W at the same speed at a 90 degree angle from its initial trajectory, with no observable turn. It was as though it stopped and then rotated 90 degrees and accelerated again, stopping after it transited approximately 35 degrees to a second position in the sky. Again, it stopped immediately with no apparent deceleration.
After holding stationary for about one second, it accelerated again at the same apparent speed back towards Polaris (000 degrees). Once…

summary: Multiple silver orbs appearing and disappearing in the same small area of sky
description: Shortly before 10 PM I let the dog out to do her duty. Several neighbors had firework displays going on, the closest maybe a quarter mile away. Then another appeared following the exact route the previous one had just taken. After traveling about the same distance, it too disappeared. Then another would appear, do the same thing, and fade out. I called out to my wife who was out on the porch and I told her where to look and pointed to where I was seeing the objects. She also witnessed several of the objects, and agreed it was very peculiar. They were not planes, flares, or satellites. They all appeared on the same vector and path one after the other, almost perfectly spaced distance wise. As one faded, another would appear. There were approximately 10 to 12 objects total, and the total viewing time was around 5 to 7 minutes. My wife managed…

description: I was watching a fireworks show when I saw a red orb coming towards my direction.  I was stunned because the same thing happened to me eight years ago. That time I was with someone and saw 6 red orbs over roughly two hours. As tonights orb came towards me a Southwest jet was coming from the southwest towards Midway airport. I'm located about 6 miles southwest of the airport. At one point the jet was under the orb. I would take the elevation of a jet six miles before landing, and double it. That would be the elevation of the orb I saw tonight.

summary: Starlike UFO drops a mysterious teardrop object before vanishing into thin air.
description: Around 8:40 pm, on the evening of July 3, 2023, I was in the backyard with our dog, Luna, and saw something strange in the eastern sky. The last bit of twilight slowly faded away. There were a few bursts of pre-fourth fireworks lighting up the sky. I looked toward the east and saw what looked like a star that seemed out of place because of the intensity and the location. I grab my phone and was about to use the Star Guide app to identify it, when it darted to the left, then right. I was thinking it could be a drone, I own two drones myself and I recently ordered lights for them. I know that you can purchase lights that allow a pilot to control the intensity from the ground, I continued recording when the object suddenly dipped down toward a lower altitude and dropped an amber teardrop-like object that I watched slowly descend towards the rooftops of distant homes, seemingly morphing into a single point of light, which disappeared behind the roofs. Check out the video. I have more footage showing the main object fading in and out. If it were a drone, it violated the FAA flight ceiling, because it was well above 400 feet when I first noticed it. It was also so close to the Deer…

summary: Saw UAP fly over house
description: I was watching some objects in the sky, that I believed to be drones but the did not have the usual red and green lights, they looked like flames. I thought they might be remnants of fireworks but they seemed to be flying controlled. Two flew side by side. I didn't even think of them as UAPs. While looking at these, my Granddaughter said "look at that!", I saw it as soon as she said it. Above us, was a circular vehicle, no lights, no exhaust, no control surfaces, no markings, no panel lines. I couldn't hear it maybe due to fireworks. It was just flying in the bottom of the clouds, it's color matched the cloud's color (grey) almost a perfect match. There was maybe a greenish haze around the vehicle. I didn't think to take a pic or video, because I know my phone's camera wouldn't be hi res. And partly due to my disbelief and awe of what I was seeing. It flew from south to north and disappeared behind trees at the horizon. It flew in a straight line just like an airplane would.

summary: I saw a cluster of metallic orbs that were 10 plus in numbers and two individual metallic orbs.
description:
My girlfriend, my seven year old daughter, and myself were staying at my friends cabin in Lava Hot Springs Idaho. During the afternoon after my daughter and I got back from a four wheeler ride to go fishing and we went inside because a lightning storm had come over us. My daughter and I went to the balcony to observe the storm and when the clouds had passed over us to the East my daughter pointed out a very strange looking group of flying objects that were very close to the edge of the storm.
At first I thought it might be a flock of birds but after seeing how far away these objects were given that they were hovering just above the next mountain range over it became clear to me that these objects would have to be extremely large to be viewed from such a distance. When I looked at the cluster of objects with a pair of binoculars they looked metallic when the sunlight would hit them just right. There were no wings, no navigation lights, and no propulsion equipment. These were indeed metallic orbs I was looking at. The group of objects hovered and fluttered in a very random pattern.
I called my girlfriend over, she was inside working on her laptop at the time. I didn't say anything…

summary: Three objects that seemed to move in concert or were connected as one. Right over highway.
description: Please note, the image is only to convey the location. I was unable to capture the actual objects, and I think the marks in this photo are a reflection. Someone else must have seen this since it was broad daylight, close and right above the road. My friend who was driving was as surprised as I was when I pointed them out. They were like three circle or spherical shapes flying in kind of a triangle shape. She says she saw something that looked like it could have been connecting them, so it could have been one object. They did not look ordinary, whatever they were. It was too hard to see if they could be drones, or birds. I tried to get a video but sadly must have hit the stop button when trying to zoom in. I did snap a picture of the location. Strangely—while I thought I was recording the video—I could not see them on the iphone screen, though I could see them in the air still. I may have just zoomed in too far. I did get a picture of the road so the exact location can be determined and I'm hoping maybe someone else saw it / recorded it, or can check if there was drone clearance or something in the area.

summary: Very bright star-like object, about the size of Venus, but much brighter, moving very fast
description:
I was walking for exercise on long deck outside, facing a full moon to the south, behind trees. Above my right shoulder I suddenly saw a very bright "star" -- a little larger than Venus and much brighter -- shoot across the sky (north to south) and disappear behind the trees. During the few seconds it was visible, it stayed exactly the same size, shape and brightness (no flickering out, no trailing or streaking) with uniform speed and a perfectly straight path parallel to earth.
Normally I would assume it was a "shooting star" but its brightness was more like intense LED white. I have never seen a meteor display that type of white light. Also that it didn't vary, flicker, or burn out, or leave a trail. It just disappeared behind the trees. Although it was very fast, it seemed slower than a meteor. It seemed to last too long.

summary: A short creature with big black shiny eyes ran from my shed back behind my car and then green lights flashed and it was gone.
description: My wife and I were sitting on our back patio on the evening of July 2, 2023. As we were sitting and talking casually amongst ourselves, at around 9:45 the “motion” light on our backyard shed turned on. It immediately caught my attention as it’s roughly 30-35 feet from where we were sitting. My wife’s car is parked a couple of feet in front of the shed where the light shines off the front left side. At first I didn’t really think too much of it but I continued watching for just a moment. Then very quickly, I saw a very short “being” run from behind the shed out past a gap and behind the car from our perspective. Its skin color was a very tan looking color. It was barely taller than the hood of the car, which is a small sedan. So roughly 3-3 1/2 feet in height. Its body was small and slender and its head was bigger and more rounded. Its eyes were huge and took up most of its facial space. The eyes were black and very shiny. I could see two eyes looking towards me as it ran by like it knew we were sitting there. I felt as if we made eye contact as it ran by and I was genuinely left speechless for a moment. Immediately after it ran behind the car there was a flash of green light what…

summary: We saw round 3 lights moving through the sky above our area two of which performed movements an airplane could not.
description: About 9:30-9:40 pm, as I was looking south at the rising full moon in a clear night sky from my back porch, I saw a bright white light cross the sky, coming toward me from south to north; it passed over my home and continued north to slightly north-east. It was moving fast, steady, level, bright and silent, and was not as high as airplanes usually are. It was of the brightness of a car headlight, but not as large. I called my husband to come, but it was gone before he could see it. We went into the street to look for it. As we were, we both saw two more lights appear just under the star Arcturus, which was fairly high in the sky to the south-west. The first light was heading east and a second was following behind it from a short distance. Again, both lights were round, bright, steady without flashing, moving fast and silent. They were more like the surrounding stars in brightness, and further away and less bright than the first light that passed over our house, and they were travelling faster than the airplanes that I commonly see overhead. We are in the flightpath of airplanes from the Rapid City Regional Airport, and planes are common sights and sounds. We are also two blocks…

It looked florescent yellow to the human eye and on tape it looks like regular white color. It came out from over the water and then as I flew above my head I fell to the ground a few moments later. (Not sure from the craft or from shock)

summary: Pre-tornado: One with a trail far away, one floating much closer
description: There was an urgent tornado warning happening, so my adult son and I went out in the backyard to take a look at the sky. There was darkness to the west where the storm was approaching, but as is typical with this kind of storm, relative calm on the other side of its front. There was an obvious object off to the southwest, very distant with a vapor trail, descending from the sky, quite far away. I immediately pointed it out to my son because it seemed odd, and we watched. The object was bright -- at some points, extremely bright. It did not have the appearance of a plane, but rather, a tiny ball of light at the tip of the vapor trail. It's hard to tell if it was falling or not; for a time I thought it was a meteor. I wondered if it was the sun reflecting off something metal (like a plan) but the flare was so bright, it exceeded any expectation of sun reflection, even though that in itself can be quite bright. While watching, I noticed a different object, much closer but high in the sky, and a bit to the right (closer to the storm off to the west). This object was NOT moving -- it was more stationary; it gave the appearance of floating. It seemed metallic and round; that's about all…

summary: Pulled alongside my boat. I was afraid I was going to hit it. Stayed about 20 feet and hovered just off surface.
description: I was on watch while sailing our boat north for the summer, watching 2 lights off in distance. This thing appeared out of nowhere 10 to 20 feet off my starboard bow. I was afraid I was going to hit it. It was a cube shape. Bottom 3 or 4 inches was florescent blue, which did not reflect in the water, as a light might. Rest was too dark to see except white light on top. Approx. 3 feet square. It was not in the water. Did not bob with waves. Did not continue on like something I would have just passed. It made no sound. I looked at it for several seconds as it stayed right beside me. I then reached across the cockpit for binoculars. When I turned to it again, it had pulled off about 60 feet and kept on same trajectory as boat. Then, white light on top began to grow brighter and brighter. It created a white cone about 3 feet into the air above. It remained for about 10 seconds and slowly and smoothly made its way SE. Watched it go. Was soon out of sight. Was not scary or threatening. I am a retired NGO director and have lived on a boat for the past 20 years. I am 76, in good health and not bonkers. I do not drink or do drugs and was well rested.
region: Approx. 2.5 NM off coast of Sloop Point, NJ

I was left feeling deeply confused, fearful, and in shock - it is hard to explain in words what I saw, because it is not consistent with anything I have ever seen before. Whatever those triangles were, they were not clouds. They were defying nature.

A sphere floating just above the ground, invisible in the dark but reflecting/emitting an infrared signal.
description:
We were at a cottage in a remote rural part of Wales. It was around midnight and raining. I was using my night-vision binoculars to look for nocturnal wildlife before heading to bed. The binoculars emit an infrared light which illuminates the immediate area and is displayed on a screen.
I noticed that the image on screen was showing some kind of interference, with horizontal lines across the display.
When I looked into the field at the front of the cottage, I saw a sphere emitting or reflecting a very strong infrared signal to my binoculars. I lowered the binoculars and looked directly in the direction of the object. It was raining and, in the absence of any light other than that from the cottage, it was too dark for me to see anything. I looked again with the binoculars and the sphere was clearly visible.
I quite honestly felt incredibly spooked. I walked back into the cottage, told my family I'd seen a UFO and they laughed at me. I convinced myself the binoculars were faulty and went to bed.
Next day, the binoculars were working fine. There was nothing visible in daylight that could explain what I'd seen. It is a significant source of regret that I didn't record what I'd seen.…

summary: Bellevue UFO

I looked up and out, expecting to see an airplane. It seemed low in the sky, like about where a commercial jet would fly, or maybe even a bit lower like when a plane will come in to land. My mind was having trouble processing what I was seeing and it happened so quickly, but I initially saw a triangle type object which I first mistook for a plane. There was lights blinking on it sporadically, green/red and possibly bluish white. It wasn’t blinking off and on, it was more erratic, like a lot were going on and off at the same time. Then it seemed to morph into a spherical shape rotating in the sky, still flashing with the sporadic colorful lights. And then it was just gone. It was there and then it wasn’t. I didn’t see it zoom away. It was just there and then not. Like someone flipping off a light switch. It was so bizarre. I kept looking out my car windshield while also watching the road and I couldn’t…

I didn’t see it zoom away. It was just there and then not. It was so bizarre. I kept looking out my car windshield the rest of the drive and I couldn’t see anything again. I was only a…

summary: A greenish light moving downward in sky
description:
I received a notification there was 16% chance of seeing aurora in our area at 10pm so I was skywatching. I saw a greenish light appear out of nowhere and it started to move left and right slowly then started to descend. I tried to hit video but I mistakenly hit the option to take multiple pictures in quick succession. It moved downward continuously until it disappeared into the horizon beneath the trees & my line of sight. It was not falling fast enough to be a meteor. It was slow moving but the entire sighting was less than a minute.
Not sure if it was any way related but my phone lost connection - could not connect to any mobile tower or wifi it had an X thru my bars and said "NO SERVICE" the entire time the light was visible and for about 5min after.

summary: Orbs of light spinning counterclockwise, 9:30 PM EST, 6 visible at a time
