Full spin lasts 3 seconds, pretty small, like the size of the stars spinning near the moon, there were 5 airplanes chasing the object, i saw some of the stray cats come out from their hiding spots, i went to get my binoculars but it was gone by then, my neighbors also witnessed it. White colored, the 2 middle ones that are visible would become bright and then as they rotate become dim in synchronization with the orbit.
Also, I would like the investigator to send mail or an email, please contact soon, thanks.
Do not call, or arrive at the house.

description: Outside looking at the sky, with a naked eye the object originally appeared circular then changed form to what appeared tic tac shaped (oblong) and then I started recording what was seen. A photo my daughter snapped on her phone, while I was videoing. In her picture, when zoomed in on, it appeared triangular. summary: Glowing white streak across the sky
description: We had bad storms yesterday afternoon/evening. I walked outside to head out to the grocery store and called my husband out to look at the rainbow that came out. As we’re looking at the rainbow we saw a glowing white streak going across the sky. At first we thought it was a plane but it was going way too fast to be a regular airplane. So I took a photo with my phone. I couldn’t get my video on quick enough but the photo I have is a live photo from my iPhone. When I zoom in and play it, it’s definitely not an airplane. It’s a bright white cylinder shape and if you look carefully, it looks almost like a gyroscope. Lasted about 30 seconds and just disappeared.

description: Two images of the craft, one from a distance and one blown up. To me, appears to be a tiny manned craft, but that’s just a guess.

There were no planes in the sky at the time of my video recording. With the size and speed it was moving I assumed it has to be a plane, but according to the flight radar there was nothing in the air at the time of the video. I attached a flight radar map showing the area i was in and an arrow pointing in the direction I was facing. The only airplane on the radar was on the ground at the local airport.

summary: Silver sphere with sun reflecting off of it. Moved slightly left then stayed still then faded from view entirely.
description: Looked up and noticed something bright almost like a star but no stars are out yet. Zoomed in with phone camera and it was a spherical shape that was reflecting the sun. Started to record the event and then the item simply disappeared.

summary: Slow moving cylinder traveling over the harbor
description: It was nearing sunset and the moon was nearly full and out in the sky. I saw a cylinder shaped craft cross in front of the moon and travel south towards Seal Beach, California…until it disappeared into the midair. There were no clouds in the sky. It was moving very slow. It had no lights flashing on it. It had no sound. It had a shadow on the bottom and was very shiny on top. It was right above Long Beach Harbour in, Long Beach, California.

summary: Noticed a stationary object above the tree line
description: Me and my boyfriend were sitting on a park bench on a clear and sunny day. I noticed across the bay a stationary object above the tree line. I pointed it out to him and we figured it was a plane because it was in a common flight path. We watched it for about a minute and it seemed to not move at all then moved in almost a straight line down towards the tree line. It stopped right above the tree line for another few seconds and then move down again out of view. The whole encounter seemed to have lasted 1-2 minutes.

summary: A shape and color changing controlled craft
description: My sister was driving us on I 90 east when we saw something flying above us. I thought at first it was a paraglider in profile, in silhouette. It was between the two sides of the mountain across the middle where the freeway runs. I couldn't tell its size or what distance away it was. It came over and around the side of the car and it appeared to be a bag, but it wasn't moving like the wind was pushing it. I couldn't see any drone frame, then it changed and looked like a purple rectangular box kite without any visible drone frame. I thought maybe it was a state patrol drone because we had just passed a vehicle that had been pulled over, but I didn't see anything other than a kite material box. I thought it was the size of a couple shoeboxes. My sister saw a bag like thing go over the top of us, that changed color from dark to purple and from a difficult to decipher shape to a bag like shape. Both of us saw it move in a controlled not natural way.

summary: Giant White Object floating, became visible for 15 seconds and then vanished.
description: I was looking into the sky, seen a giant white floating object appear and then vanished.

summary: My husband and I were outside in our backyard and my husband pointed it out flying overhead. First saw it near the moon.
description: My husband and I saw a small white object flying overhead traveling south/SE to north/NW. it was small, circular and white and was going pretty fast. It did not make any noise like all the planes we hear overhead.

summary: Formation of 8 bubble like objects, with a cone shape.
description: Very visible at first, then went higher and higher until it disappeared. It stayed in a formation of 8 bubble-like objects with a short "tail". It was very clear at first (on the beach between 18th and 19th street). When I first saw it it appeared over the ocean and was very clear. It moved higher and higher and then disappeared. I watched it for about 10 minutes or so. I kept looking around to see if anyone else noticed it because it was really clear at first. But it seemed like people were just enjoying the beach and playing ball, etc. Unfortunately, it was a day that I didn't have my phone with me. I wanted to relax and "unplug" so I left my phone at home.

description: String of lights ad no cell signal. Phone was scrambled wouldn't work at all. When the lights disappeared my phone worked fine. I called the wife to see if she saw anything too but she couldn't see the lights. It was right over me while I was fishing on the lake a little after 4 am. I was also alone, normally I am not but was this morning. The object was a string of bright lights but the string was the length of a football field. It really scared me. The sky was very dark bc expecting rain today. They were white lights. I also attempted to take a photo but my cellphone wouldn't do anything at all.

summary: I was entering the yard and I seen a disk type of “UFO” I assume and it had a blueish light surrounding it, as soon as I seen it, gone
description: It was a disk, bright with blueish light surroundings, dissapearing as soon as I was able to identify it, quickly gone, no track.

summary: Large extremely bright light traveling Northeast
description: On Jun 25th at approx. 12:38am I observed an extremely bright light in the sky traveling extremely fast. It was heading Northeast. I caught a glimpse of it for a couple of seconds and knew immediately it was not a familiar object. It seemed to be flying rather low in the sky and was brighter and faster than anything I had ever seen. It resembled a shooting start with a tail following behind it which could have been from the sheer speed of which it was moving. It was clearly not a plane, nor was it the reflections of headlights in my windshield. It was a UFO.

summary: I noticed two stars close together. One vanished and then this bowl shaped object appeared.
description: I was observing the sky and I noticed two stars were really close to each other. Roughly two inches apart. One of the stars then disappered and was replaced by a bowl shaped object that was flying in all directions at such high speeds I couldn't see it move.

summary: Bright orb with a beam of light shooting straight up out of it
description:
We went for a night swim in our pool around midnight. We were looking at the stars when I saw a really bright star in the middle of a triangle of more dimly lit stars. Then the bright “star” slowly started getting bigger, fast enough that I didn't have time to point it out.
Suddenly it was about half the size of a full moon, but it still looked like a fuzzy star, just bigger. Then a beam of white light shot straight up out of it. The beam of light was very thin, crisp looking, not hazy. It just shot straight up out of the big fuzzy star like orb, then the whole thing immediately vanished.

They came immediately after fireworks almost as if checking it out. They moved around different parts of the sky coming in and out by seeming to disappear and then emerging somewhere else. These orbs are something we occasionally see here behaving very strangely like this.

summary: Looking southwest in the night sky
description: While working night security . I was looking in the southwest nighttime sky I noticed an orange and white light pulsating and moving left to right for about 3 to 5 seconds. After about another 4 minutes I looked out in the same southwest direction the orange and white light was no longer in sight.

summary: White and red lit object floating back and forth and hovering over Virginia mountains
description: Sitting on our back porch we can see NW across the Blue Ridge mountains. It was sunset and there were dark clouds. We usually can see planes or even rarely comets, but there was a red light flying eastward, but then stopped. Turned white then red several times, and jets do not stop, change directions and hover. It also went higher and then circled back and forth about two times, then it just disappeared. I could no longer see it. I told my wife it was a drone, but she thought it was too far away, since it seemed to go in and out of that dark cloud ( the light would come and go as if it was going through the cloud).

My city was hosting an early fireworks display which started a 9:30pm I saw this object approximately at 9:16pm. summary: This might be a starlink satellite sighting. I checked the info on the satellite formations and it did not look or behave the same.
description:
The objects were a line of approximately 7 to 10 pulsating lights arranged in a straight line. The spacing between the lights was not uniform. They would pulse of and on, then disappear completely for several seconds before reappearing. They reappeared approximately 6 times before completely disappearing. They were almost due north about 20 degrees up from the horizon from my position in my hot tub. They were moving very slowly from west to east and were never all illuminate at once, although I did observe more than one light illuminated at time, perhaps 3 to 4 simultaneously. The string length was maybe 5 degrees and the lights appeared white to the naked eye. The sighting lasted for approximately one and a half minutes before disappearing completely. They appeared to be quite high in the atmosphere.
You should be able to confirm the date, time and location to determine if this was a indeed a starlink satellite. There did not appear to be any rocket activity.

summary: Fast moving high altitude light makes impossible u turn

The crescent moon and Venus were brightly lit to the west (my right). I was facing south looking up at the sky about 80 degrees above the horizon. I live approximately 12 miles from the Mexican border and this object was most likely operating in Mexican airspace. I often do this looking for satellites or space debris and occasionally the Space Station (I have an iPhone app I frequently use that identifies the debris being observed but I did not have my phone with me this time). While looking at the sky (there were two small stars visible) I observed what appeared to be a fast moving satellite moving west to east. It was just a point of light, about the same size as the star that was visible. It was at a very high altitude and moving very, very fast. I observed it for a few seconds with the intent to watch it until it went out of sight when it suddenly made an incredible u turn, reversing course in…

summary: Pair of iridescent ovals with tendrils and halos travel rapidly, at high altitude on southern course across Seattle

My initial concern was that they were weather balloons floating towards SEATAC / Boeing in the path of aircraft. I took a 3x telescopic zoom video (iPhone 14s) of the objects wherein they maintain similar positions and relative distance to each other, but observed them off camera to drift, and then nearly contact each other. They appeared to have an aura/halo that persisted as they moved south in the general direction of Olympia, and eventually disappeared. One object remained visible for ~20 minutes after the other was no longer in field of vision. I did not see either object disappear from sight - but lost contact while adjusting my recreational telescope.
I was able to use my telescope to observe the object in greater detail, and successfully sighted both objects with a clear view. I observed what appeared to be two undulating, elliptical shapes (iridescent, mainly orange and purple) with distinct attached tendrils / trails. My…

Then the white lights, red and blue would all light up at once. Then…

description: We were swimming in our pool and saw a array of lights and they were changing and we thought of the Starlink satellite but it was way to little and was changing formation so I came here to report it now.

summary: Blue Orb Shot up Into the Sky
description:
I woke up around 3 a.m. Unable to sleep and uneasy, I went outside for some fresh air. I have a second-story porch, which faces northeast and overlooks a neighborhood lane.
While sitting on the porch, I heard my neighbor's dog yelp and whimper. This sound drew my attention to my neighbor's yard, approximately 100 feet from where I sat. A few seconds after the whimper, I saw a bright blue light hover momentarily, then shoot up into the sky as fast as it appeared.
The dog's yelping solidified that it was not a sleep-deprived hallucination but a cause-and-effect situation. Also, the blue light stood out to me because of a story my mother-in-law always tells. She grew up two houses down from where the dog yelped and often commented about a blue light she would see as a child across the street in the cemetery. She said she would often see it drifting through the tree line and disappear as quickly as it appeared.

summary: Orbs of light flying
description: Orbs of light seen over the bay of fundy.. they were flying in sync then started doing an up and down formation keeping the same relative distance apart. My husband first noticed them thinking they were the Elon musk starlight’s satellites but nope they started moving up and down travelled across the sky then disappeared after 20 mins

The sky was clear except for a few clouds. It was traveling in a west to east direction. I lost sight of it after it passed over my house.

They were too high to be drones but moved slow and no sound. It was like they hovered but yet floated at same time but kept same height and came at different times. The first one came around and passed by and second one came about 30 minutes later it was different had movements that where twisting but not like anything I have seen fast movement but yet slow moving. I tried to get a picture but my phone wouldn't focus that high up. No trail like you see with jets and a plane passed after it went by in another direction that you can heat planes anytime they go by. This was silent.

description: There were 3 in my group, we didn’t see the image until later when viewing the pics.

summary: Blended in with clouds, thought it was a bird, but it reflected light and it was maneuvering quickly, not like a plane.
description: I was driving home from Elyria to Cleveland on 480 E. I always look at the clouds & I noticed what I thought was a bird soaring in and out of the clouds. I immediately knew it wasn't a plane because of the way it was moving. As I tried to watch it while driving (kinda hard and even harder to videotape while driving on a busy highway), it literally blended in with the clouds, then I lost sight and when I was able to look up again I saw it reflected light, so it wasn't a bird. But planes don't maneuver the way this one was, in and out of clouds. It wasn't triangular, more like a Chevron and kinda small (that's why I thought it was a bird, until I saw it reflect light). I lost sight when the direction of my road changed and I started going Southbound.

summary: Came out of hotel to go get coffee, bright light illuminating from a single cloud in the sky. Nothing behind it to illuminate it.
description:
Illuminated cloud. Nothing around to illuminate it, seemed to light up from inside. About as large as the hotel sign. Stationary for a few minutes the fairly quickly turned into a straight line and then the cloud dissipated.
When I increased contrast on original photo it seemed like there was a disk shape inside the cloud.
This was the only cloud in the sky.

summary: Just above treeline, orange glowing globe. Above lake underhill & dean road
description:
Just above the treeline, an orange glowing globe was visible. It was above Lake Underhill & Dean Road, just sitting there right above the treeline, low in the sky and not moving. It started fading in and out, becoming bright and dull, but never fully disappearing. After about three minutes, it split into two glowing circles, then completely disappeared. Two of us were driving down the highway and saw and watched it. It was right above Lake Underhill & Dean Road, heading south on 417 about 15 minutes before you get to the international airport.
I also have videos of other UFO sightings: a white oval-shaped glowing craft with rainbow lights circling it.

summary: We seen a bright light as we were heading south on the 15 freeway. The object was bright at first with an obvious tail coming from behind.
description: Object that looked like a plane at first but had an obvious tail coming from it. It dimmed somewhat and then we could see very faint trail still.

summary: I observed a huge area of red flood-like lighting and a red circular object emerge from it.
description: I was watching a severe cloud to cloud lightning storm over the mountains. I saw 3 white dancing lights low in the woods and considered they could be flashlights. Suddenly, the sky behind the mountains lit up bright red as though stadium lights were turned on. The entire area in my view was red. Then a bright red, circular light emerged and came from south to north, toward my location, gaining elevation. When it reached an elevation above the roof line, It disappeared as well as the red lighting. No sound, no vibration,.

summary: Outside of my window there was a really bright light that looked like a star but it was much more bright started moving and flashing
description: I looked out of my window and i saw a really bright light that appeared to be a star just much brighter it stayed there still for a while until i got up to my window to have a closer look it then started moving as the bright light dimmed and started flashing red it looked like an aeroplane however they don’t emmit lights so bright and stay still so its impossible it was one. I filmed it as it flew away and went to tell my mother as she came to my room to check it out the bright light i saw before it left was back and what i had just witnessed repeated itself with my mother there to witness. I keep seeing strange flashing lights similar to that one since that day too small to be planes.

summary: We spotted this to the left of the moon. It was round like an orb with what appeared to be lights slowly moving around.
description: The lights seemed like they could be white and red and moved slowly around in a way that appeared like flashlights - sometimes facing towards us and other times circling around the other side where you could see a lighthouse type beam. It did not move in a manner like a balloon or ship that we know of. Just hovered steady in place - never moving from it's appearence in relation to the moons position but... after about a half hour all of us 3 witnesses agreed that as the moon got lower in the sky (like over the top of the homes on the street) the object seemed to be dropping down at the same rate - very slowly. We did not stay to watch it move more or disappear but in the morning it was gone. I have witnessed another object in the sky similar to what this looked like but it was much closer - just above my town of Keyport, NJ and then over the lower NY harbor area but next to Keyport. It was a round vessel that also hovered and had lights on it - like nothing or any technology I've ever seen - it first moved slowly along the coast so I followed in my car and lost view of it - then when I was in the clear to see it - it was gone. This object reminded me so much of that one in Keyport…

Video was taken from an airplane flying east to west over western Us between Minnesota and San Diego. I believe the perspective of the photo is to the south. The craft appeared to have whit and amber lights. Port/starboard navigational lights were not observed by me.
Possibly reflections off the Ivanpah Solar Power Facility

summary: It was disk shaped had lights and at a fast speed disappeared
description: I’m lost you guys have to watch this for yourselves

summary: It was a orb that turned into a huge bright white flash followed by the strangest electro weird sound.
description: It was a stationary orb that turned into a bright 2-3 second flash followed by a electro mechanical like sound the sound lasted for about 2 1/2 seconds. I had a full view of the sky and it lit up a decent size portion of the sky. Part of the mountains lit up from the flash too. All of us (11 or 12 witnesses) were like what the hell was that and began looking online for a explanation. It happened so fast none of us had our phones out to record it. That sound is something i cannot get out of my head now, I've never heard anything like it in my life. We started to here a couple helicopters 3 to be exact shortly after the event.

summary: Object appeared a slowly left sight
description: I looked over and saw the object floating slowly to my right. I recorded the object and it left. Typically I would assume this is a plane or a helicopter. But for the object to be so close to the ground and not make any sound was what changed my mind.

summary: It was night time when I noticed a beam in the sky that then turned into two. These lights moved fast, whirlyand odd, like interacting.
description: It was night time when I noticed a light moving across the sky. It almost looked like a star but it appeared suddenly and moved with quick speed. I continued to stare at this moving star, then it soon turned into two circular lights that moved across the sky in sync really fast. These two lights zipped through the sky and changed direction in an abnormal way, then continued in a straight direction. Both of the circular lights soon disappeared. This happened within about 3-4 seconds.

summary: On my country property, I watched a near-stationery object for a long time which basically resembled a disco ball with occasional “wing
description: I stepped outside and was transfixed by a huge, glittering “disco ball” with occasional elongation which didn’t seem to traverse the sky (yet became more distanced after I went to get my phone). At first it looked like it had airplane wings, but ones which were not fashioned typically. I asked myself if it was a drone, balloon, or satellite, but it simply looked different from anything I’ve ever seen. By the time I retrieved my phone inside, I couldn’t see the wings, or elongation, just the ball of bright silver sparkles. I took this from a 1:33 minute video, but it was within my sight for at least 15 or 20 minutes. I hope someone can tell me what it was. Thank you.

summary: Very very large triangle craft with white circular lights across the bottom at least 50+ lights
description: I noticed as I stared at the night sky a strange object began to move and I thought huh, cloud is moving mighty fast, yet upon looking directly at the object made no mistake in identifying this as Extraterrestrials. The ship was massive it had numerous white lights across the bottom that were so dim they were hardly noticeable against the night sky. This object continued to fly away from my position from where I originally noticed it from almost directly overhead but must have been out of our atmosphere to be so large and travelling without sound I suspected it was orbiting earth. I have never seen anything that could fly of that size it was breathtaking and stunning to have actually witnessed Extraterrestrial presence. This is no hoax or joke, I always knew they were out there. Never in my life would I expect to see a UFO and of such size. The lights of this object were lined across the bottom of the ship with a perfect triangular shape and I just stood and stared in amazement as I watched the most amazing thing I had ever witnessed. Life, from another planet.

summary: We were stargazing and I was staring at this supposed plane because it was moving side to side.
description: We were stargazing and I was staring at this supposed plane because it was moving side to side and at speeds unlike the rest of the planes in the sky, until eventually this ‘plane’ just stopped moving and began hovering in the middle of the sky. Then the star like object next to it began to move closer to it and then after a moment the 2 UFOs separated moving unilaterally from each other and there they stayed hovering above the city of Glendale Az.

summary: Sphere shaped uap
description: During sunset the metallic orb/sphere moved very smooth throughout the air and slowly went higher in the air then disappeared in the clouds.

summary: Two vets, a pilot saw a sphere, change to cigar, get big and small, not plane, not space station, moving slow at 60k+'
description: While hanging out at my friend's apartment, myself a veteran, and one friend, a veteran pilot, saw an object in the sky. Initially they thought it was Venus. Though, I noticed it moving initially. It was moving too slow to be the space station, but I looked up its position to be sure. The object at our best guess was 60k+ feet altitude and took approximately 30 minutes to travel roughly 45 degrees. It moved from the west to the east in a slightly southerly trajectory advancing roughly 10 degrees. When we first saw it, it was spherical and bright. When it got more directly overhead it changed in size looking like its distance from us changed. It became significantly more cigar shaped, and at times brighter and less luminous. It looked like it doubled in size and then shrank, as well as going from white to gray / difficult to see against the sky. I took pictures with my phone and video, but they did not come out well.

summary: Three stationary white (cloud-texture and colored) points in the form of a triangle. followed by a fourth single to the SW, same height
description:
Sailing alone. Cloudless skies.
The first sighting lasted about 10 minutes. Stationary and in a triangle formation. Then suddenly appeared to move upwards, very fast and sort of evaporating as they went.
Second sighting about 40 minutes later. A single point this time of about the same size. appeared to drop downwards, increasing in size a little before disappearing upwards very fast, leaving a slightly bigger evaporation trail.

summary: First we saw a beam of light low down then a blue pulsing beam in the sky.
description: Saw a light in the sky moving super fast, wasn't an aircraft as it wasn't flashing or didn't have any coloured lights also was moving way to quick and was flying quite low but was super bright. Then we walked to the park and saw a massive blue beam of light looked like it was pulsing a little and was moving about. Have no idea if it's anything but was definitely something I have never seen before. Also it was witnessed by my girlfriend too. Happened between 12:00 - 12:45 at night.

I photographed it on my iPhone through my car window but in the photo the plane is missing. I tried a second time and the second photo also captures the sky where I saw the plane but it is not visible. I lost sight of the plane while passing a building and then it was gone. As I was approaching it, it quickly shot up into the sky while also moving east. Luckily, I was able to catch a pretty close glimpse of it before it ascended. I observed a bright orange ball of flames. The center of it looked dense and its shape was semi-spherical. There were what looked like ethereal artifacts surrounding it, moving similarly to fire but it clearly was not flames. Eventually, the object just faded off into the distance.

summary: Low flying, fast moving, absolutely silent reflective orb, no clouds, broad daylight.
description: Walking south easterly along a gravel path in Crown Hill Park. 90+ degrees, not a lot of people in the park and none in that area at the time. Orb approached flying north, probably about 5 degrees out of dead on toward me, going slightly toward my left. I stopped walking to watch it. It was moving much faster than planes or helicopters normally seen in the area. While it was moving too fast to be at high altitude, it was absolutely silent. Seemed like at most 1000 feet up. Plainly visible as a reflective orb. Kept waiting for more details to emerge as it neared me. Then it turned in an arc toward the west, then southwest. It came pretty close, I am sure it was over the park, but it never made a sound and never changed it's shape. No details ever emerged to indicate it was anything other than an orb. Looked metallic due to the reflectivity. As it was flying away I started walking again -- glanced toward the path and when I looked back the sky was clear, the orb was gone which I thought was jarring since it would have had to significantly alter its speed to be gone that quickly. About 40 minutes later a plane flew over that I thought might be around the same altitude. The plane was…

summary: Two very bright lights. Circled shape at first, but changed. Extremely fast, as if their chasing one another. Disappears into mid air.

The skies were blue, the clouds were so white, there’s a slight breeze so the clouds moved. I live in Pauoa Valley, looking at punchbowl crater admiring the beautiful greenery all around me. The birds chirping. Perfect O’ahu weather. As I’m staring into the sky, Watching the clouds blow. It’s about 8:33 a.m I see what appears to be two extremely bright lights zooming fast in the air, as if they were chasing each other. Dancing around each other. It would disappear into mid air, and reappear at a higher or lower altitude. As I continued to watch this happen, my phone was in the house, it would take me 15 seconds from the back door to grab it. I didn’t want to leave. I felt if I left to grab my phone even for only 15 seconds, what I saw/witnessed would disappear. I ran in the house, I grabbed my…

summary: A translucent or black "boomerang" or "flying v" shaped craft moved rapidly away from a fireworks display.
description:
I consider myself a fairly knowledgeable UFO hunter and fully disclose I was actively hoping to see one. However, in my entire life, this would be the first time I believe I saw one. I wrote down my report with a basic sketch immediately that night as to not forget the precise details. It is as follows:
June 17 10:40PM DUBOIS, PA
Object was seemingly translucent. Made visible by firework haze and lights from fireworks. Seemingly popped out of nowhere and shot off in a trajectory that was quickly obscured by neighboring house. Experience was maybe a second long. High certainty of vision at the moment.
---Current Additional Notes---
The object was most definitely a classic boomerang shape. In hindsight the object may have been black just as well. Against the night sky it could seem translucent. I was intentionally watching other parts of the sky rather than the fireworks display. The space I was observing was where it became visible. I had a straight perfect view of it. It was almost as if you could see the haze from the fireworks being navigated through by an object that was low visibility. It moved with remarkable speed and steadiness. As if turbulence or atmosphere have no effect…

summary: Cylinder below airplane, moving faster than us to our left about 30 degrees off of our heading
description: While watching the ocean below I saw a gray cylinder. There were no wings, nothing that I could see on it, no exhaust. It occurred to me that it was something strange, so I called to my husband, who leaned over to look out of my window and I asked him “What is that” and he said “I don’t know”. It was headed for a tall cloud bank, and we both saw a shadow from the cloud bank fall over it before it disappeared into the cloud, where we lost sight of it.

location: Unknown, but it was seen from Palmela, Setúbal District, Portugal
summary: Fulminating ball of light, distinct from other ilumination sources defied gravity forces and suddenly flashed up.
description:
I have very good eyesight and so I could see some distinct features of this phenomenon, it was an increasing energy source (bright orange) being expelled from possible cavities within its source, it was distinct from other light sources as it didn't "blink" and it was next in view to light sources that could be compared to such as radar lights, planes crossing by, city lights, chemical reactions, and a possible forest fire.
I don't believe in any of this. But, it defied our known physics laws, thus, I had to report it. I tried to record it with my iPhone Pro 13, but whenever the camera came close to encountering the light source it became blurry no matter what degree of zoom I applied to it, this further strains my reasoning of possible explanations.
The source gravitated for 10-12 m, as we continue our life, but I kept an eye on it (for obvious reasons), then suddenly it flashed upwards with a slight trace of light behind it, and checking it getting blurrier into what I assumed to be the stratosphere and just "Vanished"( its impossible not to leave a trace like that and suddenly disappears??). Either way, the source was definitely hot with a pasty vision blurry to it since…

summary: Planet seen dropping from sky completely vertical changing colors.
description: While walking my dogs late Thursday night, the sky was clear as usual. I normally look for certain constellations during these late night walks. I noticed that Mars was extremely brighter/closer as usual. Then I noticed the star changed its color to green. The color alternated from red to green then started to drop from the sky, descending completely vertically until I could no longer view it from behind a home (street level). The drop was rapid in a straight line which seemed impossible for a jet to accomplish unless it was in a nose dive crash. I pulled out my cellular phone and recorded the descent.

summary: Was watching what I thought was a satellite, but orbit became very erratic
description:
Object noticed in direct southern sky; about 45 degrees; south of bright star (planet) to the near west but lower.
Traveled east quickly; high up and seemed too high and fast for a plane.
I thought it was a satellite, but was traveling too quickly. Abruptly turned
north, almost a 90 degree angle, and then the pattern was erratic.
Whatever star (planet) was directly east from me, about 65 degrees, it was moving up and down there; disappeared (cloudy and ashy conditions). There was a definite up and down movement, in a zig zag fashion. Nothing that makes sense. I have been casually watching planets, stars, space stations, satellites. This was weird.

summary: Item was stationary… then lights disappeared.

I took out my cell phone and snapped this picture.There was no sounds and then suddenly the lights disappeared and the cube shaped thing was gone… There were no sounds or flashing nav lights that you see and hear from a aircraft. It was not a commercial plane and I’m certain it was not a drone. I’m retired from the US Air Force and flew for 18 years as a boom operator onboard a KC-135 tanker. I am certain this was not a military, civilian or commercial aircraft . This object was spotted from the southwest. My home is located less than 5 miles from Calabash and the Atlantic Ocean.

summary: Saw an object that was hovering in the sky with red and green. Flew to the north.   Stopped and flew back to the south. Very quick/smooth

It stopped and after a couple of seconds it flew back to the south in the same manner until it was out of my eyesight. Building was blocking my vision. I attempted to take video but in my haste just took a photo. Two photos attached. The second one is just magnified.

summary: At campground bright white disk tipped on its side and was moving slow for a few s
description: Sitting in an open field area at campground. Bright white disk above us flew around and hovered for a few minutes, it then tipped on its side and flew off and disappeared. It had a mist like look to it on the bottom and on top it had looked like a layer or two on its top. It made a swishing sound and low vibration in the air around it.

summary: There was a bright object that did not seem to move but went dark and seconds later would be bright again.
description:
On 06/14/23 at about 10:20 pm I noticed a bright object in the sky toward the town of Rumey. At first I thought it was a helicopter because it stayed in the same place but it seemed close enough that I would hear it if it was a helicopter or any type of aircraft but it was silent. I used my bonoculars to see it and it appeared to be rectangular in shape and had what looked like arms or legs with lights from the bottom and a dome type of shape on the top. After looking at it for a few minutes all the lights shut of and I could no longer see it but after a few minutes the lights came back on and I observed it for about 10 minutes and went inside for the night,
On todays date 06/16/2023 at about 10:00PM The object appeared again and I had my girlfriend look at it and she confirmed what I saw.

summary: Round multi-colored object about 2,000 ft up
description: It had just turned night. Riding in SUV. To the south, at about 2,000 ft; noticed a large round object, made up of smaller red, white, blue round parts . Appeared to be 3-4 miles away. Was very clear and sharp; clear skies.

summary: It was shiny in the sky so I snapped a pic of it, but when you zoom in, it's not a plane.
description: Saw this in the sky from my deck off of my kitchen. It was just shiny, so I snapped a pic and when I zoom in, it's not a plane.

summary: A hollow square structure white in colour Ca. 100m AGL
description:
An object Ca. 100-150m AGL was observed heading steadily on a SW course directly above High Street, Kelvedon.
The object was an open square and brilliant white in colour. Its bearing remained constant when in sight of the observer.

summary: Chevron surrounded by a clear bubble around it with a mist swirling and trailing a short distance behind it st
description: I worked as a airport fireman for 30 years at a large airport, know aircraft. Daytime sighting,no noise, traveling north below scattered clouds. No drugs or alcohol. I know of no aircraft that flies inside a bubble that looks like a Chevron

summary: At 15 min before landing I clearly saw a spherical metal object flying against the plane direction i was fast at least 5 seconds
description: I was trying to look through the plane window at San Francisco bay.   A few minutes to land and I saw clearly a sphere metallic object flying against our direction.   It was 5 seconds at least. It was fast.   I have never seen something like this, I'm not sure what was that .

summary: A small very shiny hovering object
description: I was driving on or 62 in white city Oregon and I saw something that was hovering over the vehicles ahead of me and it was making it's was towards my vehicle. It was not traveling in a straight line, rather it fluttered around like a fly would. This thing was changing shape as it traveled and was so reflective i can't describe it because i have never seen something that perfect. It had no lines or real shape as ever time I let my eyes off it for a second it changed a bit. I stopped to get my phone out and 2 seconds later it was gone.

summary: Silent brightly lit triangle object
description:
I was drinking coffee on my deck at approx 4:30 am when I saw a triangular shaped craft slowly approaching from the east. Memphis airport is 12 miles east of my home so I’m used to seeing jets every morning. However this object had colored lights above and brightly lit white light covering the entire bottom. It made no noise at all. It was traveling directly over head at approximately 300 feet. It was very low. It took approximately 3 minutes from sighting to be out of my view. It did not stop and hover but kept going in a north east direction slowly.
It was not huge triangle but about the size of a Cessna 10 seater. There was no sound at all.

summary: My husband and I witnessed and videoed many unidentified flying objects in the sky with flashing lights of different colours
description:
We counted 15+ flying objects with lights flashing red and green and sometimes stopping in the sky and flashing white. They flew in and out of our viewing window and up and down and stopped unexpectedly. 3 of them at one point flew in a triangular formation and started blinking simultaneously. We videoed some of them with our iPhone
At times it looked like the object behind the lights was somewhat much bigger than we could see clearly, cloaked in some way. It’s hard to explain but they were certainly not planes nor drones.
A few of them seemed to appear suddenly on our left.
All of the flying objects were moving inland/north (we leave on the coast)

location: Cleethorpes, North East Lincolnshire, United Kingdom
summary: Strange super fast moving orb.
description: Very clear summer night with great visability of the night sky. Could see all stars overhead. Object was really high up, well above the altitude of comercial passenger jets or military aircraft. Object travelled from west to east, was not the ISS(as checked ISS tracker) and was not as bright as the ISS. Viewed the ISS many, many times from my location and can normally have very bright visual contact for around three to four minutes. There were no flashing lights to indicate an aircraft of any sort. No sound or sonic boom(which I would expect from something moving many times faster than the speed of sound.) It disappeared before entering the Earth's shadow. It was directly overhead. There was no trail to indicate a merteorite burning up. It seemed impossible for something to travel so fast given the altitude. If an aircraft passes near our location we can normally hear it after it has passed. It was my 19yr old Son and I that witnessed the object. Also, last summer, the two of us(my Son and I) witnessed another object travelling really, really fast fly overhead and made a very sharp 90 degree angular turn which defied everything I know about physics and the capabilities of aircraft…

summary: Sightings over the last year or more.
description: About a year ago or there about, I started seeing these lights in the sky, all of red, green and blue color and I seen as many as 9 at a time as far as down to 2 at a time, and not all in the same part of the sky. I've seen many, many satellites and that is not what they were, there is not that many in the sky at the same time and everyone knows what stars look like, and it's not stars. I've watched them for over a year now, they are not airplanes, when they move they are to slow for planes, and they don't always move. Well a few nights ago about the beginning of the week, I used a green laser light and shined toward them, and just after I did, I seen one appear in the middle of the sky out of nowhere, I kind of laughed it off, but did think it was odd, so the next night I tried it again, twice and after each flash I saw more, so Thursday night I did it again, and I only saw one, well when I came back in the house I was walking from the kitchen to the living room, and all of a sudden I heard this really loud, loud whirling sound and I thought what the hell is that and I ran back out to the deck and not to far above the tree tops, I seen one of the objects shoot through the sky, I…

summary: Massive and loud aircraft sped unusually close to residential neighborhood, spotlight searching from the fore.
description: At approximately 2241, on the night of June the 14th, 2023, my significant-other and I stepped out to our front porch to smoke and within the span of just one or two minutes, heard and witnessed the speedy passage of a massive craft. We thought at first, due to the sheer apparent distance between guide-lights, that it was two helicopters flying with something suspended betwixt them. However I believe the lights we saw were too coordinated in their movements to indicate anything but a single craft. Visibility was however, low due to the streetlamp opposite the house. I could just vaguely make out the outline of the craft. As it appeared to me it seemed very like a submarine or zeppelin. I'd wager it was prop driven, given the sound. It approached from the South, approximately heading Northward, with a spotlight beaming down from the fore. Given the search-light I was hesitant to try to take a photograph, let alone the poor visibility and my potato-phone.

summary: Bright flickering light…nothing…object appears..disappears.
description: Driving home from work. 4:15pm. Clear blue sky. No clouds. See shining orb type light. Then starts to flicker. Thought just the sun reflecting off a plane. Then the light got bigger and started flickering. Then got even a bit larger, then reduced in size from the outside inward.Then vanished,nothing there. No plane to be seen. While trying to not run off the road, I looked where the light was, then it appeared. A rectangular shaped object, angled on the ends. Silver with both ends a gold color. Then in shock of what I am seeing, it then disappeared. But this is where it gets freaky. The object vanished not by flying away. This thing disappeared from one side to the other. While remaining stationary, it vanished from right to left. Like erasing a line on a chalk board with an eraser. This thing turned invisible while I was looking at it. Gave me the chills. I still look up in the sky now when driving on clear days. I would love to get a video of this. But this whole ordeal was only about 30 seconds or more, and I was driving. I now know, 100%, I saw an aircraft that is not from this planet. Have yet to tell anyone.

summary: Black rectangular UAP sighted
description: My family and I were driving from St George, UT to Mesa, AZ. We were on the US-93 highway when I noticed a black rectangular object out of my front windshield flying over my car about 400-500 ft above it. It "flew" over my car and towards the right and I screamed out to my family to check out what it was. My two sons in the backseat saw it and tried to take a picture but they said it slightly expanded and then just disappeared. It made no noise as far as we know and had no markings or lights. There were no wings or propellers.

summary: This subjects would form in different patterns triangle verticals horizontally.
description: My supervisor is the one that saw the objects first than he told me to look up and see if I could describe what it was. So I grabbed my phone and started recording to zoom in. I did see the 3 objects moving in different patterns. When I went back to my video I noticed that in some parts my phone was recording the floor and I perfectly remember that my phone was not facing the floor at all but on the video it shows that I did. That was very scary and strange to me.

location: Brockton right above RT 24, MA, USA
summary: Driving to work and a small silver object hovering above the highway and I was able to get a picture
description: Need to zoom into photo to see the small silver pointy thing floating above highway

summary: A star that turned off...
description: It was about 1am and I went outside to smoke on the terrace in the garden. From the back of the house there’s nothing but meadows a river and lakes and at night it’s really dark as there’s no street lights etc as it’s extremely rural. I turned the outside light on and was smoking, and about 2mins into smoking I look directly above me / up at the stars, and one was much brighter (about 30%) than all the others. Like a white blue colour. As I was looking at it, it turned off like. It was switched off. The light (shrank) minimalized inwards and turned off, so I looked down and thought “huh that doesn’t normally happen” then looked back and it was in a different place in the sky. Same area, but not where it was before. Same light intensity, same brightest star. Then it turned off again in the same way. When it did, this horseshoes shaped spiral, light trace, in an amber colour, like light trail, flash up and then faded. I then looked straight ahead, not understanding what I just saw and over the fields / horizon I saw a shooting star, but not as bright and much faster shoot from my left to right away from me over the fields and over the horizon then fade away.

summary: Low, slow flying dark gray rectangle with flashing lights headed north east over I-69
description: Checking horses before headed in for the night, my 9 year old son began screaming about lights in the sky that were blinking. I went out of the barn and looked up to see a VERY slow and low flying rectangle shaped object. The lights along the bottom were in a line, bright LED white, and illuminating the bottom. Bottom appeared to be dark gray. Husband, a Navy Vet, came out because of the yelling and saw the object as it crossed over our property to the adjacent property and passed by/over a radio tower and continued north east over I-69 and towards Angola and the Indiana/Ohio/Michigan border. 100% WAS NOT STARLINK, we've seen that several times and this was way way way lower, brighter, and had body to it. Husband estimates it was flying at maybe 20,000 feet. The dogs and horses have been EXTREMELY agitated since the sighting, especially the broodmare that has a foal at her side.

summary: Bright lights in sky below aircraft then quickly faded to nothing - vanished
description: We were driving home we turned on to Benet from 76 right above the hills on the camp pendelton line we saw a line of bright lights lower then aircraft flow. as soon as we looked up to it we could hold our gaze to it for maybe 2 minutes - then it vanished.

summary: Looked like a big planet dark orange or yellow with a very large trail behind. the trail was perfectly rectangular and glowing orange
description: My roommate went out to walk his dog and called me on my phone to tell me to go outside and look at something in the sky. At first it looked like an asteroid was coming to hit earth then i realized it was going away from us. It looked like a planet like mars or jupiter but it was much bigger and traveling very fast. I could see airplanes in the night sky and compared to them it was traveling much faster. It had a huge perfectly square or rectangular trail behind it that was glowing orange with these weird 90 degree swirls inside the trail that were also glowing dark orange. I asked my roommate how long he was looking at it and he said a minute or two but it had started in a completely different area in the sky than it was when i was looking at it. He said it had changed directions and thats why he called me to come look at it. I tried looking up meteor showers or anything like that in my area and couldnt find anything. I am usually someone who wouldnt believe in UFOs or anything like that but this was just so strange. The size of the trail and how it was so perfectly straight and square with those shapes in the trail i just cant wrap my mind around. My roommate tried to record a…

summary: It was a circle in my opinion, it had colors on it and under it and it had headlights with no sounds and did not move.
description:
I was driving home from being on the road for a few days for work. Me and my husband were in the truck together at the time. We turned down Brookfield Road and we were discussing a restaurant at the time. As we turned onto Wisconsin Avenue, and approached our home, near on 183rd I looked up and I see a colorful object far up in the sky. The second I saw the object in the sky I said to myself that it didn't look like anything I had ever seen.  It was up very far but I still could see it clearly.
I then asked my husband "what am I looking at"? He looked at me and saw me looking up and then he nudged his glasses to his nose and said, "a UFO"! He had a look of shock on his face.
I then had a small panic. I said pull over, park, get out of the road. Because there was a vehicle right behind us. While I looked in the side view mirror and told him to get out of the road and then look back up it went up and disappeared.
My husband then parked and we walked back to the corner or the parking lot and it was totally gone.
The object had lots colors on it and it was circular in shape, it had also had headlights pointing to the northwest of where I seen it at. It was surrounded with clouds.
I…

summary: We first saw the object in the sky and thought it was a star or planet until it moved positions.
description: The object moved positions in the sky and seemed to change shape. We took photos with a cell phone with Space Zoom. It was really bright and seemed to emit an aura.

summary: We were in our garden looking at birds flying above when a small round ball went across our line of view in a cloudless sky.   This was not an aircraft, this was strange.

location: London, Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, United Kingdom
summary: Saw white-ish object in the sky at Brompton Cemetery, London - found 2nd object later in my photos that I didn't see earlier.
description:
I was walking my dog in Brompton Cemetery (Earls Court, London, UK) when I heard a helicopter fly by (I see one almost every time I go there because the cemetery is across the street from a police HQ center). When it passed, I noticed something floating in the sky. At first I thought it was something hanging from the tree...like a bug...because it was very still and there was a tree over my head...but then it started moving from left to right very slowly.
I could not tell if it was white or shiny silver....the color seemed to be a mix at times. Could have been changing colors? Or it could have beena reflection due to the sun?
I looked down to grab my phone and when I looked up it was gone. I turned my phone on and looked up again and it was there again but looked like it stalled? It either moved very slowly or was not moving at all. I am not sure if I kept losing sight of it because it was bright outside? Took two photos and then I looked at my phone to switch it to video. When I looked back up it was gone and I didn't see it again.
Well, I thought I saw it a few minutes later but it was way too far away and in the opposite direction so I might have been imaging it? There were…
region: London, Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea

summary: Freely rotating tic-tac shaped metallic, reflective object that suddenly disappeared
description: I live on the 12th floor of an apartment building in Brooklyn. I saw something that I initially thought was a balloon and captured it on video. It was a metallic, reflective, dark grey tic tac shaped object about 5 feet long and approximately 1000-2000 feet away. I looked away for 5-10 seconds and it was gone. It would have to have moved 100s of miles per hour to disappear from my field of view in the time that I looked away.

summary: UAP seen over metropolitan Beijing night sky, shot from several locations
description: This UAP was seen from several locations throughout Beijing and on social media was supposedly also seen in the neighboring province. I have 7 different videos and 30+ confirmed witnesses.

summary: 3 bright lights in very large triangle formation. All moving together as one, heading North. Then they started to separate.
description: I was taking my dog for his nightly walk when I saw a plane. The plane still had its landing lights on, and looked kind of cool in the night sky. While watching it I saw what I originally thought was stars in a perfect triangle formation. The plane was starting to go behind some trees so I turned my attention back to what I thought was stars. As I was watching I noticed that they were actually moving in a northern direction. The most northern one then seemed to speed up and split from the other two. It quickly disappeared. As I focused on the other two, the one towards the east shot off in that direction, and the final one appeared to fade out. They appeared to be much higher than the plane, and spread out a great distance. While it's likely just a strange coincidence, I had turned off my headlamp to watch the plane. After the plane and objects left I went to turn my headlamp back on and the batteries were dead.

summary: Slowly flying towards ground, did a forward roll then disappeared into trees.
description:
-Looked like a flying car
-headlights
-horizontal shape
-red lights
-was heading into trees
-did a roll

summary: Walking dog looked up observed a very bright white double line
description: While walking dog for nightly constitutional was headed home looked up and observed a very bright white broken double line moving at an extremely high speed from west to east in the sky. If not for the illumination I would say the object resembled a con trail from a jet aircraft. In the time it took me to enter the house scream at my wife to come look at it and go back outside it was already reaching the east horizon line. The object must have been very large aand it was at about 20 to 30 thousand feet in the air about the same height as as normal flight pattern for commercial aircraft. No engine noise or sonic boom was heard. Never seen anything fly that fast and it was gone before i could even get my phone to try to photograph it. The speed had to be incredible due to the distance that was covered in such a short period of time. Quite exciting only wish I could have got a photo for you.

summary: Several lights in a row
description: Lots of lights flying in a row. Like a large space ship.

summary: String of object(s) was 15 miles out and 2 miles up, moving west to east then headed north where only the tail end showed.
description: Object looked like a string of lights at least 15 miles out and 2 miles up. Object(s) moving west to east then headed north and the string of lights ended as only the back of the line was showing and then disappeared.

summary: horizontal row of about 10 white lights appeared to grow larger as it moved closer towards me and smaller as it moved away
description: June 12, 2023 from about 10:42 pm to about 10:44 pm, I was outside my house burning trash, I saw a horizontal row of about 10 white lights North West of my position. The lights appeared to be about 200 feet in the air, then lower as it approached, then higher as it moved away. It appeared to be about 100 feet wide. I did not count the lights because I quickly went to my house to get a video camera to verify the object. All of the lights were evenly spaced except the lights at each end were spaced slightly further apart than the rest of the lights. The row of lights was moving South towards me and appeared to grow larger and move lower as it approached. I retrieved my video camera from the house and as I returned outside with my video camera the lights moved higher and towards the East. As I pointed the video camera toward the lights, the lights dimmed as it was moving away from me. I was unsuccessful at obtaining video. The lights were mostly horizontal but did change orientation tilting slightly as it moved. The lights moved together and spacing of the lights did not change as it moved, except it appeared larger as it approached and then smaller as it moved away. There was no…

summary: One perfectly straight line of lights. It was moving together very slowly. It did not appear to be Starlink.
description: It lasted almost 2 minutes. It was silent. It was moving very slowly. I immediately called channel 4 News in Washington DC they said they had another report of the same. I then contacted Loudoun county non-emergency and they told me to contact the FAA. I tried contacting the FAA to no avail.

summary: Large (carrier size snd up) craft passed overhead
description: We saw what we first thought was a jet with a glowing contrail. Contrail got brighter so not a contrail. Then i thought space debris. But everything maintained form. Had twin rows of bright lights with duller fuzzy light in between. As it passed overhead it had a fuzzy form to it. Do not have a clue on speed and size since do know altitude. But carrier size and jet speed would be smallest and slowest

summary: Disk or octagon shaped craft traveled over home
description: 1st I noticed a strange sound. Almost light a hum that seemed to come from the ground. I live near an airstrip so I am familiar with plane and chopper sounds. This was neither. You can also tell when its coming from above. I did not see the craft until it was above me. It was just above the trees and it had 2 large white lights, somewhat close together on the underside. One blinking and 1 steady. They were the only ones. I tried to see the shape but even though it was a clear night, it was hard to tell. When the light blinked it looked fuzzy, like the reflection from a cloud. Kinda pearly color. From the flashing I would estimate 25-30 ft across but couldn't see the edges to be sure. The other thing that was so odd was that it was moving slow... too slow for a plane. My dog looked at it as well. I watched it as it kept moving towards the olympic mountains, trying to come up with a logical explanation . I was never afraid but can't sleep and get it out of my mind. My parents and I saw 3 ufos about 55 yrs ago as well. Investigator can contact me if they want but not necessary.

summary: Linear pattern of 30 or more lights
description: My spouse and I saw a linear pattern of lights moving slowly over Bellingham, WA for about 30 seconds. It was a large structure and the lights appeared to be almost like large bay windows with light shining out. Honestly, it reminded me of a fleet ship from Star Wars as odd as that sounds.

summary: UAP seen less the 100ft off ground shaped like a cigar shaped harmonica
description: UAP approached our camp sight, coming up over the 40ft barrier of rocks; it seem to hover 20 plus ft above rocks for a 30 seconds or so, seeming to rotate or change direction, then is shot off faster then any known military aircraft. It had rectanglular segments that seem to create a belt around the craft of low glow white or gray lights, and two more distinct lights (that seemed to be headlights). The UAP was silent, and seemed to create a noise reaction because all the insects went silent during the sighting and then went back to normal as soon as UAP zipped off. The UAP appeared to be gray in color and devoid of any mechanical sound or sound at all.

summary: I was viewing this on my outdoor security camera in Night Vision
description: I have a lot of anomalous activity on my security camera I have set up facing west on my back patio. I decided to view it a little after 10:00 PM MST. I noticed this long cylindrical object and hit record. It is traveling from the west very slowly toward the east. I was a bit shocked at what I was seeing so I did not have the presence of mind to switch the night vision off to see if it was visible without it. I did capture a still photo. In Night Vision the object seemed to be illuminated the entire length. As it was about to exit the frame a small blinking light (a small plane probably) passed it going the opposite direction. It can be seen in the video. A few insects and orbs are flying around ( there are a lot of orbs usually but we haven't had swarms of insects, just a few) There of course are cars causing some lens flares but this is not what I an reporting, I am aware of these types of camera anomalies. I was in my gown and in bed so I did not get up and run outside I just watched it on my WYZE phone app.

summary: We were backpacking in the desert in the needles district of Canyonlands
description: Me and someone else had been at our campsite in Canyonlands for a couple of hours and it had been dark for around one hour. We were taking pictures of the stars (with all headlamps and flashlights out) around 10 feet from our tent. We both saw a bright orange light through thin tree branches, we looked at it for a few seconds and decided to get a better look because we were both intrigued. We moved around the tree and it was gone. We went back to the same spot we saw it but it was gone. The light from our point of view was a half inch in diameter but we had no idea how far away it was. We went to bed. The next morning, we tried to find where it came from. Behind our campsite (where the light came from) was a small canyon that was impassable due to giant rocks. Our best bet on where the light came from was whether it was 15 or so feet from us or a couple of miles or more on top of a rock formation around a hundred feet tall, definitely not possible for a human to get to or probably all ground animals. It was at Chesler Park in Canyonlands.

summary: Light bar was the length of a football field. Width was slender. (Similar to a huge measuring ruler). Long rectangular in shape/bright.
description: Definitely not a Starlink satellite. This object was similar to a light bar the size of a football field and width was slender. Similar to a huge jeep/truck light bar or measuring ruler with bright lights that looked like perfect squares put together. Lights were not separated like Starlink. While camping at Pinetop, Arizona near Show Low at the Blue Ridge Trailhead at approximately 9:30 p.m. on 06/12/23, this craft moved from west to east at approximately 3000 feet above the ground and faded away after 2 minutes of viewing it. No sound at all.

summary: Bright white orb moving southwest with a white tail and green flares.
description: Bright white orb moving from Northeast to Southwest for 5-8 seconds. The tail was white with green coming off the object as it flew through the sky. No indication of meteors or comets in the area.

summary: Saw a blue light on top of the cloud cover. It was moving erratically left and right and up and down quickly
description: We were standing outside. I looked up at the sk. Halfof it was covered in clouds. On top of the clouds suddenly appeared a blue light. It came out of nowhere and seem to fly towards us. Then it stopped. Then it moved quickly to the left. And then it moved straight down quickly. And then it disappeared. About a minute later it returned. Same erratic movements back-and-forth and up and down quickly. And then it disappeared.

summary: object floating in sky for around an hour
description:
this object was sitting in the same exact spot in the sky for a little over an hour.
this object was shaped like a disk and made no noise.
this object didn’t move it stayed in the same spot.
didn’t have legs or a motor or anything it was just a black disk.

summary: Black equilateral triangle daytime
description: In a car waiting for a stop light. High in the sky was a Black equilateral triangle object lurking in a cloud. Saw it in a separation within the cloud. Partially cloudy day and sunny. Clouds at the time seemed to be mid level between 26,000 ft and 31,000 ft. Not a meteorologist just what I can guess from conditions at the time. The object was at the same level or slightly above. Object was a perfect triangle 60°x60x60 with no clear visible lights or markings; being that high up in the sky, there could have been. Based on altitude and how identified objects look like from the ground; estimated size was at least 1 1/2 times that of a Boeing 747. Object appeared motionless

summary: Clear skies, then a Bright flash of light, followed by silver craft that near instantly went upwards into space.
description:
Clear blue skies and windy day at gulf islands National trail in Pensacola Beach, 8-10 miles past the city, 2 miles past portifino hotel.
Watching the clear skies and tops of trees, facing south easterly. Location near old abandoned fishery near the bay side of the trail. A large bright flash of light appeared. 7 miles away over the gulf waters from my location. The light was as bright as the sun, but the size of a coin in my hand with my arm extended. After the light, a teardrop shaped silver craft hovered for no more than 8 seconds and then flew straight up into space. Faster than any jet or craft I have seen. (Home of the Blue Angels.)
There was no sounds, and a few minutes afterwords a military plane flew by and then commercial and private airplanes. This happened around 2:36PM to 3:15PM estimated time frame.

summary: Floating possibly propelled object.
description: I was watching two f35 practicing over my property, when I saw what I had thought was one of them just floating, not flying. I thought this was strange so I started videoing with my phone and found that it was not a plane. When I reviewed video and zoomed in it appears to be some sort of zeppelin with propeller. As the video shows , it was flying erratically or being pushed by the wind. It appears to be rotating.

summary: A green blue triangle hovered near my home by my truck for 25-30 seconds. Didn't make a sound but felt something inside my bones.
description: I don't know how to say this but I felt something inside me and saw things. Went to my window and a green blueish triangle was above my truck maybe a 100 feet. Right above the trees. Left less than a minute after. But still have what I think they were trying to tell me.

summary: Actually, had three sightings. Daughter told me what she saw I came outside and then I saw it too. I tried to take pic, too fast
description: It was a spherical, very shiny, very bright, metallic, looking object. That’s what caught your attention, the fact that it was very shiny and bright even though we could tell it was very far away as fast as she could grab a Phone it disappeared. She alerted me to the object so I went outside and didn’t see anything for several minutes and then there it was we both saw it very quickly. It was not moving. It was stationary and then boom it was gone! I suppose it could have been a meeting, a light making it so shiny, but it appeared more metallic, than lit.

summary: We saw a bright light in the sky. Got Binocs. Looked like a flat panel like thing that was moving.
description:
Seen in evening, full sun. The object was not visible unless object was reflecting sunlight. It seemed there were flat, panel like objects that were synchronously moving, reflecting light. The period was not regular, but not totally random.
There were colors- green and red, but not constantly lit like nav lights.
It was moving slowly.
Object was first noticed at approximately 100° magnetic. Object was last viewed 117° magnetic from the intersection of Kelso Rd and Shalimar Dr. 25.8 degrees up (approx) measured from a smart phone level.
A commercial aircraft looked like it passed above it. The UFO was about half way between the aircraft and the ground. The aircraft was possibly Alaska Air flight 798 (info from flightaware app).
I have video (poor quality) with GPS tag. I attached screenshots and a screenshot with the date, time, and location of the picture.

location: Ryton on Dunsmore, Warwickshire, United Kingdom

He saw a craft which was spinning, tilting and seemed to have a hole in the middle. He went upstairs to find binoculars. When he returned it had gone. He went upstairs again and then saw 6 or 7 white dots much further away dancing around. He said none were birds or aeroplanes .
Did anyone else see them?

summary: Shiny aluminum type in the sky

From my viewpoint what I saw could be described as a piece of aluminum foil rotating, and it was shiny from all angles. I tried to get some teams to look at it, and they couldn’t see it initially. At that point an airplane flew by and perspective, they could see what I was referring to. It continued to stay there for another three more minutes until it kind of just like a light switch went off and just disappeared.

summary: Object that from distance looked like clouds rising, meeting in air, ascending, descending traveling is straight lines
description: These Objects were noted from a distance as small clouds, but when they came closer, and one of them actually landed in front of us, they looked like masses of bubbles, very dense bubbles with a denser nucleus. My friend who directly observed them first, stuck his hand in to one, he stated it was like bubbles but not, he couldn't pop them and they seperated from his hand, went straight up in the air, descened onto a driveway 10 feet away. Changed shape into something that looked like a small dog looking up into the sky. It then glided straight down the driveway 8 feet or so, then made a hard right perfect turn and started down the sidewalk about 20ft or so. It then puffed up and went straight up in the air, flew into the branches of the tree, moved around in the branches and came out the right side even larger and coalescing, it sparkled but not on the surface as of the sun, from the inside. It then flew straight over the house(with the driveway stated earlier) and descended upon the house, changed into a cone shape and developed what could only be described as wings flapping. We then had to leave and go back to the Church, when we left this on object was still there and many more…

summary: V shaped craft with 5-7 diffused lights. Directly overhead, flying low, traveling from west to east. Silent and fast
description: We were in the backyard at my cousin’s, celebrating his birthday. I wandered away from the porch to look at the stars. I was looking straight up, facing the southern sky and noticed a very faint, bluish white light. It looked as if someone was pointing a flashlight through fog, but the sky was clear of any clouds. As my eyes focused and adjusted, I saw more of the same lights. They were all in a V formation like the way geese fly. The lights appeared to fall in and out of sync ever so slightly, which made me think it might have been multiple craft. This all took place within a matter of seconds. I was stunned and couldn’t believe what I was seeing. The only thing I could do was mutter an expletive to myself. As it passed over the house, out of my line of sight, I ran to the opposite end of the backyard to see if I could follow it again, but it was gone. I returned to the group and told them what I saw.

summary: We were followed by this craft until we went to it and made contact

The light began to flash and 6 other objects began flashing red with it in the vicinity. Then I watched the ufo turn its light off and back into the sky blending in. As it got later we continued to follow this object to a dark area where we then seen a light hovering behind the trees, we continued to to approach this location that we were being drawn to. Once we stopped that’s when it happened, we made contact. We could feel their presence all around us and could see the silhouettes standing there. We initiated contact with them and they touched us to let us know they were there. We then looked up and seen a craft fly right over heads slowly letting us know they were there. Also, there were other crafts flying in a bouncing motion in the area. In conclusion, we had seen over 6 alien crafts and made contact with these beings who brought us to the forest.

summary: Silver Orb/Balloon Passing Aircraft around 5,000 feet MSL near Fort Liberty/Fort Bragg June 10th, 2023 3:17pm local
description:
My passenger and I saw a silver orb (possible balloon) with small flat edges (not a perfect circle) while flying northbound at 5,000 feet msl at ~135 knots (ground speed). The object appeared in front of the airplane on the left side and traveled pass the left side slightly lower at perhaps 4,500 to 4,800 feet msl. Perhaps the object was 200 to 3,000 feet from my left wing.
The object appeared near the western edge of the Fort Bragg/Fort Liberty Restricted -5311 airspace.
The object was reported to Fayetteville Approach in the air shortly after the sighting. Also, video/digital evidence was provided to an FAA (Fayetteville approach) employee after landing. As of this post on June 13th 2023, there has been no follow up questions.
Either the object was either small (weather) balloon perhaps extremely nearby (possibly stationary) or a larger object, further away traveling in the opposite direction… hard to tell without a known size of the object… perhaps someone can calculate possible speeds and sizes based on the aircraft’s information, my estimates, and the object relative to the relative ground reference in the video.
I’m withholding the tail number of the aircraft unless someone…

summary: See attached
description:
Date – June 10, 2023
First, I heard loud helicopter rotors
The sound was coming from North of my location, very loud.
I noticed the Blackhawk first and then as it banked to the right around the UAP I noticed the ORB
It was over the mountains at about 5000 feet in elevation
After the Blackhawk flew about halfway around the object the ORB began to rise fairly slowly at first and then disappeared straight up.
The Blackhawk stayed around for 10-15 minutes, apparently still looking for the ORB and then flew south.
The ORB was not particularly large, about the same diameter as the fuselage of the helicopter. It was very reflective, metallic, it almost looked like it was chrome.
I called the Oro Valley police, they declined to take a report

I call my wife and tell her just drop whatever you're doing and get out here as quick as you can. She is by my side now and the lighted object is slowly coming towards us like it's zeroed in on us. I finally get my phone that takes amazing pics at night to take a picture of it. I had my stupid flash on and it like spooked it and took off. I hurriedly turn it off and take another pic. It quickly disappeared into the far horizon sky. You could see the light still as far as the eye could see. We both exclaimed at the same time WHOA, now that was weird!! I was kicking myself for not taking any video but if you zoom in on the original photo around the bright light that looks like thrusters, you can see a circular shaped object lined with small circular lights.

By then I had gotten the attention of 3 mechanics I knew to ask if they saw what I did, which they did. They pulled out their phones and tried taking video but could only get still-photos of it. After another minute or so it stopped and remained completely still. The mechanics called over another 2 people to ask what they thought it was. The 2 jet fighters stopped making a race track pattern and came around together low and fast from the south towards the object. Before the jets made it to about 500 meters away from , the object shot like a bullet to the west parallel to the ground. It moved so quick that it would have looked like it just disappeared if we had not been watching it.
