(it never truly went full dark) There was aircraft in the field of view that were easily discernable travelling much more east to west or vice versa. I thought maybe i was lucky enough to observe an astrological event close enough to earth that the effects would be visible to the naked eye. Then i noticed it was moving. It seemed to be moving perfectly in alignment with true north. If this object was in our atmosphere, as i watched it travel further away before disappearing into the horizon, then the rate of speed would be totally feasible by current…

Then I realized the star on the left was actually moving. Slowly, it drifted down, diagonally to the left, and then it disappeared completely. I kept watching, trying to figure out if a cloud had obscured it, or if it had really vanished, noting that the star on the right remained entirely visible. The left star reappeared in different spot, slightly above and to the left of the last position. It did not move, but the light from it seemed to pulse/flicker. It stayed in that position for a few seconds, and then disappeared again. The star on the right remained static. In a few seconds, the left star reappeared, this time, much less bright and smaller, as if it had quickly traveled away from me to the East, it seemed. Its position had lowered to about the midpoint of the other two positions. I lost it soon after because it blended in with the other stars at that point. All of the different positions…

I work as a professional photo editor. I know camera artifacts. This is no camera artifact.

My radio also received static. I am concerned because I live near a military base and this thing was very close to it. This is no joke my cell phone number is (deleted). Please do something with this information, it scared the shit out of me.

summary: Bright plasma, light in the sky while driving down the highway
description: Bright blue green plasma, colored lights, in the sky while driving down I 94 east in between Paw paw, Michigan and Matawan Michigan. Lights were dimming then getting bright, then flickering, then getting bright then staying bright. Looked like lightning that lit the sky up longer than normal. The color of it was very odd. I’ve never seen the sky that color before and the closest thing I can compare to it is lightning, but it was way different.

summary: It was triangular, white, glowing, and soundless
description: The shape of the craft was triangular diamond shaped that had sharp edges. It was white, glowing, and soundless. It stayed the exacted speed with the exact height for the duration of its travel. It wasn’t going fast or slow maybe like 5-10 mph. The motion of it was unusual it was gliding but unnatural. Certainly something I haven’t seen before. We were in the pool swimming when I looked up and it emerge from the house and flew across to the end of garage then disappeared. It was a residential neighborhood near Lake Erie.

summary: Not of human origin

summary: Object was morphing and pulsating.
description:
Latitude - Longitude 48.41050, - 122.30815
UFO/UAP
06/01/23
10:30 pm
I was looking north, it was heading east, from over the ocean
I have been watching a low traveling, morphing, bright light through my high powered binoculars. It was heading north east from me and low in the sky.
It first appeared oval, but then it became perfectly round.
Its bright orange gold light, changed from lighter to darker.
It also had black dots or holes that moved across it changing directions and sizes, like boiling liquid.
I first saw it in the shape of a circle. It was pulsating and shining very bright then darker colored gold and orange.
Then it would change position and just looked like a flat golden pancake.
It maneuvered again and I only saw a dark sliver of it.
But, on the outsides of the dark sliver, it was still bright gold.
It appeared at first to be flying up right, and now it was flying on its side.
Then back to flying upright. Pulsating with those black holes moving continuously.
Very active and appeared to be always pulsating and changing its shape. It kept dropping lower and was heading west. Towards Mount Baker.

summary: We saw two hovering things we first thought were lights from a while away

She stopped to look when I said there was a second one and then they sped off. One went in the direction of a field and the other I don't know. summary: I was sitting on steps when a strange red/blue object zoomed by and hovered before changing shape and color and quickly heading east.
description: The object looked like a multicolored , shapeless...thing which shined almost as if were reflecting against the night sky, When first spotted it was red and blue before putting on a light show and changing from green yellow and red, as well as a teal like color, it was really quite beautiful. it hovered in place and zoomed around at very fast speed, dipping beneath the tree line at times, after a while it just flew eastward at high speed. Sadly I was drinking at the time of seeing this so my memory will be effected. but included are some videos of the object (Please excuse my language/behavior in the videos as stated before I was excited by what I was seeing and had consumed several beers.) The main reason I decided to report this was due to the congressional UAP hearings and the Las Vegas incident that happened around the same time, which somewhat resembled what I had seen. I seen the object again about a week or so later but it didn't act as strange and the sighting lasted only a couple of minutes

summary: Star gazing in my backyard, notices an orb closer than a satellite would be
description:
5/31 8:49 While looking up at the stars I noticed an image moving across the sky that I thought was a satellite. It seemed lower and to be moving faster than satellites I've seen in the past. After observing it for maybe 30 seconds as it moved west to east, it mad a sharp turn (not quite 90°) and proceeded North east and it seemed to speed up.
The following night (6/1) I was outside with my dogs at 8:01 PM I captured an image of an orb moving in the same general direction. I had time to notify my wife and she observed it to with the naked eye. This time it didn't turn on an angle but rather kept on the same path, west to east. It was in view for just over a minute and as I was simultaneously recording on my phone and watching with the naked eye, it suddenly disappeared. I had it locked in on the recording and it wasn't really dimming or fading away. It just disappeared. I had convinced myself it was a floating latern but after showing others and examining and comparing images, I'm not so sure.

Then I saw flashing white lights. It was a sunny day with zero clouds. I thought hmm, maybe they are blimps and the light is just a reflection when it moves.
When I pulled into my driveway, I threw it in park and quickly recorded what I saw.

summary: A round object that didn't move in one spot.
description:
I have to share with you guys what I saw in the sky on the way home from work in Bozeman, Montana in the morning of June 2nd, Thursday. It was around 5:45am in the morning. I thought I saw UFO. A little shiny metall round or something that didn't move, just still in one spot. Color...grey or silver that looks like dark shiny metal or something. FYI, I am a deaf paranormal investigator.

At times becoming faint then becoming clear. I followed it too see it flash a second time then quickly it had travelled past the point where I was unable to see this portion of the sky due to the way my building is faced.

summary: I was lying down, studying for an exam, and I saw through the window a large ball of blue and white light that was flying at a low altitude.
description:
I was lying down studying, and next to my bed, I have a window. Out of nowhere, the UFO appeared. It was something similar to a ball of energy about the size of a car or even larger. It flew in a straight line at a low altitude, about 40 or 50 meters from the ground.
It had a color mixed between blue and white and seemed like something out of a movie. I didn't hear any noise of turbines, nor helicopter, nor drone. I don't think it was something from this planet.
After what I saw, I went outside my house and climbed onto the roof, and nothing was visible, just the starry sky. There were no clouds, there was no wind.
I don't believe it was something from this planet; it could be a meteorite that entered the atmosphere and disintegrated, or it was something much more complex. During the day, I didn't drink alcohol and didn't consume any kind of substance that could cause hallucinations. Nothing like this has ever happened to me before.

Estaba acostado estudiando y al lado de mi cama tengo una ventana, de la nada apareció el…

summary: Two extremely large triangle objects moving in the air from southwest to northeast
description: The two triangle shaped objects were extremely large, were glowing bright white, made no sound, moving so close together that it looked like they could have been touching. They were moving at a speed faster than anything ever seen in comparison (planes, helicopters, satellites). After watching the objects for approximately 10 seconds, they both simply vanished. There was no trace, to trail, nothing in sight any longer. We had a clear and unobstructed view of the sky with no clouds and no wind. Both objects vanished in the middle of the sky. Both of us that observed this are law enforcement officers

summary: Large bright red fireball/orb followed by large white orb
description: I was outside looking at moon and I turned around and saw a huge red orb/fireball type object flying perfectly horizontal across sky…it was low…maybe 2000ft above ground. It was not discharging any material behind it like a meteor or comet but it had a huge smoke trail behind it but after it left my field of view the smoke trail was gone. Extremely clear night with almost full moon, no wind or clouds so I should have been able to continue to see trail but it was gone. About 2 min later a BRIGHT white orb followed same path but about twice as high…4000ft above ground . Neither object made a sound, never changed brightness as it moved across entire sky. Would space junk or a comet/meteor be flying that low and horizontal to ground?!?!

summary: Was outside& noticed a red/orange glow way above Luxor, as we were watching it it started to fade& disappear b4 photo taken
description: I met my spouse outside after my niece ran to tell me something was in the sky, a UFO, I came out front to see there was an orange-ish red-ish craft in the sky above the Las Vegas Strip, it was staying in one place, Hoovering. Thecraft looked like it was surrounded by a fog and halo of red/orange light. It was a circular in shape. The craft faded dim fairly quick and disappeared, after less than a minute, it showed back up more towards the lower left. After the photos were taken it disappeared. We did not see it again.

summary: Orangey red orb, not blinking, moving steady north/West to East. Vapor trail with it. No sound.

Had a vapor trail following it which I thought was very odd, especially this time of night. It seemed to be moving in semicircle the farther East it went, like it was getting closer to the ground the farther East it went. Looked to be just a bit closer than a plane would normally be from the ground when it came from the North/West.

Visible energy wave around object with possible plume emitting behind object, not following but propelling. All the dogs were barking across town. Big arc relative to curvature of the world

Left a smoke trail behind that quickly dissipated. It was definitely burning- orange in color. No sound at all. We followed it until it was out of sight behind the trees.

summary: Bright red glowing ball moving slowly across the sky then as it got closer it has a stream of sparks behind it as long.
description: We were coming home from bowling and saw a glowing red ball moving slowly across the sky as it got closer it had a trail of sparks behind it like a fire work but it travels from north to the southeast across the entire skyline and kept flying. Too slow to be a meteorite. I’d say it was about 1000 ft above the ground but seemed closer at first.

description: i was outside in my backyard and a pink cube started going across the sky very quickly leaving smoke behind.

summary: Light moved like a balloon, and not a plane/ drone, and the light turned off after 5-10 seconds of view.
description: I was facing South at 172 degree(s) and also facing toward the moon when I saw a light appear under the moon and while it was moving in a NW pattern, I noticed it seemed to move like a balloon, rather than a plane or a drone. After about 3-5 seconds, I grabbed my phone, but before I could open up the camera, I saw the light disappear. It seemed fairly high up in the sky, but I couldn’t see that well due to the dark sky, and there were no other aircraft present nearby.

summary: Orange craft flying across sky with very faint trail.
description: Traveling westbound on I-44. I was about mile marker 192. My vehicle was between St. James and Rolla, Missouri. I spotted the orange orb traveling from North to South. I thought I may be a meteor but it never broke apart and it also maintained the same altitude. Was on the way to work so I didn't stop to get video. I don't think it would have even shown up. I have had numerous sightings over a 30 year period. I work overnights at a hotel, and an entrepreneur.

summary: Small glowing red orb moving over 3x faster than any plane I’ve ever seen. In a perfectly straight line from North West to South East
description: Was in my living room, with my boyfriend. I looked out the window of our apartment townhome that faces North and all of the sudden saw a small, but very clear and prominent, solid, glowing, red orb darting in a straight line across the sky. At first I thought it was some sort of drone, and I got my Boyfriend’s attention. It was moving faster than either of us had ever seen a plane, or satelite move before. As it was about to leave our view from inside the house, we sprinted outside to try to continue viewing the mysterious object. As we got out there we could not find the orb anywhere. I ran around the block looking at its projected path, to no avail. We have no idea what this could possibly be.

summary: Metallic orb flew over our house - silently and at low altitude
description: Sitting on back deck in early evening. Watching planes overhead and tracking with Flight Tracker app. Noticed an object coming towards us. It seemed to be a low altitude, but I would be guessing - maybe around 2,000-3,000 feet. It was low enough and close enough to the ground that we could visibly see it spinning. It was a round, shiny silver orb that seemed to have small fins on it that would glisten in the sun. That was how we knew it was spinning - we could literally see it turning. It flew very smoothly, in a straight line, directly over our house from south-east to north-west and out of sight. No sound. No blinking lights. No exhaust or contrail. I took a video which I will try to upload. If you zoom in on the video, you can see the object get bright and dark as it spins. It was not a plane - I checked the flight tracker app. It was not the ISS, it came over (north to south) several hours later. I am familiar with rocket bodies, comets, balloons, etc as I track a lot of things in the sky. This was completely different and very much what I have heard described by other sightings of metallic orbs. It was unlike anything I have ever seen. My wife experienced the same thing I did…

summary: A strange light appeared out of no where and remained for about 2-3 minutes before disappearing.
description: Every time I tried to take a video and zoom in, I’d lose focus. This wasn’t happening any other time besides when I tried capturing footage of the strange light. It was NOT THE MOON AND NOT A PLANE OR DRONE! A plane did fly by in close proximity immediately as soon as I noticed the UFO.

summary: Fireball Traveling Across Sky
description:
On a mesmerizing night, with Venus shining brightly in the sky, I found myself gazing at its celestial beauty. As I marveled at the radiant planet, something peculiar caught my attention just beneath it. There, a luminous object was in motion, captivating my curiosity. Initially, I considered the possibility of it being an airplane, but as I observed further, it became apparent that this sighting was unlike anything I had witnessed before.
Unlike an airplane with its distinct blinking lights and steady flight path, this object lacked those familiar characteristics. Its movement seemed different, almost ethereal. Determined to capture this mysterious phenomenon, I hurried indoors to retrieve my iPhone, hoping to document the encounter. My heart raced with anticipation as I began recording, zooming in 100% to gain a clearer view of the object's shape.
To my astonishment, the object revealed itself as a fireball, engulfed in a mesmerizing glow. At its center, a small, solid core seemed to pulsate with an otherworldly energy. Aware of the importance of capturing the magnitude of this sighting, I adjusted the camera to showcase the object's size and speed relative to the moon, towards…

summary: A line of lights spaced equally apart in a line, moved quickly across the sky.
description: I was outside on my back patio and looking up at the moon. I also noticed a circular cloud to the left of the moon, which I thought looked different. Just then, a line of white lights was coming in from the right flying towards that cloud quickly. They flew in a line formation. I counted 10. No sound, no flashing lights. It happened so quickly and then they disappeared. No other clouds in the sky besides the circular one.

summary: Circular light
description: Sitting outside with my Husband. We both witnessed the ball of light and watched it travel East. It was not an aircraft as it was moving too quickly, no blinking lights and then quickly became smaller before disappearing this was all within a minute or less.

summary: I saw the object plummeting to earth extremely rapidly.
description:
While driving south on Jog Rd.,in Palm Beach Gardens Florida, I saw a green rectangular object plummeting towards Earth for 5 seconds in the Southern sky. I lost sight of it when it dropped below the tree lines. It was vivid green in color and appeared to be producing some kind of vapor or smoke but did not leave a trail.
I am a high school teacher.

summary: We saw a very strange craft traveling west at a very high speed that appeared to have the main craft up top with a strange form under
description: We were sitting outside having a holiday cookout and I saw a very strange looking aircraft directly to the North and it was traveling at a high rate of speed to the West. I instantly pointed it out to the 4 other adults present and everyone thought it was the strangest thing they've ever seen. The shape was almost undescribable as it looked like a main craft on the top carrying a large object underneath it around the size of a car but shaped completely different. It seamed to change a few different shapes and it appeared to have some sort of orange boosters at the very top. We did not hear a single noise. I snapped a few pics on my galaxy s22 ultra but tried to take them quick on 100x zoom as it was moving out of view quickly so I couldn't get a completely focused picture. The first picture was with the tree in it where I tried to snap a pic before it went behind the tree and you can barely see it in the corner. I then had to run to the end of the driveway to snap the other pictures on 100x zoom to see past the tree. Also, this was traveling directly west away from the direction of Wright Patterson AFB.

summary: Bright light slowly drifting southwest
description:
Very bright light -- brain initially went to Venus. Knew it was not a weather balloon cause I work for the NWS and those are non-reflective...and launched right at 23Z, which is not when the sighting occurred (2130Z). Object was drifting at high altitude towards the northwest. Observed it for a few minutes, noted that it was definitely *not* a plane (we are 20 miles southwest of KATL). Attempted to view it using my 8" aperture telescope. I caught onto it briefly and all I could get was a rather small but very bright dot. It then drifted behind some cumulus clouds. Some very thin high cirrus was present. The object's brightness rose and fell a few times, but it wasn't always clear if it was a change in reflection angle or high cirrus obscuring the object.
My wife was outside with me...she also saw it. My 8 year old son came out, saw that I had the telescope, briefly tried to see it, but couldn't get sight of it.
Her guess was some kind of drone. My guess was cynically another one of those "Chinese Spy Balloons" like I saw on the news a few months ago, but who really knows. I'm mostly filing this report to figure out if anyone else saw that cause I'm just really curious what I was…

summary: Floating like object; changing shapes but seemed to revert to the same shapes.
description:
Noticed a darker object by itself in the sky. Looked like a super dark small cloud, it was cloudy here today. We kept watching and it was almost staying in the same place until we noticed it moving slowly, changing shapes, and somewhat moving closer. Definitely moved closer, floating around until we lost sight of it in the woods behind us. At one point a small piece “ broke off” and continued near the larger section.
I would appreciate you letting me know what it was if you know.

summary: Commercial flight crew observes burst of light during takeoff.
description:
May 28, 2023
Atlanta-Hartsfield (ATL) Sighting Report
Narrative of Events During Takeoff
2215 Hours: After a 15 minute gate hold, the aircraft, a Boeing 767-300ER with 226 souls and 2 laps on board, is pushed back from the terminal. Ground Control clears the aircraft to the active taxiway.
2245 Hours: Idle fourth in line, after 30 minutes aircraft cleared to taxi onto RWY 26 Left where we are instructed to hold. ATL Tower reports clear skies, visibility 10 miles or better, altimeter 29.92, winds calm.
2248 Hours: Cleared for takeoff, ATL Tower instructs us to climb heading 275 degrees to intercept course 288 degrees to Snufy. Flight course put us just west of East Point and south of state route 166, where we expect to be cleared to 15,000 feet, and from there to flight level 240 (24,000 feet).
2252 Hours: Outbound from ATL, Departure clears us to flight level 240. First Quarter Moon visible in the clear night sky, having risen high on the eastern horizon at sunset.
2300 Hours: Climbing through 15,000 feet, First Officer points over the instrument panel towards a sizable burst of white light, 12 o’clock off the aircraft nose, approximately 5 miles distant.

As I said,the object was very tiny and we assumed it was very high not low and small. We were able to watch it as it moved east to west, directly overhead and then into the wester sky. We both agreed we had never observed something moving in this way or displaying this kind of bright light dimming and flashing bright again. summary: A very fast-moving, consistently bright light that traveled from the NE horizon to the SW horizon in about 10 seconds with no sound.
description: I was in a hot tub with three friends. The object caught my eye as soon as it cleared the home that was adjacent to me. My first thought was that it was a bright fireball, and I instinctively shouted to my friends as I pointed, "look"! All four of us followed it with our eyes as it raced across the sky in a seemingly straight line all the way to the hills that were to our southwest. This all occurred in about eight seconds. I must admit that my sense of time was skewed; I was so transfixed on what I was seeing that the duration of the sighting might have been anywhere between six and ten seconds long. What I do know is that it was a white-blue or white-green object and it was exceptionally bright -as bright as fireballs, yet it NEVER dimmed or flared up. Its brightness remained consistent during its entire trip over us. In addition, it didn't break apart and it didn't make a sound, or at least any sound that we could hear. There's really no way for me to know how large it was, as its light output obscured what was actually there. This was much too fast to be a satellite of any kind -even low-orbit satellites. It wasn't the ISS, which was definitely over the Catskills that night.…

No images.

It was gone. This was a round circle of very bright light. It wasn't fire, but did seem to be high energy. This circle of light / energy did not emit light and there was no sound from it. I live about 20 miles from O'Hare airport. we have planes that circle Elgin and start there decent to land. The altitude of this wasn't treetop, but I believe well below the altitude of planes we see which will land at the airport. Again, this only lasted about three seconds, but was incredible. My wife told me not to tell anyone, but I can't forget this. I'd like to know if there was anyone else had seen this and reported it to anyone.
I'd like to stay anonymous other if someone would want to contact me.

description:
I was driving, my partner sat in the passenger seat beside me. The sky was clear but there weren’t too many stars visible. Something caught my eye as we were talking: an oblong orange shape was suddenly visible in the sky in front of us, just left of center of our field of vision, maybe 30 degrees above the horizon. It gradually brightened as it appeared, like a slow flare, but constant in shape, speed, and utterly silent (the windows were down), and it traveled at a speed that, at the time and in recollection, seemed too fast to have been a plane or a drone, but far too slow to have been a meteor. It travelled upwards on a diagonal for maybe 5 seconds, give or take, before it gradually dimmed as it disappeared. I took the next turn-around and wondered aloud about the possibility of an aircraft practicing for the upcoming Memorial Day Air Show. My partner noted the time, 1:19 am, not an hour that one would expect such practice flights to take place. There were no other vehicles nearby.
Object left no trail and the light source never blinked or flickered and had no discernible haze. Encounter was too brief to accurately estimate the object’s speed, size, or supposed distance from…

summary: Orange Light Moving Across Sky & Other Experiences
description:
I was outside and I saw what I thought was a plane as I always see planes in the air, but this was not a typical plane like I usually see. It was an orange round light slowly moving across the sky, no sound and no blinking. I watched for about 40 seconds and it looked like it slowed then stopped and then vanished. I waited for about three to four minutes looking into the sky, but I did not see it anymore. Who knows how long it was in the sky before I noticed it. And where did it go? Most importantly, what was it?
This is not the first time I've seen unusual objects. Me and my partner both witnessed something strange. A handful of years ago in a place where we use to reside at, I was awakened to a strange sound in my kitchen, so I quickly glanced out from our bedroom and I noticed a red orange what looked like a fireball in the center of our kitchen, and it just vanished. While also there, we noticed strange lights moving in the night sky, I think I still may have a video of it somewhere. I also have dreams of seeing UFO's, there are always lots of them with…

summary: Black dots moving as a group over SF Bay.
description:
While exercising my dog with a friend, I looked out over the bay near Alcatraz Island. I saw what I initially thought were balloons released.
There was a scattering of about 15 black spots, possibly spheres. Most were in a scattered pattern and there was a clump of several.
The objects were moving all together, from West to East over the bay. My friend and I started hypothesizing what we thought they were.
We had several minutes to observe them as they moved across the sky. We dismissed the idea of balloons because we thought there looked too large from our vantage point. They moved all together and it seemed unlikely that the objects were propelled from the wind as they kept a random but distinct shape the whole time. It was not particularly windy that day but it could have been stronger at altitude.
I watch the sky often as I enjoy identifying birds. San Francisco has had many more birds of prey in the area since the COVID lock downs.
I am in the habit of looking up often. I'm also interested in aviation and like to note the various helicopters and aircraft in the region.
This sighting looked nothing like any air craft I've seen before. No sound was made either. It's possible…

summary: Observed a round metallic object with bright flashing red light (like a welder's torch) 3-5 miles away with two white orbs.
description: At approximately 1023 AM while walking northwest along Canyon Village Parkway near Mint Orchard Drive in Henderson, Nevada I had just completed my morning jog when I observed an extremely bright red flash in the skyline just to the east of Black Mountain towards Las Vegas. I then witnessed what appeared to be a round metallic object continue to flash in an extremely bright red light similar to a welding torch. I thought at first it may have been an aircraft reflecting sunlight as the sun was to my back, but it remained stationary approximately 3-5 miles due northwest at about 45 degrees above the skyline just to the east of Black Mountain from my location. It continued to flash brightly for a couple of minutes. There seemed to be no pattern to the flashes. After about 5 minutes, I then witnessed two bright white orbs appear from the east and west of the flashing object. The two orbs were smaller than the first object and stopped to each side adjacent to the flashing red light. The orbs were illuminated in a very bright white light and remained solid in color. After five minutes, all three objects disappeared. There was no sound and I could not tell which direction they went as…

summary: Green and red flying object while looking west from my kitchen window making odd moves
description: At about 00:05 hrs in Phoenix, Arizona, from my kitchen window I saw a red & green lighted object acting unusual to the west of my house near 44th Street & Indian School. I grabbed my iPhone and went out to my back yard to video it. I was probably over 2 or 3 miles away at a 20 degree angle above the ground to the west of my house. My wife, Jacque, came out also when I grabbed my iPhone and told her there was an unusual light flying to the west. I also saw and filmed a second object which I only saw for 10 or 15 seconds. The object seemed to be rotating and giving off a green and red light. It acted erratically when it started to move and was able to descend and accend at a fairly fast rate which told me it was not a normal aircraft and was not a helicopter because of the speed of vertical movement. I am a private pilot and very familiar with aircraft lights and motion. We frequently see aircraft flying near by because of our proximity to Sky Harbor Airport 3 miles directly south of us. Both lights shot downward and out of sight after about 5 minutes.

summary: Large object with rounded edges that bent light from stars
description: While camping I was having a fire at my sight, my head started to feel loose if that makes any sense, the weather was not severe but there was a lot of wind/insects/waves crashing but not overly loud. I had an odd feeling that something was about to happen, then everything went silent!   The wind stopped, and it felt like I had gone deaf for a short bit. I looked up to see if there was a severe weather event about to break due to the pressure change and when I looked I saw a large object passing that was bending light around it, almost like it was see through but with rounded edges. The sky was clear and the deafness in my ears stopped as soon as it was gone. All sounds/wind/insects came back very quickly afterwards in almost a split second it felt like. I have 0 idea what I saw or thought I saw, but the sudden stop of everything left me feeling uncomfortable and had a hard time sleeping due to the intense pressure in my ears and lightness of my head, in terms of lightness I mean I felt no weight of my head on my neck for almost half the night.

I was picking up kids toys and the wife had just got home from work met her out in the driveway. I looked up in the sky that I’ve looked up into 1000 times or more and noticed a bright light. summary: A ball of light flying in a straight line from north to south on the east side of the moon no trail and then slowly blinking out.
description:
I was looking at the waning moon through my telescope as it was exceptionally clear that night, and looking amazing.
Zooming in and out and exploring the area I noticed a white dot moving with purpose travelling from north to south in a straight line, it had no trail and was moving with great velocity, it was really clear and as bright as the moon itself, it was visible for about 5 or so seconds then slowly disappeared.

summary: Saw large white orb slowing landing on other side of mountain
description:
We were taking the dog out for a pee and my husband saw this large white bright orb in the sky that was not very far away from the ground or the mountain top. This orb was gracefully lowering down with barely any shaking, it was bright and beautiful. We watched as it disappeared behind the mountain.
No flashing of lights, no spiral, it stayed in the exact position as it slowly came down.
After this I saw a smaller orb in the distance. Which I thought was a star as I saw it before the large orb that was extremely close to us.
This smaller orb started moving away in to the distance and farther into the sky, somewhat fast. It ended up moving above over our heads until it was so small we couldn’t see the light coming off of it.

summary: Multiple pulsating lights trailing each
description: I was sitting at a gas station, eating and looking south on I-75 South, and I saw a pulsating white light in the distance, moving in a horizontal direction from east to west. After that, two minutes later, another light came, moving at a steady pace. Two minutes later, the same lights came back from the west and started heading east. Estimated altitude was about 16,000 feet and about 15 miles out with no trees or obstructions. I ruled out as being an aircraft because there are no active high altitude airways that go from west to east in this area only south.

summary: Walking dog, looked up and saw object drifting, then noticed secondary object drifting in opposing direction.
description: I went outside to let my dog walk around the grassy area next to my apartment and upon looking up (West), I noticed the cigar shaped object drifting across the sky at a consistent pace, going downward (left) at about a 45° angle. Could not decipher if it was metallic or white in color. Appeared somewhat translucent at times with naked eye. I then notice a secondary object which begins higher up than the first and appears further away, behind some faint clouds at times. Secondary object appears to be moving at a similar speed as the first object, however, the secondary object is moving downward at about a 45° angle, rather than upward like the first object. Both moving left. I watched for about 10 seconds before then recording with my cell phone for about 17 seconds. Objects drifted behind cloud cover and couldn’t be located after that. Second video attached is the same as the first video, just zoomed in more. Video time stamp says 9:06AM.

summary: Ball of light passsed from south to north, following I-77.
description: Orange-ish ball of light passed in a virtual line south to north following I-77 near the football HoF. Moved slowly, checked flights nearby and saw none on radar. No noise heard as it passed by. Didn’t record until tail end after checking flights. Is not high in atmosphere.

summary: Videoed a bright object changing colors and shapes and moving faster than man has accomplished
description: Husband stepped out and yelled to come. He saw it zooming around about 30 seconds before I started filming. A bright object, no shape at the time and changing from red to blue to green. It started moving horizontally faster than man made. Not as high as Chinese Spy balloon which I also saw and videoed. Not as high as airplanes along the flight path. Could have been so large that it looked lower in the sky. Turned into a circle, changing colors then blinking. Shape changed from circle to shapeless streaks darting so fast I don’t even think the military has anything that fast. We were skeptical but nothing else explains it. Just like in Close Encounters when it flew around the mountain road as people stood there. There was only one object and it darted around so fast and went behind the tree line. Someone was shooting fireworks to the northwest. We heard no sound at all. Video was too long to load.

description: I witnessed 2 flying objects traveling at unbelievable speeds, in formation for about 10 seconds before I pulled my camera out to snap only one picture before they disappeared in an instant . Unbelievable, and now I’m definitely a believer now that I witnessed first hand something I can’t explain , even with all the knowledge I’ve learned in 42 years I still look at this picture just in amazement and what makes it even better is that’s the North Star and Jupiter in the picture when it was snapped.

summary: Observed an erratic moving light in the sky shaped like an elongated oval over Dulles Airport
description: Upon leaving Dulles International Airport and as I was headed to my car of the parking garage at 9:29 PM, I observed and erratic moving light shaped like an elongated oval darting through the sky. I took a video of it because I was fascinated by this random object. During the video capture, one other woman, whom I did not know, observed the same object and joked it must be a UFO.

description: At first I thought it was a paragliding craft. But it was solid black and sphere shaped. It was moving fairly fast. I saw two more coming right above me. I took two pics and a video.

description: I saw an object traveling through the jet trail of an airplane. It was traveling faster than the plane. When it reached the plane, it passed right by it and kept going. I wasn't able to get my phone out and start recording until it was already at the plane and passed it.

summary: 5 Black star shaped objects

They were very difficult to make out unless you stared with concentration. They were floating/lumbering along the cloud layer slowly. At times they appeared to disappear. We took a video and photos, but the resolution was too low to discern them in the photo/video. They were hard enough to see with the naked eye, let alone a phone camera.

summary: Was not loud almost an eerie silent radio got very static had am channel on for weather sky lit up bright white very quickly
description: The light was so bright it blinded me for a quick couple of seconds I had to stop. At first I thought it maybe a rescue helicopter or something similar but there was no sound very quiet. The object seemed to get closer and closer then suddenly In an instant it shot off in the opposite direction and everything was dark again I did not know what to think of it

summary: 3 lights blinking and moving before disappearing
description:
I've seen 3 lights blinking at different pace. They were aligned in the sky, and from my position of observation they were almost at vertical, I'm not sure how to express this in degree angle. What surprised me, it's when 2 of these lights moved together in a straight line apart from the other one, like they were part of the same object. The motion was quite fast and smooth. Being aware of ET presence, i immediately thought, "that's another sighting" and at that moment, the lights disappeared.
The lights were white, though I may have spot a lite different color at some point but given the fact I just came out of a lighted room before stepping outside in the dark, I can't be sure. They were the size of a big bright star, or a planet like Venus. Since that event I am very very exhausted without explanation and at the beginning I didn't make the connection, but since it lasting despite resting all day long for 2 days, I am questioning if there could be an relationship.

summary: It was triangular. It was moving fast, but I belive it may not have been in the atmosphere. It was three lights and they were not brigh
description: I have a week bladder, and I happen to have a door from my bedroom going outside, so I go out and pee every 2 hours or so. I always look at the stars, sometimes for 5 minutes or more at a crack. I spotted a dim red light moving north to south. It was fading in and out, and I was trying to relocate it when right over my house a triangular thing flew from east to west. The lights were slightly dim but seeable. That’s why I think it was outside the atmosphere. It was about the size of say a full moon. It was moving very fast.

summary: A light moving south across the sky, then it faded and was gone.
description: My husband and I let the dogs out before bed. The sky night was clear. Stars were visible. A single bright light that, from our perspective, resembled a star, being the same size and brightness of those around, was moving southwards in a regular pathway across the sky. The speed was measured yet steady and the trajectory smooth and straight. It had no red lights anywhere and no blinking lights so did not seem to be a plane. There was no sound. As we watched, it faded and was gone.

summary: Very bright light in the west
description: I observed a very bright, what appeared to be yellow/orangish light in the western sky late at night. I saw the light and noticed it because it was so bright. I thought this might be Venus and it could be the case in which case ignore this report. The light appeared to be moving very slowly and appeared to be dipping somewhat rapidly at times but I'm willing to admit my eyes could be playing tricks on me. I observed it for maybe 15 minutes at which time it definitely moved as I noticed it moving further towards the horizon. It was also becoming more and less bright but I couldn't determine what might be causing this. It eventually moved below a line of trees at the end of the 15 minutes at which point I could no longer see the light and it never reappeared. I can't confirm what it was. Maybe its nothing in which case ignore this. But I enjoy watching the skies at night and haven't noticed anything like this before. It struck me as odd so I thought I'd report it. Do with this report what you will.

summary: Could not see with naked eye, only thru phone camera. Objects lowered & got larger with each picture. Then they pulled away & disappear

They almost looked like entities as they got lower. When I looked without the camera I couldn't see them at all. A star to the left of then then got larger & looked like a spacecraft of some kind & disappeared.

summary: 2 sphere like a balls of red fire.
description:
Initially, we saw one sphere moving south to north along the coast line in Sea Isle, City, New Jersey. The sphere stopped close to where our location is, and was suspended. Moments later a second sphere followed in the same path as the initial sphere moved. First sphere made a 90 degree turn and quickly moved out toward the horizon . The second sphere also stopped in the same place as the first and made the identical 90 degree turn.
They appeared red -glowing like a fireball. There was not trail. It was self-contained pulsing red light. There was no sound made from the objects. We reported to the US coastguard immediately. I confirmed with Cape May Coastguard that they were not currently flying in the area.

As I was taking my picture of Venus and the moon the object caught my eye and while I focused on it the object it simply disappeared.
I was on the camp deck there were no windows or screens, and the night sky was clear. Though I could see it, the object did not appear to have any illumination. When I downloaded my camera to my computer, I noticed the object was in the frame.

In the clearest photo the object appears to be square with a ring of lights around it and a smaller grayish rectangular object next to it. Then about half an hour or so later the same light came back and did the same thing but flew around a bit more into the distance and back, the vanished. The light that was next to me the came on . I then went out onto the deck to see if I could spot anything else. Then strangely something flew past the ship very fast just above the water, as if it was going to dive in, the were no lights that I could see, but I could make out a craft shape even though it was dark there was illumination from the ship lights.

description:
The eastern sky camera views the area of sky to my east and trees in my back paddock are used as reference points for the FOV.

In the frames preceding the object entering the FOV it illuminates the top of a reference tree which is known to be 70m (229ft) from the camera.
It is raining heavily and the object leaves a light trail and wake through the rain which is consentient with its shape and size.

summary: A white stationary for 10mins, shape-changing-object. Possible balloon. Between fast moving clouds. Flew North slower the clouds 12mins
description:
(4:30pm) I walked out of AutoZone towards my car. There was a chill in the air, and wind gusts at approx 6-8mph. I looked up at the low dark fast moving scattered clouds in the sky. During a quick break in the clouds I saw a white stationary-shape-changing -object. For a few minutes it was shimmering off the setting Sun.
The object was above the moving clouds. -Not going through them. For 10 minutes.
I didn't have my glasses on, I couldn't see the complete details of the object. So I asked a guy working on his truck if he could see what the object was. He said "it looked like one or two of those white spy balloons."
A few minutes later, when I was next to my car. The object appeared to change shape, *(like a pulsating piece of chewed bubble gum) and become a darker gray color and started floating North for approx 12 minutes. *(slower than the moving clouds)
(4:52pm) As the sun set and the sky grew darker I lost sight of the object. I saw the object a total of 7 times between the clouds during the 22 minutes I watched it.

He started to pay attention to it more at this point, he says did that just move I told him I didn’t know I couldn’t see it from the windshield he said holly shit it did move it changed from a one star looking light then it spreaded apart into 3 star looking lights with 3 red lights in the tips of the triangle on the bottom of the ship my fiancé said “look out the window I got the steering wheel” I did a quick head tilt to the left out of my window and I saw 2 white lights with a red light flashing between the white one I stated “that’s just…

description: Saw a row of 3 bright lights and 1 larger lower brighter circle light. Due west over ocean. Stayed in fixed position for 1/2 hour, then we got cold. Saw 3 planes headed directly toward them. 1 seemed very close, enough to probably get a good look.

summary: Saw what I assumed was a formation of aircraft lit up flying West to East
description: Saw contrails behind the clouds and then a formation of what I thought looked like aircraft flying West to East. It took about 40-60 seconds to cross the sky where I was before I lost sight. I do have trees on both sides of where I was sitting/standing. They were lit up with what appeared to be soft white lights, don't remember seeing any other color lights. Almost looked like a caterpillar formation. Did not appear to me that they were that high in elevation. Had my hot tub running so I did not hear any sound. Same line of flight that I saw a group of aircraft flying single file spaced out one or two to a slot, that was about 20 aircraft and was early morning earlier this spring. Again, I assume both of these instances were military aircraft.

summary: Huge bright light in the sky that didn’t move
description: A couple weeks ago I saw a bright light in the sky, but didn’t think anything of it, a couple weeks later my daughter saw it and said mom, there’s a bright light outside, so we started taking pictures and recording it, and it didn’t move at all. I looked the next few nights for it but it was Over cast so on Monday 5/22/2023 I checked the sky and it was not there anymore.

description: A bright light orb it looked like it moved for a while.

summary: I just received a new iPhone. After set up I went outside my front door to test the camera. I saw something in the screen and looked up
description: I noticed an object in the sky . We live near the airport but this wasn’t a plane. It was stationary then moved to the side. This was the best of the two pics. I went in and called my wife to the front door . I showed her the pictures. We went back out and it was gone. The whole event took less than two minutes. I didn’t know what to make of it. I sent the picture to my brother. After he examined it for a minute he advised me to report it. I was afraid to be wrong about it and thought there must be some explanation . I have decided to report it because the image quality is very good. This picture was taken October 12 2021 at 9:00 pm. The bright light in the pic was a star.

summary: A bright light appeared and just stayed there, was visible for about 20 minutes.
description: Bright light noticeable with the naked eye. It was visible for about 20 minutes. Light first seen at 8:49pm. Multiple videos and photos up until 9:04pm. During the time of watching phones started acting weird on 2 separate cell phones for a brief minute.

summary: I saw a cone shape with 4 circular objects below it floating North
description: I was parked near the church at lookout road and 79th getting sunset photos. I looked east of my location. I saw a black shape I initially thought was a bird. I pointed my 500mm lens at it and got multiple photos. It looked like it has a cone shaped balloon at the top of the object. The cone was grey and had a black tip facing upward It had 4 round gray shapes hanging below the cone shape. I think something was tethered at the bottom of the round shapes by a single strap. It looked like it was floating north of my position

summary: Fading white light in my backyard
description:
I was letting out my dogs in the backyard while looking northwest, I saw a Light, the best thing I could compare it to is a flashlight far in the distance. It moved southwest from its position, and faded completely out of existence and blended with the sky. It could be a airplane that went behind a cloud near it,
But I waited and never saw the thing again. I thought most stories were made up but I swear to my grave that I saw that thing.

summary: 2 jets chasing 1 triangular shaped aircraft.
description: Two gray fighter jets were chasing a dark gray or black triangular shaped craft headed west. I’m unsure the elevation they were at but looked to be about 1.00” long. I would guess they were 5000-8000’. They were doing slalom like maneuvers which is what caught my attention. They were moving so fast it caught me so off guard I didn’t even notice the black triangular aircraft at first. The triangular craft was seemingly just moving, if that makes sense. As in, there wasn’t the expected movement like the jets. Almost as if I was blinking very quickly as it would move, but I wasn’t blinking. It definitely seemed like the craft was easily outmaneuvering the two jets. Unfortunately I couldn’t react fast enough to get pics or video.

summary: Noticed a silver something in the sky high up in elevation. It didn’t move just stayed in place.
description: I filmed it in the sky. It seemed to flash the silver colour as if it was spinning and the sun was hitting it. I videotaped this object but it won’t let me send it. Send me a phone number and I’ll send it to you. I work on a boat that goes back and forth in the inner harbour of Vancouver. It was very high up in daylight. Hope this helps. Cheers

summary: Object observed in the sky I don’t believe was man made.
description:
While driving I observed a very brief very white flash or strobe from the sky. This caused me to look skyward which I did. After looking up into a clear blue cloudless sky I saw nothing for 8 - 10 seconds. I then observed an object that I would estimate to the size of a commercial airliner drifting to the east at an elevation of 15,000 - 20,000 ft. Battleship gray in color. After observing this object for maybe 5 - 8 seconds it disappeared. I continued to look in the sky and saw nothing. Another strobe or flash occurred in the sky but I saw nothing in the sky. I produced a drawing of the object but it looked much more advanced than I could create in a drawing. I checked with local law enforcement, see if they had any reports of something unusual in the sky. They had none. Also checked with the Vero Beach Air Traffic Control Tower, see if they have anything on radar during that time frame. They would not tell me anything.
I am a good witness. I was a Fire Rescue Lieutenant for almost 33 years with no need to fabricate anything.

summary: Large Blimp like object about 15-30 bus lengths long moving slowly, 300-500 yards above lake
description:
Large Blimp like object about 15-30 bus lengths long, moving slowly 25-50 MPH, only about 300-500 yards above lake surface. Moving in the North-East direction, linear movement. Observed from 18.5 ft aluminum boat drifting in Lake.
Yes we realize the photos could resemble starlink, but this object appeared to be a Blimp, which doesn't display in Photos. We're fairly sure about the distance off ground of 300-500 yards, as I'm a surveyor. This is the first UFO myself and friend have seen ever (40 years old).

summary: Craft appeared as faint dot of light, flared to intense luminosity, dimmed back down, and departed at high speed
description:
Stargazing at 10:30 pm local time, facing north, my attention was drawn to a faint light I saw traveling high in NE sky (about 70 [seventy] degrees).
The light appeared initially like a common satellite in terms of brightness and size as it approached from the east. Then, it slowed and seemed to descend, tracing out a path in the shape of the number 5. In other words, it slowed, continued to travel east-to-west, then dipped straight down, and then traced an arc (again, imagine the shape of a number 5).
As it traced the arc, it increased in brightness until about midway through the arc's completion, it was as bright as an approaching airliner's landing lights, whereupon it began to decrease in luminosity.
When the arc was completed, the light was back at its original luminosity. At this point, it accelerated in a straight path directly to the north and was gone in about five seconds.

I live in a place where I regularly see planes move from east to west, preparing for landing at Chicago Midway airport. This light was not following one of the typical plane paths that I see approach the airport. Since it was just a single point of solid whitish, blue light, I thought it might be a plane very high in altitude, but as I watched it move, I realized it was something much smaller and much closer to the ground. I cannot rule out a drone entirely, but the speed and distance seem to rule that out. The object was moving at a somewhat steep angle, seemed to come from quite high in the sky, and move towards midway airport in a descending motion approaching lower altitude. The sighting only lasted about two seconds. In that short amount of time I watched the object move from nearly above me to a great distance from me, perhaps closer to the airport. If I…

I thought at first that I was seeing a bird, and remarked to my wife how weird it was that there was a bird up so high. She saw the object, and as we approached it we both realized it was not a bird at the same time. We both observed it to be two spheres, gray or metallic, connected by a horizontal tether. The spheres appeared to be about 12" diameter. They were perfect spheres. Our first thought was maybe party baloons, but they were too perfectly spherical and had no apparent surface deformations that would indicate a baloon's neck/tie-off spot. We did not observe a tether to the ground, or any means of propulsion. As we passed them, they appeared stationary to me but my wife said she thought they accelerated in the opposite direction of our track. We were on the CTAF frequency for the area, and heard no radio reports or disturbances. We were not on flight following, and therefore did not report to…

summary: Red cloud with rotation/movement occurring within it.
description: I saw the red cloud from my living room at first then went to my balcony to video what I was seeing. The light from the cloud would grow dim then brighten as it appeared to have some sort of rotation or movement occurring within the cloud. Two videos were taken - 1st one just over 2 minutes long and the 2nd video approximately 1 minute, 43 seconds in length. I paused one of the videos and took a screenshot to have a still photo of the cloud. I enhanced the photo to see of a definitive object would appear. The cloud was in the north sky above the city lights and tree lines. I watched it for approximately 20 minutes before it darkened, then disappeared completely. I sent short versions of the videos to Jason Wilde, a MUFON investigator as well as the enhanced photo. He stated he had never seen anything like that before and termed it bizarre. He contacted local officials who verified there were no fires in the area at that time. Chatham-Kent does not have the pink grow lights for agriculture and there were none in the area. Videos and photo were sent to local news agencies, but there has been no feedback from them. I live on the top floor and have a great view of the sky at night…

duration: Over an hour and a half
summary: 3 triangular shaped orbs,each with 3 colored lights.Each orb pulsate or ovulated,all 3 were stationary for over an hour and a half.
description: The fact that they never moved and they were clearly not stars,planets or satellites has left me wondering just what was it I was witnessing.

summary: At 11.30, I was standing in my balcony, and saw a V shaped light in the sky, which disappeared after almost15 sec.
description: I saw a V shaped object, which was moving slowly towards the west, it was dark at night and I was confused, I looked at it for a little about 15 seconds, and then it just disappeared, as if the lights turned off, there were no gaps in between the v shape, it was a continuous v shaped light, I searched a little and I found another sighting that looks similar

summary: Large shape changing triangular orb like light rays producing object
description: Around 11pm my fiancé saw why he thought was a very bright star. I told him no? It must be a plane as I saw it moving. We started watching further and saw a large, sometimes triangular, sometimes orb like, object/mass that was staying stationary in the sky but sometimes moving closer/farther. With various light rays at different times. We used a gun spotter scope to see closer and observed a large orb like object that sometime appeared triangular like with various light ray like things at what would be the “points”. At the end of its dissapearancd it had a large blue like light trail before departing. Also, when we zoomed into it 40x zoom it appeared to be a large grey swirly like “disc”

summary: We see small clouds of “something” that moves around on top of my house.
description: Objects appear nightly. They sometimes appear as small clouds that move very quickly. There is also a long straight light that moves very quickly and changes direction very quickly. There are no current objects that can change direction this quickly.

summary: 3 black objects in a vertical line, spinning and changing shape an high altitude.
description: All 3 objects changed shape, Top object was pyramid shaped. middle was octogon and flat. No sound. Bottom was super 3d and diamond shape. they would spin independently of each other and would move imperfectly in the same direction, getting closer and farther apart. This took place while I was walking my dog on Monday evening. At first it hovered in the same place, each object spinning at different speeds; the line formation was reminiscent of how a clown balances spinning plates. When it started moving, it didn’t seem to move fast but I was on top of a big hill with wide open sky, and it covered a large distance, quickly. And it was increasing in altitude. I also saw a small plane flying past that looked like it was trying to get a closer look at the mysterious objects. I took video and sent to my mom, who lives 20 miles away the next town over. She sent me a video tonight (Friday) of the same craft formation in the sky! With a plane flying by it! We live VERY close to rocketdyne and Santa susana fields laboratory! Home of the worst nuclear disaster in USA history!

summary: Object was flying aside a commercial jet liner that was flying very low.
description: Robert

summary: Every night behind Hardwood Dr
description: I see the sighting every night for over a year. They are very bright with red and white lights. Sometimes they come close to the ground and sit there for hours. I would only see one but now there are at least 4. It scares me because they are too close to the backyard.

summary: Bright Red-Orange Orb Dancing Across Sky for 30 min
description:
I pulled over to take a video of a bright red-orange light in the sky- a star was next to it & the light was so bright and red as if it were close to the same size. (Attached is the video, the light was so bright in the video it shows as white. Zooming in you can see the reddish flickering aura.) I got home and told my dad to come outside because it was sitting in the same spot hovering.
It came from south-west to north-east. It went over the star Corona Borealis & ascended up before stopping and hovering around 5-10 minutes.
We called our neighbor out and it appeared to dance and move around the star, rarely moving straight. Our neighbor’s wife & daughter came outside to see.
It then started on a southern direction ascending up- went between stars Nekkar & Seginus of the constellation Boötes.
Hovered between (Nekkar & Seginus) at least 5 min- During this we saw at least 2 tiny orbs crossing the sky, one went south & a minute later we saw one go north- from each side of constellation Boötes.
The orb of light(?) went from the middle of the 2 stars (Nekkar & Seginus), north toward the end of Big Dipper’s handle. It then went east until it faded out of sight.

summary: I saw an orange orb fly across the sky at an incredible speed and then it went off and got obstructed by the building adjacent to me.
description: I was out walking my dog and in the corner of my eye I saw an orange glowing orb jet across the sky (no sound) at an incredible speed. Once I turned my head and made full eye contact with it, it quickly passed and got obstructed by the building adjacent to me. I have seen drones before in the area that people like to fly, I can say with much certainty this was not a drone of any kind I am aware of since the glow was spherical and the rate of speed it moved was way too fast. I am unsure of the altitude since it happened so quickly, but I would imagine it is in the range of 200-400 feet (im no expert on prediction of altitude)

summary: Very bright green light with yellow purple and red lights rotating in the middle
description: 3rd sighting. Solid green with rotating red yellow and purple lights. Hovers in the same spot for different lengths of time and the it will quickly drop out of sight. Always after sunset. Once there were 3 other lights flying around it.

summary: Spinning-top type UFO with multi-colored rings hovers 1 hour, sends out green "drones" then moves rapidly West until out of sight
description: While facing West at 11th + Elden, Los Angeles we noticed a UFO shaped like a spinning top with multi-colored light rings moving around it, similar to how an atom would look with electrons whizzing around it. It was producing flashes of color as we watched it. It stayed relatively low in the sky, well below airplane flight paths. We got out binoculars + continued to watch it as it stayed stationary in the sky. It was clearly spinning + flashing with a strange aura or energy field around it. While we were watching it, a police helicopter flew by it and stopped briefly, appearing to be checking this object out then eventually continued on. While we were watching this, 2 tiny green-lit crafts similar to small drones zoomed up over top of us then stopped directly overhead as we looked up at them. They stayed above us approximately 8-10 seconds then continued East-bound then they looped back in the direction of the UFO + appeared to return to the craft. Shortly after this the UFO began to rapidly fly West towards West LA + the ocean. We jumped in the car + tried to follow it but it was moving to quickly to catch.

summary: 3 egg shaped craft shot between 2 cloud formations travelling very fast one after the other white in colour no vapour trail.
description: Three tictac shaped ufo craft white in colour against blue sky ,shot between two cloud formations approximately 3000 metres apart ,they followed the same flight path approximately 500 metres apart in a very straight line , compared to commercial aircraft they were at a speed of approximately 5 times that of the aircraft

summary: Orb looking object at high altitude, with bright flashing white light.
description: Thanks for taking the time to look into this. I was compelled to report this because of the unusual nature of the experience. This was seen on the roof of a residential building on 2nd Ave in East Village, Manhattan. The video shows a point of view looking at Queens/Brooklyn. The roof is about 15-16 floors in height. I was looking towards the east sky and noticed a bright flashing white light which appeared to be at a very high altitude and moving fast. The object was not moving like a typical airplane or helicopter. It appeared to be in the direction of and directly above LaGuardia airport. There were planes in the sky flying towards LaGuardia that are not shown in the pictures or videos because by the time I got my phone out to record they were out of view. The object moved looked like it was moving very fast and able to stop and stay stationary in the air at times, and it was emitting a flashing bright white light not familiar to me to be a typical aircraft. I have included a picture with a drawn red circle, where when you zoom in you can see the shape of this object. I could not tell if it was changing shape while in motion.

summary: 5 orbs moving vertically and horizontally and getting very bright than dim
description: A/C flying at approximately 36,000FT reported seeing approx. 5 orbs moving vertically and horizontally. They would get very bright than dim back down again. The pilot of the A/C reported they had video. They were given the website address to make a report as well.

summary: Lit up object resembling the same color as lightning after or near the end of a thunder storm but it moved sideways like a craft And it appeared out of no where and followed the path of the street…
description: It’s very clear on video from the shop cameras and saved on the shop camera digitally, as well as on my phone.

summary: Fireball descends and flickers away into night sky
description: I left my house to enter the garage and noticed what seemed like a very visible and enlarged Mars. I went inside to call my sister out of her room and went back outside to observe some more. It clearly lowered what seemed to be inches from my point of view, but could've possibly been hundreds of feet (depending on its distance.) I yelled out for my sister to "Hurry and get out here." Before she could come out and witness the anomaly, the red "fireball" flickered away into the night sky, just as a dying flame would. What bothers me most is that I had every opportunity to capture it on my phone, but as soon as I realized it wasn't Mars, it all just happened so fast, my phone wouldn't have made it in time. I'm glad I was at least able to capture a visual memory. As of a week later, I've seen no reports or videos on what I saw on that date, however, there are videos of fireballs doing exactly what I witnessed.

description: Seen for two hours. In the sky. From home at the back door.

summary: 3-4 Lights appearing in the sky, going directly upward in a perfectly straight line, before one would fade out and a new one appear.
description: On the night of May 6th, 2023, I was walking my dog some time shortly after 10 p.m., when I happened to look up through the budding branches of a tree in front of my neighbor’s house, and noticed that the stars in the sky seemed to be moving. I thought my head was spinning or something, so I pulled the dog over and away from the tree to get a better look, and I clearly saw the following: there were little lights that looked like stars fading into view, before traveling directly straight upward and fading out again. Three to four of them would be visible at a time; as the one on top was disappearing, a new one would be reappearing at the bottom. I estimate that I was looking into the sky at a 40 degree angle from the ground, and this lasted from about 30 seconds to a minute, before everything suddenly faded out before my eyes. Their movement was perfectly vertical and perfectly regular (same speed and same distance apart). Everything appeared and disappeared in the middle of the sky at the same level; there were no clouds to obscure my view if they might’ve been traveling up from the horizon, and I could clearly see many other stars around. Further up northward, I could clearly see…

summary: 4 aligned orbs or stars top one would fade and a new one would appear on the bottom of the line
description: I was having a fire for my kids and other kids in the neighborhood when I looked up and saw 4 moving stars horizontally in a line. The top one would vanish and a new one appeared at the bottom. Then there were 2 and then they dissapeared. I said look, do you guys see that. They did. All of us saw it. I yelled for my brother to come look, at that time my daughter grabbed my phone and shot the video. Only 2 lights are visible during the time we finally took the video

summary: 7-10 orange lights heading north, followed by huge flying saucer, bottom illuminated by city lights. Followed by 7-10 military choppers
description: Two witnesses described numerous (7-10) orange-type lights in a cone-like formation formation in the sky coming from the south heading north toward Oak Grove. The dogs were acting crazy at this time. About 3-5 minutes later one of the witnesses looked straight up and noticed what he called a "flying saucer". The main witness then scrambled to get a cell-phone shot of the craft and got only about 4 seconds of video. The object was perfectly round with the center (about half the mass) black or dark gray. with its outside being silver gray and middle almost black, described as a flying saucer. Apparently the outside of this object was being illuminated by the city lights as the saucer was not lit. Witnesses described a smell of burning wiring.  After the saucer-like ship flew past, military choppers were everywhere in the sky. Witness has actual video of one of the choppers chasing one of these lights. Within a 5-minute time-frame the witnesses saw 3-4 lights or orbs which went in the same direction, disappeared, then reappeaed and headed in a different direction from east to west. Within 7-10 minutes they began to hear and see 7-10 military choppers flying around in an apparent…

summary: 2 orbs hovering, apart but aligned with each other, then vanished, separately.
description: We were walking on Grant St. in Centerport, New York, approximately 9:15pm. It was dark, with some clouds. My friend noticed 2 orbs hovering in the western sky. They were apart from each other but seemingly aligned. One disappeared, then the other was gone.   No sound.

While driving, noticed an unmoving white cylindrical object in the sky. Pulled over to take video.
description: While driving back home from a haircut on May 6, 2023, I noticed an object in a fairly cloudless sky. The object was shaped like a Tic Tac - and from my vantage point was unmoving. I pulled over to take video for roughly 13 seconds before moving along as where I was pulled over wasn't fully "off" the road. I didn't want to obstruct traffic. After pulling away, I lost sight of the object. From my vantage point, I couldn't see any fins, tails or markings like you usually can from an aircraft. The object did not seem to gain in size or decrease in size - which from my vantage point - looked as if it was hanging in midair. The Worcester Airport is just to the left of where this object is seen. When filming the object, I tired to stay as zoomed out as possible to decrease shakiness.

summary: Video of planes contrails/chemtrails, little flash
description:
I was watching the airplanes and decided to video record them as there were very long, expanding contrails or chemtrails behind them.
I can't recall if I reviewed the video before I got home or after, but I think it was before.
I had thought I had seen a small flash or two of something near a contrail so I enlarged it and slowed down the video. I have a Samsung S22 Ultra.
That's when I saw a white triangular craft of some kind in the image.
I have NO idea what it is, but I DO know its not a plane or star or cloud, etc.

summary: Object initially appeared dark and spherical, but quickly turned, revealing that it was dull gray and cigar-like
description:
I was walking my dog and the encounter happened too quickly, so I was unfortunately unable to film this brief encounter.
I heard a few airplanes in the sky. I love to watch them fly, so I took a look and saw 2 airplanes SE and SW of my position. Between them, nearly dead-on South, I saw a dark, almost black orb hanging suspended in the sky, quite high up. It didn't even take a second before the object turned (I assume that is what happened), revealing that the object was in fact a dull gray color and shaped like a fat cigar. After turning, the object headed quickly in a SE direction and disappeared from sight due to a combination of trees and buildings. The entire encounter couldn't have lasted more than 4 seconds, if even that long.
The skies were almost perfectly clear, with most clouds being light, fluffy, and to the East and North. The object was between 40-50 degrees above the horizon.

summary: Noticed 2 very distinct light orange/yellowish lights low In the night sky. Once stopped the object moved towards me silently at 500 ft
description: As I rounded a curve in the road the object was low In the night sky about 3/4 of a mile ahead and off my 1 o'clock position and I would estimate a altitude of 400-600 ft. I pulled over and shut my motorcycle off and removed my helmet to listen for any familiar sounds of propulsion but heard nothing then literally as soon as I pulled my phone out and opened the camera app the object silently and slowly tracked towards my position in a slow hovering but not directly at me, it ended up coming up on my right side at approximately 300 ft now and as it neared closer to me I became overwhelmed with the fight or flight feeling of danger that was like nothing I've experienced before. Every fiber in my body started screaming for me to put distance between myself and the craft which I should mention was seemingly quite large (maybe twice the size of a Blackhawk).
