Pulsar light,disappeared and reappeared in same spot twice 120min duration minimum
description:
I was watering in the garden when I noticed a pulsating light. Observed it for a few minutes and it disappeared and reappeared in the same location. Used phone to zoom in and captured the video that I have uploaded to my YouTube channel. Sky was clear. Stars could be see,planes passed over.
File is too big to all me to attach. Please contact for video or look at my YouTube https://youtu.be/Nx9wBKSUY34

summary: Object over streaking low skyline intersecting flight path
description: We were sitting on our balcony, saw an object at a slightly lower altitude inspecting the flight path last night where lt least 4 planes were approaching DIA. It was moving at what we both felt was a supersonic speed, a green light on its front, with forward propulsion, moving from SW to NW in a matter of possibly 2 seconds. IT MOVED SO FAST, yet it was silence. No sonicbomb, not exhaust, just extremely straight plane of motion. I saw it, as well as my husband.

summary: Saw a bright flying object in the southern sky seemingly tapered at both ends flying east to west at a low altitude.
description:
Friday night at 9:25 I was driving south on CO-93, just west of Leyden Rock and south of Coal Creek Canyon Rd, when I saw one bright flying object, orb-ish and seemingly tapered at both ends, flying east to west at a low altitude, easily in commercial airspace below the clouds. I pulled up FlightAware immediately and saw no commercial aircraft in the vicinity.
The object was very bright and relatively large, easily distinguishable from stars or satellites. I had it in my sight for less than 30 seconds as I lost sight after it flew over the nearby foothills.

summary: A light flying low in the atmosphere going extremely fast from south to north. There was no trail.
description: We were heading west on C470 in Littleton, CO at 9:23 PM on 5/5/23 and getting off onto the ramp to Wadsworth when a super fast low flying object flew from the south to the north. It was on a straight line. It was a white light going extremely fast, almost missle-like. There was not a tail, just a really fast flying object. We watched it zip by for two seconds and then our view was obstructed by trees. After we passed the trees, we could not see it any more. It was in the air about skyline. The Foothills were in the background and it was hard to tell if the object was in front or behind because it was about that height. There was no sound at all.

summary: Witnessed two cylindrical orbs hovering for 30 minutes over the James River in Gladstone Virginia.
description: Two orbs were witnessed just after sunset hovering above the James River. One had white light and was donut shaped within a circle spinning counterclockwise then clockwise and moving back and forth in place. The other object was further away with colored lights and was moving in a tumbling motion. We witnessed these objects for 30 minutes to an hour. Sky was somewhat lit just after sunset. They were visible to the eye and pictures and video show detail.

summary: Saw an extremely bright light moving incredibly fast east to west parallel to the horizon.
description: Sitting on the patio about 8pm. An extremely bright white light traveling at an incredible speed crossed the sky parallel to the horizon. Sighting lasted approximately 5 seconds. During that 5 seconds the object covered approximately 30 miles based on known mountain peaks. Object appeared to be 5 to 10000’ above the mountains which are approx 6 miles from sighting location. No sound, no trail, no sonic boom. I am a pilot familiar with the area, and know the distance between peaks and landmarks.

summary: Very bright, large, shimmering object with propulsion
description: My 17-year old spotted a large, very bright object in the sky that ascended with a glimmering pale bluish-white light illumination propulsion. When he began to film the object is stopped ascending and remained idle in the sky for a couple minutes until it vanished. Two brand new iPhones phones were filming the object, one overheated and the other lost complete charge. Digitally documented through the night. The object reappeared briefly the next couple hours behind a nearby star. There was no noise generated. There was little movement by object once we identified it in the sky. The object was identified in protected FAA commercial airspace but did not see anything on the FAA data tracker. Oddly, we were the only two people to see object in our immediate area as it was still very light outside. This is the sending sighting in the same area in two years.

summary: Large Bus Like Dark Gray Rectangular UFO
description: I was traveling west on Highland Ave to pick up our dog’s arthritis medication and saw coming out of the cloudy sky a dark gray aircraft that resembled a large bus due to its rectangular shape and it was traveling north to south. I thought is this a blimp ? Realizing that I have never seen a rectangular blimp in my life. This flying object was no aircraft I was familiar with. It seemed to be flying faster than a blimp yet slower than a plane. I can’t say how far the objects distance was from me but it wasn’t very high in the sky. I pulled into the veterinarians office parking lot in hopes of capturing a video or picture but the object was now hidden behind large Perris Hill Park Trees. I have been searching google to see if any one else witnessed this UFO here in San Bernardino California but there is no reports so far. I know I wasn’t the only person to see this UFO. I anticipate some sort of reports to confirm that there was definitely a strange flying object in our skies!!

summary: Saw two crafts appearing then disappearing and moving back and forth
description: My partner, my mother in law and I were headed south on the 101 Freeway to go to a family wedding in Gilbert. My partner, who was driving, noticed two disc shaped metallic crafts moving back and forth quickly and disappearing and then reappearing. My Mother in law and I spotted them too. I then took my phone out to record them. They eventually disappeared and we lost track of them so aren’t sure if they reappeared. These were not aircraft, as they would quickly move right and then to the left and back and forth. The sky seemed a bit hazy, though it was sunny. We have no explanation but wanted to share the sighting.

summary: While sailing overnight to Florida we saw 2 objects in the sky over Florida moving randomly for approx an hour.
description:
We were sailing from the Bahamas to the Port St Lucie, Fla inlet overnight 5/4/23-5/5/23 and around midnight I noticed two objects in the sky over Florida moving randomly. I quickly got my husband to watch them with me.
One object seemed to have just a white light and moved very randomly, like a firefly. At first we thought maybe a drone but it was too random and seemed to darted around in all directions. This light stayed in the same general area.
The other object had a red light which seemed to be blinking and while it moved randomly it seemed more intentional. This object moved back and forth in the sky, seemingly still along the Fla coast, with occasional random up and down movement.
Neither object appeared to have the movement I would associate with a drone.
When I first saw the lights they were close together, then the red one went up the coast a bit. It later came back near the other light for a bit, then left and went down the coast and then back by the other light again.
Both myself and my husband watched both for at least an hour. Then some light cloud cover and the full moon made them harder to see so we stopped looking for them.

summary: Bright triangle in the sky rotating, maybe a pyramid. 6 dim, blinking red and green lights circling each other. Came out of nowhere.
description: First time posting here. I’ve been seeing these lights in the sky at least three times in the past year but this was so strange I had to report. It was dark and I was driving from Loveland to Fort Collins when my sister and I saw a bright star. Together, we think we’ve seen this before, coming home from DIA. This time, the star was so bright, and changing in intensity that we stopped. We had to squint to catch the outline of the strange light but when we did, it was pyramid shape with what looked like a rope of light hanging from one corner. We stared for maybe an hour when out of nowhere 6 smaller, less bright, blinking red and green grafts appeared over the mountains. Two of them circled each other and the lights eventually went separate directions. I think three of them are still over the mountains. I had to take my sister (21 yrs old) because she was freaked out and was getting anxiety. When I went back to the same exact spot, pulled over on the side of the road, the bright triangle was no longer there and the blinking red and green lights were gone except for three. They’re spread out but still high above the mountains, relatively close. I left because they weren’t moving but…

summary: west heading east looked like a pencil shape with solid lights maybe 6 feet apart object seemed a mile away and mile up no sound
description: Coming from west to east no sound a string of lights looked to be 50 yards long maybe 2000 feet AGL. Im a pilot! Traveling horizontal maybe 80 to 100 knots absolutely no sound 9:45 @ night Hickory airport control tower closes at 9 PM. Or they would have seen it!

summary: Multi color circular lights grouped in a staggered pattern flying
description: These weren’t satellites and they varied in size and color. They moved silently across the sky well over 30000 feet with about 99% clear visibility from the ground traveling towards northwest part of Georgia towards Tennessee.

summary: Walking outside and looked up.
description: We walked outside and my boyfriend looked up and said babe what is that? I seen the same thing back in 1999, so I ran inside for a phone to record. It was a line of at least 20 orbs of light, connected by strands of the same color light. It stayed very still and just passed on by. Lasted about 1-2 mins. This color was a light blue/white. I know it’s not Starlink because I seen this same thing over 20 years ago but a different color and there were two lines of them with less amount of orbs. Same speed, same design. I later on found the same picture in a UFO book at school 2 years later and it said they can be different colors. Then a different aircraft passed by 10 minutes later, lights like a drone, but it was loud in the sky, too low for a plane. And it stayed around the neighborhood for some time. My boyfriend recorded the video. After it was all done with we went to check the video, it never recorded.

summary: No outline of the object it was like a long worm the sky was dark 15-20 lights emitting from what appeared to be its side
description:
This object appeared quite high in the sky there are always aircraft flying in the night sky (non at the time of the sighting) coming into Malta Airport the object was a lot higher than local air traffic
It was its length that caught our eye and the fact it was at least 4-5 times the length of any aircraft flying at that height its speed was that of an aircraft
Not fast but again not slow and flying in a different direction to local aircraft traffic a local witness told us the direction it was travelling Malta towards Sicily
As it was dark the shape of the object couldn't be identified it was like a worm with white lights.
The lights were the same size and distance apart without noise or any other flashing lights or power source as it went into the distance the lights slowly disappeared merged to one as it disappeared into the night sky

summary: String of lights move simultaneously across sky

description: The currently unidentified object appeared to be changing in the video when zoomed in, sometimes appearing then getting hazy before changing shapes again. Sky around object looks hazy and distorted.

summary: Bright stationary object prior to dusk that was a hollow ring through telescope.
description: Astronomy is a hobby of mine. At 8:12pm my wife texted and said my son wanted to know what planet was northeast. I knew there shouldn’t be one at that time so I came out and saw a light that was comparable to the size and luminosity of Venus, but nowhere near the location of Venus and much too early to be seeing any other astronomical body. I opened my astronomy app and nothing should have been there. I laid down with it right on the corner of a building for 30-60 sec and I did not see movement. I got out my telescope and saw that it was a very bright ring with 10-12 impossibly bright lights around the outside. It appeared to be hollow. I called my brother in Lincoln and he could see it from where he was as well but in a much different direction. We shot some azimuths and using trig we estimated it was roughly above Palmyra and about 11.5 miles up. I started to notice that it was in fact moving imperceptibly slowly south and maybe slightly west. I followed it for at least 30 min. As the sun went down the stars got brighter and it slowly faded. As it got darker I could see a distinct blinking light in the center that pulses at roughly 1bps, but all of the other individual lights I…

Thanks

summary: Bright white circle left light streak, faster than any jet
description: Bright white circle appeared in NE and instantly shot NW, it was between Cesna and commercial flight height, maybe 10000-15000ft and size of quarter in my finger measurement, distance covered was about 4 inches in tenths of a second. It left a perfect white light trail its whole distance that all disappeared at the exact same time as the ufo. The streak was so defined and clear I could see windsheer around the object seperating the light from the object. While camping on the Santa Maria River in the spring of 2008, my friend and I looked out the tent and saw beams being emitted in a lateral fashion approximately 900-1,500 feet above the valley floor. Initially the beam was emitted from one craft, towards the other craft (that we did not know was there yet). The initial beam was a neon blue hue, the beam traveled in what seemed to be slow motion, and only for a couple of hundred feet before dissipating. A second craft then emitted a beam back towards the first craft with a neon green beam in the same way.
There was no sound emitted from the crafts, and they seemed to be hovering in place. The crafts had a few exchanges of beams in this way, and then disappeared without further consequence. My tent mate rolled to me, asked if I saw that, I responded that I did and then we rolled over and went to sleep dumbfounded and a bit terrified. The crafts were never visible, just the beams were visible.
At the time of the sighting, my friend and I had just graduated college with environmental degrees. We were not under the influence of any substances. There is no history of mental illness of any kind.

The light was so bright and large that it almost appeared burning, as if it were a large meteor, but the movement of the light made it impossible to be a meteor, because it was not falling down towards the Earth. Another result of the size and pure brightness of the light is that it was very disorienting as far as depth perception; it was very hard to tell how far away it was because of the bright, burning nature of the light. When I say "burning", I mean similar to a pulsating light, but closer to the way light appears to move through a fire. I watched it move for no more than two minutes, then went inside to grab my phone and came back outside (no more than 30 seconds later), and it was gone, which is very strange considering how slowly it was moving.

Those flew in direct lines, and were smooth flying, no sudden moves or changes of direction. The orbs I saw made no sound, flew randomly but continued West to East, some changed direction in a darting fashion, side to side and up and down. There was no blinking, no sound, no exhaust that I could see or hear. They started right about dusk, and continued for about 21 minutes. I made a video, which offers commentary, and posted it here: 
https://youtu.be/mD5yZsvGEbY

summary: I recorded a minute 17 seconds of this object. I saw the object for 30 seconds before I could get my video started.
description:
The object was almost directly overhead when I first saw it but it had moved SE some before the video starts. It changed speeds and stopped several times. I live 5 miles south of the Knoxville TN airport and I see a lot of aviation traffic of all types here including a lot of military fixed wing aircraft and helicopters. I grew up as an Air Force Brat so I'm used to seeing aircraft my entire life.
Feel free to contact me if there are any questions about this sighting.

summary: Rocket-shaped object floating in place above Spokane Valley
description: Multiple people on the I-90 in Spokane Valley, Washington witnessed a stationary flying object. Depending on the angle, it looked rocketship-shaped or cylindrical with a dome top. It was visible and didn't move for about 20 minutes while we drove down I-90. Don't know how long it has been visible. It must be pretty large to be visible for so long and from different angles. At one point there may have been a flashing light from the base of the object.

summary: Object viewed flying within wingspan of commercial aircraft
description: I was with a group of friends barbecuing just after 5pm yesterday evening. i was walking out into the open area because my friend was pointing to something in the sky. We then saw a small object flying dangerously close to a commercial airline. It looked to be metalic and spherical. The event lasted long enough for me to call out additional friends to see it as well. We did not get a picture of the event, however, i did snap a picture of a strange chemtrail left in the area of the event. Note that the craft was actually moving perpendicular to this trail though.

I could immediately see bright lights flashing and rotating out in the corn field approx. .5 mile from the road. Instantly this terrified me. I could see the object, large in nature was rising above the tree line in the field. It was huge, about the size of a 2 story house. It appeared to be silent, but the lights were very bright.

They were moving slower than a meteor but much faster than any satellite I’ve seen. The ufo moved from east to north and seemed to cross through the Big Dipper. They were quite large and dull orbs much larger than anything else in the sky. I was able to track it with my eyes. I looked to see if any Star link passed above after reading your page, but I couldn’t find any reason to believe that was them.

summary: UAP light show in Venice, CA
description:
Typical outside, fresh air break and on a vastly clear nighttime sky looking in a mostly E - S.E. direction and -flash!- once...trailed off. -flash!- a second one (as it moved to the east) and then a third, final -flash!- * -flash!- being like a bright, soft white oval, almost cotton tail rabbit like and although there were three separate pings I feel that only one craft was involved here.
*the entire time the UAP flew to the east it did not change its seemingly linear trajectory and then vanished

summary: A triangular object viewed from my backyard during a cloudy night.
description: I'll start with the background of the observer. I've always been a skeptic when it comes to UFOs especially since a lot of the time when I hear about sightings in my area drugs or alcohol were involved and I assume the witnesses saw an airplane as I do live near an airport. However, last night I was staring out my window after hearing a couple of loud cars drive past (I have an interest in cars and was curious to see if I could see what they were). There wasn't much to see as I live in the city and it was cloudy but that made the dark isosceles triangle I saw in the sky stand out even more. Somewhere around 9:50 PM I noticed a triangle that seemed to have a faint glowing white outline just hovering still in the air. Around the same time, my phone restarted on its own as well as the motion-sensing lights in my backyard had flickered twice. After the second flicker, the shape was gone. If it weren't for the sudden issues with my electronics I would have tried to come up with a more rational explanation of what I saw but I can't come up with anything. Airplanes tend to fly that low here, but not when it's cloudy and they definitely don't hover.

summary: We were walking ABS suddenly saw 3 things in the sky
description: Just saw those lights which seem to be red.

summary: Heard what sounded similar to a turbo diesel engine but we knew that it wasn't that. We all began to investigate the sound,
description:
My neighbors and their daughter was sitting on our porch talking. Ironically, I always like to ask people if they believe in UFO's which i did and of course that started our neighborly debate. Roughly 1-3 minutes later we heard what was similar to a turbo'ed diesel engine. His wife looked at me and said what is that? Her husband turned and looked up the street waiting for a vehicle to speed down the hill. Their daughter went out on the sidewalk and said, well Bob, it looks like you might be right about UFO's. At that point we all ran down onto the sidewalk and saw a square object fly about 100'-150' over our house.
The square object had lights in each corner of the square, with 3 of the lights being white, one being red. The square object seemed to fly with one of the corners being in the front. It did not fly with the flat side. My wife looked at her airplane app that tells what planes are in the sky and there wasn't any planes showing. The thing that bugs me the most is, four adults saw this, all of which had cell phones in their hand or pocket and we all just frozen and watch this object fly by.
NOTES: As I thought about this all day, the only logical explanation I can think of…

summary: Observed object cuise down above tree line, then fly away at fast rate of speed
description: Lights flashing, white and red. no sound. Attached video is one of a few visits we had that night. There was also other signs of paranormal activity. Many organized single lights moving at same time with other lights. As the lights descend, (you can see a glow behind the light if focused on it long enough to pick up the details), there's a breeze that is created, then the trees start to straighten out, stretch to the sky, like a form of ani-gravity being created.

summary: Bright white, with pink and blue lights encompassing the white object hovering with slight angle, very slowly moving away.
description:
I was taking a break from making planters at my friend's house on her back porch when I decided to take a break. Looking out and at the sky over my friends yard, I noticed what I thought was a strange, shaped bright cloud. It looked to be less than a mile away. I watched it for about 5 minutes and not seeing it dissipate, and because there were no other clouds this day, it didn't make sense to see this one. I called out to my friend, to have her look to see what she thought it might be. We could see it but we couldn't make out anything but a bright light. We walked to the end of her yard at her fenceline, about an acre sized yard, then I ran to get the binoculars so we could see it better. Looking through the binoculars I saw this white object with pink and blue lights encasing it. Like a halo around it. It appeared to be hovering, and moving away very slowly in the sky and was tilted about 20-30° angle towards the left the whole time we saw it.
We called out for her roommate to see what he thought it might be and so he wouldnt think we were crazy. This was probably 10 minutes after I first saw it.
We took turns watching this through the binoculars. At one point I was looking…

summary: I stepped outside to take a picture of the sky after sunset for a photographic group challenge.
description: I was unaware of the detail in the photograph until I loaded it on my computer and viewed it in Adobe Lightroom. The greenish object stood out as an oddity to me. Enlargement of the image gave a little more detail, but as with many pictures like this it leave a great deal to the imagination. There were no other lights associated with it, no sound or any indication of aircraft in the area. I'm a retired design engineer, and an avid photographer, but in this instance was taking a quick shot of the sky to fulfill a photochallenge for a group I post to on a weekly basis. I am not prone to wild flights of the imagination, and am certainly not an attention hound, in fact I was a little reticent about filing this report, but thought you might be able to interested in it. I've not contacted anyone else about this and only published it to the photogroup 52 Frames.

summary: Multiple small pieces of reflective material moving fluidly like a flock of birds high in the sky
description: Driving north on highway 285, a reflection of sunlight caught my eye, except it was coming from the north instead of the direction of the sun. I looked up and saw a very unfamiliar sight. The reflection was coming from what sort of looked like a flock of birds similar to how starlings could move (fluid but creating beautiful patterns while flying roughly in the same area). So I first thought they must be some sort of bird flock that looks very white and could possibly reflect sunlight, but I’m not sure of any birds that fit that description and this was very high in the sky. I continued to watch it move around and continued on. Two other things to note, cell service dropped off right before I saw the thing and there were other cars there, just traveling south. When I looked back in my mirror, I could not see the thing anymore. The observer is a college graduate with no history of observing anything like this and is aware of how crazy this sounds.

summary: South to North completely silent 4-5 white round lights.
description: I was walking my dog along the west side of Seminole Lake in Largo Florida. It was approximately 12:45 in the morning when I looked to the west towards the condominiums. I observed flying from south to north a chevron/boomerang shaped craft. The craft had I believe 4-5 round white lights on it that were not very bright. The craft seemed to look almost transparent as it traveled north. If I’m looking at the roof of the building the craft was about four finger lengths above the roof line. It was hard to say how high the craft was, but close enough to make out the shape and size which was pretty big. The craft as it was traveling north almost appeared to be canting to its left. To me it appeared as of the craft had appeared out of nowhere. The craft appeared to be in and out of cloaking. As I was attempting to get out my phone to record the craft it faded out as it traveled north behind trees. I was hoping I could pick it back up as it traveled north. I immediately called my wife and told her, then called my friend to share my sighting.

summary: Round spinning object with lights
description: I didn’t see this but heard it outside and found the community discussing it the next morning on Facebook. Many people in town saw the object and there is video of it posted on a community member’s Facebook page. This object sounded like a jet, it was loud and hovered in the area for 15-30 minutes. It’s round, hovered and moved around, sped up, slowed down, all over the western edge of Ardmore. There are two rings of light on the object, it spun on its side then disappeared from the view of Ardmorites. I’m estimating that over 30 people saw the object and many more heard it outside, but didn’t go to investigate as it appeared after midnight.

summary: Bright orange aircraft
description: Bright orange object floating in far distance for 1 to 2 minute. Thought it was a planet at first, but the color seemed to be unique. It became larger and larger very very quickly - sustained in air for a 1 minute. Moved sideways very slowly until it could no longer be seen. Way too high up, too bright, and it moved way too quickly to be a drone.

During the fifteen minutes I saw a small red dot fly towards it, but I couldn't get that object seen on my smartphone.

description: I was with my friend in the backyard looking at the sky one of our favorite things to do. We saw what looked like a plane towing another plane but was connected. We thought maybe it was a blimp but I dont know why there would be a blimp near where I live and it would have been on the news. It was very big and kinda low to the ground and made no sound. summary: Saw two organic appearing UAPs above my house
description: On April 20, 2023 I was in my backyard with my mom and we saw what first appeared to be a plastic bag floating in the air above us. However it was large and very high up in the sky. For a moment we thought it was a spy balloon but it moved in a very strange way and was shaped more like a jellyfish. We watched while a 2nd object flew in extremely fast right above my head and they both moved to the same area of sky. Both objects stayed above my house for 10+minutes moving, twisting, almost dancing around. One was shaped like a worm and was doing flips almost. We watched both for over 10 minutes and have video and images. While reviewing the videos we noticed there appears to be multiple other objects flying it at different rates and speeds throughout the event. Small black shapes coming from one of the objects. At another point they sort of “glitch” and pull away from each other. They also appear to have a glow around them. After about 10-12 minutes they both just went away, slowly. We noticed our Ring camera stopped working during that time even though we were moving around the yard constantly to watch. We have never been able to find a place to report our sighting until this…

summary: Driving along when suddenly a passenger in the backseat noticed an odd object in the sky on a clear day that was definitely not an airplane.
description: 3 adults, 1 child witnessed a UFO one afternoon while driving home after running errands. An adult in the backseat first noticed this & brought it to driver/passenger's attention. Driver pulled the vehicle over in a safe spot to better view the unknown object. This was certainly not an airplane, or other familiar aircraft. Shaped like a cigar, it was white in color, made no noise at all, had no jetstream, and we attempted to get photos & video, which came out poorly, due to inexpensive cellphones & object being a great distance away. We were able to watch this for awhile before it seemingly faded away, disappeared then reappeared in a different part of the sky. It was very bizarre. This happened not far from Janine's in Ware, MA.

summary: Orbs appearing, slowing down, then dimming from left to right.
description: For multiple nights in a row, at least 4 local police officers wanting to remain anonymous have seen several orbs come into view at approximately 02:12 AM and in the same vicinity directly north of town each morning looking like bright and dim stars that change brightness and speed. The orbs continue for nearly and hour or longer each time we have seen them. Several appear to fly in tandem with each other, and others can appear alone. They appear at several different heights, and some can be brighter than the brightest stars in the sky, while others will be more dim than most. The orbs will also change brightness from time to time, going from dim to very bright, and vice versa. They have also appeared in tandem generating shapes such as triangles and hexagons as they pan across the sky. They are not consistent with Starlink, and after viewing the star link tracker, they can not possibly be related. At times, the orbs would be so bright, they would have an aura surrounding them as they panned across the sky, while at other times, they would be barely visible, both incidents happening within the same sighting as the sighting would occur. There were also, on few occasions during the…

summary: Craft went from right to left and stopped then floated and turned to the right and then flew off at about a 45 degree angle slow moving
description: The craft appeared a dull finish of silver. No windows, front tube shaped went back to a fan tailed flat shape at the back. No vertical tail. There was no noise, The sun was to the right and the sky was full blue. The craft was easily seen and didn't seem to reflect the sun, It was easy to see the shape of it. As it flew off towards the north west I could see that the rear had two darker areas on either side. Didn't see any sign of panels or seams. It was all very smooth. It looked like it was climbing in elevation as it flew off and got far enough away until it disappeared. At first sight it might have been a couple hundred feet off the ground. I'm guessing it to be 75 to 100 ft long.

summary: Bright melted reappeared. Followed by 5 more

Grabbed phone off charger came back out there it was again. By the time I turned camera on it did not reappear waited over 10 minutes filming and nothing. Hate to go to sleep. I am a retired medical professional and an avid skywatcher. Please inform me if any other reports come in. Started before 11pm. Cannot believe phone was indoors charging.

summary: Witnessed surreal UFO in Encino, CA. Massive object spinning with vibrant lights. Video evidence available for further investigation.
description:
A few nights ago in Encino, California, I was outside at 4 am, smoking and FaceTiming my friend who lives in the UK. I couldn't help but notice a peculiarly flickering streetlight about two houses away. As I continued to watch it for a couple of minutes, the flickering intensified, and suddenly, it was as if a separate light that was growing stronger and stronger emerged from the original light, as if it had been camouflaged within the flickering itself. The light grew incredibly fast, and I screamed to my friend that it was a UFO. In the blink of an eye, it was right in front of me, only two houses away, either facing me with its top or bottom side. The enormous object appeared to rotate, emitting vibrant flashes of green, red, blue, white, and other colors. It looked surreal, as though it had been plucked straight from a sci-fi movie.
If not for what happened next, I might have doubted my own sanity. Panicking, I tried to record the UFO with my phone, only to realize I couldn't do so while on a FaceTime call. I urgently instructed my friend to check his phone and record the phenomenon. As I aimed my camera at the UFO, he screamed, "What the fuck is that?" and started to…

The controller suggested it could possibly be a STARLINK satellite. Memphis ARTCC Quality Control Office is submitting the UFO Report online as a follow-up to the occurrence report. summary: Object traveling south-west towards rural area of the county. Dark-gray triangle shaped craft. Massive area
description: On 04/18/2023 on or about 2345 hrs I was sitting with a co-worker in a darkened area of a property just on the outskirts of the city in a vehicle. When I blacked out my vehicle. A moment later, I observed a triangle shape craft flying through the night sky; the object appeared to be dark gray with curriculum patterns on the bottom of the unknown craft. As I was talking with my co-worker I quickly startled him and asked him to look towards the sky. The object was in range for less than 10 - 20 seconds before it was out of sight over the darkened area.

summary: Sighted a strange hovering light above hills a near/on ground west of Paradise
description: Went outside to let in dog. Sighted a light northwest of Paradise hovering above the hills I’d never seen before. At times thought I might have seen two. It remained stationary and seemed to brighten and dim. I got my phone and took several videos. Upon zooming in the light appeared to be spinning and be comprised of several smaller lights giving off various colors. After 10 minutes of observation, it disappeared but then I noticed at least six more below on the ground.

summary: Multi flashing objects
description: Husband son myself and neighbors were outside and flashing lights started appearing but not moving.

summary: 2 extremely low "flying" lights no noise hovered then zoomed completely unnatural NOT aircraft lights (one light caught on camera)
description: While I was perched precariously on top a ladder installing new CCTV cameras at my recently deceased father's home my nephew said "hey nanny what's that?" I glanced back and immediately knew something wasn't right... I can't explain the feeling other than I was immediately concerned for our safety and wanted to get us away and safe (as a confirmed nightowl I can confidently say without doubt I have NEVER seen ANY THING like this before in my life!!! I am frequently outside in the country at night and typically alone and I have never been "spooked" I've done and seen ALOT but THIS was different somehow...) Not wanting to frighten my nephew I said "prolly just a plane" as I tried to climb down safely but swiftly! When I looked again the light was now fully visible (it had been partially hid from view by the tree tops across the road before) I now saw TWO HUGE yellow-ish lights hovering above the trees that line the road... My nephew said that the lights appeared to "be on fire" I replied I didn't see that and he said well my eyes are better than yours (true... Lol) he said it looked like how a fire "crackles" but again I only saw solid lights... Everything seems to be in slow motion…

summary: Not a craft and not an orb. Diamond shape, stayed in one spot, starburst like with red, white and blue colors.
description: Live at the base of the Catskill Mountains. Walking dog at night in my back yard. Looked up..West..towards the mountain range. Saw this diamond shape object. It did not move…..but had a starburst-twinkle like pattern. Remained stationary for about 5-8 minutes…..then just disappeared.

summary: Balls of light that fallow
description:
Had on going issue with balls of light, one very large and others very small at night in Maine for about the last year or so. I MOVED to SC a few days ago partly to see if the anomaly would surface again. And to attempt to rule out any drone theory.
Tonight the major bright light is very active and it displayed an ability to "dim down" when I would try to get a picture or video at one point. https://youtube.com/@crowbaril903

summary: A silver sphere shaped object was noticed while looking out over an open field.
description: This silver object was bright which may be from sunlight that was shining on it. This is what made me notice it but while driving it was only observed briefly. It seemed visible enough so that it did not resemble an airplane. At first it seemed stationary but then moving towards the Northwest.

summary: Flying above highway 401 during rush hour it was going east above the lights
description:
I thought it was a bird but it flew seamlessly. Then I thought it must be a drone. As it got closer I couldn’t understand what it was. Then I thought maybe it’s a plastic bag blown by the wind. There was no wind and this seemed to move controllably.
I figured once it flys by, I can see what type of drone it is, as it flew by there was no backing, only a small hump at the back. The only item I could compare it too was that of a dinner plate, but flying horizontally but in a vertical position. I was driving west, this was flying east, above the highway. I didn’t record a video and I kept making rational excuses that this was a man made drone.

summary: Looked like a sail boat type shape with red lights, very big
description: Humming sound woke me up and I laid there and tried to figure out what it was. I got up and looked out the window and put my face against the window to see if it was vibrating and when I looked back up to the sky, I saw this object that was kind of rectangle-shaped but oddly it looked like a sailboat with red lights around it. It was a pretty big object. By the way, even as far away as it was, when it disappeared from my site a few seconds later, the humming stopped. I was so shocked for a few seconds I couldn't move and I didn't have enough time to grab my camera off my nightstand to take a picture. I couldn't go back to sleep the rest of the night and felt like I needed to tell somebody about this. I did check the flight radar app on my phone to see if any airplanes or helicopters were in the vicinity of our home and there was none... maybe a small training plane from the naval air station but nothing that was near the size of what I saw. I would like to know what it was, if you could tell me.

summary: A white orb zigzagging and changing speed rapidly in the night sky.
description: I had walked out to take my dog to the bathroom and I looked up thinking it was a plane but the flashing light was way higher than a plane with fly and made no noise and would go in a zigzagging pattern whilst changing speed rapidly.

summary: Extremely large chevron with rounded nose, at least 3 bright lights underside flying 7 miles from Oceana NAS
description: Extremely large light gray/white? chevron with rounded nose flying 7 miles from Oceana NAS (Appeared to be making a loop around NAS). This UFO would be the size of 3 jets flying in group formation and had 3 bright lights located on its underside with one under the nose and another under each wing? UFO had a low humming engine noise-not really loud like the jets we see all the time.

summary: We were looking at a star formation and I wanted a photo and that appeared when I took photos.
description:
The craft appeared hazy like in upper right and then left hand corner.
The two ships seemed to follow it from right to left and look as though there are entering back into the craft on the last picture.

summary: Running Lights
description: Initially spotted three stationary white lights in the sky that were in a straight line parallel to the ground, due west, as a passenger in a vehicle traveling down highway 70, at mile marker 265. There was a decent amount of distance between them, not a massive amount, just enough to know that they were together. They stood out against the stars but did not emit an overpowering amount of light; Venus at the time was brighter than these objects. After noticing the lights, the far left light faded out and at the same time, another light of equal distance faded into sight to the right of the formation. This sequence happened again, the left light faded out and a new light appeared to the right of the formation. This sequence happened one last time, the left light faded out and a new light appeared to the right of the formation. I reached for my phone to open my camera app, and as soon as I did, the three visible lights all faded out to darkness at the same time. The distance of the formation was difficult to determine, they could have been out a few miles to as far as 30 miles, hovering over the White Sands Missile Range.

summary: Beam (ball shape) of light
description: I missed the turn off for the a11 so I was travelling real slow to get a turning spot next thing this beam of light come towards me and past my van I was stunned never seen anything travel as fast in my life and I worked in a navy base with fighter jets , no sound and it was low or seamed low to me

summary: I was in the traffic line looked up saw this craft and another craft eject from the main one
description: Middle of the day look up and see a disk shaped craft metallic shiny watched made several videos at one point looks like another craft ejects from the main craft and it begins to blink white and looks more like a ball. I was very shocked it was the middle of the day.. one video shows an airplane in the distance and it’s clearly not that. The background is a clear sky. April 17 2023 5:58 pm.

summary: Light Dots dancing in the sky
description:
- Several light dots dancing above near Ashford International Railway Station
- I was too nervous and tired. Therefore, I shut the curtain and buried myself in bed after taking the video.

summary: Orange fleet of lights in the sky.
description:
I was driving from Silverlake, WA towards Castle Rock, WA on Sunday night when to the right of me I saw what looked like a fleet of orange colored lights. At first I was like, what is that… thinking that they might have put up cell towers or something to warn planes of a hillside, but then I realize that they were actually something that was up in the air. Definitely NOT planes, or helicopters. Possible drones of some kind, but they all seemed to move kinda like burning embers that would be floating in the sky or fireflies, but they were at least the size of planes.
As soon as I got into Castle Rock I immediately pulled over and watched them cross over me. It looked like they were coming from the Southwest of me over towards the Columbia River heading Northeast.
I had been listening to a podcast and had my phone hooked to Bluetooth, and when I opened my camera to try and catch some footage of them I couldn’t find the video button (I swear it was like the icon wasn’t even on my phone.) I then disconnected from Bluetooth thinking that might be why the video wasn’t working, I was fumbling and full of adrenaline so I rang my mother who was in Silverlake and told her to run outside to…

Then will stop and dance again from left to right untill it finally disappears behind the tree line. It looks as if it may be changing colors, and so much bigger and brighter than all other stars. Looks nothing like satellites mentioned. Moves to erratically. In the past, you would see 2 of them. But it is now only 1. Does anyone know what this is that I am seeing?

summary: April 16, 2023, around 12 p.m., a large object reflected or shined light toward me. It was stationary and at a very high altitude.
description: On Sunday, April 16, 2023, around 12 p.m., I was outside my house in Old Hickory TN when I noticed a bright stationary light in the sky. It was very high and did not move. It was not a plane, a star, or a satellite. It was reflecting light or beaming light at odd intervals. Its shape seemed to be oval or like a figure eight. My wife also saw it with me. I tried to take a picture of it with my phone, but I couldn't zoom in far enough to get a clear image. It stayed in the sky for about 15 minutes and then disappeared.

summary: Bright light shining down on highway in front of me in the dead of night darkness
description: As I was heading North on I-39 on my way home from picking up my daughter from Nashville TN. This is a trip i have made numerous times and was very familiar with. I had set up check points along the way to determine how much more time I had left but something was strange that night, just ahead of us in the path of travel was a very bright light. At first, I thought I was just making better time than I thought because it would have been the next overpass in which all the exits have Street lighting, but as I go closer and closer, I noticed where I was and it's no way that its overpass lighting. At that time, I looked to my daughter and asked her if she sees the same light and her response was "yea Dad, I see it. What is it?" My response was I have no clue. So, I kept moving towards it. As we got directly under the light, which was still bright, I tried to look up out the windshield to see what it was. I couldn't see nothing but the light but as soon as I passed thru and looked in the review the light was gone. Not knowing what it was or what had happened I just told Arial something that wouldn't scare her so I brushed it off like must have been a helicopter or something searching…

summary: witnessed 6-7 lighted crafts
description:
While photographing the milky way on top of the dunes in great sand dunes national park, starting at 1:20 am to approximately 2:00 am or later. Witnessed 6-10 luminous craft flying in very bizarre patterns north of the park. We did photograph the lights. I have 5 raw photos I have exported as jpeg for this report of the lights from a sony a7riv 61 mp camera with a 14mm focal length. The lights changed luminosity constantly, sometimes disappearing completely and reappearing extremely brightly. The flight patterns were very fluid but bizarre and erratic, akin to fireflies. When zoomed into the photos, the streaks of the craft of the 30 second exposure photos exhibits what can be described as a pulsation of light or maybe a twisting of the craft. The crafts stayed up too long to be drones and were too bright and inconsistent to be anything ordinary.
Report alludes to he bright streaks to the left of the much more faint formation of Starlink satellites seen just abov the tops of the distant mountain top.  Photos are 30-second exposures.  To the eye, in real time, the "streaks" appeared to the witnesses to be "orbs."

summary: Sighted a large rectangular craft hovering above our property on a clear moonless night and viewed it for about five minutes.
description: It was a clear dark moonless night with a full complement of stars. We live on an 8-acre rectangular property with an old abandoned house about ¼ of the way up the property, a new house we built about 1/2-way up the property, and another 4 acres of woods at the top of the property, which slopes upward most of the way. I went to check the mail and was walking up the driveway and was in front of the old abandoned house when I realized that something was blocking out the stars above me. It was a rectangular-shaped craft about three times as long as it was wide, and it was just hovering there with what I perceived to be its “nose” pointing due east. There was a red light and a blue light visible on the bottom of the craft; not prominent but large enough to be easily seen. It also had what looked like two “headlights” on the nose of the craft. They reminded me of headlights because they emitted a clear white light such as headlights emit. I recall that I wasn't at all afraid, just intensely curious about what it could be. I was standing directly under it and it seemed immense, yet there was absolutely no sound coming from it. It just hovered there. We have tall fir trees around our…

summary: It appeared out of nowhere started moving slowly from West to east
description: From where I was sitting it it appeared out of the West side of the sky heading towards the east bright fireball looking thing moving slowly but what got my attention is when it stopped in mid air and started going backwards again then stopped started moving forwards again and that's when I ran in and told my dad there's something in the sky he came out and watched it with me. Then it turned right heading south and just disappeared.

summary: Seen in gap in clouds
description: Looked up and saw this. In the picture look for the Godzilla shape and then zoom into the “mouth” area and in the clear area you will see the disk shaped object. Clouds moved and didn’t see it again.

summary: Unknown object moving across sky zooms away
description:
Upon arriving at my wife’s salon, while walking in, I happened to look up in sky and observed something going across the sky. I initially thought it was a balloon. Something then didn’t feel right which led me to believe it was something else. Perhaps a drone. I tried to continue filming on my iPhone 13 max, however I wanted to see with my own eyes so at that point I stopped filming.
As soon as I stopped filming I saw two flashes. Then a few seconds later two more flashes. At this point I lost it and began recording again looking for it. I couldn’t find it. In the 14 second video after going inside and showing my wife and oldest daughter, my daughter asked did you see that? What she referred to was the very first second on the 14 second video.
It appears what ever I saw seems to Zoom down and away at high acceleration beyond anything I have ever seen. I would never have thought much about it until I saw that portion of video and felt the need to report this. I am a police officer in Massachusetts and would like to stay anonymous to the public. Thank you for your time.

region: Livermore/Sky over East Bay Area, CA

summary: Dog sensed it/barked into the sky. Grey sphere. 3-4 miles high. Zig zagged and paused between movement. Met with 2nd and took off.
description:
I am submitting this report to document my observation of an unidentified aerial phenomenon (UAP) in the vicinity of Langley Air Force Base. I was sitting in the front yard of my residence, accompanied by my dog, when the sighting occurred. My dog growled and barked at something in the sky, and her unusual reaction to the UAP prompted me to investigate and document the occurrence.
Description of the UAP
After I discovered what my dog was reacting to, I observed the UAP at an estimated altitude of 3-4 miles, and it exhibited a grayish, spherical appearance. Its flight patterns are characterized as sporadic, rapid zig-zag movements without any signs of gradual acceleration. Instead, the object displayed instantaneous changes in motion. Between movements, the UAP paused momentarily, distinctly stopping in mid-air before altering its trajectory, an action inconsistent with the known capabilities of conventional aircraft.
Analysis of Possible Explanations
In an attempt to rationalize the observed phenomenon, I considered various explanations, such as insects or birds. However, the object's considerable altitude and atypical behavior quickly ruled out such possibilities. I also…

summary: Small greenish light .
description: Small green light that was below the cloud line and moved at a medium speed that went down in front of me and was gone in about 2 seconds.

summary: Two unknown lights behaving strangely
description: I am a pilot and know what to expect to see in the night sky. I do not drink or use drugs. At 2:30 in the morning there should be almost nothing. But tonight I looked out my south facing balcony window to see two very orange lights in the south west sky. These lights were too orange or bright to be landing lights. My estimate would put them around 20,000 feet up and spaced roughly 3 miles apart. What really caught my eye was how they were in almost perfect formation as if intentionally. I opened foreflight, my app for tracking aircraft locations and there was nothing shown to be flying nearby. Then one would move more eccentrically. Until eventually the second more tame one disappeared. Possibly just turning off their light. I recorded a video of the transition to one. Then as the remaining one got to a distance that appeared to be within 5 miles I tried to run downstairs to see it from outside. However when I got outside I couldn’t find it again. I heard no sound of aircraft the entire time. Within 15 minutes the sky went from completely clear to a cloud front rolling in from the west. Concealing anything at high altitude.

summary: A somewhat softly triangular shaped light, the color of an old streetlight (yellowish-orange)
description:
I was on a walk home when I looked into the sky as I normally would when outdoor and especially on a walk. I noticed what I thought was a bright star before realizing there was overcast. Within seconds of me watching it, I seen it go East with the speed of a shooting star. Within seconds of the object moving away from my location, I heard but did not see a gentle roar, as if it were a Jet or being followed by a Jet. There were no lights though and I have never seen or heard any sort of aircraft move this fast. I am unsure if the initial object made this noise as it took off or if something else was on its trail that I just couldn't see. It was only a matter of 15 seconds or so before this "light object" was out of sight. I have told a few people that I trust very much but or course I just sound crazy. Without a doubt, I seen something unexplained.
After being home and speaking to some friends/family about it. I did experience a black out/fainted which I've never had happen before. This could be purely coincidence, however, I now have a bruised spine and brised ear/jaw from the fall. (I am only adding these details because of the questions following this statement)

summary: A shiny round object flew from west. It flew below the clouds, than turned North.
description:
I spotted a bright shiny dot on a blue sky that was flying fast above the town from the west. I called my father to see it. It flew below the clouds, father grabbed binoculars. After a moment object started to turn north above Chapelstown area. I spotted tiny wings sticking out from otherwise oval object as it began the manouver. summary: An unusually fast, straight tracking object, at passenger flight altitude
description: First, this is the first time I have ever reported seeing a UAP. I am fully aware that most UAP can be identified, and that certainly may be the case here. However, this was so unusual, that I have felt the need to at least report what I saw. My wife and I were at the beach in Delaware. The East Coast of the US is, obviously, a major fly-way for airport traffic. We saw many jets that day, at cruising altitude. We also see military aircraft from time to time as well. In the middle of the afternoon I observed a cylindrical/spherical/circular-like disk traveling at a rate of speed that was anomalous to all other aircraft. It was moving in a straight path heading ENE out over the ocean at a high altitude. I knew I had never seen anything like it before. I could not hear any aircraft-related sound, as is typical with other aircraft. I attempted to get my wife to visually verify, but it was moving too quickly and it was out of sight very quickly. I dismissed the possibility of a drone, because it was too high, and too large. It was definitely not a passenger plane or military aircraft that I am familiar with. The most logical, and easiest explanation is that it was just an ordinary…

summary: Elongated, silver, reflective object hovering over Capitol
description:
I exited my hotel on School St with a co-worker. Upon looking up, I saw a thin, roughly cylindrical looking object in the sky. The object was oriented vertically and was silvery looking. It was silver in color and was occasionally glinting in the sunlight. It was not an airplane, and reminded me of a long, skinny mylar balloon. I pointed it out to my coworker, and he made a similar observation, but was relatively uninterested. Based on the surrounding buildings and the viewing angle, I would estimate it was between 2000 and 8000 ft. I cannot say with certainty how long it was, but would estimate maybe 20-30 ft and a couple feet in diameter. Its long axis was vertical. Of course, if the object was really high, it could have been the size of an aircraft fuselage.
The day was spectacularly clear and beautiful. The sky cloudless and winds calm.
Per consulting a map, it was approximately directly above the US Capitol Building.
I can accept that this was probably a balloon. I am sure it was adequately checked out and evaluated by the authorities . But, I wanted to report it mainly because of where I saw it.

summary: Bright white craft stays mostly still in the early morning.

location: Estimated around Grand Junction, CO, USA
summary: What seemed to be crafts with bright lights rotating in circle formations descending to earth, then ascending later on.
description:
I’m a first officer on a Boeing 737-800 cargo jet and while at 38,000ft just passed Albuquerque on a flight from Dallas to Las Vegas my captain and I noticed individual bright lights moving relatively slowly in a circular motion descending from the sky a few hundred miles north and well above our altitude. We couldn’t tell whether it was 10-20 circling lights or 4-5 circling around each other. After watching them descend from high altitude from west to east they later departed in the same fashion and ascended back into the sky in an east to west direction of flight. We looked up starlink’s position during our time of flight and it would not have been visible that night. These objects also traveled in opposite directions (originally descending West to East, then ascending East to West). These objects also did not appear to be other aircraft as there were no position or strobe lights visible, furthermore the bright lights were far brighter than an aircraft I’ve seen, especially at such high altitudes. The area around Grand Junction is our best guess. We were over Albuquerque at FL380 and the objects appeared North Northwest a few hundred miles and very high altitude.
Please do not…

summary: Several Flashing objects in sky
description: There are about 10 objects in the sky at varying distances away. Some as far as to appear like a star, then some close enough to see as though it were a plane. All of these objects are flashing white, red, and blue lights. When one flew overhead, is was close enough to see that it appeared at first to look like a plane but then possibly a diamond shape. The front was flashing white almost as if the shape of a unicorn horn. Then one side flashed blue light and the other side flashed red light. Some of the objects appear to hover stationary while other fly away. However, when one flys away, another will appear, keeping about 10 in sight consistently. They also appear to ascend quite quickly as if jumping up stairs to the sky.

summary: 10’x10x10’ magnificent triangle craft aprox 25 feet in the air flew slowly over us and past us at a somewhat slow pace.
description: My girlfriend and I were in an outside for a couple of hours because it was just a gorgeous night. We had the back door open again just going in and out here in there when my girlfriend stepped out back and in an instant told me to come here, as I went out back she asked is that a plane? At first I said yes but immediately I realized it was far from a plane. It was flying relatively low maybe 25/30 feet in the air, approaching from the east and at first you couldn’t really make out what shape it was. In front it had blue, red and green lights. It look like just a straight line approaching us again somewhat slowly and low. But as it came closer and closer to the point where it was directly over our head, you can clearly see it was a brilliant triangle underneath it had four lights. Lights of colors I’ve never seen before, on each of the corners of the triangle they were this gorgeous and brilliant red color. In the middle, it was this golden yellow light. I could have literally threw a tennis ball with no strength and hit. It almost felt like it was a personal experience just for us, and it kept flying towards the west. Again, at a slow pace. It made no sound whatsoever, and it…

summary: Round ball of light lasted 5 mins
description: I was letting my dog out around 10:30 pm. I was standing in front of my apartment when I looked up to the sky and noticed something was hovering in the air, it was too big to be a star but maybe a little bigger than a plane. It was about and air plane height. Was just hovering in the air for about 5ish mins. I saw white, green, blue and red lights all come from it. I went inside as I was scared and don’t know if it disappeared after that or what.

summary: A big bright circle in the sky is not moving it is just floating in the sky
description: A really bright circle in the sky not moving or doing anything its just floating there like a ufo

summary: Group of shimmering lights jiggling in sky
description: They are perhaps colored, with reddish or bluish tints, and are staying pretty much in the same position relative to Venus and each other. There are about 10 or 15 lights, maybe more. I cannot see a background object that the lights might be attached to. The array is about half the size of Cassiopeia (that is a rough estimate; I am not actually looking at Cassiopeia when I say that). The lights shimmer and dance slightly but are constant when viewed with binoculars. (When I was watching it without binoculars they appeared to be fizzling out and restarting.)

summary: Light pulsating in the sky that started to fly around in the same spot doing circles in the sky
description: When my daughter(who was 4 years old at the time) and I got out of the car, I started to get the clothes out to take them inside the laundromat. My daughter yelled "look mommy a shooting star", and I looked up at the sky to see what she was talking about. Once I started looking at what she thought was a star, indeed it was shooting up like a shooting star, but then it just stopped moving and started having this green glow pulsating around it. I instantly took my phone out and started recording. I recorded for about 2-3mins, and during this time the object had changed colors, did circles in the sky, and it would go back and forth from a very bright light to a very dark spot in the sky. It even changed shapes while it was flying(circle object to a long rectangular object then back to a circle).

summary: Fast moving object with tail traveling west over Seattle
description:
On the evening of 4/12/23, I was shooting stock night footage of Seattle for my drone company. I had not looked over all the full resolution videos on my PC until last night, 4/16.
Upon watching one of the videos, I saw what looked like a rocket powered aircraft or missile in the sky above Seattle. I played the video back multiple times and could not rule it as lens flare since the light source in the video had a definitive tail that did not change direction as the camera panned the cityscape. I reviewed the evening flight traffic using https://www.flightradar24.com/   at the specific time I was filming, which the plane traffic matched my clip, but zero westbound flights are in view on the map.
In the attached video clip, the object enters frame from the left (east) moving right (west) at a high rate of speed. The aircraft traveling towards the camera are going north, at approximate speeds of 300+ mph, per flightradar24 records of those flights at those locations.
If you feel this clip is worth investigating, I have a higher quality original video directly from the camera that has not been compressed for upload.

summary: Various probes observed at Chisholm Trail Park
description: I saw various probes at an altitude higher than skyscrapers and lower than airplanes. I initially thought they were birds but they became dark and then light up with a clear sky and no clouds at this time of day. They moved making designs and at times looked like tentacles of a jellyfish. It looked liked about 30 - 40 probes. All of a sudden they disappeared and I only had 2 witnesses that saw it.

summary: Saw flying orb
description: I saw an orb flying fast 3 different days at the same location. Fortunately I could record it the last time but I used my phone to do so. I’m not sure what it was but I felt I should report it. Attached is a screenshot from my video recording.

summary: Either one or two objects seen, white lighted objects , angle formation. Moving fast and silent, low enough to see turbulence
description: Stepped outside. Noticed two lights in the sky. Thought it was a meteor or something of sorts. But it seemed to be way lower, As I could see the turbulence on the object as it or they flew across the sky. Going south to north. There was absolutely zero aircraft noise. I've seen many satellites and other random things in night sky but this seemed to be an actual aircraft of sorts in the sky. If I had to guess height I would say at least 2500-4000ft up, it was low.

summary: A far distance in the sky as a little red dot! Came down with speed that was not normal! Changed shape disappeared abnormal speed.
description: There was four cars including mine that saw this event. It started out as being a little red dot in the sky and begin to materialize as a larger red beam. It was a very far distant and came down with abnormal speed, approaching our cars. As it came closer, the shape changed and look like a Jelly with little rubbery fringes around it and was vibrating. I told my nephew hurry and take a picture and time I requested this it zoomed back into the sky with such speed we didn't even see it leave and we looked in the sky and it was far, far away to the East over the Lake Michigan! The SUV that was next to my car had a young man sitting with his body out on the window seal of the car, saying; what is that. And the strangest part of this ordeal, is that it seemed like we were suspended in time. None of us could move our cars and the light was green! I went to the Kenosha police to report this incident. I do not know if the the other three cars of people reported it or not.

summary: Objects would fade in and out, changing altitude, speed and direction.
description:
I am an overnight delivery driver and for the past 3 mornings in a row I have seen multiple orb/star like objects appearing and disappearing over the NE sky from my location (Would put objects over Central MO). The objects appear from between 2am and 4am and will appear to "dance" around the sky, changing altitude, direction and traveling at insane speeds.
The first morning I witnessed 4 of the objects together, the second morning two, and this morning I seen 3, however I was only able to get a partial picture of two of the objects before they faded away.
The objects do not appear to have any lights similar to that of aircraft also flying in the sky, as you can see airplanes in the sky with their flashing beacons where as these objects are a solid color that fades in and out as they move.
I did check multiple flight radars to see if there was a group of aircraft in or around the area where they might be flying, but nothing was found.
The fact it has occured 3 mornings in a row, either tells me its the government testing some secret aircraft near Whiteman Air Force Base, or the objects are indeed UFOs.

summary: 4 objects total, emitting dim white lights, low altitude, even speed, flew at high speed but were completely silent
description: At about 2am I witnessed three unidentified flying objects (UFOs) in a formation heading in the direction of Lackland air-force base. About a minute later, another object with same features flew in the opposite direction. The three UFOs were low enough that I could see them making minor adjustments in their position between each other, indicating that they were independent from each other and not connected. They had a circular shape and emitted white lights, but lights were dim, each object had same light intensity, shape and size. Objects were not very noticeable if not flying directly above. They flew right above me and quickly blended in with the night sky as they moved away. They did not make any sudden or erratic maneuvers but rather flew in a linear direction. They were fast, but there was no sound associated with them. I remember clearly at that time there was no wind, or clouds. they looked too large and too quiet to be drones. They also flew in a restricted airspace, which would require permission to operate drones. This happened around 1:50-2 am, when there was very little traffic or people around, and at that time I don’t remember any cars or people in the area. The…

summary: Hovering craft with blinking lights of different colors, no sound, then vanished
description:
I was in my backyard at about 1:45 AM with my dog and I always look up at the stars to find certain constellations, the moon, shooting stars, etc. This time I noticed what I first assumed was a helicopter hovering in the western sky. But it was much higher up than helicopters usually are and seemed too big to be a helicopter and there was no sound coming from it. I could not really tell the shape of the craft because it was dark out. I could only see the lights, some of which were blinking. There were at least 3 lights, white, blue and red which made me think it was a law enforcement helicopter but again, too big and too high. I watched it for about 30 seconds to a minute and then turned to go back inside my house, then looked back and it was gone. I had looked away for exactly 5 seconds because I have a trail camera set up on my patio to take 10 second videos of wildlife triggered by a motion detector and it captured videos of me and my dog while we were in the yard. So I can see exactly how long it was from when I looked away to when I looked back and couldn't see the object anymore. I don't know if flew off at a high rate of speed or simply turned off its lights.
If I had to…

description: Security cam alerted me of motion directed. When I review the camera I saw this flash of the light beam up on the top left corner of the video.

summary: Saw bright white lights followed by a dimmer light that moved erratically and sometimes very quickly while staying aloft for 4+ hrs
description:
Night of Tuesday 4/11, early morning Wednesday 4/12
(Clear night after the first very warm day of the spring here. Very little cloud cover; clear enough that several stars were visible throughout the night. I have tall windows and can see a great deal of open sky, looking north mostly across a large parking lot, with my view of the sky blocked only by one other building, a few trees, and the foothills off to the west.)
At approximately 1:20am, while seated at my desk in front of my north-facing, third-floor window in North Boulder, a bright spot of white light caught my eye. Fairly high in the sky, it lasted for about five seconds before moving straight horizontally to the right (a short distance from my vantage point), with the light dissipating as it moved until it faded out completely within the span of about a second. Light was much brighter than any other object in the sky at the time. (Throughout the night, small planes were visible periodically.) Very hard to discern distance.
Roughly 10 minutes later, I saw the same thing again, lower down in the sky. Similarly bright, it repeated the pattern, staying stationary for a moment and then fading out quickly as it began to move…

summary: Bright orb changing shape and rotating 3 days in a row
description: I have extensive photo and video over 3 days. The bright orb has appeared 3 days in a row. It hovers silently, is very bright, rotates and changes shape. I see 2 other people have reported it on here. One calls it a "disco ball in the sky" and that is a great description. I have video of it disappearing from sight. It throws off sparkling lights, and sometimes there are several small bright orbs in what appears to be a fleet. Several sightings have been concurrent with reports of meteor/fireball.

summary: A large blue light bobbing in the western sky with occasional random flashes of red.
description: Blue object spotted bobbing in the western sky that occasionally and randomly flashed red.

summary: 3 stars orions belt. Inside left of orions belt stars bright light very fast 4 times same star and stop.
description:
Got out of car talking to my brother. Saw a bright light moving almost like a shooting star so I pointed it out to my brother and his son. The light got alittle brighter as it passed through and disappeared but then it happened again moving same direction exact same spot start and stop. Their were planes you could see flying in same area passing through but not nearly as fast as the lights and obvious blue and red lights and flashing on planes. The lights had no tracer behind them either like a falling star.
The light would be dim then get brighter as it passed through orions belt and dim out and disappear same spot. All 4 times exactly the same way. Also plans flying through lights on plane never disappeared so not like it was clouds or anything. Very clear night.

summary: 2 very dark, silent, unlit objects moving together, one behind the other. Low in the sky, difficult to confirm shape in dark sky.
description: 2 objects observed moving super fast, one behind the other, making a couple slight, subtle but distinct direction changes, dark but faintly brighter than night sky over the city, no lights as you would see on a plane, silent. Not birds, too quiet for unlit drones, too fast for balloons. Seen moments ago from the roof while stargazing on a clear night here in San Francisco. Total duration observed was 15 to 30 seconds max before they passed behind buildings and my view was obscured. Too dark and blurry to determine a clear geometric or distinct shape, but they were somewhat flat and long, possibly thicker in the middle. I’ve seen commercial aircraft, the ISS, satellites and the Starlink train in the night sky but I’ve never seen anything remotely like this before. April 11, 2023, 8:45PM.

summary: Light from the east moving at incredible speed, then comes to dead stop.
description:
I was sitting on the patio outside my cabin just after dusk. The ship was moving south and i was on the port side on floor 9. My eyes caught a white light moving east to west. It was 15-20 degrees above the horizon and moving at an amazing speed in line with the horizon. I am a private pilot and live 15 miles from Luke AFB. See fighter jets all the time. Have never seen anything move this fast. And light suddenly stopped completely. It sat still for maybe a second. Then slowly went straight up and back to the east. It was gone from sight in a split second. I cannot possibly emphasize the speed it was moving
when it came to a complete stop. I would be amazed if the crew on the bridge did not see it as it would have been right on their port view. I have replayed this in my head a thousand times. Never seen anything like this. Thank you.

summary: Three person observed a 12' black ring that descended and vanished in 30 secs
description: Witness reported that this incident had occurred in his side yard and it had lasted approximately 30 seconds. The incident was also witnessed by a friend whose name was removed from the report. It had happened on a beautiful spring day with a clear blue sunny sky without any wind or anything else unusual. He and his wife, Lisa, were chatting in their driveway when he suddenly noticed some sort of unknown black object just appear about 50 ft overhead. The object appeared out of thin air in total silence. It did not seem to have any sort of propulsion. The object or "enigma" was a 12 foot ring or circle, black in color. He was unable to identify what it was. It had a gigantic 12 foot wide spiral "corkscrew" device that was slowly rotating under the ring or circle. He immediately alerted Lisa of what he was watching and she also witnessed the same strange enigma. They both just stared in awe as the weird object descended downward. As it was about to touch down, the object just vanished into thin air. It just disappeared. In less than a second. What ever this enigma was, is a total mystery. It did not leave any clues as to what it may have been, or where it may have come from or if it…

It was very dark with no lights and almost wasn’t visible. summary: Silent, came out of the west and then made almost a complete circle disappearing to the northwest over the houses.
description: Maybe a minute before, the critters in the woods started running around. Being that it's dark, I assumed the critters were just active. Then look up to the sky and saw a ufo. Very cool. Then I realize the critters went quiet.

It left, made a circle back to the same exact spot and the same thing, same pattern. Two videos from same area, different side of the river during the day.
