description: I've been seeing objects like this almost every night for over a year. They are very bright and emit all kinds of colors. When I look at them with binoculars I see what is seen in video just with more detail. The border of these things isn't constant. summary: 3 colorful lights stationary, than one by one they would disappear to the south
description: It was my during my graduation of high school at the WSU Vancouver campus. My friend and I were sitting in the grass celebrating graduation. After a while of being there that night, we had noticed 3 stationary colorful lights towards the east side of the campus. After noticing them for about 15 minutes, the farthest light to the east disappeared at incredible speeds to the south. After about another 5 minutes the middle light did the same thing. About another 5-10 minutes had gone by and the last light had followed the other’s direction. I am now 25 years old and still cannot get what I saw out of my head. I have never been able to figure out where to send this information to nor who I could trust to tell. It was the most incredible phenomenon I have ever seen.

summary: Flickering object, changing colors
description: Initially I thought I was observing a satellite orbiting the earth until I realized this object was flickering and changing colors. It varied between blue, green, purple, red and white. It was completely silent but moved slowly up and down in the sky. Also appeared to have a tail that was glowing as well. When I went to the window to get a closer look I heard a loud powerful propulsion lasting a couple seconds then no more to report. During the time I saw lights there was no sound just silence. After the propulsion noise no more sighting.

Almost looked like it was over the water, but you could see the other side of the water where another town was & we don't know. It was confusing. Didn't move at all, if any movement it looked as though it was almost lightly lightly hovering in a counterclockwise circle ⃔up then back down and up but micro movement to the naked eye if any. Tried to take a video it was so hard to get it to focus. Almost looked like the light was diffracting from a triangle like shaped object. We are still mad confused, it didn't leave and eventually we left and went home. Could have been nothing but it felt like it was something, I was so confused why no one else was sussed out. It was a beautiful night as well and you could see all the stars, but there was a bit of haze where…

It has sparks occasionally flying off randomly at any side; one minute there would be several sparks the next few minutes there would be only a few. It moved in all different directions - up, down, left, and right - and often hovered in one stationary place. Over the 45 minutes that I watched it, it moved slowly in the west direction until it was out of view. Got a small video of it but couldn’t see any of the sparks with my camera quality.

summary: While looking out a window of the house a ball of orange light appeared in the trees past a neighbor’s house.
description:
My background I am in customer support, and a musician. I want to start this off by saying I’ve been trying to actively make contact for a while now using meditation and CE-5-like cognitive thought sequencing techniques. I tried something similar at 8:00 - 8:45 pm tonight while on a night walk and sitting in my backyard looking for any anomalies. I did see two very high, distant white lights that traveled off, one of them flaring, but it was impossible to know if they were anything significant or just space trash or something.
At 10:30 pm I was standing in my dark bathroom brushing my teeth and I happened to look out the window. In the trees past my neighbor’s house an orange light suddenly appeared and flared. It blinked at me. I called my partner in saying “I think it’s a UFO.” He took one look at it and had the usual instinctual fear reaction he has when he sees something unusual and he left the room. It continued to blink at me, then disappeared.
For a moment nothing happened, and I opened the window so I could listen for any sounds or anything unusual. Then it returned again and disappeared again after about a minute of being there.
Out loud, I very quietly said, “Do you mind…

It had 3 or 4 square or rectangular mirror sides and looked like it might have been rotating slowly. I was driving and saw it for about 2 minutes and took my eyes off to drive. summary: An object that sounds like a prop airplane
description: Had just come home from day out at the movies. I asked my dog to get his favorite toy. A stuff Scooby-Doo. We went outside to play a little. I heard an airplane approaching. It was a sound of a propeller airplane. The sound a single engine prop airplane. I was looking at the northwestern when I saw it flying west and close enough but still out of sight to see if its an airplane. The airplane looked white or that was what my brain was thinking. I lost it in the sky here and there. I took out my cellphone and took some pictures of it and aimed the phone in the direction it was flying. I plugged my ears and unplugged them and the sound of the airplane was gone but I could still see the object going west. I kept my sights on it and it disappeared. I went back in the house and I examined the pictures. I took two good pictures of the object. The object in the first picture has a whitish triangle with three lights that make up a triangle and a dome in middle. The second picture has just the three lights with faint triangle. Both of the pictures have the object with black tips at the pointy ends of the triangle.

I observed it for around 10 or 15 seconds before it vanished. I checked ADSB maps and weather radar but saw nothing in the area.

description: We spotted this object above our home last night at approximately 10:15 pm. It was oddly shaped and looked like a fireball flying horizontally the way an airplane would in a fairly straight line. We were on our back patio and as the object flew over our roof I ran to the front of the house and it seemed to take a 90° turn and then fly into the distance quite quickly. It all of a sudden was just gone. It was like a light flicked off

summary: Continuous fireball almost like a Roman candle, resembled a comet but definitely wasn’t a “shooting star.”
description: Sighting was around 9:30 PM CST. My friend and I both saw a large fireball shoot across the sky. I was facing Northeast and the object traveled from my right to my left, then disappeared. It was an incredible bright white and left a solid white tail behind the initial light source that faded rather quickly. At first we thought it was a Roman candle type firework but then realized it was too large and intense as well as too high in the atmosphere to be a firework. The closest thing that I’ve personally witnessed that I could compare it to would be the Hale-Bopp Comet, but I haven’t been able to find any reports of meteor activity in my area.

summary: Color changing, appears to be spinning UFO over Lake Champlain
description: It was spotted from the bedroom window of a lake house on Lake Champlain. I had just settled in for the night and was innocently gazing out my window, as one does, when I saw it. The object appeared to be spinning as it changed from green to fuchsia to deep purplish blue to teal and back again. It remained stationary in the sky while this took place. It's still in the sky an hour later, though it doesn't feel like an hour has elapsed. My father went outside to see for himself and captured footage of his own.

I thought it may have been a meteor entering the atmosphere. Then it became more visible. It was one craft with what seemed like 3 lights, lined horizontally, all touching. There was also a yellowish/greenish aura around the craft. The craft seemed to get closer and closer, with the lights getting larger, but still seemed far away. It was hard to tell, I felt it was far away but could reach us very quickly it it wanted to. We watched it hover in the sky for a while. Hovering up and down, it almost seemed like it's distance was moving closer to us very slowly. But hovering at the same time. We watched this for probably about 10-15 minutes. We went back inside for maybe another 20-30 minutes and decided to venture to the front yard…

Standing in my suburban backyard at 6:45pm EST looking at the stars facing West. I saw the object as it passed directly overhead heading in a South Westerly direction.  The object was triangular in shape with approximately 10 lights on the forward two sides and 3 on the rear side.  The lights were white and not flashing. Stars were blacked out within the triangle as it passed over.
The object appeared to be the size of a football field in width and there was no sound whatsoever.  It appeared to be quite close.
I lost sight of the object as it passed over a hill to the South West.   The object was visible to me for approximately 20 seconds.

location: Cayo Costa state park/ gulf of mexico, FL, USA
summary: Watched one row of lights coming off gulf which we thought to be an airplane without strobes. It was extremely slow and stopped.
description:
We were anchored in our boat and set up for the evening. I was idly watching airliners now and then come and go, not many but easily known by landing lights and strobes. I am an ex pilot and familiar with this. I kept noticing this row of lights coming slowly towards us at a lower altitude than commercial craft, in fact it's slowness is what got my attention. Finally I noticed it had become stationary.
The night was dark with mild humidly which allowed me to then notice a light emitting out of what you may describe as wings, 90 degree to the craft. Primarily aiming towards us was a light or lights, one in the middle and others further out. Looking at it with binocs they seemed to be rainbow colors other then primary white.The craft now just set there near our boat and I judged it to be quite large. After 20 minutes or so, due to the lights shining out into the atmosphere which glowed somewhat like a flashlight in the humidity, I could see a wobble as though it were balanced with whatever kept it afloat was aimed downward like a gravity cancellation device, certainly not blades or jets for lit was completely silent .This wobble is reported by other observers in other circumstances…

It almost looked like one of the surveillance balloons that were recently shot down by our military except it was emitting a bright blinking light. It’s hard to gauge the size of the object but if I were to try I would have to say that it was at least as big as a public transit bus. summary: 3 lights forming a triangle, converging, disappearing. Then reappearing forming a triangle, converging then disappearing again.
description:
We were the pilots from United 1325 DEN-PDX. About 50 miles from the northwestern border of Colorado on a heading of 285 at 38,000ft we noticed a series of lights, appearing at first to look like 3 light bright stars or satellites forming a triangle, at 2'clock high. As we watched this the lights moved going west to east then up and down converging and then disappearing. They stayed in our approximate 1:30 to 2'clock position appearing to be well above us. The patterner of forming a triangle, converging, moving, and then disappearing continued every 2-3 minutes for approximately 20 minutes as we passed the Wyoming border and then into Utah. They appeared to be far away at a high altitude.
The other pilot I was flying with mentioned that he had seen the same moving pattern of lights on a different day in the same location in northwestern Colorado.

summary: Very large bright light in sky below cloud cover. Stock still for 2 minutes then vanished with no exiting trajectory. Just vanished.
description:
At about 5:20 am, sky was still dark and cloudy. I looked out of my large picture window from a dark room to see a very bright, large light in the rural sky above the foothills, which were less than two miles away. Normally there are no lights of any kind in that area of the view or horizon.
First thought was large planet or airplane. Eliminated possibility of planet as it was cloudy and seemed below cloud level. And could not see any other stars or planets or moon.
I stared at it extensively to detect any movement. But it did not move. So not an airplane.
Just kept staring at it. Then after about 2-4 minutes, it vanished from the spot. Like a light switch turning off, it vanished.
No one was with me nor in the room. It was not a reflection in the window glass.
Background: I’m 52 years old, educated and never experienced anything like this before. But I have a deep interest in physics. I was wide awake at the time of sighting.

summary: Very Bright Erratic Lights Appeared to Spread out and Jump Forward and Backwards
description:
Went to the window when I heard a plane passing by the area a little after 9pm. I spotted the plane heading away in a South West direction then noticed another light I thought was a helicopter. At first the light was only a small point of light in the sky but appeared to be moving closer to my location following along MA Rt. 3 North.
After the plane was no longer audible I noticed no sound from the approaching light. The light was bright white with red flashes and appeared to be moving in erratic ways but in a direction closer towards my location. About halfway to when I lost sight the light about the size of a dime at arms length seemed to spread out creating a gradient of copies of in front of itself then snapped back to a more disk circle shape. I could not make out any detail of the underlying structure. The highway passes about six properties down from my location and watching the lights pass by it was about the size of a small plate at arms length. Estimating about 200 to 400 feet above the highway and I got the sense it was fairly large but totally silent.
Anyone driving up MA Rt. 3 last night between 9-9:30pm should have had a pretty good view of the light show.

summary: At least 2 or 3 low flying silent crafts one was bluish and white the other was greenish and the last one was black with red lights
description:
3 crafts one bluish and fairly stationary the second one looked green and yellow with wire like appendages floating around the craft.
The 3rd was black with red lights looked transparent as if I could see the operator tall white long legs. This craft came down my street silent and slow turned above my Nieghbors house to the right hesitated and slowly moved off towards the north gradually gaining altitude. No sound at all the size of a small bus that came to a point also with wire like appendages flowing around.This went on for well over an hour. I have pictures that look like it’s small and far away but these were flying just above the roof tops. I didn’t think to video it. It was a clear cold night and these were not drones or helicopters, they emitted no sound at all. These were brightly lit , I believe that the one that looked transparent had an operator in a seated position moving arms around controlling the aircraft.
This is a true statement I was not drinking or under the influence of anything. I am 60 years old and never seen anything like this in my life.

summary: Blinking lights but not a plane
description:
On my hammock tonight enjoying a clear sky, I saw a white light blink in the West sky almost directly where I was looking. I thought to myself “”where did that plane come from” and I honestly just thought that I had missed it traveling across the sky. So I locked eyes on it and it blinked two more times in the same position then stopped. I thought it was odd because plane lights don’t stop. So I kept looking. About 30 seconds to a minute later, I saw a brighter light flash slower to the left, about an “arms length” away (when held up to the sky). It was bigger than the first. Now I was really confused. Then after a minute, back closer to the original spot, another flash of a light two times.
I stared for a long time afterwards. I saw two typical small satellites cross the sky. I am use to those. But the other lights were much larger and brighter. I have never seen anything like that and never reported anything in my life.
It may be total coincidence, but when this was happening my dog and other neighborhood dogs were all barking. Before the incident, I heard a plane to the east of me.

Given the military uniforms I fear they might have a political agenda and may be planning acts of domestic terrorism. My photos aren’t great, but I am willing to hand over the images I have to the authorities. If there’s a plausible explanation for what I’m seeing I don’t know what it is.

summary: Saw craft with multicolor flashing/strobing lights s
description:
Saw what i thought was an odd color star (blueish green). Looked with binoculars and realized it was some type of craft very very slowly moving in sky over tree line while looking south east. Blue green red white and yellow lights flashing and rotating. Almost as if it were spinning. We watched it for about 30 minutes. We got 2 pictures that show some type of strange light/lights. In one picture you can see a star above in the frame. No sound that we could hear.It slowly moved away (south) and eventually went behind clouds appearing less bright until we could no longer see it. A plane actually flew past it while we were watching. Not really close but in same field of view.
Very unusual. We plan on setting up our telescope tomorrow night to see if it returns.

summary: 5 bright orange lights in a straight line. Disappeared and reappeared farther to the west.
description:
08MAR23
Approximately 9:00 pm
Five bright orange lights in a straight line appeared in the sky for approximately 10-15 seconds. The lights disappeared from view for a short period of time only to reappear a short distance to the west. After 10-15 seconds, the lights disappeared again. After approximately 1 minute, one large bright orange light appeared farther to the west. Commercial aircraft with flashing lights could be seen moving elsewhere in the sky. I checked Flight Radar 24 and could find commercial aircraft, but nothing in vicinity to the lights I observed.
Grissom AFB is east of this location. Perhaps it was a military aircraft dropping flares? I did not perceive any vertical motion as though something was falling towards the ground.
I attached a History Channel picture for reference. This is similar to what I observed.

summary: I saw a triangle of lights hovering quietly about 250 feet above Hwy 65 in Warsaw, Mo, with a sequenced series of flashes.

Usually it comes in from Clinton, Mo, to the west, then it circles back just south of Hwy 7 and lands. I've seen it a couple of time, and while it's creepy seeing it land right next to the hwy at night, it's obvious what it is.
We live near Whiteman AFB, so the airspace is controlled by the military. The only aircraft we see here are Air Force planes and choppers, the life-flight helicopter and on occasion a cesna.
But this object was North of Hwy 7 by about a half mile just hovering over what we call Lost Valley Road which is an outer road of Hwy 65. So, it drew my interest since it was just hanging over the hwy, and I rolled down my window to see if I could hear the sound of rotor blades chopping the air, but all I could hear was road and wind noise from driving 45mph.
As I approached the object, I vaguely remember a small, steady red light on the northern side, but it soon was gone as I was passing the object on its western side (and honestly, it could've been just me expecting to see a red…

summary: Brilliant light hovering over Holston Ordnance Army Ammunition Plant, then moved northeast very slowly
description: I was sitting in my living room when I noticed a very bright light towards the west. At first I thought it was Jupiter or Venus. Then I realized it was under the dark cloud layer. There was still a sliver of light on the western horizon. The object sparkled with several colors. I retrieved my binoculars, but couldn't make out the size or shape of the object. It was stationary for a while. It appeared to be over the Holston Army Ammunition Plant which is across the Holston River from my neighborhood. After a while it began slowly approaching my location. I took my binoculars and went to the front porch. Here I observed several variously-colored lights. I noted a large red light that appeared on the bottom. This bright red light was constant. As it got closer I couldn't understand what shape it was. It continued over my house and I lost sight of it. One thing that really stuck out in my mind was the absence of a anti-collision or beacon lights, which are required and strobe a brilliant white light visible for at least 20 miles. The object seemed compact and to have some thickness. The colored lights were at the edges. No noise, no trail, moved in a straight line.

summary: Light "flash" for about 30 seconds, seen by 2 state employees who confirmed the sighting to each other
description: Myself (a corrections officer for 8 years and 34 years old) and another corrections officer (4 years in corrections and 24 years old) at a prison at this approximate location, were walking to post and saw a light in the sky to the east, it appeared to fade in and fade back out with its brightest time being about 20 seconds. We both said out loud, "what is that" and it faded out. There was no obvious or visible other aircraft in the area before or after. We thought it may be the suns reflection on a plane going into or out of RIC, which is in the direction we saw the light, but nothing was visible after, as if it disappeared. We nervously joked about reporting it to our work but have both chosen not to. Both of us have good eye sight, were not tired and had good daylight to see by. We had just left our regular pre-work briefing, so I'm very sure of time and date.

summary: Two craft flying in formation with invisible abilities

After the left side craft finally became visible again they both vanished very quickly. I don't know if they became both invisible or just sped off without a trace .It was overwhelming. I Googled Texas UFO sightings and came up with a website by that actual name. There was a testimonial from a husband who saw the exact same two craft behaving the exact same way while he observed from the passenger side of his vehicle while traveling northward in Dallas, Texas. These craft are around and the problem seems to be that they can't be seen if they don't want to.

This “star” was shining brighter than anything else in the sky, other than the moon which was behind us. Over the course of a few seconds, this object dimmed its brightness until it was invisible, then a few seconds later began to brighten back to the original brightness. This occurred maybe 4 or 5 times. This light was not moving relative to the stars at this time. After the last dimming, we began to see multiple lights that looked like stars (at least 3 objects possibly 4), but they began moving in very strange ways. They appeared to be orbiting each other, then stationary, then they would move very fast across the sky and sometimes change direction rapidly. One of them dove down and disappeared on the horizon faster than anything I have ever seen or heard of. After about 20 minutes of this, we stopped seeing any more activity from that area. We had our main Flight Attendant…

summary: South south west of Orion, between Sirius and 1 hand of Orion
description: Romantic walk with my wife on our last night at our resort. I often point out Orion as I follow astronomy. Walking over the walk bridge, turned right on the walking path, I looked up and saw what I thought was 1 x satellite. Pointed it to my wife who couldn't see it. Oddly enough the dot seemed slow and accelerated and to my surprise curved and dissappeared. I stopped and froze… my wife said and I quote "sorry I didn't see your satellite, let it go and come walk". I stood there stuned and looked at her and said… I don't know how to explain but I saw something that curved, it was not a satellite. I was still looking up trying to relocate and she joined me looking up. We saw 2 dots (size like one of the Orion stars) appearing moving different directions not simultaneously then disappeared. My wife was calm but I was so excited I couldn't stand still. I was hoping to see people near us but no luck. Our cells were in the room charging so I asked people coming out of the bridge for the time, 9:47 PM was given, I deleted 3 mins as it was my expectation of the time between my sighting and asking the time. I didn't sleep all night and watched several times the sky but nothing.

I use a dedicated video recorder that degrades the image somewhat but is the best solution I’ve found for recording through a night vision device. I watch the sky often enough that I’ve become quite skilled at identifying mundane objects: primarily satellites and how they reflect the below-horizon sun. The objects I describe below and have provided video of do not appear to be reflecting the sun on as they spin and they do not follow an orbital path. summary: Saw three but only one was visible by time I got phone for picture
description: Saw 3 object flying in formation with a long streamer dangling below each one. By the time I got my phone only one was visible. Thought it may be a balloon or helicopter until I saw it instantly do a pinpoint vectored 45degree turn changing it’s heading from north to northeast. They appeared to be somewhere east of I-5 and when I first spotted them they were directly east of Green so southeast of Roseburg Oregon. They were going slow enough that the hanging streamer was swaying forward and backward in relation to its travel instead of streaming behind. Wasn’t able to take video but got one good picture.

summary: Colorless orb, flying relatively low at high speed in a straight line
description:
My daughters and I were taking a break on our bike ride and looking at two red tail hawks circling high above. The object was traveling toward us in our eye line with the birds. At first I thought it was another bird, but soon realized it was going very very fast. It is difficult to determine our distance to the object, but I could clearly see it getting closer, passing us, then continuing on toward the ocean. It seemed rather small. It made no noise and it left no contrails.
It was flying well below low hanging clouds.
The object was completely black or colorless. My daughter said it looked like a flying bowling ball.

summary: Caught it with my camera flying about 100 ft above ground level at mach 1+ yet no visible engine, no sonic boom, no contrail, no sound!
description:
I was out for a Sunday drive snapping photos of the snow on the peaks east of Santa Maria.  The snow level had recently dropped down to about 1000 ft--a rare event here. Hoping to snap better pictures, I drove about 12 miles southeast of Santa Maria to the little village of Sisquoc which offers more dramatic views of the mountains. I was looking for snowy picturesque peaks, not UFOs.
At approximately 11:40 AM (give or take 15 minutes), I had just driven east of Sisquoc and started snapping more pix. Sisquoc is at about 460 ft elevation. My guesstimate is that this craft was flying about 100 ft above the ground at an elevation of 560 ft above sea level. I guesstimate the vessel to be travelling 800-1200 MPH.
The craft had no visible engine or intake humps, no sound, no contrails, no visible lights, no markings & no tail. The craft was far too large & fast to be a drone. Also, the nose of the craft was too blunted, the "wings" too "vee'd" & the craft was too tailess to be a Stealth or an F117. I did check out "secret" prototype aircraft online to see if there was anything like it but they all had long needle noses or were otherwise too different so no match.
THE MOST ASTOUNDING…

summary: Solid lit triangle heading north northwest

Quiet., moving quickly lower than a usual plane would be over our area. Light went out after about 5 seconds while I was watching it but could faintly see it still moving but then got difficult to follow. It was moving toward where the big dipper area of sky usually is at that hour. (445am)but there were some clouds in sky as well. No blinking lights on this triangle.

After the hovering phase, the objects split into two pairs, with two of them moving to the left and the other two veering to the right. Notably, one of the objects exhibited remarkable speed, while the rest moved a bit slower. I tried to follow the one that was moving to the left but I couldn’t see more since it was moving fast and the buildings were blocking it. Also I believe they were close to the airport since a lot of planes were passing by. They weren’t airplanes or Jets since they were faster and were at higher altitudes and were hovering. That’s the last time I saw of them that day I never saw them again.

summary: Triangle shaped with energy shield or microwaves

I stood up and said, “What the F is that???!!” “WTF!!!” “Do you see that???” Wife looked up and saw it, smiled at me and said, “yup, I dunno, that was wired.” as she smiled. I’m pumped right now! description: It looked like a normal star, albeit very bright. I believe Venus was visible just above it, both were equally luminous and the same apparent size. Clouds would pass over this object and it would become much dimmer, but as the cloud moved past it would reappear (at least we believe it’s clouds, it is night so it’s kind of hard to tell). After 4-5 minutes, it had moved to a lower angle, possibly 23 degrees above the horizon or so. We went back inside, but about 20 minutes later I went back out to see it again and it was still there. The possible aura or haze that I am checking may be due to astigmatism (which both mom and I have). Also, I am saying that animals were effected. I could see what I thought was an unusually bright white star hanging in the sky. I looked up from my game a couple times just to see if it was maybe a helicopter (they had been in the area during the day to repair high power electrical lines). I remember thinking that was odd and I wondered if this was a plane or helicopter, then why were there no flashing lights? Still sitting in bed, I watched it to see if it moved. It seemed to move ever so slightly toward the NW. Realizing this was “different” (we’ve lived on the property for almost 40 years, and I’ve looked out this window in this same position in bed for over 20 years) I got up and grabbed my glasses and phone. summary: Chilling audio encounter like nothing I have ever experienced.
description: I had got up to go to the bathroom in my bedroom and laid back down. Like I usually do, I scrolled through Twitter. My bed sits in front of my large bedroom window. The curtains typically stay up open for natural light. We live near train tracks so I’m used to strange loud noises. All of a sudden I heard and felt this strange vibrational whooshing. I cannot explain it. It sounded close yet far at the same time and had a distorted talking within it. I couldn’t make out what it said. It lasted between 35-34 seconds and became so loud that it woke up my daughter who was sleeping next to me. The only thing I can say with certainty is that it sounded not of this world. In all my years I’ve never heard anything to resemble this noise. I immediately got goosebumps. It sent shivers down my spine I woke up husband up who is a very sound sleeper. The only thing I noticed when looking at the sky is that one star seemed brighter than normal. Maybe I just haven’t noticed it or there is a reasonable explanation for that component, but the sound is terrifying and unexplainable. I know it sounds crazy, but it really happened. I have to believe it was alien. I have never believed in aliens, but…

And then there was this craft, gliding almost directly overhead of the apartments I live in, at about normal passenger jet speed, except, no blinking lights, no discernable wings or shape at all. I spoke with a pilot today about it and he said two large down facing lights on a plane sounds unusual and then didn’t offer anything else to say about what it could have been. description: There was an electricity blackout from 10.30 pm until 3 am. I went out to the back yard because it was a clear night. I looked around the sky and a very bright white light caught my attention. It lasted for about one second and I thought it was an aeroplane but the light didn't flash. I looked in the direction of the light and after about 15 seconds it shone again. It was about 45 degrees up in a westerly direction. There were stars around the area but no bright ones. I wanted to see it again but nothing happened. A plane crossed the sky travelling NW, maybe on it's way to Jakarta or Malaysia. I waited until 2.05 am but did not see the bright light again. If this is the only report of this bright light then it won't be much use on its own but if others saw it, then maybe the time and position of the light will help you to judge height and location. The light came from the same position so I guess it wasn't moving. It seemed to be a long way off so I heard no sound.

summary: Light moving erratically in the sky.
description: Weird light in the sky that is blinking and moving erratically. It is moving side to side, up and down, and roughly hovering in one place the entire time. It is also moving in a circular type movement. It looks like a really bright star but it is moving all over the place and moving very fast.

summary: A single ufo sighting from kitchen window.
description: A local news agency reported on facebook that something made a flash and boom. A person responded to the post with a picture of an object they saw outside of their kitchen window. They said it hung around for 20 minutes then faded away. The person who reported no other details. I gave them your web address, but am making sure it gets reported. I am uploading a photo of the original post by the news agency and the photo the person posted. I am also uploading a close up of the photo.

summary: Bright white light orbs with green edges, very bright and rocketing very fast towards the ground west of PTK airport
description: I am a Pilot at PTK airport, been there for years and know what normal airport activity looks like. At approximately 21:00 I was on the ground and saw west of the airport white and green lights spinning and plummeting out of the sky incredibly fast. At First thinking it was a plane crashing I pointed out to the lineman next to me. After seeing it for slightly longer it was far too brightly lit, large, and moving much too fast to be any standard plane. It appeared to be plummeting to the ground and disappeared over the horizon line. ATC at the airport tower did not see it with there only being a skeleton crew left at the time. Only one plane was in the air near the airport and traveling in the opposite direction as the lights. I have been flying out of that airport for years and seen thousands of different planes and helicopters come in and out. I fly myself and have a comprehensive knowledge of aviation. That thing looked like nothing I have ever seen and I’m so baffled as to what it could be.

summary: Bluish semicircle, flying fast, making absolutely no sound
description: The UFO was flying low and fast between nimbus clouds. It was a bluish semicircle about as big as the top of my little finger nail in my field of vision, about 70 degrees above the horizon in the North-West portion of the sky. The edges of the object were difuse and it made absolutely no sound. I saw it while standing in my backyard. There was no storm activity. I am 64 years-old and this is the first time I have ever seen anything like it. I was in the USAF and am acquianted with aircraft, balloons, Starlink, but have never seen anything like this. We have no active swamps (It's now winter and dry). We're at 42 degrees, 36 minutes North and 84 degrees 7 minutes West.

summary: Two objects in sky moving north one disappeared the carried on till out of sight.
description:
1st object appeared in the West, slowly moving north. 2nd object appeared about 10 degrees to the north also moving north. The second object was at a lower altitude. The second object then disappeared The first object carried on in a north direction until disappearing out of sight.
The objects shone very brightly and looked like there was light beams shooting out of them. There was low cloud in the area no stars where visible. I watched them with my wife and a neighbour for approximately 15 minutes .
Possible sightng of Venus and Jupiter

summary: 2 bright lights seen diagonally from one another over the horizon
description:
Whilst driving from Chelmondiston to Holbrook my partner point out 2 bright star like lights very close to the horizon, as we spend a lot of time watching the stars from our countryside home we did not recognise these as stars. When pointing various star map apps at them they could not be identified as stars nor planets. (Venus could be identified to the right of these objects but not close enough to be mistaken). 1 of the objects stayed stationary whilst the lower one over the course of 45 minutes of observation slowly dropped in height towards the horizon until it was out of sight. The higher of the 2 objects as I write this report is currently still visible. I took some photos of this sighting some better than others which can be provided.
Photo conforms to positions of Venus and Jupiter that night.

summary: 3 weird lights in a row and then another 3 weird lights above those. Not moving. Just sitting. Looks like big windows in the sky.
Moon behind diffuse clouds. Not moon.
description: Looked out of blinds in a N-NW direction. about 7:15 local time. saw what I thought was full moon behind diffuse cloud cover. It had been cloudy and overcast earlier. I was closing blinds across the Western side of living room. After I thought about it--- that seemed to be a place the moon couldn't be. So- I went outside and saw nothing there. Also -- once my eyes adapted to the dark I saw that the sky was completely clear of clouds. The object was a bright round disk as big or slightly larger than a full moon--- and has the appearance of the moon behind thin clouds---- like a light with a white or grey shade over it. Brightness was similar to the full moon behind clouds as well. It was about 20 degrees above the horizon and in a N-NW direction. I suppose it could be described as an "orb"………. I stood outside for about 10 minutes but saw nothing else.

summary: A bright BRIGHT light at twilight that suddenly appeared and disappeared over the tree line about the distance of a blimp in the sky
description: Driving on Rt 66 heading East from Front Royal my husband was driving and stuttered my name, I looked up and saw a very very bright light. It was brighter than any LED and it was very unusual for the distance, luminosity, and appearance. The distance was above the tree line, like what you imagine a blimp would be as high as. Twilight was just beginning, so stars were barely out and the sky was just starting to get very dark. This was in between the mountains on the highway. The light was shaped like a circle with a sharp ring around the back or base of it with a very short tail of light behind it. It suddenly disappeared, no trail, no trace. We searched for comet or asteroid happenings, but nothing came up. We both felt the hair on the back of our necks stand up.

It was dark gray with no windows and no markings. It was not a helicopter since it has no propellers. No sound. The last time I looked back it went up further in the air a bit and then a slight tilt to its left side and then it was gone so quick.

summary: Object in the sky, flickering spectrum of colours, maintaining general position but darting back and forth impossibly fast
description:
My girl friend observed a flickering light in the sky, it was showing several different colours intermittently. The object was seemed to be saying in the same general place although it appeared far off, but was darting In different directions akin to the way a humming bird moves. It was moving far too fast and irregularly to be any conventional air craft, and was stopping with no inertia. The craft was also completely silent.
My girl friend and I observed it for about 10 minutes with no major noticeable change in behaviour. I have had a similar experience in this same location years ago, and I am beginning to think it has something to do with the Buddhist temple that has been under construction for over a decade now.
I have long suspected that the Buddhist temple, which is to be the largest in North America, and is fully funded by Chinese enterprises, may have ulterior motives. It has never been open to the public excluding a few choice showings that brought people in with Chinese coach busses.
I don’t think this was extra terrestrial, I think it was man made, and potentially related to this “temple”.

summary: Object coasted overhead in complete silence and nearly invisible.
description: Clear night with perfect visibility and little to no wind. I was letting my dogs outside one last time for the night. As I was waiting I looked up, and from the corner of my eye I saw movement in the sky. I focused my attention to the object and noticed it was flying but I could not make out any details such as shape or size until it started to pass in front of stars. This object emitted no lights or sounds. The color perfectly matched the sky and so would have been invisible had it not been moving in front of stars. This is when I could see the silouhette of a boomerang or chevron shape. The object coasted steadily in a straight line until it left my field of view. I am an avid bird watcher, skygazer and am familiar with all aircraft types including drones. I am 32 years old and have never witnessed an aerial object I couldn't identity until this incident.

summary: 2 orange fireballs flying parallel to each other then progressively fading out.

They appeared to be flickering slowly, getting dim and then bright again, but they were also going up and down slightly, almost like the were floating or bouncing on the wind... like they were dancing. Then the one to my right dimmed and went out completely. After maybe 15 more seconds the other dimmed and went out. Since it was late at night and the sky was dark I could not tell if there were any objects in the sky after their lights went out. They were not aircraft, because there were no other lights or even a craft seen. There was also no sound. They did not behave like flares or skydivers with flares. They were not falling, but flying straight ahead, keeping the same altitude and same rate of speed.

summary: A string of evenly spaced lights, like Japanese lanterns, traveling in a stream across the northern sky, west to east.

I went outside to gather kindling and looked up at the sky as usual. In the northern sky, I noticed a string of evenly spaced lights traveling across the sky from west to east. The lights were orbs, somewhat dim, perhaps due to light pollution, and were going across the sky as if pulled along by a string, like a trail of lights moving across the sky. I ran inside and called my husband out. They were still there when he came to look. He stayed outslde, and I ran inside to grab my phone to film it. By the time I returned, they were gone. My husband reports that they just faded and then disappeared.
It was already dark at night. The sky was clear at the time and several stars were out. There did seem to be a dim line connecting the lights, but I couldn't be sure. I can't actually say how many there were because there were so many going across the sky, single-file. The orbs were white light all shaped and sized the same.
My husband and I live in a rural area alongside a river. Many cows and fields around. The lights came from the direction of a ridge in the northwest that borders our skyline. There was no sound associated with the objects. I am a writer/artist. My husband is a retired…

summary: Something in the sky appeared to be falling straight downward.
description:
About 5:40 PM my 11-year-old son and I were driving on route 212 from Saugerties New York, to Woodstock, New York. It was twilight. Roughly halfway there, I saw something in the sky in front of me (south/southwest). It was in the distance. It was a perfectly straight column of white smoke or vapor, like a thick contrail, with darker gray at the bottom. It looked perpendicular to the ground. To both my son and me, it looked like something was falling out of the sky, straight downward. It was not falling quickly, or in an arc, like a meteorite. We were able to see it for a couple of minutes before the road made a turn, and I lost sight of it. Neither of us saw it again, although we did see the empty sky where it should’ve been. A bright star or planet appeared there.
My son, and I were both very struck by how strange it was, and how unlike anything we had seen before. As we arrived in Woodstock, we both saw two trails at angles to each other that appeared to be airplanes. They might have just been regular airplanes, but it’s not often that you see two together in the sky over Woodstock.
When I got home, I posted a description of the experience on Facebook. A friend who lives in the…

I called the non emergency police department phone line on Thursday, Feb. 16, curious if anyone else reported it, but no one did.

summary: Large straight line formation from western horizon rapidly dimming out after passing overhead.
description:
While observing Venus and Jupiter, a point of light was seen 30-45 degrees to the North of Venus rising from the horizon. At about 30 degrees it appeared to be a well-lit contrail though the sun was well below the horizon . At 45 degrees, it became evident it was a straight-line formation of 18 or more white lights spaced at irregular intervals. At 60 degrees overhead, the lights brightened to the intensity of Venus and appeared to be made up of both points and rectangular lights. The formation was longer than the space between thumb and index finger of an outstretched arm. No aircraft navigation lights were seen, and no noise was detected. After continuing eastward, the lights rapidly dimmed out. No clouds were detected in the sky. Video was captured by other witnesses several miles away and both sightings were reported to the local Sheriff’s Department.
In my opinion, given the size of the formation, the intensity of the lights, complete absence of sound, and lack of navigation lights, it is unlikely the formation was that of a commercial aircraft.
Likley Starlink

summary: Every 30 seconds a star-like object appeared and moved down a couple of degrees and disappeared. This was repeated 5 or so times.
description:
Sighting details:
Today, Feb. 10, 2023, I was outside from 4:50 to 4:55 am local time. The sky was clear, no clouds, the moon was bright.
Over the course of two or three minutes, I saw star-like objects move about one or two degrees down toward the star Ras al hague a.k.a. 55 Oph located at 17h 34m 55.4s/+40d 10m J2000.0 according to my Stellarium app. They appeared and disappeared one at a time. They had no discernable shape, though my impression is that they seemed a bit fatter than stars.
One of the objects looked like a fairly bright star, brighter than 55 Oph and not as bright as Vega. It was white. It appeared, descended, and disappeared in about one second. It seemed to move slower than a meteor.
After about 30 seconds, another object repeated the same sequence in the same location on the sky.
I waited after for a couple of minutes after seeing 5 or 6 repetitions, but did not see any more during that time. I went back inside the house.
Background: I am a retired Math and Science professor. I taught at a college in Boston. I am frequently out before dawn for a few minutes to look for shooting stars, satellites, planes, etc.

I expected to see some kind of outline of a helicopter and waited for some noise, but nothing was presented. Total silence, which is what really made me take pause. The sphere then ascended, its movement more like floating rather than something propelled. As it rose, it seemed to lengthen out, the orange ball became more stretched out into a ovular shape. At this point, it stopped moving for about ten seconds then the orange light went out from the front to the back and was replaced with a fuzzy whitish blue. It popped, or split in half, the orange light returned for the front with a kind of fuzz or blur with it, and remained still, while the other light, the back part, took off away from where it had been…

At first I thought there was a black spot on the screen and touched it to wipe it off. Then I realized it was a black object between me and the Moon. I had the camera set on infinity, I got a very sharp image. It was cubicle, reminded me of our Moon landing vehicle back in the 60s except without legs. This object appeared to me to be in our atmosphere, probably the altitude of an airliner, and as large.
It was moving upward at about a 75 degree angle. It was moving too slow to be an airliner, (which I have seen cross the Moon several times), and too steep a climb for a helicopter. I snapped the shutter, however I have a 3 second delay to allow the camera to settle, and by the time it snapped the object had passed into the darkness at about 2 o'clock.
I am submitting a photo I took that night. I used a photo editor to insert the little black box to indicate the size of this…

Not calling attention to it amd not wanting to look a bit nutty I just silently took a break and watched it for 30-60 seconds (not sure if it was more or less). It went directly over the moon and down towards the mountains before I lost track of it. This was a few days before all the balloon craziness started and I'd briefly wondered if it was related but the track it took was by and large opposite the direction that had gone. I'm really kicking myself now for not saying something to someone or pulling my phone out because it would have definitely helped me validate it in my mind a little better.

summary: Something like drone
Unexplained movement of one object and 40 or so more objects.
description:
On Monday January 30 2023 about 9:15pm I went out to get mail and decided to look up to the sky. It was a bright clear night. The moon was about 3/4 full and was on the western side of sky. There was nothing to see by the naked eye except Orions Belt and what I thought was the Northern Star.
The white round object that I thought was the northern star started moving not fast not slow towards me. I froze and watched. Then object stopped when a plane flew by for final approach to land. When the plane was gone, the white object moved back to its original spot and then a red light and blue light appeared on right side of object. Now where there was hardly anything in the sky before there was now 40 or 50 white round objects formed very close to each other and each object had a red light and blue light appear on right side. This cluster of objects were opposite the one white object that had earlier moved across the sky. I could not reason this out in my mind about what I was seeing. So I went inside and didn’t think to tell my husband about it till Tuesday night January 3, 2023. By telling him what I saw, I realized I really did see unusual activity in the sky.

summary: I rushed outside to check if it was a drone or an airplane but it was gone.

A few minutes after I noticed the fountain in the lake behind my home was off but no idea if there's a connection.
I would just like to know how many others saw the same thing.

I drove off so not sure how long it remained. I haven’t seen it since.

summary: Bright shimmering triangle-shaped craft in the northwestern sky.
description:
The craft was in the northwestern sky above the tree line, as I was heading home from work. It was visible for about half a minute, and looked as if it was stationary, or moving very slowly. The shape of the object looked like a triangle, with the right side being longer in length than the left. The craft was moving slowly, and I lost sight of it as soon as I cleared the trees onto Snelling Avenue. I would put it at between 10-20,000 feet in the air, and it was brightly shining against the sun. The craft was not visible once I broke the trees. I was trying to film it with my phone camera but could not keep the camera steady as I was driving northbound. I later reviewed the footage and did not see the UFO on the camera. It may have disappeared by the time I started filming.
The color of the craft matched the sun flare off of it, however the shape of the craft told me something was different. A few minutes prior to this, I heard what sounded like a jet liner going west to east, probably landing at Minneapolis/St. Paul International. The sound of the jet passing over was too low to be this object.

Initially, saw a bright orb and observed it for several minutes. The single source changed color to a more white, then broke into 4 distinct irregular shapes (elongated) of blue-white light. This lasted only for a minute or two. The elongated shapes disappeared, and the central object then reappeared, but was not nearly as bright. Observed it for another few minutes, but then the object dimmed out and disappeared.

summary: The object hovered in place changing from a teardrop shape to triangle to flying saucer shape. It tilted at an angle of 45 degrees
description: I first noticed the UFO hovering in the western sky while at the McDonald's drive through. I returned home to watch it still hovering in the sky. I began to photograph the object and each photo showed a seemingly shape-shifting from a tear drop shape, to triangular shape and then to a more permanent flying saucer shape that hovered in the sky. In some pictures there appeared be cloud ejection at right angles to the flying saucer shape. At one point it appeared twist like a half of an infinity sign. I believe that this craft is capable of interdimensional travel as it appeared to enter into what we know is the 3 dimensional space and at one point it appeared to hide behind the cloak of our space-time, yet parts of the vessel was hidden in the other parallel dimensions. I called North Bend Police department and an officer arrived. He witnessed the object and can confirm he saw the object. Later, I spotted another similar sized UFO in the eastern sky simultaneous as the other one hovered off the coast of southern Oregon.

summary: Glowing orb approached aircraft spotted from Porter Airlines flight from Toronto-Newark
description:
I was on a Porter Airlines flight PD2141 from Toronto to Newark, it was descending, only a few minutes from landing. The time was 7pm EST. The city was passing by below.
Out of my right side window, I saw an orb of yellow light approach the aircraft from the back-right side. At first I thought it was some kind of distortion through the plexiglass mirror of another aircraft or helicopter, but it was clearly an orb. With regard to is size, either it was larger and further away, or it was smaller and closer to the plane -- I am unsure. But I saw it again the backdrop of the moving city lights below, which is how I got a sense of its relative distance and movement in relation to our aircraft.
It looked very similar to what was filmed in this YouTube video of a separate incident: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mUBFjz1os5c 
After a minute or so, it passed out my field of view, toward the back of the aircraft. I do not know if anyone else saw it. It was quite terrifying.
I contacted the airline after to see if the pilots reported anything.

We do not have any background in spotting UFOs. So not sure if they were drones or UFOs but there maybe some military details on if they were UFOs.
In the videos you will see them as emerging round balls coming in and out of focus throughout the video. Difficult to count how many because there were several but all were not visible at one time and their movements prevented our ability to count them. summary: 2 pale orange circles moving next to eachother but not in sync
description: My brother and myself were outside with his 15x telescope trying to view the comet, after being outside for about 30-45 minutes looking at all the stars, constellations & planets, he brought to my attention what he perceived to be a UFO over Orion's belt. This was near an airport so we are very familiar with different types of aircrafts as we have seen a few different ones fly over us that night. It started over Orions Belt, it appeared to be 2 faint orange circles, not moving in sync with eachother but still being next to eachother, so it seemed to be 2 separate objects. We watched for about 10-15 seconds of them moving through the sky then suddenly vanish, not behind any trees and there were no clouds in the sky that night. It was unlike any other celestial object or aircraft we've ever seen, it also made absolutely zero noise. It was almost like seeing a very distant glow of yellow/orange headlights with the circular shape, again not moving at the same speed, one kind of trailing behind the other, slowing and speeding up at different intervals so it must have been 2 separate objects.

After observing for 10-15 seconds I ran into the house to fetch my camera with zoom lens. When I came back out the object was now definitely moving South into the Orion consellation and I managed to get one shot off on autofocus setting, but before I could re-adjust for a sharper image the object faded as if a booster burned out.
Checked launch schedule from Vandenberg SFB but next Space X launch not scheduled until today or tomorrow; in addition, I have seen many launches from Vandenberg and they are always about 30 degrees from the Western horizon. ISS was over New York that night and the color seemed wrong as well for ISS. Apologies for not getting a sharper photo.
Thank you.

The outer ring looked like it was on fire and or pulsating and not as clearly defined as the white inner circle. It was very large in comparison to the airplanes in the further background. I grabbed my phone and looked down for a second to click on the camera to record it, and when I looked up to recorded it, it was gone. Totally disappeared and was no where in the sky to be found. I have always been interested in what is beyond the stars, so if there is any other information from someone else reporting this object, I would like to hear about it as well. Thank you for listening.

summary: Huge flying circle object, w/ beautiful colorful trickling lights flying impossibly fast, then took a 90 degree turn into the clouds.
description:
So last night around 10:30 I was outside walking some little ones and saw a huge flying circle object, with beautiful colorful lights flying impossibly fast, heading north from DT Bellevue. It appeared to be flying north and then did this insane 90 degree turn into the clouds.
So this happened while I was in Kirkland, north of / very close to the water. It WAS definitely cloudy but not directly over Kirkland, the clouds appeared to be further away like over Bellevue.
The whole incident lasted probably 8 to 10 seconds and then it was gone.
Again, taking into consideration the distance it appeared to be and relevant buildings and homes below it, it would have had to have been incredibly large, like 150 feet across kind of thing. The lights were like a flowing trickling effect, coming out from the center of the object to the edges and it was ALL different colors, beautiful colors. In fact the ONLY thing I could see were the lights and its shape, otherwise it was too dark to see the actual object itself.
And the object was completely round, meaning, not flying saucer round but like an actual upright circle flying towards my general direction.

summary: Gazing up at the full moon. Clear night. 5 or 6 large long triangles with red lights at the ends. I thought they were satellites.

The Strange thing about my story is that the next day I was driving to Hilton Head, SC and I found a photo on my phone. I don’t remember taking. I think they were following me. It freaks me out.

summary: Large aircraft displaying three blinking lights approx 500 feet above ground noiseless stopped briefly while moving slowly (10-15 mph)
description:
I was outside on the back porch of my mountain cabin next to a fire pit when I noticed some lights seemingly stationary behind the trees but high in the air about 1/2 mile away. There are no towers or tall buildings in the area. As I watched I realized the lights were part of an arrangement of three bright flashing lights affixed to a single object. The lights were moving slowly right to left in a northwest direction along the ridge line. They remained about 300-500 feet above the ground, slowing to a near stop briefly and then continuing. There was no sound. The object slowly disappeared behind the mountain top. I was able to capture it on video.
This is a second home. I am 53, male, live full time in Atlanta, a licensed attorney and former FBI Agent. I have never seen anything like this before.

summary: A very bright light was idle in the sky, 2 seconds later it shot downwards at lightning speed.

We later met up with our friends and described the event, which they saw too, in the North sky. They also said that they saw a tennis sized cloudy bubble floating in the intersection. It didn't seem to be affected by the wind, and was hovering in the intersection. They described it as cloudy or milky. All of these sightings occured between 8:05 and 8:10 PM last night in Fort Collins Colorado.

Jet seemed to spot it again over the tree line and turned sharply to follow leaving an angled contrail in the sky. Object was heading west ward. summary: I saw a bright light that looked metallic in mid-day float straight then disappear.
description:
I was sitting on a bench at the waters edge of downtown Benicia enjoying my coffee and muffin before work. I was looking south-bound towards port costa and what caught my eye was this shimmer of something metallic moving very still and straight east-bound. The objects reflection got brighter and my eyes lost focus because I was also facing the sun and could no longer see it or where it went. My immediate reaction was to dismiss it as a small airplane that caught reflection off the sun and then I lost focus of it. That's when I noticed 3 airplanes that I could positively identify as such at much further distances emitting chem trails. One plane was traveling the exact same course as said unidentified object except my eyes didn't lose focus of it despite the sun and was not reflecting sunlight either. The movement of the object was way to still, straight and ominous to be a plane.
Why would I even witness a reflection if the object was between myself and the sun? the light would reflect south and not north in my direction and why did it disappear after it got to its brightest point and in mid-day? What the hell did I witness?

summary: Two non-blinking lights with a distance between them the same as the length of the big dipper.
description: I saw what I thought was the international space station but it was slightly less bright. I've seen the ISS many times. Then I noticed another dimmer light in front of it that appeared to be leading it. I thought it was star link but there were only 2 lights with nothing visible in between them. The lights were as far apart as the big dipper is long. I checked the ISS flyover times and none were scheduled at that time. I have seen other satellites before but never one following another. They never blinked and they were traveling from north to south. I also saw this same event 5-8 weeks before this but I don't remember the date. I do know I saw that at 5:40 AM when I saw it and it was traveling from northwest to southeast. During both these events it was dark and the stars were bright.

summary: Star sized flickering object at satellite height, moving erratically at speed of a plane, then stopping dead and remaining still.
description:
I went out into my back yard at approximately 5:30 am while waiting for my coffee to brew and saw an aircraft above flying in from the SSW. Nothing unusual there. I then took a gander at the stars and noticed one was moving, coming from the southeast. Not quickly but slowly, at the speed of a plane, and it was flickering, if not blinking, but with only white lights. I thought it was too high for a plane so I figured it might be a satellite. So I continued to watch it and after about five seconds it momentarily stopped, made a small looping movement off course to the southwest and then back on course, continued for a moment, then made a straight movement to the southwest again, returned to its original course and then stopped dead and remained still. I watched for another minute or so, but it didn't move, so I went back inside.
It covered two inches of sky I'd say and the side movements an eighth of an inch.

summary: Over 30 min, observed a starlike object, moving rapidly in the vertical, and horizontal, varying intensity, for 5-10 seconds each time.
description:
Delta 8934 MIA-MSY, B757, flight level 380, we began to observe a small, point-light object moving rapidly in the vertical and horizontal. The sighting was towards our 11 o’clock and we were headed due West, over the Gulf of Mexico, offshore from KSRQ, approximately between BAGGS and REMIS waypoints.
It was a very dark night, and we had the lighting as dim as possible in order to help us detect thunderstorm build ups over the Gulf. The object appeared intermittently over about 30 minutes, and would vary in brightness intensity. Sometimes the object glowed very bright, much brighter than a typical planet. Then it would fade to a dim point, and accelerate in various directions, unlike most aircraft I’ve ever seen, including military fighter aircraft I have flown. It would appear for about 5-10 seconds each time. We observed it illuminate, and then accelerate rapidly straight down. It illuminated, and went pure vertical. It got very bright, then dim, and accelerated horizontally, and continued into an arcing zoom climb before fading out. A nearby shooting star occurred, which looked very distinct from this phenomena. Various iterations of these maneuvers occurred and the sighting was…

My husband pulled over and I opened the window and pointed to it so it was no reflection…. Was still in the sky as we pulled in, but off in the distance.

summary: Sharp cutout in heavy cloud layer, stayed static and lines very defined before clouds immediately recondensed.
description: Football pitch sized (approximate) sized cutout opened in the dense clouds at night, moon visible through this hole. The edges of the clouds were sharp and the shape was distinctly symmetrical down the length of the would-be object. This was directly over Lunken Field in Cincinnati, Ohio. Four to five minutes elapsed, and the cloud volume swirled back into place rapidly. There was apparent cloud movement in the lower atmosphere that night, and this punch-out stayed perfectly still during the duration it was there. I have not seen any online live-feed or Artemis cameras from that night that would be facing directly upward or have that portion of the sky in their field of view. Local AM radio was not being received by my vehicle at the time this occurred, then was clear when switched back on after returning to car.

They were followed by a second formation of 5 additional objects (lights) perhaps 5 to 10 seconds behind the first formation, flying at a similar speed and in the same northeast direction. Also with one orange light each, with no navigation or anti collision lights visible on any of the group in the second formation. There was no sound from any of the objects in either formation, either during or afterwards. The shape or outline could not be determined in the short time both formations were visible (about 30 seconds, plus or…

I want to add something about myself. I have always been able to detect when I am being watched. No matter the distance or situation. My fiancée says it’s my Native American DNA at work, but while on the playground I always would have the overwhelming feeling of being watched. Perhaps this is the reason only I seem to notice the sphere.
I never mentioned this to any co-workers. It seems the sphere would always appear at the same time in the same location.  I had playground duty Tuesday and Thursday. Sometimes I saw it on Tuesday and sometimes on Thursday. Never on both days in one week.  Taking a photo or video was extremely problematic. The sphere seemed to almost react to me raising cell phone at it by…

summary: Visually observed Delta shape over the foothills adjacent to Stillhouse Lake, Texas - just south of Killeen / Harker Heights
description:
Around 10 P.M., we drove to a small lakeside park - by Stillhouse Hollow Lake, in the foothills- just adjacent to the 3481 Stillhouse Lake Bridge.
After approximately an hour, we decided to call it a night - and head back to my place.
On the drive south - I looked out of the passenger window (facing west) and commented that a nearby 'cloud' was oddly delta-shaped. After a few minutes, we decided to pull over to the shoulder of the road and take a better look. At 11 p.m., the driver, Ryan Keaton, jumped out of the truck to snap a few pictures with his cellphone.
We could not believe what was photographed. Afterward, we continued to drive back home, I looked in the rearview mirror - and at first, thought the hills were on fire. After closer inspection, I realized that the 'fire' was up in the sky above the mountains, and in the shape of a giant triangle. It was quickly descending. Ryan then saw it too. We then turned the truck around - hoping to find a good place to snap more images. Unfortunately, the thing fell below the hills - and we didn't see it again. But luckily - we did have the first sighting images. They are posted in chronological order. They are not as dramatic as what…

Our car has a dash cam so as soon as I got home, I uploaded the footage and sure enough it captured it. I also noticed a 4th, dimmer light in the footage that moved insanely fast, turned sharply down, and stopped, but it stayed lit up when the others disappeared. I thought the 4th light was a meteor at first, except it didn't fade away.
I've attached the video and a map of where we were and what direction we saw the lights.

description: This morning saw two bright lights in the sky about half a mile to a mile apart from one another. They also didn’t look too high up. The first one I saw was in front of me on Derry Road facing North West, in the same location from my last report. At first, I thought it was a plane until I noticed it wasn’t moving. I didn’t think much of it until I turned onto church road, now facing North, and noticed another one in the sky about a mile down the road, and it wasn’t moving. Fortunately, I was able to get a couple pictures of the second one while sitting at a light. When I turned my focus back to the road, a minute or two later I looked back in the same spot the light was at and it was no longer in the sky. A couple minutes later I got to work, pulled out my radar app, and there wasn’t any commercial planes in the sky in the area. The only ones were one I saw in the sky that was thousands of feet high and one facing south that was going west. While I was at work, I get a message from my friend who he claimed to have seen a bright metallic object in the sky hours after my encounter.

location: Great Smokies National Park, NC, USA
summary: Massive, moving behind ridgeline
description: Driving from Tennessee toward Cherokee, on a cloudless, sunny afternoon through Great Smokies National Park. I caught a flash of reflective light and looked out my driverside window toward the ridgeline. I was shocked to see a massive, silver metal clad object that appeared to be tracking with me in the same direction. It disappeared behind the mountain, and then reappeared as the ridgeline dipped and then disappeared again behind the next peak. I pulled over on the opposite side of the road, very shaken. My first thought was a jumbo jet was crashing, but then it didn't make sense in my mind. It should have made a noise, but nothing. It should have reappeared on the other side of the peak, but nothing. I did not see the leading edge or the trailing edge, no wings, windows or markings. It wasn't smooth but I can't say what the texture was I observed, only an impression of louvered panels maybe? The sight only lasted a few seconds. Those mountains are at an elevation of about 4500 feet. It was very low, the object was massive, as long as a foot ball field at least. I am an air force veteran, and I have never seen anything fly like this.

With the naked eye, the object was about a quarter inch in diameter. It wasn’t the typical lights of an aircraft. It was stationary, so I got my small camera and tried to zoom in on the object. While snapping pictures, I saw blue, and then blue and orange, and after that, purple (see photos). The object wasn’t high enough in the sky to be a star but too high to be an attachment to a tower. There were airplanes coming toward me to eventually land in a Baltimore airport, but this was much higher than they were. I am curious to find out if this is manmade or otherwise.
